about: every declaration of the background library (Lib) that the argument (New) uses by name, classified as definition / elementary / named / substantial

declarations.name: Filling.besselCharMatrix
declarations.says: The chain matrix C of T: the matrix for which tr(Cu) = σ(u) + conj σ(u⁻¹) on isometries u, where σ(u) = ∑ u_{j,j+1} on the frame.

declarations.name: Filling.big_cell_unique
declarations.says: Uniqueness in the big cell: if v₁(w_pσ)v₂⁻¹ = w₁(w_qσ′)w₂⁻¹ with v_i, w_i in 𝖴, then p = q (on the first ϱ entries) and the pairs agree.

declarations.name: Filling.coe_weylElem_mul
declarations.says: The matrix of w_pσ in block form: the Weyl element exchanges e_a and e*_a with coefficients p_a and 1/p̄_a, and σ acts on the middle block.

declarations.name: Filling.exists_big_cell_decomp
declarations.says: Bruhat's big cell: over a field with involution and an element of trace 1, if all leading minors of Z(γ) are nonzero, then γ = u⁻¹w_pσu' with u, u' in 𝖴, w_p a Weyl element of length ϱ and σ in U(X₀ ⊕ Az).
declarations.reference: Bruhat decomposition, the open (big) cell of a unitary group characterised by non-zero leading minors (A. Knapp, Lie Groups Beyond an Introduction; S. Helgason, Groups and Geometric Analysis, Ch. I §5)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for the unitary group of the proof's frame over a field with involution containing an element of trace 1: γ = u⁻¹w_pσu′ with u, u′ in 𝖴, w_p a Weyl element of length ϱ and σ in U(X₀ ⊕ Az), when all leading minors of Z(γ) are non-zero. REFERENCES.md: Knapp place confirmed at second hand, but no place is given in the header.

declarations.name: Filling.frameGram_weylElem_mul
declarations.says: The frame Gram matrix of w_pσ is diagonal with entries p_a and the top entry of the frame Gram matrix of σ.

declarations.name: Filling.simpleRootSum_inv
declarations.says: For u in the Bessel subgroup 𝖲, the simple-root sum of u⁻¹ is minus that of u.

declarations.name: Filling.trace_besselCharMatrix_mul
declarations.says: tr(C·u) = σ(u) + conj σ(u⁻¹), with σ the simple-root sum and C the chain matrix.

declarations.name: FloorPairs
declarations.says: The index set of the hyperbolic pairs of the chart of V_b other than the first: the m further pairs of V_ϱ and the pairs (e_a, e*_a), a > b.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis
declarations.says: A volume-preserving basis of V_ϱ = X₀ ⊕ Az made of m+1 hyperbolic pairs and an orthonormal part indexed by ι.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.floorBasis
declarations.says: The matrix whose columns are the basis of V_b formed by the given basis of V_ϱ and the pairs e_a, e*_a with a > b.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.floorQuadric
declarations.says: The measure δ^(b) on the quadric h(v, v) = h(f_{b+1}, f_{b+1}) in V_b: the flat chart measure Place.quadricMeasure carried over by the basis of V_b.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.gram_floorBasis
declarations.says: The floor basis is a hyperbolic basis: its Gram matrix for the split form is a sum of standard hyperbolic planes.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.isDisintegration_floorVolume
declarations.says: The floor volume disintegrates along the quadrics h(v, v) = const into the measures δ^(b) on the quadrics.
declarations.note: coarea (disintegration) of Lebesgue measure along a hermitian form, in the floor basis.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.map_floorBasis_volume
declarations.says: The floor basis carries Lebesgue measure to the floor volume.

declarations.name: HyperbolicBasis.measurePreserving_mulVec
declarations.says: The linear map v ↦ Ev given by the matrix E of a basis HyperbolicBasis of V_ϱ preserves volume.

declarations.name: IsL2Contraction
declarations.says: The L² bound ∫ ∑ᵢ |∫ φ(y) kᵢ(x, y) dμ(y)|² dm(x) ≤ ∫ |φ|² dn holds for every bounded measurable φ : Y → ℂ.

declarations.name: IsL2Contraction.pi
declarations.says: L² bounds of integral operators multiply: if finitely many measurable kernels k_v, integrable in y, satisfy IsL2Contraction for σ-finite measures, so do the product kernels ∏_v k_v(x_v, y_v) for the product measures.
declarations.note: Fubini and Cauchy–Schwarz (19 lines).

declarations.name: Place.heisenbergMeasure
declarations.says: The measure η_l on the unitary group: for l < ϱ the image of dv dβ on V_{l+1} × A⁻ under (v, β) ↦ ν(v, β), otherwise the unit mass at 1.

declarations.name: Place.plancherel_inequality
declarations.says: Plancherel's inequality at a place: for a unit η and f measurable and integrable on A^ι, ∫ |∫ ψ(η v*w) f(w) dw|² dv ≤ (c/md η)^{|ι|} ∫ |f|².
declarations.reference: the Plancherel theorem for a local field (J. Tate, Fourier analysis in number fields and Hecke's zeta-functions, 1950, §2)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: an inequality with the explicit constant (c/md η)^{|ι|} for the Fourier transform with kernel ψ(η v*w) on A^ι, at an abstract place, instead of the isometry for self-dual measures (30 lines).

declarations.name: Place.weylLaw
declarations.says: The law of w_l(c)⁻¹, w_l(c) the Weyl element of floor l, when c in A has the measure md(c)^{d_l} dc, d_l = |κ| + 1 + 2(ϱ − l − 1).

declarations.name: TraceOne.heisenbergElem
declarations.says: The isometry ν(v, β) of floor a: the Eichler transformation with e*_{a+1} ↦ e*_{a+1} + v + (β − τh(v,v))e_{a+1}, for β skew and v projected to V_{a+1}.

declarations.name: ae_ascConv_mem_unipotentBelow
declarations.says: Almost every point of the ascending convolution of the Heisenberg measures of the floors below j lies in 𝒩_{<j}.

declarations.name: ae_descConv_mem
declarations.says: If each σ_l is concentrated on the group G_l, so is their descending convolution.

declarations.name: ae_mem_floorUnipotent
declarations.says: The Heisenberg measure of floor l is concentrated on 𝒩_l.

declarations.name: ae_mem_mconv
declarations.says: A convolution of two measures concentrated on a measurable subgroup S is concentrated on S.

declarations.name: ascConv
declarations.says: For measures σ_l on a group, the convolution σ_0 ∗ ⋯ ∗ σ_{j−1} in ascending order; the Dirac measure at 1 if j = 0.

declarations.name: ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_dirac_comm
declarations.says: Dirac measures at s in H_j commute with the ascending convolution of the Heisenberg measures up to j.

declarations.name: ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_invariant
declarations.says: The ascending convolution of the Heisenberg measures up to j is invariant under left and right translation by 𝒩_{<j}.

declarations.name: ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_succ
declarations.says: The ascending convolution up to j + 1 is the Heisenberg measure of floor j convolved with the convolution up to j.

declarations.name: besselS_le_normalizer_besselU0
declarations.says: If the Gram matrix of the whole space is hermitian and invertible, the Bessel subgroup 𝖲 of the unitary group normalises the subgroup 𝖴⁰ of elements of 𝖴 fixing the frame.

declarations.name: continuousAt_unitOrOne
declarations.says: The map sending c to c as a unit (and non-units to 1) is continuous at units, when the units are open.

declarations.name: descConv
declarations.says: For measures σ_l on a group, the convolution σ_{a+i−1} ∗ ⋯ ∗ σ_a in descending order of i consecutive terms; the Dirac measure at 1 if i = 0.

declarations.name: descConv_add
declarations.says: Descending convolutions split: the convolution of i + j consecutive measures is the convolution of the last j with the first i.

declarations.name: descConv_succ
declarations.says: descConv σ 0 (i+1) = σ_i ∗ descConv σ 0 i.

declarations.name: dirac_mconv_heisenbergMeasure_comm
declarations.says: Dirac measures at s in H_{l+1} commute with the Heisenberg measure of floor l.

declarations.name: enorm_toReal_smul_le
declarations.says: ‖x·v‖ ≤ x‖v‖ for x in [0, ∞] and v in a normed space (extended norms).

declarations.name: exists_eq_heisenbergElem_of_mem
declarations.says: For a < ϱ, every element of 𝒩_a is a Heisenberg element ν(v, β) of floor a.

declarations.name: exists_factor_orbitPoint
declarations.says: A measurable function on H_b invariant on the left under Q_{b+1} ∩ H_b factors measurably through the orbit point σ ↦ σ⁻¹f_{b+1}.

declarations.name: exists_floorGroup_mul_floorUnipotent
declarations.says: Every s in Q_{l+1} ∩ H_l factors as gν with g in H_{l+1} and ν in 𝒩_l.

declarations.name: exists_floorGroup_mul_unipotentBelow
declarations.says: Every s in Q_j factors as γν with γ in H_j and ν in 𝒩_{<j}.

declarations.name: exists_ne_zero_of_ae
declarations.says: If p holds almost everywhere and ∫f ≠ 0, then p(x) and f(x) ≠ 0 for some x.

declarations.name: floorVolume
declarations.says: The Haar measure of V_l, as a measure on V: the image of the volume on the coordinates of floor at least l under the inclusion.

declarations.name: gram_inclMatrix
declarations.says: The Gram matrix of the inclusion of a subset of coordinates is the corresponding submatrix: (inclMatrix g)ᴴ J (inclMatrix g) = J restricted to g × g.

declarations.name: heisenbergElem_inv
declarations.says: The inverse of the Heisenberg element ν(v, β) is ν(−v, β′) with β′ the explicit skew correction.

declarations.name: heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent
declarations.says: Every Heisenberg element ν(v, β) of floor a < ϱ lies in the group 𝒩_a = H_a ∩ 𝒩_{<a+1}.

declarations.name: heisenbergElem_mul
declarations.says: Heisenberg elements multiply by the Heisenberg group law: ν(p)ν(q) = ν(p₁ + q₁, p₂ + q₂ + skew part of the cross term).

declarations.name: heisenbergElem_mulVec
declarations.says: The action of the Heisenberg element ν(v, β) on a vector, by the Eichler formula.

declarations.name: heisenbergMeasure_eq_dirac_one
declarations.says: For l ≥ ϱ the Heisenberg measure of floor l is the Dirac measure at 1.

declarations.name: heisenbergMeasure_mconv_dirac
declarations.says: The Heisenberg measure of floor l is invariant under left and right translation by 𝒩_l.

declarations.name: integrable_toReal_smul
declarations.says: If φ is measurable, F a.e. strongly measurable, and ∫φ‖F‖ < ∞, then y ↦ φ(y)F(y) is integrable (φ real-valued from [0, ∞)).

declarations.name: lintegral_dirac_mconv
declarations.says: ∫ f d(δ_s ∗ μ) = ∫ f(sx) dμ(x).

declarations.name: lintegral_eq_of_dirac_mconv_eq
declarations.says: If δ_s ∗ μ = μ ∗ δ_t, then ∫ f dμ = ∫ f(s⁻¹xt) dμ(x).

declarations.name: lintegral_mconv_dirac
declarations.says: ∫ f d(μ ∗ δ_s) = ∫ f(xs) dμ(x).

declarations.name: lintegral_mconv_symm
declarations.says: ∫ f d(μ ∗ ν) = ∫∫ f(xy) dμ(x) dν(y) for measurable f ≥ 0.

declarations.name: lintegral_pi_prod
declarations.says: Tonelli's theorem for finite products: for σ-finite measures μ_i on nonempty spaces and measurable [0, ∞]-valued functions f_i, the integral of x ↦ ∏ f_i(x_i) against the product measure is the product of the integrals of the f_i.
declarations.reference: Tonelli's theorem

declarations.name: map_inclMatrix_eq_floorVolume
declarations.says: The inclusion of the coordinates of floors ≥ l carries Lebesgue measure to the floor volume.

declarations.name: mconv_apply_eq_lintegral
declarations.says: (μ ∗ ν)(Y) = ∫ μ{x : xy ∈ Y} dν(y) for measurable Y.

declarations.name: mconv_comm_of_ae
declarations.says: If δ_s commutes with ν for μ-almost every s, then μ ∗ ν = ν ∗ μ.

declarations.name: measurableSet_floorGroup
declarations.says: The floor groups H_l are measurable subsets of the unitary group.

declarations.name: measurable_unitary_of_coe
declarations.says: A map into the unitary group is measurable when its matrix is measurable.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_floor_block_mulVec
declarations.says: For s in H_l, multiplication by the floor block of s preserves volume.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_shuffle_coords
declarations.says: For ζ s-finite, the regrouping (((t, x), w), (y, z)) ↦ ((t, (x, w, y)), z), with t in A, x, y in A^n, w in A^ι, preserves the products of volumes and ζ.
declarations.note: regrouping of coordinates preserves products of volumes.

declarations.name: mul_heisenbergElem
declarations.says: For s in H_{a+1}, s·ν(v, β) = ν(s v, β)·s.

declarations.name: padTuple
declarations.says: The sequence indexed by ℕ that is the tuple c at indices below n, t at index n, and 1 at indices above n.

declarations.name: simpleRootSum_conj_heisenbergElem
declarations.says: For s in H_{a+1} and v in V_{a+1}, the sum of the entries just above the diagonal of the frame block of sν(v, β)s⁻¹ equals −h(v, s⁻¹f_{a+2}).

declarations.name: unipotentBelow_induction
declarations.says: Induction on the groups 𝒩_{<j}, for a hermitian invertible Gram matrix: if C 0 1 holds, and C j ν implies C (j+1) (γν) for all γ in 𝒩_j, then C j s holds for every s in 𝒩_{<j}.

declarations.name: unitOrOne
declarations.says: The element c as a unit if it is invertible, and the unit 1 otherwise.

declarations.name: Shape.Form.GT
declarations.says: The subgroup H_l of the unitary group fixing e_a and e*_a for a ≤ l; also z if l > ϱ, and every basis vector if l > ϱ + 1.

declarations.name: Shape.Form.unipotentBelow
declarations.says: The subgroup 𝒩_{<l} of the unitary group: block upper triangular with identity diagonal blocks for e₁, …, e_l, V_l, e*_l, …, e*₁; for l ≥ ϱ it is 𝖴.

declarations.name: Shape.Form.unitriGroup
declarations.says: The subgroup Q_l of the unitary group: for l ≤ ϱ + 1, elements unitriangular on the first l vectors of the frame (e₁, …, e_ϱ, z); otherwise 𝖴.

declarations.name: commute_weylElem
declarations.says: The Weyl element of length l commutes with H_l.

declarations.name: commute_weylOn
declarations.says: A product of floor Weyl elements on floors below l commutes with H_l.

declarations.name: conj_mem_floorUnipotent
declarations.says: 𝒩_l is normalised by H_{l+1}.

declarations.name: conj_mem_unipotentBelow
declarations.says: 𝒩_{<l} is normalised by H_l.

declarations.name: eq_one_of_mem_floorGroup_inf
declarations.says: H_l ∩ 𝒩_{<j} is trivial when j ≤ l or ϱ ≤ l.

declarations.name: floorGroup_anti
declarations.says: The floor groups decrease: H_{l+1} ⊂ H_l.

declarations.name: floorGroup_apply
declarations.says: Elements of H_l agree with the identity matrix in the rows and columns of the floors below l.

declarations.name: floorGroup_apply_besselFrame
declarations.says: For 0 ≤ b ≤ ϱ, σ in H_b and s in Q_{b+1}, the vector σf_{b+1} has coordinate zero at e_a and e*_a for a ≤ b, and the coordinate of σs f_{b+1} at every other basis vector.

declarations.name: floorGroup_eq_bot
declarations.says: H_l is trivial for l ≥ ϱ + 2.

declarations.name: floorOf
declarations.says: The floor of a basis index: a for e_{a+1} and e*_{a+1}, ϱ for z, and ϱ+1 for the basis vectors of X₀.

declarations.name: floorUnipotent
declarations.says: The group 𝒩_l = H_l ∩ 𝒩_{<l+1}, where H_l = U(V_l).

declarations.name: floorUnipotent_superdiag_eq_zero
declarations.says: Elements of 𝒩_l have zero superdiagonal frame entries except at floor l.

declarations.name: floorWeyl
declarations.says: The Weyl element w_l(c): e_{l+1} ↦ ce*_{l+1}, e*_{l+1} ↦ e_{l+1}/c̄, fixing the other basis vectors; it is 1 if l ≥ ϱ or c is not a unit.

declarations.name: floorWeyl_mem_floorGroup
declarations.says: The floor Weyl element w_l(c) lies in H_l.

declarations.name: frameGram_eq_form_orbitPoint
declarations.says: Let the form h with Gram matrix T.splitGram be hermitian and invertible. For isometries σ, τ and 0 ≤ b ≤ ϱ, the diagonal entry of Z(στ⁻¹) at the frame vector f_{b+1} is h(σ⁻¹f_{b+1}, τ⁻¹f_{b+1}).

declarations.name: frameGram_floorWeyl
declarations.says: The frame Gram entry of w_a(c) at floor a is c.

declarations.name: inclMatrix_mulVec_floor_block
declarations.says: The floor block of s in H_l acts compatibly with the inclusion of the floor coordinates.

declarations.name: inclMatrix_val_mulVec
declarations.says: The inclusion of floor coordinates is zero below floor l and the identity above.

declarations.name: inv_mul_mem_of_orbitPoint_eq
declarations.says: If σ, τ in H_b have the same orbit point, then σ⁻¹τ lies in Q_{b+1} ∩ H_b.

declarations.name: inverse_star_unit
declarations.says: For a unit u, the inverse of ū is the conjugate of u⁻¹.

declarations.name: level_le_or_exists_dual
declarations.says: Every basis index either has level at most ϱ or is a dual vector e*_b of floor b.

declarations.name: mem_floorGroup
declarations.says: g lies in H_l exactly when its columns at floors below l are those of the identity matrix.

declarations.name: mem_unitriGroup
declarations.says: Membership in Q_l in terms of matrix entries (unitriangular on the first l levels).

declarations.name: mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_besselU
declarations.says: 𝖴 is contained in every Q_l.

declarations.name: mem_unitriGroup_of_mem_floorGroup
declarations.says: H_l is contained in Q_l.

declarations.name: mem_unitriGroup_succ_iff
declarations.says: For s in H_b, s lies in Q_{b+1} exactly when its orbit point is f_{b+1}.

declarations.name: oppositeIndex_spec
declarations.says: The opposite-index map is an involution preserving floors, with levels adding to 2ϱ.

declarations.name: orbitPoint
declarations.says: For b ≤ ϱ and an isometry g, the vector g⁻¹f_{b+1}, where f = (e₁, …, e_ϱ, z) is the frame.

declarations.name: splitGram_col
declarations.says: The columns of the split Gram matrix at floors below ϱ are standard basis vectors at the opposite index.

declarations.name: splitGram_eq_ite_oppositeIndex
declarations.says: The split Gram matrix pairs each index of floor < ϱ with its opposite index.

declarations.name: superdiag_conj_eq
declarations.says: Conjugation by s in H_{l+1} preserves the superdiagonal frame entries of g in 𝒩_{<l}.

declarations.name: unipotentBelow_eq_besselU
declarations.says: For l ≥ ϱ, the block unitriangular group 𝒩_{<l} (unipotentBelow) equals the Bessel unipotent group 𝖴.

declarations.name: unipotentBelow_le_besselU
declarations.says: 𝒩_{<l} is contained in 𝖴.

declarations.name: unipotentBelow_le_unitriGroup
declarations.says: 𝒩_{<j} is contained in Q_l.

declarations.name: unipotentBelow_mulVec_apply
declarations.says: Elements of 𝒩_{<j} fix the coordinates of floor ≥ j of vectors whose e*-coordinates below j vanish.

declarations.name: unitriGroup_anti
declarations.says: The groups Q_l decrease in l.

declarations.name: unitriGroup_dual_row
declarations.says: For s in Q_j and a < j (hyperbolic pairs indexed from 0), the row of s at e*_a equals that of the identity matrix in every column other than those of the e*_b with b < a.

declarations.name: unitriGroup_mulVec_dual
declarations.says: For s in Q_j and a < j, (sv) has the same e*_a coordinate as v if the e*_b coordinates of v vanish for b < a.

declarations.name: weylElem
declarations.says: The Weyl element w_p of length l: e_a ↦ p_a e*_a and e*_a ↦ e_a/p̄_a on the first l hyperbolic pairs, fixing the other basis vectors.

declarations.name: weylElem_mul_left_comm
declarations.says: The Weyl element of length l commutes past s in H_l on the left (and so does its inverse).

declarations.name: weylElem_star
declarations.says: w_l(p̄) = w_l(p)⁻¹.

declarations.name: weylElem_succ
declarations.says: w_{l+1}(p) = w_l(p_l)·w_l(p) (one more floor).

declarations.name: weylOn
declarations.says: The isometry e ↦ ce*, e* ↦ e/c̄, c = p(a), on the hyperbolic pair of each floor a < ϱ satisfying P with p(a) a unit; it fixes the other basis vectors.

declarations.name: G
declarations.says: The adelic unitary group G = G_∞ × G_f for signs s at the infinite places and the identity matrix at the finite places.

declarations.name: G.mat
declarations.says: The n×n matrix over the adeles of an element g of the adelic unitary group G.

declarations.name: G.mat_mul
declarations.says: The matrix of a product is the product of the matrices.

declarations.name: G.mat_one
declarations.says: The matrix of 1 is the identity matrix.

declarations.name: G.mat_snd
declarations.says: The finite part of the matrix of g is the finite component of g.

declarations.name: G.toUnitary
declarations.says: The isomorphism from G = G_∞ × G_f to the unitary group over the adeles of the standard form stdForm.

declarations.name: GInf
declarations.says: The archimedean unitary group G_∞ for signs s: one copy of the complex unitary group U(diag s) for each infinite place of E.

declarations.name: Gf
declarations.says: The finite adelic unitary group G_f: matrices g in GL_n(𝔸_f) with gᴴg = 1.

declarations.name: Gf.atPlace
declarations.says: The homomorphism G_f → GL_n(E_w) sending an element to its component at w.

declarations.name: Gf.coe_inv
declarations.says: The underlying matrix of g⁻¹ in G_f is the inverse matrix.

declarations.name: Gf.coe_mul
declarations.says: The underlying matrix of a product in G_f is the product.

declarations.name: Gf.coe_one
declarations.says: The underlying matrix of 1 in G_f is the identity.

declarations.name: Gf.supportedOn
declarations.says: The subgroup of G_f of elements supported on S ∪ S̄, that is, with component 1 at every place outside S ∪ S̄.

declarations.name: Gf.trivialOn
declarations.says: The subgroup of G_f of elements with component 1 at every place in S (hence, being unitary, also at the conjugate places).

declarations.name: HasLevel
declarations.says: The function F on G = G_∞ × G_f has level K ⊂ G_f: F(g·(1, k)) = F(g) for all k ∈ K and g ∈ G.

declarations.name: IsLevel
declarations.says: The subgroup K of the finite adelic unitary group G_f is a level: it is open and contained in K_0 = G_f ∩ GL_n(Ô).

declarations.name: IsLevel.isCompact
declarations.says: A level is compact.

declarations.name: Kf
declarations.says: The subgroup K_0 = G_f ∩ GL_n(Ô) of the finite adelic unitary group, the stabiliser of the standard lattice Ô^n.

declarations.name: Kf.map
declarations.says: For a ring homomorphism f from the integral finite adeles to S, the homomorphism K_0 → GL_n(S) applying f to each entry.

declarations.name: Kf.reduceAt
declarations.says: Reduction modulo w: the homomorphism from K_0 = G_f ∩ GL_n(Ô) to GL_n of the residue field at w.

declarations.name: Kw
declarations.says: For a finite place w of E, the subgroup GL_n(O_w) of GL_n(E_w) of matrices that, with their inverses, have entries in the local integers.

declarations.name: Space
declarations.says: A hermitian space with a point: a matrix J over E and x in GL_n(𝔸) with xᴴJx equal to diag(s) at the infinite places and 1 at the finite places.

declarations.name: Space.baseLattice
declarations.says: For a space V = (J, x), the lattice E^n ∩ x_f Ô^n of rational vectors y with x⁻¹y integral at all finite places, as an additive subgroup.

declarations.name: Space.embFin
declarations.says: For a space (J, x), the homomorphism U(J)(E) → G_f sending γ to the finite part of x^{-1} γ x.

declarations.name: Space.ratEmbed
declarations.says: For a space (J, x), the homomorphism γ ↦ x⁻¹ γ x from the rational unitary group U(J)(E) to G.

declarations.name: Space.toRatCoords
declarations.says: For a space (J, x), the isomorphism g ↦ x g x⁻¹ from G to the adelic unitary group U(J)(𝔸).

declarations.name: Space.vecAtPoint
declarations.says: For a space (J, x), the adelic vector x⁻¹y attached to a rational vector y in E^n.

declarations.name: atSplit
declarations.says: For a split place w, the homomorphism GL_n(E_w) → G_f sending g to the unitary element with component g at w and 1 off w, w̄.

declarations.name: evalAt_star_GL
declarations.says: At a split place, the component of ḡᵀ at w is the transpose of the conjugated component of g at the conjugate place.

declarations.name: evalInf
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism 𝔸 → ℂ taking an adele of E to its component at the infinite place v.

declarations.name: heckeGL
declarations.says: The j-th Hecke operator on a representation π of GL_n(E_w): the action (heckeFun) of the indicator function of basicDoubleCoset j, for K = GL_n(O_w).

declarations.name: isCompact_intGL
declarations.says: GL_n(O) is compact when O is compact.

declarations.name: isOpen_Kf
declarations.says: K₀ is open in G_f.

declarations.name: isOpen_intGL
declarations.says: GL_n(O) is open when O is open.

declarations.name: localLevel
declarations.says: The subgroup of G_f of elements whose component at each place w in S lies in K w; by default K w is GL_n(O_w).

declarations.name: mass
declarations.says: The mass of the genus of O_E^l: the sum of 1/#Aut over the classes Γ\G_f/K_0 for the space I_l.

declarations.name: matrix_ext_𝔸
declarations.says: Two adelic matrices are equal when all their infinite components and their finite parts agree.

declarations.name: mem_Kf
declarations.says: g lies in K₀ exactly when all its entries are integral finite adeles.

declarations.name: mem_localLevel
declarations.says: g lies in the local level exactly when its component at each w ∈ S lies in K_w.

declarations.name: mkAdelicGL
declarations.says: The element of GL_n(𝔸) with components a_w in GL_n(ℂ) at the infinite places and finite part b.

declarations.name: stdEmbFin
declarations.says: The homomorphism U_n(E) → G_f sending a matrix γ over E with γᴴγ = 1 to its image over the finite adeles.

declarations.name: stdForm
declarations.says: The diagonal adelic matrix that is diag(s) at every infinite place and the identity at the finite places.

declarations.name: stdLevelIndex
declarations.says: For a subgroup K of G_f, the index [K₀ : K ∩ K₀], where K₀ = Kf; it is 0 if the index is infinite.

declarations.name: stdRatPoints
declarations.says: The image of U_n(E), the matrices γ over E with γᴴγ = 1, in the finite adelic unitary group G_f.

declarations.name: stdSpace
declarations.says: The definite space I_n with J = 1 and x = 1: the sum of n norms with its standard lattice.

declarations.name: Filling.ratIntegralOff
declarations.says: The ring of S-integers of E: the elements integral at every finite place outside S.

declarations.name: Finset.StarStable
declarations.says: The finite set S of finite places of E is stable under complex conjugation.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace
declarations.says: A finite place: a place A with a compact open subring R of volume 1 that is self-dual for ψ and compatible with τ, δ, ν, and with c = 1.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.R
declarations.says: The ring of integers of the finite place: the compact open subring O of A.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.ascConv_mconv_unfolding
declarations.says: Unfolding at a finite place: let η = η₀∗⋯∗η_{j−1}, K(g) the congruence subgroup of level g, θ an s-finite measure and c an element of the unitary group. Then (η∗θ)(K(g)c⁻¹) = η(K(g))·θ(𝒩K(g)c⁻¹), with 𝒩 = 𝒩_{<j} (Shape.Form.unipotentBelow).
declarations.note: a bespoke unfolding identity for the proof's Heisenberg floor measures at a finite place (10 lines); the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.contentIndex
declarations.says: The volume of the set of c in A with cp integral if the entry p_i is a unit of A, and ∞ otherwise.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.exists_content
declarations.says: Content: if some entry of p is a unit of A, there are a unit t of A and a row r over R with r·p = t such that cp is integral exactly when tc ∈ R.
declarations.note: content of a primitive vector over a valuation ring.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.exists_eichler_orbitPoint_eq
declarations.says: Let h(u, ·) be the z-coordinate, vanishing at u; β the z-coordinate of e, v = e − z, ς = h(v,e) − τ(h(e,e) − h(z,z)). Then g = 1 + β⁻¹(βu h(v, ·) − (v + ςu) h(u, ·)) is unitary (β⁻¹ = 0 for non-units), in U(V_ϱ) if e ∈ V_ϱ, and ge = z if h(e,e) = h(z,z), β a unit.
declarations.note: an explicit Eichler transformation (15 lines).

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.exists_ideal_cardQuot_eq
declarations.says: For a unit u of A lying in R there is an ideal I of R of finite index (md u)⁻¹ with u⁻¹x ∈ R exactly for x ∈ I.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.intUnits
declarations.says: The group of units of R, as a subset of A.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.intVectors_open_compact_vol
declarations.says: The integral vectors Rⁿ form an open subset.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.lintegral_contentIndex_pow_le
declarations.says: Let ζ_R(μ) ≤ 2, V ∈ GL_ι(R), β a unit, and single out s + k coordinates of Vᴴw, k ≥ μ. The integral of IntegralPlace.contentIndex^s of these coordinates over the w with βw integral is at most ζ_R(μ)·md(β)^(−(|ι|−s)).
declarations.note: a local integral estimate with the ideal zeta value ζ_R(μ) ≤ 2 (15 lines); no source cited; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.mass_near_quadric_off_places_le
declarations.says: Let sm = 1, β = β̄, ζ_Ô(μ) ≤ 2, 2μ+2 ≤ |κ|. Integrals of f(x_T) over x integral off T with m(x*x−β−a) ∈ Ô are v times the same integrals at T, for a finite v with vol(codifferent E s)·ν{Γ : mΓ/δ ∈ R}·v ≤ ζ_Ô(μ)vol(Ô)^|κ|.
declarations.note: a mass estimate for integral points near a hermitian quadric off finitely many places (36 lines), of the kind of Siegel's local densities; no source cited; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.md_det_eq_one
declarations.says: At a finite place with integers R, the determinant of a matrix in GL(R) has modulus 1.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.md_le_one
declarations.says: The modulus of an integral unit is at most 1.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.md_le_volume
declarations.says: If u·R ⊂ S then md(u) ≤ vol(S).

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.measurableSet_exists_mul_mem_level
declarations.says: The set of y with u(yc) in the unitary level for some u in S is measurable.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.measurableSet_unitaryLevel
declarations.says: Unitary levels are measurable.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.quadricMeasure_cone_le
declarations.says: If ζ_R(μ) ≤ 2 and |ι| ≥ μ + 1, then on |ι| + 1 hyperbolic planes the measure δ(h(v,v))dv (Place.quadricMeasure) of the v with βv integral is at most ζ_R(μ)·md(β)^(−(2|ι|+1)).
declarations.note: a local density bound for a hermitian quadric cone (25 lines), with ζ_R(μ) ≤ 2; no source cited; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.skewMeasure_setOf_mul_mem
declarations.says: For a self-conjugate unit u, the skew measure of {b : ub ∈ R} is md(u)^{−1/2}.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.unitaryLevel_open_compact
declarations.says: Unitary levels are open, and the level of 1 is compact.

declarations.name: IntegralPlace.volume_setOf_mul_mem
declarations.says: vol{x : ux ∈ R} = md(u)⁻¹.

declarations.name: adeleOfLocal_evalPlaces_mul
declarations.says: Extension by zero is linear over the S-components: adeleOfLocal(b_S·a) = b·adeleOfLocal(a).

declarations.name: adeleOfLocal_mem_integralOff
declarations.says: Extension by zero lands in the adeles integral off S.

declarations.name: adeleOfLocal_star
declarations.says: Extension by zero commutes with conjugation.

declarations.name: denomIndex_ne_zero
declarations.says: The denominator index of a local element is non-zero.

declarations.name: enorm_integral_codifferent
declarations.says: Fourier inversion: for Mm = 1, β = β̄, a finite measure μ and C = codifferent E M of finite volume, |∫_{z ∈ C}∫ψ_f(z(x^*x − β)/2) dμ(x) dz| equals vol(C)·μ{x : m(x^*x − β) ∈ Ô}.
declarations.note: orthogonality of characters on the compact group (codifferent); 17 lines.

declarations.name: genIndex_eq_inv_prod_norm
declarations.says: The generalised index of x in ∏_{w∈S} E_w is (∏_w |x_w|)⁻¹.

declarations.name: idealZeta_locProd_le
declarations.says: The ideal zeta function of the S-components is at most that of Ô.

declarations.name: integralOff
declarations.says: The ring of finite adeles of E that are integral at every place outside S.

declarations.name: isOpen_integralOff
declarations.says: The adeles integral off S form an open subgroup.

declarations.name: locProd_O_eq_map_evalPlaces
declarations.says: The integers of ∏_{w∈S} E_w are the image of Ô.

declarations.name: locallyIntegrable_sqrt_inv_norm
declarations.says: 1 + √(|x|⁻¹ − 1) is locally integrable on E_w.

declarations.name: map_evalPlaces_restrict_volume
declarations.says: The projection to the places of S carries Haar measure on the finite adeles integral off S to vol(Ô) times Haar measure on the product of the E_w, w in S.

declarations.name: mem_integralOff
declarations.says: x is integral off S exactly when its components outside S have valuation at most 1.

declarations.name: mem_Ô_iff
declarations.says: x ∈ Ô exactly when its S-components are integral and x is integral off S.

declarations.name: ratToPlaces
declarations.says: The diagonal ring homomorphism from E to the product of the completions E_w, w in S.

declarations.name: sqrt_genIndex_le_prod_norm
declarations.says: Product formula inequality: for a nonzero S-integer y, the square root of the generalised index [R : yR], R the integers at S, is at most the product of |y|_v over the infinite places.
declarations.note: from the product formula.

declarations.name: star_evalPlaces
declarations.says: Evaluation at S commutes with conjugation.

declarations.name: sub_adeleOfLocal_mem_iff
declarations.says: x − (extension by zero of its S-components) is integral exactly when x is integral off S.

declarations.name: CMType
declarations.says: E is a CM number field equipped with a CM type: for each infinite place w of E, a chosen complex embedding of E that induces w.

declarations.name: DenseRange.eq
declarations.says: Two continuous maps to a Hausdorff space that agree on the image of a map with dense range are equal.

declarations.name: FinPlace
declarations.says: The set of finite places of E, that is, nonzero prime ideals of its ring of integers.

declarations.name: FinPlace.IsSplit
declarations.says: The finite place w of the CM field E is split over the maximal real subfield: it differs from its complex conjugate.

declarations.name: FinPlace.below
declarations.says: For an extension L/K, the finite place of K below the finite place w of L.

declarations.name: FinPlace.comap
declarations.says: For f: K → L and a finite place w of L, the finite place of K below w: the preimage under f of the prime ideal w.

declarations.name: FinPlace.one_lt_q
declarations.says: The norm N(w) of a finite place w is greater than 1.

declarations.name: FinPlace.q
declarations.says: The absolute norm of the prime ideal w, that is, the order of its residue field.

declarations.name: FinPlace.q_bounds
declarations.says: Elementary bounds: N(w) − 1 > 0, N(w) ≠ 0, N(w) ≥ 1.

declarations.name: LocField
declarations.says: The completion E_w of E at the finite place w.

declarations.name: LocInt
declarations.says: The ring of integers of the completion E_w of E at the finite place w.

declarations.name: Nat.Coprime.valuation_eq_one
declarations.says: If p and q are coprime and p lies in the maximal ideal of a valuation subring B, then q is a unit of B.

declarations.name: PlaceEmbedding
declarations.says: A choice, for each infinite place w of E, of a complex embedding Φ w of E that induces w.

declarations.name: ResField
declarations.says: The residue field of the completion E_w of E at the finite place w.

declarations.name: StablyUnram
declarations.says: The hypothesis on a CM field E, called stably unramified, that E contains a primitive root of unity of order 5040 = 7!.
declarations.note: a bespoke hypothesis of this proof (E contains a primitive 5040-th root of unity).

declarations.name: StablyUnram.exists_i_c₀
declarations.says: If the CM field E contains a primitive 5040-th root of unity, then O_E contains i with i² = −1, ī = −i, and ω with ω + ω̄ = 1, ωω̄ = 2.

declarations.name: adeleMap_algebraMap
declarations.says: The adelic map induced by f agrees with f on elements of E.

declarations.name: coe_star_ringOfIntegers
declarations.says: The conjugate of an integer of E, as an element of E, is the conjugate of the element.

declarations.name: evalAt
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism sending a finite adele to its component in E_w.

declarations.name: evalAt_apply
declarations.says: Evaluation at w of a finite adele is its component at w.

declarations.name: finAdeleIncl
declarations.says: For an extension of number fields L over K, the inclusion of the finite adeles of K in those of L.

declarations.name: finite_natCast_mem
declarations.says: Only finitely many finite places contain a given non-zero integer n.

declarations.name: map_star_CM
declarations.says: Maps between CM fields commute with complex conjugation.

declarations.name: map_star_complex
declarations.says: Complex embeddings of a CM field commute with complex conjugation.

declarations.name: mem_star_place
declarations.says: x lies in the conjugate place w̄ exactly when x̄ lies in w.

declarations.name: mem_Ô
declarations.says: A finite adele is integral exactly when all its components have valuation at most 1.

declarations.name: reduceAt
declarations.says: Reduction modulo w: the ring homomorphism from the integral finite adeles to the residue field at w.

declarations.name: tendsto_place_comap_cofinite
declarations.says: Every finite place of K lies below only finitely many places of L (restriction is finite-to-one on places).

declarations.name: toAdele
declarations.says: The diagonal embedding of E in its adeles, given at the infinite places by the chosen embeddings Φ w.

declarations.name: uniformizer
declarations.says: A chosen uniformiser of the completion of E at the finite place w.

declarations.name: v_algebraMap_eq_one
declarations.says: An element of K not in w is a unit at w.

declarations.name: v_algebraMap_eq_valuation
declarations.says: The valuation of x in the completion at w′ is its w′-adic valuation.

declarations.name: v_uniformizer
declarations.says: The chosen uniformiser has valuation e^{−1}.

declarations.name: valuation_star
declarations.says: The valuation at w̄ of x̄ equals the valuation at w of x.

declarations.name: GlModule.E
declarations.says: For a gl_n-module and indices a, b, the endomorphism by which the elementary matrix E_{ab} acts.

declarations.name: HCParam
declarations.says: Integer vectors indexed by n, attached to the signs ε; they serve as doubled Harish-Chandra parameters l = 2λ and as integral weights of U(diag ε).

declarations.name: HCParam.HasGap
declarations.says: l = 2λ is a parameter of gap h: λ has distinct entries in (n−1)/2 + ℤ, and |λ_i − λ_j| ≥ h whenever ε_i ≠ ε_j.

declarations.name: HCParam.HasLargeGap
declarations.says: l = 2λ is a parameter of gap 500n³ + A, where n is the size of the index set.

declarations.name: HCParam.dsCoeff
declarations.says: The function ψ_λ on matrices: the normalised Flensted-Jensen integral HCParam.flenstedJensen at (a, a⁻¹g), with a the block diagonal part of g for the signs ε.

declarations.name: HCParam.dsKernel
declarations.says: The function e_λ on U(diag ε) given by e_λ(g) = deg_λ times the complex conjugate of ψ_λ(g), for l = 2λ.

declarations.name: HCParam.flenstedJensen
declarations.says: Flensted-Jensen's integral, normalised: c_Λ⁻¹ ∫_K m_Λ(gk) conj(m_Λ(k)) / m_{−μ}(k*zk) dk for matrices g, z, with μ = λ + ρ, c_Λ = ∫_K |m_Λ|², l = 2λ.

declarations.name: HCParam.formalDegree
declarations.says: The degree deg_λ: the inverse of the integral of |ψ_λ(g)|² over U(diag ε), for l = 2λ.

declarations.name: HCParam.kTypeNormSq
declarations.says: For an integral weight l, the number c_l = ∫_K |m_l(k)|² dk, with K = U(diag ε) ∩ U(n) of mass one and m_l = weightMinors.

declarations.name: HCParam.lowestKType
declarations.says: For a parameter l = 2λ, the weight Λ = λ + ρ − 2ρ_c, with ρ, ρ_c the half sums of all and of the compact roots positive for λ.

declarations.name: HasHolGap
declarations.says: The condition on signs ε, integer vector w and natural number γ that w_i + γ ≤ w_j whenever ε_i = +1 and ε_j = −1.

declarations.name: IsHolOfWeight
declarations.says: F on U(diag ε)^Φ is holomorphic of weight u: some F' is analytic at all hb with F'(hb) = b^u F(h), for b invertible o-triangular and h, b commuting with diag(ε').

declarations.name: IsKDominant
declarations.says: The weight w is K-dominant for the order o: w_j ≤ w_i whenever ε_i = ε_j and o_i < o_j.

declarations.name: IsPosFirstOrder
declarations.says: The order o has distinct values and puts every index of sign +1 before every index of sign −1.

declarations.name: blockDiagAlg
declarations.says: The algebra of complex matrices commuting with diag(ε), that is the block diagonal matrices for the signs ε.

declarations.name: blockDiagPart
declarations.says: For signs ε and a matrix g, the matrix keeping the entries g_ij with ε_i=ε_j and having zero elsewhere.

declarations.name: diagTorus
declarations.says: For a tuple t of complex numbers of modulus one, the diagonal matrix diag(t) as an element of U(diag ε).

declarations.name: exists_equiv_of_card_neg
declarations.says: If two sign vectors on sets of equal size have the same number of −1 entries, they differ by a bijection.

declarations.name: expU
declarations.says: For X with X*J+JX=0, the matrix exponential exp X as an element of the group U(J).

declarations.name: gapThreshold
declarations.says: For an index set of size n and a natural number A, the real number 500n³+A.

declarations.name: haarK
declarations.says: The Haar measure of total mass one on the compact group K=U(diag ε)∩U(n).

declarations.name: holMinors
declarations.says: For signs ε, weight o and matrix b, the quotient m_{o+c·1₊}(b)/m_{c·1₊}(b) of products of principal minors, with c = 2∑|o_j| and 1₊ indicating sign +1.

declarations.name: holMinorsPi
declarations.says: For weights u_τ and a tuple h in U(diag ε)^Φ, the product over τ of the quotients of minors holMinors of weight u_τ at h_τ.

declarations.name: maxCompactU
declarations.says: The subgroup U(diag ε)∩U(n) of U(diag ε), consisting of the elements that are unitary matrices.

declarations.name: negCount
declarations.says: The number of indices i with sign a_i = −1.

declarations.name: negCount_neg_add
declarations.says: negCount(−a) + negCount(a) = the number of indices.

declarations.name: negCount_sumElim
declarations.says: The number of −1 signs is additive over disjoint unions.

declarations.name: paramAddRho
declarations.says: The integer vector μ with entries (l_i + 2ρ_i)/2 rounded down, ρ the half sum of roots positive for l; it is λ+ρ for a parameter l = 2λ.

declarations.name: toHCParam
declarations.says: The integer vector l, regarded as a doubled parameter or weight for the signs ε.

declarations.name: twoRho
declarations.says: The vector with i-th entry #{j : r(i,j), l_j < l_i} − #{j : r(i,j), l_i < l_j}: the sum of the roots selected by r that are positive for l.

declarations.name: unitaryLie
declarations.says: The Lie algebra of U(J): the real vector space of complex matrices X with X*J + JX = 0.

declarations.name: weightMinors
declarations.says: The function m_l(g): the product over t ∈ ℤ of the principal minor of g on {i : l_i ≥ t}, each factor with t ≤ 0 divided by det g.

declarations.name: weylDimensionPoly
declarations.says: For l = 2λ, the product of λ_i − λ_j over all pairs of indices with λ_j < λ_i, divided by ∏_{i<n} i!.

entries.known_result: congruence subgroups and level structures of adelic groups

declarations.name: Kf.map_apply
declarations.says: The map K₀ → GL_n(S) induced by a ring map f acts entrywise.

declarations.name: Kf.map_eq_one
declarations.says: The image of g ∈ K₀ under f is 1 exactly when f kills every entry of g − 1.

declarations.name: Kf.reduceAt_eq_of_atPlace
declarations.says: If the component of k ∈ K₀ at w is an integral matrix t, the reduction of k modulo w is the reduction of t.

declarations.name: Kf.reduceAt_eq_one_of_atPlace
declarations.says: If k ∈ K₀ has component 1 at w, its reduction modulo w is 1.

declarations.name: Kf.reduceFamily
declarations.says: The homomorphism from K₀ to ∏_i GL_n(k_{w_i}) given by reduction modulo each place of the family w_i.

declarations.name: blockParahoric
declarations.says: For a level function b on the indices, the parahoric subgroup of the g in GL_N(𝒪) with g_ij ∈ 𝔭 whenever b(j) < b(i).

declarations.name: card_GL_le
declarations.says: #GL_n(R) ≤ #R^{n²} for a finite ring R.

declarations.name: diagGL_mul_permGL
declarations.says: diag(t)·perm(σ) = perm(σ)·diag(t∘σ).

declarations.name: dvd_iff_reduceAt_eq_zero
declarations.says: If a has valuation 1 (is a uniformiser) at every prime containing it, then a divides y exactly when y reduces to 0 modulo every such prime.

declarations.name: dvd_iff_Ô
declarations.says: Divisibility by an integer a of E is the same in E's integers and in the integral finite adeles.

declarations.name: exists_reduceFamily_eq
declarations.says: Every family of elements of the GL_n of the residue fields at the places w_i is the reduction of an element of K₀ supported on those places (Chinese remainder theorem).

declarations.name: inf_trivialOn_le_levelOf
declarations.says: Elements of K₀ trivial at the places w_i lie in every level levelOf w H.

declarations.name: isOpen_levelOf
declarations.says: The level levelOf w H is open.

declarations.name: isOpen_principalLevel
declarations.says: The principal level K(a), a ≠ 0, is open.

declarations.name: isUnit_algebraMap_finAdele
declarations.says: A non-zero element of E is a unit in the finite adeles.

declarations.name: levelOf
declarations.says: The subgroup of G_f of elements of K₀ whose reductions modulo the places w_i form an element of the subgroup H of ∏_i GL_n(k_{w_i}).

declarations.name: levelOf.reduction
declarations.says: The homomorphism from the level levelOf w H to H given by reduction modulo the places w_i.

declarations.name: levelOf_le_Kf
declarations.says: levelOf w H is contained in K₀.

declarations.name: mem_prod_finPlace_iff
declarations.says: For distinct places w_i, x lies in the product of their primes exactly when it lies in each.

declarations.name: principalLevel
declarations.says: The principal level K(a): the subgroup of g in K₀ = Kf with all entries of g − 1 in aÔ, for an integer a of E.

declarations.name: principalLevel_le_Kf
declarations.says: K(a) is contained in K₀.

declarations.name: principalLevel_le_levelOf
declarations.says: If a lies in every w_i, then K(a) is contained in levelOf w H.

declarations.name: principalLevel_le_of_dvd
declarations.says: If a divides b, then K(b) ⊂ K(a).

declarations.name: proIwahori
declarations.says: The pro-p Iwahori subgroup I₁ of GL_n(𝒪): matrices that are upper triangular with ones on the diagonal modulo the maximal ideal.

declarations.name: reduceFamily_atSplit
declarations.says: Reduction of the image of a local element k at a split place w_i is k mod w_i in the i-th factor and 1 elsewhere.

declarations.name: reduceGL
declarations.says: The reduction homomorphism from GL_n(O_w) to GL_n of the residue field at w.

declarations.name: relIndex_levelOf
declarations.says: The index of levelOf w H in K₀ equals the index of H.

declarations.name: relIndex_ne_zero_of_isLevel
declarations.says: A level has finite index in K₀.

declarations.name: relIndex_principalLevel_le
declarations.says: For a nonzero integer a of the CM field E, the index of the principal level K(a) in K₀ (Subgroup.relIndex, 0 if infinite) is at most N(a)^(n²), with N(a) the absolute norm of (a) and n the rank.
declarations.note: from #GL_n(O_E/a) ≤ #(O_E/a)^{n²}.

declarations.name: residuePreimage
declarations.says: The open subgroup of the g in GL_n(𝒪) satisfying P, where on GL_n(𝒪) the property P means that the reduction modulo 𝔭 lies in the subgroup H.

declarations.name: IsFreeEntry
declarations.says: The matrix positions (a,i), a among the first ϱ rows, with column e_j or e*_j for j>a, or any column of the middle block.

declarations.name: J₁_eq
declarations.says: J₁ = I·Dᴴ + D·Iᴴ + C·Cᴴ − z·zᴴ in terms of the isotropic, dual and definite column matrices and the column z (the Gram matrix in block form).

declarations.name: Shape.FrameMat
declarations.says: The space of complex n×n matrices, where n = ϱ + 1 is the length of a frame.

declarations.name: Shape.G₁
declarations.says: The complex unitary group G₁ of the whole space, for the form with ϱ hyperbolic planes, Gram matrix 1 on X₀ and −1 at z.

declarations.name: Shape.J₁
declarations.says: The complex Gram matrix J₁ of the whole space in the standard basis: ϱ hyperbolic planes, 1 on X₀ and −1 at z; G₁ is its unitary group.

declarations.name: Shape.UnipotentParams
declarations.says: The space of pairs (a, b) with a a complex ϱ×κ matrix and b a real ϱ×ϱ matrix: the parameters of the isometries unipotentOf.

declarations.name: Shape.besselHaar
declarations.says: The measure on 𝖴 that is the image of dx du under (x, u) ↦ u·x̃, with x unitriangular, x̃ its lift, dx Lebesgue measure and du = Shape.besselHaar₀.

declarations.name: Shape.besselHaar₀
declarations.says: The measure on 𝖴⁰ that is the image of Lebesgue measure on the parameter space Shape.UnipotentParams under the parametrisation unipotentOf.

declarations.name: Shape.definiteCols
declarations.says: The complex matrix whose columns are the standard basis vectors of X₀, indexed by κ.

declarations.name: Shape.dualCols
declarations.says: The complex matrix whose columns are the standard basis vectors e*₁, …, e*_ϱ of the last block.

declarations.name: Shape.dualFrameCols
declarations.says: The complex matrix with ϱ+1 columns: the basis vectors e*₁, …, e*_ϱ, then the chosen basis vector of X₀ of index k₀.

declarations.name: Shape.frameCols
declarations.says: The complex matrix whose columns are the frame vectors e₁, …, e_ϱ, z in the standard basis.

declarations.name: actOnCols
declarations.says: The matrix 1 − CCᴴ + ChCᴴ; for orthonormal columns C it acts by h on their span and fixes the orthogonal complement.

declarations.name: besselQuotMeasure
declarations.says: The measure on G₁ that computes integrals over 𝖴\G₁: Haar measure weighted by a chosen cutoff for the measure Shape.besselHaar on 𝖴.

declarations.name: embedH
declarations.says: For h in the unitary group U(κ), the element of G₁ acting as h on X₀ and as the identity on the other basis vectors.

declarations.name: exists_embedH_eq_of_fix_frameCols
declarations.says: If s fixes the frame columns, then s·u_q equals the embedding of some h in U(κ) for some unipotent u_q.

declarations.name: exists_mul_unipotentOf_dualCols_eq
declarations.says: If B has ϱ columns that span an isotropic space and are dual to the frame sf (h(sf_a, B_b) = δ_ab, with h(sz, B_b) = 0), then B = su(e*₁, …, e*_ϱ) for some u = unipotentOf q in 𝖴⁰.

declarations.name: frameVector
declarations.says: For y in G₁, the a-th vector y⁻¹f_a of the frame moved by y⁻¹, as a vector of the standard Euclidean space.

declarations.name: freeEntries
declarations.says: The continuous ℝ-linear map sending a matrix M to its entries M(e_a, i) at the positions (a, i) satisfying p, together with the imaginary parts of the entries M(e_a, e*_a).

declarations.name: inclMatrix_gram_eq_one
declarations.says: If the index map e is injective, the inclusion matrix has orthonormal columns: (inclMatrix e)ᴴ·inclMatrix e = 1.

declarations.name: isHermInvolution_J₁
declarations.says: J₁ is a hermitian involution (an instance of a property).

declarations.name: liftUnitri
declarations.says: The lift to G₁ of the upper unitriangular matrix unitriMatrix x of size ϱ+1: an explicit isometry acting by this matrix on the frame e₁, …, e_ϱ, z and fixing X₀.

declarations.name: liftUnitri_mem_besselU
declarations.says: For every family x of entries above the diagonal of a (ϱ+1)×(ϱ+1) complex matrix, the lift of x lies in the subgroup 𝖴 (Shape.Form.besselU) of G₁.

declarations.name: lintegral_bruhat_coords
declarations.says: Integration in Bruhat coordinates Z = x⁻ diag(c) x⁺, x^± unitriangular: for measurable f ≥ 0 on n×n complex matrices, ∫ f dZ = ∫ ∏_a |c_a|^{4(n−1−a)} ∫ f(x⁻ diag(c) x⁺) dx⁻dx⁺ dc, with a numbered from 0.
declarations.reference: the Jacobian of the LDU (Bruhat) decomposition of n×n complex matrices

declarations.name: mul_mul_eq_of_mul_eq
declarations.says: If AB = C then A(BM) = CM.

declarations.name: norm_embedH_mul
declarations.says: Multiplying by an embedded element of U(κ) does not change the operator norm of a matrix in the unitary group.

declarations.name: realFrameGram
declarations.says: For y∈G₁, the (ϱ+1)×(ϱ+1) complex matrix Z(y) of products h(f_j, y f_l) of the frame with its translate.

declarations.name: unipotentOf
declarations.says: For q = (a, b), a complex ϱ×κ, b real ϱ×ϱ: the isometry 1 + XaWᴴ − WaᴴDᴴ + X(sk b − ½aaᴴ)Dᴴ, where X, W, D have columns e_i, x_i, e*_i and sk = skewOfReal.

declarations.name: unipotentOf_mem_besselU0
declarations.says: The elements u_q lie in the unipotent group 𝖴⁰.

declarations.name: unitriMatrix
declarations.says: The upper unitriangular j×j complex matrix whose entries above the diagonal are the given family x.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces
declarations.says: The chosen places (chosenPlace) and the places over the primes of a twist (twistPlace).

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm
declarations.says: The space of algebraic forms of weight (κ, e) on I_n on which the level cut out by H at the places of S acts through the character χ.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.algFormRep_eq_self_of_mem
declarations.says: A level form is fixed by the level cut out by the trivial subgroup at the places of P.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.conj_innerAt
declarations.says: σ⁻¹(conj σ⟨φ′, φ⟩_σ) = ⟨φ, φ′⟩_σ (hermitian symmetry of the conjugate pairing).

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.covolumeSq_elim_le
declarations.says: Adjoining k forms of squared norm at most e^β at σ to a family of squared covolume at most e^V gives squared covolume at most e^(V + kβ).

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.eq_zero_of_innerAt_self
declarations.says: Definiteness of the σ-conjugate pairing: if an algebraic form φ of weight (κ, e), level H and character χ has LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt σ of φ with itself equal to 0, for an automorphism σ of ℂ, then φ = 0.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt
declarations.says: For σ ∈ Aut ℂ, the index of the level in K₀ times the pairing smoothPairing of smooth forms for the Gram form with σ⁻¹ ∘ conj ∘ σ as conjugation.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt_eq_stdClassSum
declarations.says: The pairing LevelPlaces.LevelForm.innerAt σ of φ and φ′ is σ⁻¹ of the class sum, over the level, of conj(σφ(g))ᵀ G σφ′(g), with G the integral Gram matrix of weight κ.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.integralForms
declarations.says: The module, over the valuation ring of j: ℂ → ℂ_l, of forms φ with every value φ(g) of gauge at most 1 for Weyl's lattice at g under j.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.mem_sphericalAt
declarations.says: A level form is spherical at every place w outside the places of P and their conjugates.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.normSqAt
declarations.says: For σ ∈ Aut ℂ, the number ‖φ‖²_σ: the class sum of the squared Gram norms of the vectors σ(φ(g)).

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.norm_inner_le_one
declarations.says: If x is integral at j∘conj, y is integral at j, and A is divisible by the orders of all stabilisers at the level, then |j(A·⟨x, y⟩)| ≤ 1.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.norm_map_det_gram_le
declarations.says: If the squared covolume of y is at most e^V at every automorphism of ℂ, then |σ(det G)| ≤ e^V for the Gram matrix G of y.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.norm_map_inner_le
declarations.says: Cauchy–Schwarz for conjugates: for algebraic forms x, y and σ ∈ Aut ℂ, |σ⟨y, x⟩| ≤ ‖x‖_σ·‖y‖_{σ′}, where σ′ is σ conjugated by complex conjugation.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.LevelForm.toSmoothForm
declarations.says: An algebraic form φ on I_n of level H, viewed as a smooth form: it is fixed by a subgroup of finite index in K₀.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.isOfFinOrder_level_char
declarations.says: The character of the level has values of finite order.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.map_inner_self_eq
declarations.says: Let φ, B be forms, σ ∈ Aut ℂ, p a permutation of the infinite places carrying the weight of φ to that of B. If always σ(φ(g)_i) = c·a(g)·B(g)_{p i}, conj σ(conj φ(g)_i) = c'·a'(g)·B(g)_{p i}, a(g)·conj a'(g) = 1, then σ⟨φ,φ⟩ = conj(c')·c·⟨B,B⟩.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.placeAt
declarations.says: All places of P: those of chosenPlace and of twistPlace, indexed by the disjoint union.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.places
declarations.says: The set of finite places that occur in the families chosenPlace or twistPlace of P.

declarations.name: apply_eq_evalForm
declarations.says: φ(g) is the evaluation of φ at g.

declarations.name: fockLetters
declarations.says: The algebra map sending the variable (τ, i, h) to the sum of the variables (τ, i, a) over the indices a with sign s(a) = c and ord(a) = h.

declarations.name: gramForm_mem_embValRing
declarations.says: If u has gauge at most 1 for Weyl's lattice at g under j∘conj, and v has gauge at most 1 under j, then the Gram pairing u*Gv is integral with respect to j: ℂ → ℂ_l.

declarations.name: letterPoly
declarations.says: The linear map sending ξ of weight κ to its polynomial toPoly ξ, with each variable (τ, i, h) replaced by ∑ X(τ, i, a) over s(a) = c, ord(a) = h.

declarations.name: maxCompactAt_le_levelOf
declarations.says: For w outside the places of u and their conjugates, the maximal compact subgroup at w lies in levelOf u H.

declarations.name: stdClassSum
declarations.says: The class sum classSum for the rational points of the standard definite space I_n, as a function of the level K and the summand.

declarations.name: CMLattice.deriv_mem_phiSeriesRing
declarations.says: The ring 𝔬[[φ]] of integral power series in φ, viewed as series in z over ℂ_p, is stable under d/dz.
declarations.note: amounts to φ′ ∈ 𝔬[[φ]], i.e. integrality of the invariant differential in the parameter φ; rests on the unit discriminant of the normalised cubic proved in the same file.

declarations.name: CMLattice.isSeriesGenerator_translatedWpDeriv
declarations.says: The Taylor series of φ, read in ℂ_p, has constant term 0 and linear coefficient 1 (since ℘′(t) = 0 and ℘″(t) = 2), so it is a generator of the ring 𝔬[[φ]].

declarations.name: CMLattice.norm_a₁_le_one
declarations.says: For d a prime ≡ 7 mod 8, a CM lattice and any embedding ι: ℂ → ℂ_p, the invariant a₁ is p-adically integral: |ι(a₁)| ≤ 1.
declarations.reference: integrality and good reduction of CM elliptic curves: J. Milne, Complex Multiplication (2020); for Weber's unit, B. Birch, Weber's class invariants, Mathematika 16 (1969), and M. Deuring, Die Klassenkörper der komplexen Multiplikation (1958)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: The known result (file header) is that for prime d ≡ 7 mod 8 the normalised CM cubic has unit discriminant at every prime (good reduction everywhere); the lemma is its consequence that a₁ is integral at every p-adic place. The file proves the unit discriminant by a monotone quantity along the cycle of 2-isogenies, without modular polynomials. REFERENCES.md: Milne place confirmed at second hand; Birch work found, no place given.

declarations.name: CMLattice.norm_monomialSection_le
declarations.says: For d a prime ≡ 7 mod 8, a ring map ι : ℂ → ℂ_p and x = (a, b, c), the monomial θ^a·σ^{2b}·G^c, G = CMLattice.phiThetaCube, satisfies |ι(value at w)| ≤ h(w)^{a+2b+3c}, with h the height CMLattice.naiveHeight.
declarations.note: immediate from the doubling bound for the naive height in the same file (h(2w) = h(w)⁴ and |G| ≤ h³), which uses good reduction.

declarations.name: CMLattice.norm_translate_le_naiveHeight_pow
declarations.says: Tate's trick. Let d ≡ 7 mod 8 be prime, a: C → C′ an isogeny of degree N, y torsion modulo Λ′, h, h′ the heights CMLattice.naiveHeight at a p-adic place ι. If |ιg| ≤ h′^m on ℂ, then |ι((U′^m_y g)(az))| ≤ h(z)^{mN} for all z.
declarations.reference: the technique (Tate's telescoping trick for local heights): J. Silverman, Advanced Topics in the Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves (1994), Ch. VI (file header)
declarations.note: a bespoke local-height bound for twisted torsion translates of the proof's theta function pulled back by an isogeny; the write-up must read the proof (25 lines).

declarations.name: CMLattice.phiSeriesRing
declarations.says: The subring 𝔬[[φ]] of ℂ_p[[z]]: integral power series in the Taylor series of φ read through ι.

declarations.name: CMLattice.taylorAtZero_congr
declarations.says: If two functions agree off the translated lattice t + Λ, they have the same Taylor series at 0.

declarations.name: CMLattice.taylorVia_translatedWp_mem_phiSeriesRing
declarations.says: Read in ℂ_p, the Taylor series of ξ(z) = ℘(z+t) − ℘(t) lies in 𝔬[[φ]].
declarations.note: integrality of the coordinate ξ in the parameter φ; uses the cubic relation and the integrality of a₁.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator
declarations.says: The series T has constant term 0 and linear coefficient 1, and A = 𝔬[[T]] consists exactly of the g(T) with g an integral series.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.exists_mul_eq_one
declarations.says: If B = 𝔬[[T]] and f ∈ B has constant term of absolute value 1, then f is a unit of B.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.exists_subst_inverse
declarations.says: A generator T of B = 𝔬[[T]] has a compositional inverse Z, and f ∈ B exactly when f∘Z has integral coefficients.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.generator_mem
declarations.says: A generator T of B = 𝔬[[T]] lies in B.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.norm_coeff_le_one
declarations.says: Every element of B = 𝔬[[T]] has constant and linear coefficients of absolute value at most 1.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.of_mem
declarations.says: An element of B = 𝔬[[T]] with constant term 0 and linear coefficient 1 is again a generator of B.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.rescale_mem
declarations.says: If the rescaled generator T(az) lies in B = 𝔬[[T]], then B is stable under rescaling z ↦ az.

declarations.name: IsSeriesGenerator.smul_mem
declarations.says: B = 𝔬[[T]] is stable under multiplication by scalars of absolute value at most 1.

declarations.name: expSubst
declarations.says: The series exp(a): a substituted into the exponential series over ℂ_p (meaningful when a has no constant term).

declarations.name: expSubst_add
declarations.says: exp(a + b) = exp(a)exp(b) for series a, b without constant term.

declarations.name: expSubst_sum
declarations.says: exp of a finite sum of series without constant term is the product of the exponentials.

declarations.name: norm_lt_one_of_eq_mul_add_mul
declarations.says: In ℂ_p, if |x|, |y| ≤ 1 and |u|, |v| < 1, then |xu + yv| < 1 (ultrametric inequality).

declarations.name: norm_natCast_eq_inv_pow_padicValNat
declarations.says: For n ≠ 0, |n|_p = p^{−v_p(n)} in ℂ_p.

declarations.name: padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc
declarations.says: For p prime and n < p^K, one has 0 ≤ n/(p−1) − v_p(n!) ≤ K, a consequence of Legendre's formula.
declarations.reference: Legendre's formula v_p(n!) = (n − s_p(n))/(p − 1)

declarations.name: rescale_subst
declarations.says: Rescaling z ↦ az commutes with substitution into a series T without constant term: (f∘T)(az) = f∘(T(az)).

declarations.name: rpow_le_norm_factorial
declarations.says: |n!|_p ≥ p^{−n/(p−1)} in ℂ_p (Legendre's formula).
declarations.reference: Legendre's formula

declarations.name: subst_rescale_eq_subst_smul
declarations.says: Substituting a into the rescaled series f(cz) equals substituting c·a into f.

declarations.name: G.mat_sum
declarations.says: The matrix of a block-diagonal element is the block-diagonal matrix of the blocks.

declarations.name: G.neg
declarations.says: The isomorphism between the adelic unitary groups for signs s and −s that is the identity on matrices, since U(J) = U(−J) at each infinite place.

declarations.name: G.reindex
declarations.says: For a bijection of index sets carrying signs s to signs t, the isomorphism of the corresponding adelic unitary groups relabelling rows and columns in every component.

declarations.name: G.sum
declarations.says: The block diagonal embedding of the product of the adelic unitary groups for signs s and t into the one for the concatenated signs.

declarations.name: IsPrimitiveMatrix.exists_map_subtype_eq
declarations.says: A matrix primitive over a subring O is the image of a matrix over O with a left inverse over O.

declarations.name: Space.move
declarations.says: For a space (J, x) and g in G, the space (J, xg): the same matrix with the point moved by g.

declarations.name: Space.neg
declarations.says: For stably unramified E and a space (J, x) with signs s, the space with signs −s, matrix −J and point x multiplied by the scalar normNegOneIdele.

declarations.name: Space.reindex
declarations.says: For a space V with signs s and an index bijection carrying s to t, the space with signs t obtained by relabelling its matrix and point.

declarations.name: Space.sum
declarations.says: For spaces V, W with signs s, t, the space with concatenated signs whose matrix and point are the block diagonal sums of those of V and W.

declarations.name: U.block
declarations.says: The block diagonal embedding U(1_m) × U(1_l) → U(1_n) of unitary groups of identity matrices, along a bijection of the disjoint union of m and l with n.

declarations.name: U.blockSumOne
declarations.says: The block diagonal homomorphism U_m(R) × U_n(R) → U_{m+n}(R), (g, h) ↦ diag(g, h), between the unitary groups of identity matrices.

declarations.name: U.reindex
declarations.says: For a bijection e of index sets carrying the matrix J to J', the group isomorphism U(J) ≅ U(J') relabelling rows and columns along e.

declarations.name: U.sum
declarations.says: For matrices J, J' with block diagonal sum J'', the homomorphism U(J) × U(J') → U(J'') sending (g,h) to the block diagonal matrix diag(g,h).

declarations.name: Weil.normNegOne
declarations.says: The chosen element of norm −1 of Ô, the finite part of normNegOneIdele, as a unit with inverse minus its conjugate.
declarations.note: a choice made possible by the hypothesis that E contains the 5040-th roots of unity.

declarations.name: blockGL
declarations.says: The homomorphism GL_m(R) × GL_n(R) → GL_{m+n}(R) sending (g, h) to the block diagonal matrix diag(g, h).

declarations.name: exists_orthonormal_mul
declarations.says: Gram–Schmidt: for a complex n × k matrix X with a left inverse there is an invertible b, block upper triangular for wt, such that X b has orthonormal columns.
declarations.reference: the Gram–Schmidt process

declarations.name: exists_orthonormal_Ô
declarations.says: For stably unramified CM E, a hermitian square matrix b with entries in Ô and a left inverse over Ô satisfies kᴴ b k = 1 for some k in GL_n(Ô).
declarations.reference: classification of unimodular hermitian lattices (R. Jacobowitz, Hermitian forms over local fields, Amer. J. Math. 84 (1962)); U. A. First (2015)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: only for the integral finite adeles of a stably unramified CM field (all unimodular hermitian lattices are standard there); the header of the family file AdaptedHom says the lattice case is proved by a polar decomposition.

declarations.name: gram_mkAdelicGL
declarations.says: If each archimedean component a_w carries J to diag(s) and the finite part b carries J to 1, the adelic matrix (a, b) carries J to the standard form.

declarations.name: reindexGL
declarations.says: For a bijection e of index sets, the isomorphism GL_m(R) ≅ GL_n(R) relabelling rows and columns along e.

declarations.name: signMatrix_sum
declarations.says: diag(sign(s), sign(t)) = sign(s ⊕ t).

declarations.name: signedSpace
declarations.says: For stably unramified E, the space I_{p,q} with matrix diag(s); its point is diagonal, with entry 1 where s_i = 1 and normNegOneIdele where s_i = −1.

declarations.name: star_normNegOne_mul_self
declarations.says: For stably unramified E, the chosen unit ε = Weil.normNegOne of Ô satisfies ε̄ε = −1 in the finite adeles of E.

declarations.name: stdForm_sum
declarations.says: diag(stdForm(s), stdForm(t)) = stdForm(s ⊕ t).

declarations.name: witt_Ohat_of_orthonormal
declarations.says: Witt over the integral finite adeles: two integral n × k matrices with orthonormal columns (XᴴX = YᴴY = 1) are related by some g in K₀ = GL_n(Ô) ∩ G_f: gX = Y.
declarations.reference: Witt's extension theorem over semiperfect rings: U. A. First, J. Pure Appl. Algebra 219 (2015); for lattices R. Jacobowitz (1962)
declarations.place: First, Cor. 4.9 and 4.11 (the header lists both without assigning them)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: only for primitive orthonormal frames of the identity form over the integral finite adeles of a CM field containing the roots of unity of order 5040. Place from the header of Lib/SiegelWeil/SingularForms/AdaptedHom; unchecked.

declarations.name: Filling.exists_basis_matrix
declarations.says: Every submodule L of Rⁿ (R a field) is the column span of an n × dim L matrix with a left inverse.

declarations.name: HasLeftInv
declarations.says: The n × k matrix X over R has a left inverse over R.

declarations.name: HasLeftInv.mulVec_injective
declarations.says: A matrix with a left inverse is injective as a linear map.

declarations.name: HasLeftInv.of_isUnit_gram
declarations.says: If the Gram matrix XᴴJX is invertible, X has a left inverse.

declarations.name: HasLeftInv.of_ker_le_bot
declarations.says: A matrix with trivial kernel (over a field) has a left inverse.

declarations.name: HasLeftInv.of_ne_zero
declarations.says: A non-zero column vector has a left inverse.

declarations.name: IsPrimitiveMatrix
declarations.says: The matrix X has entries in the subring O and a left inverse with entries in O.

declarations.name: IsValuationPair.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul
declarations.says: If (A, R) satisfies IsValuationPair and the n × k matrix X over A has a left inverse, there is an invertible b, block upper triangular for wt, such that X b has entries in R and a left inverse with entries in R.
declarations.note: Hermite reduction over a valuation pair.

declarations.name: IsValuationPair.exists_mul_clear_cols
declarations.says: Hermite form: if the subring R of A satisfies IsValuationPair, then for a k×n matrix M over A and an injection ι: k → n, some V in GL_n(R) makes the columns of MV outside the image of ι vanish.
declarations.reference: Hermite normal form over a valuation ring

declarations.name: IsValuationPair.hermite
declarations.says: Hermite form: if (A, R) satisfies IsValuationPair and ι embeds k in n, an n × k matrix y over A is U_ι D with U ∈ GL_n(R), U_ι its columns at ι, and D = (rows ι of U⁻¹)·y block upper triangular for wt.
declarations.reference: Hermite normal form over a valuation ring

declarations.name: apply_inr_of_mem_besselU
declarations.says: For x' in 𝖴, the entries in rows outside the first block and columns outside the last block are those of the identity: x' keeps the span X of the e_a and is trivial on X^⊥/X.

declarations.name: besselFrame_castSucc
declarations.says: The frame vector f_a for a < ϱ is the basis vector e_a.

declarations.name: besselFrame_injective
declarations.says: The frame vectors are distinct.

declarations.name: besselFrame_last
declarations.says: The last frame vector is z.

declarations.name: colSpan
declarations.says: The submodule of R^n spanned by the columns of the matrix X.

declarations.name: eq_one_of_mem_besselU_of_fix
declarations.says: An element of the unipotent group 𝖴 that fixes ϱ vectors whose coordinates at e*₁, …, e*_ϱ form the identity matrix is 1.

declarations.name: frameGram_inv_mul_mul
declarations.says: For x, x′ in 𝖴, Z(x′⁻¹γx) = M(x′)ᴴ Z(γ) M(x), with M the frame matrix.

declarations.name: frameMatrix_mul
declarations.says: The frame matrix is multiplicative on 𝖴.

declarations.name: frameMatrix_unitriangular
declarations.says: The frame matrix of an element of 𝖴 is unitriangular.

declarations.name: mem_besselU0_iff
declarations.says: x lies in 𝖴⁰ exactly when it lies in 𝖴 and its frame matrix is 1.

declarations.name: star_form
declarations.says: For hermitian J, conj(h(u, v)) = h(v, u).

declarations.name: submatrix_mul_besselFrame
declarations.says: Taking the frame columns of M·x′ equals multiplying the frame columns of M by the frame matrix of x′.

declarations.name: witt
declarations.says: Witt's theorem: over a field with involution having some z − z̄ ≠ 0, for invertible hermitian J, left invertible X, Y with XᴴJX = YᴴJY satisfy g X = Y for some g in U(J).
declarations.reference: Witt's extension theorem for hermitian forms: U. A. First, J. Pure Appl. Algebra 219 (2015); over fields J. Dieudonné, La géométrie des groupes classiques (1955)
declarations.place: First, Cor. 4.9 and 4.11 (the header lists both without assigning them)
declarations.relation: the theorem
declarations.note: over a field with a non-trivial involution, for an invertible hermitian J, stated for frames (left-invertible X, Y with XᴴJX = YᴴJY); proved by quasi-reflections. Place from the header of Lib/SiegelWeil/SingularForms/AdaptedHom (the family's known result); REFERENCES.md: Dieudonné work found, no place given; First not listed, so the place is unchecked.

declarations.name: BaseLevel
declarations.says: Base data: places S; a space Y of forms with an open-level character above S ∪ S̄, stable under operators commuting with K₀ there; all orders |Γ ∩ gK₀g⁻¹| divide m.
declarations.note: the base data of the proof's spaces of forms and their levels.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.Eigensystem
declarations.says: Systems of eigenvalues of level L: the isotypic spaces that contain a nonzero form of BaseLevel.formsOfLevel.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.ellIntegralForms
declarations.says: Integral forms: the O-module of forms whose values at all points integral above ℓ have coordinates that ι sends to ℓ-adic integers.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.formsOfLevel
declarations.says: The forms in Y that are fixed by the components off S ∪ S̄ of the principal level subgroup of K₀ at the places L.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.formsOfLevel_base_le
declarations.says: The forms of base level (empty family) are contained in the forms of every level L.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.integralEnd
declarations.says: The O-algebra of ℂ-linear endomorphisms of the space of forms BaseLevel.formsOfLevel that preserve its integral forms.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.localGroupAlgebra_le_endPreserving
declarations.says: For a place w not above ℓ, the local group algebra at w preserves the ℓ-integral forms.

declarations.name: EllAdicIntegers
declarations.says: The valuation ring of ℚ̄_ℓ, as a new type; it maps to ℂ by the inverse of the chosen isomorphism ιℓ from ℂ to ℚ̄_ℓ.

declarations.name: Isotypic
declarations.says: Isotypic spaces: for a system t of eigenvalues at all places, the space (possibly zero) of forms that are spherical eigenforms with eigenvalues t_w at almost all split w.

declarations.name: Isotypic.attached_galRep
declarations.says: A non-zero form in an isotypic space has an attached Galois representation in the artifact's sense: a continuous semisimple ρ : Gal(Ω/E) → GL_n(Q̄_ℓ) such that, for every η > 0, at most Frobenius elements (the filter of most degree-one Frobenii) the characteristic polynomial of ρ is coefficientwise within η, ℓ-adically, of the Hecke polynomial of the space at that place.
declarations.reference: Galois representations attached to automorphic forms on definite unitary groups: G. Chenevier, M. Harris, Construction of automorphic Galois representations II, Camb. J. Math. 1 (2013); with J.-P. Labesse (2011) and T. Barnet-Lamb, T. Gee, D. Geraghty, R. Taylor (2014)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: weaker than the published attachment (equality of characteristic polynomials at all unramified split places): here only ℓ-adic closeness at most Frobenius elements. The Lean proof is three lines quoting the artifact's own construction (Lib/GaloisRep/Main/AvatarCompatibility, sphericalCompat_std), whose header says that for the standard definite form and a CM field with enough roots of unity the Hecke polynomials are ℓ-adically close to characteristic polynomials at most Frobenius elements and kill Frobenius at spherical split places, proved by ℓ-adic limits and theta lifts with no eigenvariety or patching. Place from that header; REFERENCES.md: Chenevier–Harris work found, no place given.

declarations.name: Isotypic.galRep
declarations.says: A chosen representation Gal(Ω/E) → GL_n(Q̄_ℓ) attached to the Hecke polynomials of the isotypic space x; arbitrary if none exists.

declarations.name: Isotypic.heckePolyAt
declarations.says: The Hecke polynomial at w, of degree the rank n, formed from the chosen eigenvalues of the isotypic space x at w.

declarations.name: Isotypic.isEigenform
declarations.says: A non-zero member of an isotypic space is a Hecke eigenform with the space's Hecke polynomials.

declarations.name: Isotypic.map_mem
declarations.says: Elements of the local group algebra preserve isotypic spaces.

declarations.name: TaylorWilesPlaces
declarations.says: Auxiliary places: a family x_j (j in J) of FrobeniusDatum data at distinct places w_j of prime norm q_j ≡ 1 mod m, no conjugate w̄_i being among the w_j.

declarations.name: TaylorWilesPlaces.w
declarations.says: The auxiliary place w_j of Q with index j.

declarations.name: commute_of_mem_localGroupAlgebra
declarations.says: Elements of the local group algebra at w commute with translations trivial at w.

declarations.name: eigenformsAt
declarations.says: The forms that, if w is split, are spherical at w with T_{w,j} f = t_j f for all j; all forms if w is not split.

declarations.name: exists_isotypic_of_isSphericalOff
declarations.says: A nonzero form of maximal level off S that is a spherical Hecke eigenform at every split w with w, w̄ not in S lies in some isotypic space.

declarations.name: hasHeckePolyAt_of_mem_eigenformsAt
declarations.says: A form in the eigenspace at w with eigenvalues t has the Hecke polynomial built from t at w.

declarations.name: heckeFun_mem_localGroupAlgebra
declarations.says: Hecke operators at a split place w lie in the local group algebra at w.

declarations.name: iota_ell_algebraMap
declarations.says: ι_ℓ is compatible with the inclusion of the ℓ-adic integers.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.apply_det_eq_charOfTamePart
declarations.says: If ν has weight e and tame part ψ trivial off the places of 𝔪, then for k in K₀ the value of ν at det k is the character of O_E/𝔪 built from ψ, evaluated at det(k mod 𝔪).

declarations.name: IsTameFor
declarations.says: 𝔪 ≠ (1), ν has weight e and tame part (ψ_w) nontrivial exactly at the primes w dividing 𝔪, and χ = ∏ψ_w on O_E/𝔪.

declarations.name: IsTameFor.apply_det
declarations.says: If ν is tame for 𝔪 with character χ, then ν(det k) = χ(det(k mod 𝔪)) for k in K₀.

declarations.name: IsTameFor.inv
declarations.says: If ν is tame for 𝔪 with character χ, weight e, then ν⁻¹ is tame for 𝔪 with χ⁻¹, weight −e.

declarations.name: IsTameFor.mul
declarations.says: Multiplying a character tame for 𝔪 by a character of weight d with trivial tame part keeps it tame for 𝔪, with weight e + d.

declarations.name: LevelPlaces.levelModulus
declarations.says: The modulus M^c·Q, or M^c if b is false, where M and Q are the products of the primes in the two families of S.
declarations.note: the level modulus built from the proof's chosen places and twist places.

declarations.name: Modulus.charOfTamePart
declarations.says: The multiplicative character x ↦ ∏_{w∣𝔪} ψ_w(x mod w) of O_E/𝔪, for characters ψ_w of the residue fields.

declarations.name: Modulus.levelOfSubgroup
declarations.says: The level cut out by a subgroup H of GL_n(O_E/𝔪): the elements of K_0 (Kf) whose reduction modulo 𝔪 lies in H, as a subgroup of G_f.

declarations.name: Modulus.matrix_ext_modulusResidue
