declarations.says: Chinese remainder theorem: if the ideal of 𝔪 is the product of distinct primes w_i, two matrices over O_E/𝔪 are equal if and only if their reductions at every w_i are equal.

declarations.name: Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff
declarations.says: If the ideal of 𝔪 is principal, generated by a, then k lies in the principal congruence level of a exactly when k ≡ 1 mod 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.principalLevel_le_levelOfSubgroup
declarations.says: For a ∈ 𝔪, the principal congruence level of a lies in the level cut out by any subgroup H of GL_n(O_E/𝔪).

declarations.name: Modulus.stdLevelIndex_levelOfSubgroup
declarations.says: The index of the level cut out by H in the standard level equals the index of H.

declarations.name: exists_reductionK₀_eq
declarations.says: Every g in GL_n(O_E/𝔪) is the reduction modulo 𝔪 of an element of K₀ supported on the places dividing 𝔪 and their conjugates.
declarations.note: strong approximation for the finite product of residue rings (Chinese remainder theorem).

declarations.name: fockPairing_polarisation
declarations.says: Polarisation: suppose M(q(uᵀY)) = K(u) for all tuples u of unitary n×n matrices. Then ⟨q, ∏_τ det(rows r)^{#ι_τ}⟩·M(∏ det(η_{τk}Y_τ)) = ⟨K, ∏ det(η_{τk}X_τ)⟩ in the Fock pairing, X_τ being the columns r of the generic n×n matrix.
declarations.note: a polarisation identity for the Fock pairing (20 lines), used in the theta-lift computations; no source cited; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: levelResidueAt
declarations.says: For a place i among the chosen and twist places, the reduction homomorphism from the residue ring modulo M^c·Q (c ≥ 1) to the residue field at that place.

declarations.name: liftMod
declarations.says: A chosen lift of g ∈ GL_n(O_E/𝔪) to K₀, with component 1 outside the places dividing 𝔪 and their conjugates.

declarations.name: pairedDetProd
declarations.says: The element ∏_τ ∏_k det(η_{τk} Y_τ) of the ℂ-algebra S, for n×a matrices Y_τ over S and complex a×n matrices η_{τk}.

declarations.name: places_levelModulus
declarations.says: The places of the level modulus are exactly the chosen places and the twist places.

declarations.name: prod_places_le_iff
declarations.says: A product of distinct primes is contained in the prime w exactly when one of them is w.

declarations.name: reductionK₀_liftMod
declarations.says: The reduction modulo 𝔪 of the chosen lift of g is g.

declarations.name: reductionK₀_surjective
declarations.says: Reduction from K₀ to GL_n(O_E/𝔪) is surjective.

declarations.name: IsEquivariantLift
declarations.says: 𝒟 maps a GL_m-stable space M of Schwartz–Bruhat functions at S, supported on matrices with a left inverse, to automorphic functions on U(X), equivariantly at S up to ρ(det), with values fixed by K₀ away from S.

declarations.name: ReadsAt
declarations.says: π reads the components at A: A is disjoint from its conjugate, π is continuous with a continuous additive section σ, σ(πx) being the A-part of x, and π(x) ∈ O iff x is integral at A.

declarations.name: ReadsAt.star
declarations.says: Reading components at A is compatible with conjugation: if π reads the components at A, then π∘(complex conjugation) reads them at Ā.

declarations.name: RepresentedBy
declarations.says: At every infinite place, the component of T has the form c* diag(t) c for some complex square matrix c.

declarations.name: SplitTameChar
declarations.says: A character ν of [U(1)] of positive weight e with tame part ψ non-trivial exactly on a non-empty finite set S of places disjoint from its conjugate.

declarations.name: SplitTameChar.localChar_apply_of_isUnit
declarations.says: For a split tame character, the local character at a unit u is the product of the residue characters ψ_i(u mod w_i).

declarations.name: SplitTameChar.readsAt
declarations.says: Evaluation at the places S of a split tame character reads the components at S.

declarations.name: SplitTameChar.tameLocalChar
declarations.says: The residue rings at S and their characters.
declarations.note: an instance supplying the residue rings at S with their characters.

declarations.name: atPlaces
declarations.says: The homomorphism G_f → GL_n(∏_{w∈P} E_w) sending an element to its components at P.

declarations.name: atRealPlace
declarations.says: The complex matrix of components of the adelic matrix x at the infinite place v.

declarations.name: componentsAt
declarations.says: The ring map sending an adele to its components at the ramified places S of 𝔠.

declarations.name: evalPlaces_mem_O
declarations.says: Evaluation at the places P maps integral adeles to integral elements.

declarations.name: gram_map_real
declarations.says: At a real place, the components satisfy x_vᴴ·diag(signs)·x_v = (xᴴ J x)_v: the Gram matrix commutes with taking components.

declarations.name: isIntegralUnit_iff_v_eq_one
declarations.says: An element of ∏_{w∈P} E_w is an integral unit exactly when all its components have valuation 1.

declarations.name: localChar
declarations.says: The multiplicative character of ∏_{w∈P} E_w that is t ↦ ξ(t)|t|^{k/2} on invertible elements, t read as an idele, and 0 on the others.

declarations.name: localDatum
declarations.says: The datum in 𝒮(Hom(S,T)) with real part v, the function Ψ of the components at A, read through π, and the vacuum at the other finite places.

declarations.name: namedVector
declarations.says: The vector of 𝒮(Hom(S,T)) named, in the model at the places A, by the function x ↦ Ψ(πx) of finite adelic matrices, applied to the vacuum.

declarations.name: residueAt
declarations.says: The ring map from the integers of ∏_{w∈P} E_w to the residue field at the place i of P.

declarations.name: thetaIntegral
declarations.says: The function g ↦ ∫ θ^{S,T}_{a,b}(f)(g,h) dh on U(S), the integral taken over [U(T)].

declarations.name: GaugeLe
declarations.says: The bound c for the form φ read at d: the gauge of φ(g) at gd and ι is at most c for every g.

declarations.name: Kf_le_localLevel
declarations.says: K₀ is contained in every local level built from the integral matrices.

declarations.name: StdClasses
declarations.says: The set of classes of I_n at level K: double cosets of the finite adelic unitary group by its rational points on the left and K on the right.

declarations.name: adeleExtension_mem_intGL
declarations.says: If k is integral above p, its image under the extension of σ is an integral matrix.

declarations.name: embValRing
declarations.says: The valuation ring O_ι ⊂ ℂ of complex numbers whose image under ι : ℂ → ℂ_p has absolute value at most 1.

declarations.name: exists_mul_mem_integralAbove
declarations.says: Some rational γ makes γg and dγgd⁻¹ integral above p (weak approximation).

declarations.name: exists_reps_integralAbove
declarations.says: Every class of the standard space at level K has a representative integral above p.

declarations.name: integralFormsAt
declarations.says: The O_ι-module of forms φ in S that are integral at d: the value φ(g) has gauge at most 1 at gd for every g.

declarations.name: sqrt_weylNormSq_le_of_dual
declarations.says: Duality for the Gram norm, σ an automorphism of ℂ: if |σ(c·v)| ≤ C for every c with |σ(c·w)| ≤ ‖σ(w)‖ for all w, then ‖σ(v)‖ ≤ C.

declarations.name: sqrt_weylNormSq_sum_le
declarations.says: The Gram norm of a finite sum of vectors is at most the sum of the Gram norms (triangle inequality).

declarations.name: weylGauge_deltaForm_le
declarations.says: For K inside the stabiliser of the standard lattice and χ with values of finite order, the delta form attached to χ, x, v has, at every point g, gauge at ι at most the gauge of v at x.

declarations.name: weylGauge_embFin
declarations.says: The gauge is invariant under the rational action: gauge(γg, ρ(γ)ξ) = gauge(g, ξ).

declarations.name: weylGauge_le_one_iff
declarations.says: For k integral above p, the gauge of ξ at k is at most 1 exactly when all ι_p(ξ_i) are integral.

declarations.name: weylGauge_le_one_of_integralAbove
declarations.says: If φ is integral at every point integral above p, its gauge is at most 1 everywhere.

declarations.name: weylGauge_mul
declarations.says: The gauge of ξ at g is unchanged when g is multiplied on the right by an element k integral above p.

declarations.name: weylGauge_smul
declarations.says: gauge(g, cξ) = |ι_p(c)|·gauge(g, ξ).

declarations.name: weylGauge_sum_le
declarations.says: If each term has gauge at most C ≥ 0, so has their sum (ultrametric).

declarations.name: weylNormSq_deltaForm_le
declarations.says: For a level K with a character χ whose values have finite order and σ ∈ Aut ℂ, the value at any g of the delta form δ_x(v) on U(I_n) satisfies ‖σ δ_x(v)(g)‖² ≤ |Aut(x)|²·‖σ v‖² in the Gram norm.

declarations.name: ClosurePlace
declarations.says: The valuation subrings of Ω: its finite places, together with Ω itself (the trivial valuation).

declarations.name: IsComplexConj
declarations.says: The element c of Γ is a complex conjugation: for some embedding j : Ω → ℂ, j(cx) is the complex conjugate of j(x) for all x.

declarations.name: IsFrob
declarations.says: σ stabilises A and σx ≡ x^q modulo the maximal ideal for all x in A; for q the residue order of the base, an arithmetic Frobenius.

declarations.name: IsFrob.conj
declarations.says: Conjugating a q-Frobenius at A by g gives a q-Frobenius at gA.

declarations.name: IsFrob.inv_mul
declarations.says: Two q-Frobenius elements at A differ by an element of inertia.

declarations.name: IsFrob.map
declarations.says: Frobenius elements are carried along compatible maps of fields and Galois groups.

declarations.name: IsFrob.mul_iff
declarations.says: If σ is a Frobenius at A for the exponent q, then στ is a Frobenius for qq' exactly when τ is a Frobenius for q'.

declarations.name: IsFrob.pow
declarations.says: The n-th power of a q-Frobenius at A is a q^n-Frobenius.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver
declarations.says: The valuation subring A of Ω lies over the prime v of K: an integer of K is in the maximal ideal of A exactly when it lies in v.

declarations.name: conj_mem_decompGroup_smul
declarations.says: Conjugation by g carries the decomposition group of A onto that of gA.

declarations.name: cycChar
declarations.says: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character Γ → ℤ_ℓ^× of a group Γ acting on the field Ω by ring automorphisms.

declarations.name: cycCharIn
declarations.says: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character of Γ composed with ℤ_ℓ^× → O^×, for a commutative ℤ_ℓ-algebra O.

declarations.name: decompGroup
declarations.says: The decomposition group of a valuation subring A of Ω: the elements of Γ mapping A onto itself.

declarations.name: decompGroup.map
declarations.says: Decomposition groups are carried along compatible maps of fields and Galois groups.

declarations.name: inertiaGroup
declarations.says: The inertia group of A: the σ in Γ stabilising the valuation subring A with σx − x in the maximal ideal for every x in A.

declarations.name: unitsRep
declarations.says: The ℤ-linear representation of Γ on Ω^× (written additively) coming from the action of Γ on the field Ω by ring automorphisms.

declarations.name: val_comap_lt_one
declarations.says: Valuations compare under comap along a field embedding: |x| < 1 for the pulled-back valuation exactly when |j(x)| < 1.

declarations.name: valuationVia
declarations.says: For a valuation subring A of Ω and x in K, the value of the image of x in Ω under the multiplicative valuation attached to A.

entries.known_result: sigma and theta functions of a lattice, addition and doubling formulas, and uniformisation

declarations.name: CMLattice
declarations.says: A lattice Λ, a point t of order two with g₂ = 12℘(t)² − 4 (that is, ℘″(t) = 2), and a₁ with a₁² = 12℘(t); if d ≠ 0, also 𝒪_K Λ ⊂ Λ and ωt, ω̄t ∉ Λ.
declarations.note: the proof's normalisation of a CM elliptic curve for K = ℚ(√−d): the origin moved to a 2-torsion point t with ℘″(t) = 2, and a₁ with a₁² = 12℘(t); to be defined in the text.

declarations.name: CMLattice.exists_latticeModule_eq_scaledIdeal
declarations.says: The lattice of every CM datum is a scaled fractional ideal u𝔞 of K (u ∈ ℂ^×).
declarations.reference: J. Silverman, Advanced Topics in the Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves, II.1 (a lattice with 𝒪_K Λ ⊂ Λ is homothetic to a fractional ideal)

declarations.name: CMLattice.latticeModule
declarations.says: The lattice Λ of a CM datum regarded as an 𝒪_K-submodule of ℂ.

declarations.name: CMLattice.multiplier_eq_canonicalMultiplier
declarations.says: For z in the lattice Λ of a CM datum (d ≡ 7 mod 8), the multiplier of its theta function at z is the canonical one for multiplication by ω̄: χ(z) = exp(πi E(ω̄z, z)), with ω = (1+√−d)/2 and E the Riemann form of the hermitian form H.
declarations.note: follows from the Appell–Humbert description of the multiplier proved in the same theory.

declarations.name: CMLattice.translatedWp
declarations.says: The function z ↦ ℘(z+t)−℘(t) for the lattice Λ and its 2-torsion point t.

declarations.name: CMLattice.translatedWpDeriv
declarations.says: The function φ(z)=½(℘′(z+t)−a₁ξ(z)), where ξ(z)=℘(z+t)−℘(t).

declarations.name: CMLattice.twistedTranslate
declarations.says: The twisted translation by y for the form mH: (U^m_y F)(z) = exp(−mπ(zȳ + |y|²/2)/A)·F(z + y), A the area of Λ.

declarations.name: QuadField.area_eq_of_eq_scaledIdeal
declarations.says: Let d be a prime ≡ 7 mod 8. If the lattice of C equals u𝔞, with x = (u, 𝔞), u ∈ ℂ^× and 𝔞 a nonzero fractional ideal of K = ℚ(√−d), then its area is |u|²·N(𝔞)·√d/2.
declarations.note: the area of a fundamental domain of a fractional ideal 𝔞 of K is N(𝔞)√d/2.

declarations.name: QuadField.exists_latticeModule_eq_scaledIdeal
declarations.says: For d a prime ≡ 7 mod 8, every nonzero fractional ideal 𝔠 of K has a multiple u𝔠, u ∈ ℂ^×, that is the lattice of a CM datum.
declarations.note: existence of the normalisation (scaling a lattice so that ℘″ = 2 at a 2-torsion point); 25 lines, routine.

declarations.name: QuadField.mem_scaledIdeal
declarations.says: z lies in u𝔞 exactly when z = uy for some y ∈ 𝔞.

declarations.name: QuadField.scaledIdeal
declarations.says: The monoid homomorphism (u, 𝔞) ↦ u𝔞 from pairs of a nonzero complex number and a nonzero fractional ideal of K to 𝓞_K-submodules of ℂ.

declarations.name: conj_mem_quadInt
declarations.says: The image of 𝒪_K in ℂ is stable under complex conjugation.

declarations.name: linearSeries
declarations.says: The linear form ∑ c_i z_i, as a power series in the variables z_i.

declarations.name: quadGen
declarations.says: The complex number ω = (1 + i√d)/2.

declarations.name: quadInt
declarations.says: The image in ℂ of the ring of integers of K = ℚ(i√d), as a subring of ℂ.

declarations.name: taylorAtZero
declarations.says: The Taylor series ∑ f⁽ⁿ⁾(0) zⁿ/n! at 0 of a function f : ℂ → ℂ, as a formal power series.

declarations.name: taylorVia
declarations.says: The Taylor series of f at 0 with the ring homomorphism ι : ℂ → K applied to its coefficients.

declarations.name: CharUnramifiedAt
declarations.says: The condition that the finite idele character ψ is trivial on the local units at the finite place v.

declarations.name: HasPrimeDensity.sum
declarations.says: Prime densities are linear: a finite linear combination of sequences with prime densities l_i has the combined density.

declarations.name: abs_log_norm_eulerProd_le
declarations.says: If |a_v| ≤ 1 for all v and s ≥ σ ≥ 2 are real, the Euler product with coefficients a is non-zero at s, and the logarithm of its modulus has absolute value at most 2[K:ℚ]·2^{2−σ}.

declarations.name: eulerProd
declarations.says: The Euler product exp(−∑_v log(1 − a_v q_v^{−s})) over the primes of K, a function of real s > 1, extended to s = 1 by the limit from the right.

declarations.name: eulerProd_eq_exp
declarations.says: If |a_v| ≤ 1 and s > 1, the series ∑_v log(1 − a_v q_v^{−s}) converges, its sum is continuous at s, and eulerProd at s is the exponential of minus this sum.

declarations.name: eulerProd_erase
declarations.says: For |a_v| ≤ 1, Q finite and P(s) = ∏_{w∈Q}(1 − a_w q_w^{−s}): P is analytic at the real point 1, P(1) ≠ 0, and for real s > 1 putting the coefficients at Q to zero multiplies the Euler product by P(s).

declarations.name: finIdeleIncl
declarations.says: The homomorphism from the finite ideles of K to the units of 𝔸 K sending a to (1, a), with component 1 at every infinite place.

declarations.name: hasProd_eulerProd
declarations.says: If |a_v| ≤ 1 for all primes v of K and s > 1 is real, the Euler product ∏_v (1 − a_v q_v^{−s})^{−1} converges unconditionally to the value of eulerProd for a at s.

declarations.name: heckeCoeff
declarations.says: The function on finite places sending v outside S to the value of ψ at the local idele of the chosen uniformiser at v, and v in S to 0.

declarations.name: ideleAt
declarations.says: The homomorphism sending a finite idele to its component in K_v^×.

declarations.name: idelesUnitOff
declarations.says: The group of finite ideles of K whose components at all places outside S are units.

declarations.name: idelesUnitOff_mono
declarations.says: The group of finite ideles that are units outside S grows with S.

declarations.name: isOpen_idelesUnitOff
declarations.says: The group of finite ideles that are units outside S is open.

declarations.name: locIdele
declarations.says: The homomorphism sending x ∈ K_v^× to the finite idele with component x at v and 1 elsewhere.

declarations.name: locIdele_mem_idelesUnitOff
declarations.says: The local idele of a unit at v is a unit outside every S.

declarations.name: mem_idelesUnitOff
declarations.says: A finite idele is a unit outside S exactly when all its components outside S have valuation 1.

declarations.name: principalIdele
declarations.says: The diagonal homomorphism from K^× to the finite ideles of K.

declarations.name: IsFrob.cycChar_eq
declarations.says: If σ is a q-Frobenius at a place A not above l, then the l-adic cyclotomic character takes the value q at σ.

declarations.name: IsFrob.mem_ker_cycCharMod_iff
declarations.says: Let Ω be algebraically closed of characteristic 0, N ≥ 1 a unit of A, and σ stabilise A with σx ≡ x^q on A. Then σ fixes the N-th roots of unity if and only if q ≡ 1 mod N.

declarations.name: continuous_cycChar
declarations.says: The l-adic cyclotomic character of a profinite Galois group is continuous.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_eq_iff
declarations.says: The mod-N cyclotomic character takes the value a at g exactly when g acts on every N-th root of unity by ζ ↦ ζ^a.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_eq_of_dvd
declarations.says: If M divides N and the mod-N cyclotomic character of g is a, then so is its mod-M character.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_eq_of_isPrimitiveRoot
declarations.says: If g sends a primitive N-th root of unity ζ to ζ^a, then the mod-N cyclotomic character of g is a.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_eq_one_of_dvd
declarations.says: If M divides N and g is in the kernel of the mod-N cyclotomic character, then g is in the kernel of the mod-M character.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_of_mem_inertiaGroup
declarations.says: Inertia at a place A where N is a unit acts trivially on N-th roots of unity.

declarations.name: cycCharMod_prime_pow_eq
declarations.says: The mod-l^r cyclotomic character is the reduction of the l-adic cyclotomic character.

declarations.name: cycChar_of_mem_inertiaGroup
declarations.says: Inertia at a place A not above l is in the kernel of the l-adic cyclotomic character.

declarations.name: cycloField
declarations.says: The cyclotomic field ℚ(ζ_N) inside ℚ̄, defined as the fixed field of cycloGalGroup N.

declarations.name: eq_of_pow_eq_one_of_val_sub_lt
declarations.says: Let A be a valuation subring of a field Ω and x, y in Ω with x^N = y^N = 1. If the multiplicative A-valuation of x − y is strictly smaller than that of N, then x = y.

declarations.name: map_cycCharMod_mul
declarations.says: An additive map μ into the roots of unity (written additively) carries multiplication by the cyclotomic character of g to the action of g.

declarations.name: map_cycChar_smul
declarations.says: Let Ω be algebraically closed of characteristic 0, A a ℤ_l-module and f : A → B additive with image killed by l^r. Then f(χ_l(σ)x) = χ_{l^r}(σ)·f(x), with χ_l the l-adic and χ_{l^r} the mod l^r cyclotomic character.

declarations.name: pow_dvd_cycChar_sub_iff
declarations.says: l^r divides χ_l(σ) − q exactly when the mod-l^r cyclotomic character of σ equals q.

declarations.name: Gf.commute_supportedOn_trivialOn
declarations.says: Elements supported on S commute with elements trivial on S.

declarations.name: Gf.componentOn
declarations.says: The endomorphism of G_f that keeps the components of g at the places of S ∪ S̄ and replaces all other components by 1.

declarations.name: Gf.componentOn_mem_Kf
declarations.says: The S-component of an element of K₀ lies in K₀.

declarations.name: Gf.ext
declarations.says: Two elements of G_f with the same component at every place are equal.

declarations.name: Gf.mem_Kf_iff_of_supportedOn
declarations.says: An element supported on S lies in K₀ exactly when its components at S are integral.

declarations.name: Gf.mem_supportedOn
declarations.says: g is supported on S exactly when its component is 1 at every place w with w, w̄ ∉ S.

declarations.name: Gf.mem_trivialOn
declarations.says: g is trivial on S exactly when its component at every place of S is 1.

declarations.name: Gf.supportedOn_mono
declarations.says: Support on S implies support on any larger T.

declarations.name: Set.Finite.cj
declarations.says: The conjugation closure of a finite set of places is finite.

declarations.name: Set.IsConjDisjoint
declarations.says: The set S of finite places is disjoint from its complex conjugate: its places are not self-conjugate, and it holds at most one place of each conjugate pair.

declarations.name: Set.conjClosure
declarations.says: The set S ∪ S̄ of the finite places in S and their complex conjugates.

declarations.name: atPlace_atSplit_of_ne
declarations.says: The image of a split-place element has component 1 at every place other than w, w̄.

declarations.name: atSplit_mem_supportedOn
declarations.says: The image of a split-place element is supported on {w}.

declarations.name: map_evalAt_cutGL
declarations.says: The cut of g along idem(S) has component g_w at w ∈ S and 1 elsewhere.

entries.known_result: reduction theory, namely Mahler-Godement compactness, finite covolume and adelic Minkowski theorems

declarations.name: Space.Form
declarations.says: The complex vector space of forms of type e for the space V, as a type; it carries the Petersson inner product.

declarations.name: Space.IsAutomorphic
declarations.says: F on G is automorphic: continuous, left Γ-invariant, and right invariant under some open subgroup of G_f.

declarations.name: Space.IsAutomorphic.comp_mul_right
declarations.says: Right translates of automorphic functions are automorphic.

declarations.name: Space.IsAutomorphic.conj
declarations.says: The complex conjugate of an automorphic function is automorphic.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm
declarations.says: F is a form of type e, for a function e on G_∞: F is automorphic, bounded, and R(e)F = F if e is integrable.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.comp_mul_right
declarations.says: Right translates by finite adelic elements of forms of type e are forms of type e.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.isBoundedMeasurable
declarations.says: A form of type e is bounded and measurable.

declarations.name: Space.formRep
declarations.says: The representation of G_f on forms of type e by right translation.

declarations.name: Space.isAutomorphic_const
declarations.says: Constant functions are automorphic.

declarations.name: Space.petersson
declarations.says: The Petersson product ⟨F, F'⟩ = ∫_{Γ\G} conj(F) F', taken with the measure Space.quotMeasure.

declarations.name: Space.quotMeasure
declarations.says: The measure on G that computes integrals over the quotient Γ\G for the space V: Haar measure weighted by a chosen cutoff for counting measure on Γ.

declarations.name: finRightRep
declarations.says: The representation of G_f on complex functions on G by right translation.

declarations.name: realConv
declarations.says: Right convolution over the real points: R(k)F(g) = ∫_{G_∞} k(x) F(gx) dx, for k on G_∞ and F on G.

declarations.name: typeKernel
declarations.says: The function x ↦ ∏_w e_{l_w}(x_w) on G_∞, the product over the infinite places of the functions dsKernel on U(diag s) with parameters l_w.

declarations.name: IsFromU1
declarations.says: χ is locally constant and χ(Art x) = η(x/x̄), η a character of finite ideles trivial on E^× and on ideles that off S ∪ S̄ are units and ≡ 1 at the places of I outside S ∪ S̄.
declarations.note: the Galois-side condition for characters that come from U(1) (anticyclotomic characters x ↦ η(x/x̄) through the Artin map); the proof's twists ϑ are of this kind.

declarations.name: UnramCMField
declarations.says: E is a CM number field, stably unramified (StablyUnram), with an embedding in the algebraic closure Ω of ℚ.
declarations.note: StablyUnram means that E contains a primitive 5040-th root of unity: a bespoke hypothesis of this proof.

declarations.name: cmConj
declarations.says: A complex conjugation in Gal(Ω/ℚ), chosen once and for all.

declarations.name: cmConj_algebraMap
declarations.says: For a CM field E embedded in Ω, the chosen complex conjugation of Ω restricts to the complex conjugation of E.

declarations.name: conjGal
declarations.says: The endomorphism g ↦ g^c = cgc of the Galois group of Ω over E, c the chosen complex conjugation.

declarations.name: cycInv
declarations.says: The inverse of the ℓ-adic cyclotomic character of Gal(Ω/E), with values in the ℤ_ℓ-algebra Λ.

declarations.name: ellVal
declarations.says: The valuation −log_ℓ|x| in [0, ∞], normalised by v(ℓ) = 1; it is ∞ at 0, and 0 for |x| ≥ 1.

declarations.name: isComplexConj_cmConj
declarations.says: The chosen element c = cmConj of Gal(Ω/ℚ) is a complex conjugation: for some embedding j : Ω → ℂ, j(cx) is the complex conjugate of j(x) for all x.

declarations.name: placesDividing
declarations.says: For a natural number N, the set of finite places of E whose prime ideal contains N.

declarations.name: selmerModule
declarations.says: The Selmer module: locally constant cocycles for ρ with values in B^n, unramified outside S and obeying the relations L.

declarations.name: shaLocalSet
declarations.says: The union over places above ℓ of the inertia groups if e = 0, and of the kernels of cyc in the decomposition groups if e ≠ 0.

declarations.name: shaOdd
declarations.says: The locally constant cocycles z in (Λ/ℓ^νΛ)(−e), unramified outside ℓ, vanishing on shaLocalSet for e, and, if e ≠ 0, odd: z(g^c) = −z(g).
declarations.note: the odd part of a Tate-twisted Tate–Shafarevich group in cocycle form.

declarations.name: tateTwist
declarations.says: The rank-one representation Λ(−e): the character cyc^{−e} with values in Λ, as 1 × 1 matrices.

declarations.name: twistRep
declarations.says: Given a ring map e:O→O', a character ψ:G→O' and a matrix representation ρ over O, the representation g ↦ ψ(g)·e(ρ(g)) over O'.

declarations.name: coe_star_Ô
declarations.says: The conjugate of an integral finite adele, as an element of Ô, is its conjugate as an adele.

declarations.name: idem
declarations.says: The finite adele with component 1 at the places in S and 0 at the other places.

declarations.name: idem_apply
declarations.says: The idempotent of S has component 1 at the places of S and 0 elsewhere.

declarations.name: idem_compl
declarations.says: The idempotent of the complement of S is 1 minus that of S.

declarations.name: idem_mem_Ô
declarations.says: The idempotent of S is integral.

declarations.name: idem_mul_mem_Ô
declarations.says: idem(S)·x is integral exactly when x is integral at the places of S.

declarations.name: idem_mul_self
declarations.says: The idempotent of S is idempotent.

declarations.name: q_star
declarations.says: A place and its conjugate have the same norm.

declarations.name: reduceAt_eq_zero
declarations.says: An integral adele reduces to 0 modulo w exactly when its component at w has valuation below 1.

declarations.name: reduceAt_idem
declarations.says: The reduction of the idempotent of S modulo w is 1 if w ∈ S and 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: star_idem
declarations.says: The conjugate of idem(S) is the idempotent of the conjugate set.

declarations.name: v_inv
declarations.says: The component of the inverse of a finite idele at w is the inverse of its component, which is non-zero.

declarations.name: algebraMap_ResField_eq_zero
declarations.says: An integer of E maps to 0 in the residue field at w exactly when it lies in w.

declarations.name: algebraMap_ResField_surjective
declarations.says: The map from the integers of E to the residue field at w is surjective.

declarations.name: algebraMap_mem_Ô
declarations.says: An element of E is an integral finite adele exactly when it is an algebraic integer.

declarations.name: card_ResField
declarations.says: The residue field at w has w.q = N(w) elements.

declarations.name: coe_mem_Ô
declarations.says: Integers of E are integral finite adeles.

declarations.name: denseRange_algebraMap_finAdele
declarations.says: E is dense in its finite adeles.

declarations.name: exists_forall_mul_mem_Ô
declarations.says: Finitely many finite adeles are made integral by a common non-zero integer N.

declarations.name: exists_natCast_smul_mem_of_isCompact
declarations.says: Let M be a module over the finite adeles of E with a topology making scalar multiplication continuous. For K compact and U a neighbourhood of 0 in M, some nonzero natural number N has Nx in U for all x in K.

declarations.name: isCompact_Ô
declarations.says: The integral finite adeles Ô form a compact set.

declarations.name: isOpen_Ô
declarations.says: Ô is open in the finite adeles.

declarations.name: isUnit_natCast_finAdele
declarations.says: Non-zero integers are units in the finite adeles.

declarations.name: star_algebraMap_finAdele
declarations.says: Conjugation of the finite adele of x ∈ E is the finite adele of x̄.

declarations.name: star_mem_Ô
declarations.says: The conjugate of an integral finite adele is integral.

entries.known_result: Abstract Hecke operators of a pair (G,K), level eigenspaces and weighted class sums

declarations.name: HasFiniteType
declarations.says: Finiteness for Γ and K in G: K is open and compact, Γ\G/K is finite, and every stabiliser Γ ∩ gKg⁻¹ is finite.

declarations.name: HasFiniteType.of_le
declarations.says: The finiteness condition HasFiniteType for Γ and K (K open and compact, finitely many double cosets, finite stabilisers) passes to every subgroup K' of K that is open in G.

declarations.name: apply_doubleCoset_out
declarations.says: A function on double cosets read at the chosen representative of the class of g equals its value at g (for f constant on double cosets).

declarations.name: card_classes_eq_classSum
declarations.says: The number of double cosets Γ\G/K equals the class sum of the constant function 1 (each class weighted by 1/#stabiliser, when trivial).

declarations.name: classIntegral
declarations.says: The integral of f over Γ\G with vol K = 1: the class sum at the level K' of elements of K fixing f, divided by [K : K'].

declarations.name: classIntegral_eq_classSum
declarations.says: The class integral equals the class sum (by definition, at level K).

declarations.name: classIntegral_eq_of_le
declarations.says: Changing level: for K′ ⊂ K fixing f, the class integral is [K : K′]⁻¹ times the class sum at level K′.

declarations.name: classIntegral_mem_nsmul
declarations.says: If all stabilisers of points gK in Γ are trivial and f is right K-invariant with values in A, the integral of f over Γ\G is a sum of elements of A, one for each double coset in Γ\G/K.

declarations.name: classIntegral_sum
declarations.says: Assume HasFiniteType for Γ and K. If F(g) = ∑_{i∈s} L_i(f_i(g a_i)) for all g, with L_i additive, a_i ∈ G and f_i smooth and left Γ-invariant, then the integral of F over Γ\G is ∑_{i∈s} L_i(integral of f_i).

declarations.name: classSum_eq_relIndex_smul
declarations.says: Assume HasFiniteType for K and K', and let L = a⁻¹K'a have finite index in K. If F(g) is the value of f at the chosen representative of Γ(ga)K for all g, the class sum of F at K' is [K : L] times that of f at K.

declarations.name: classSum_one_of_le
declarations.says: For K′ ⊂ K, the class sum of 1 at level K′ is [K : K′] times that at level K.

declarations.name: rightStab
declarations.says: The subgroup of k in G with f(gk) = f(g) for all g.

declarations.name: surjective_doubleCoset_mk_mul
declarations.says: Every double coset Γ\G/K′ is the class of gk for g a representative of Γ\G/K and k a representative of K/K′.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.exists_conj
declarations.says: Let μ have weight e and tame part ψ, and let σ ∈ Aut ℂ permute the CM type: σ∘Φ_v = Φ_{p(v)}. Then some ν has weight e∘p⁻¹, tame part σ∘ψ, and ν(u) = σ(μ(u)) whenever u has archimedean component 1.
declarations.note: σ applied to the finite part, with the infinity type permuted.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.inv
declarations.says: If μ has weight e and tame part ψ, then μ⁻¹ has weight −e and tame part ψ⁻¹ (an instance of a property).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.mul
declarations.says: Weights and tame parts multiply: μν has weight e + e′ and tame part ψψ′.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.norm_map_eq_one
declarations.says: Let μ have weight e and tame part ψ. If u ∈ U(1)(𝔸) has archimedean component 1, then |σ(μ(u))| = 1 for every ring homomorphism σ : ℂ → ℂ.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.norm_padic_eq_prod
declarations.says: If μ has weight e and a tame part, then for ι : ℂ → ℂ_p and every norm-one adele u trivial at infinity, |ι μ(u)| = ∏_τ |u_τ|^{−e(τ)}, u_τ the image of u at the prime induced by ι∘τ.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.one
declarations.says: The trivial character has weight 0 and trivial tame part (an instance of a property).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.zpow
declarations.says: μⁿ has weight n·e and tame part ψⁿ for every integer n.

declarations.name: AutChar.eq_of_mem_integralU1
declarations.says: If ψ_w is trivial outside S and f(u) = g(u)·∏_w ψ_w(u mod w) for integral u, then f = g on the integral norm-one adeles of level S.

declarations.name: AutChar.exists_hasWeight_of_prod_eq_one
declarations.says: Let ψ be trivial off a finite set S. If ∏_v Φ_v(u)^{e(v)} · ∏_{w∈S} ψ_w(u mod w) = 1 for every integer u of E with uū = 1, then some character of U(1)(𝔸), trivial on rational points, has weight e and tame part ψ.
declarations.reference: A. Weil, On a certain type of characters of the idèle-class group of an algebraic number-field (Tokyo–Nikko 1955, 1956); exposition A. Raghuram, Notes on the arithmetic of Hecke L-functions, arXiv:2207.03399
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: existence of an algebraic Hecke character with prescribed infinity type and tame part, for the norm-one torus U(1) of a CM field, under the compatibility condition on global norm-one units. Place from the header of the family file SplittingCharExists; REFERENCES.md: Raghuram compared, place confirmed; Weil work found, no place given.

declarations.name: AutChar.exists_mem_tameChars
declarations.says: Every complex character of the class group of U(1) of tame level S, pulled back to U(1)(𝔸), is a character of weight 0 with tame part trivial outside S.

declarations.name: AutChar.tameChars
declarations.says: For a finite set S of finite places, the group of pairs (μ, ψ): μ a character of U(1)(𝔸) of weight 0 with tame part ψ, and ψ trivial outside S.

declarations.name: exists_unitary_of_mem_rationalU1
declarations.says: A rational point of the norm-one adeles comes from a norm-one element of E.

declarations.name: pow_torsionOrder_eq_one
declarations.says: Kronecker's theorem in a CM field E: an algebraic integer γ of E with γγ̄ = 1 satisfies γⁿ = 1, n the number of roots of unity in E.
declarations.reference: Kronecker's theorem: an algebraic integer all of whose conjugates have absolute value 1 is a root of unity (L. Kronecker, 1857; e.g. L. Washington, Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: the case of a CM field E: γγ̄ = 1 forces all conjugates to have absolute value 1; the conclusion is γⁿ = 1 with n the number of roots of unity of E.

entries.known_result: adelic points of unitary groups, levels and Haar measures

declarations.name: G.continuous_iff
declarations.says: A map into G is continuous exactly when its adelic matrix is continuous.

declarations.name: G.ext_mat
declarations.says: Two elements of G with the same matrix are equal.

declarations.name: G.isClosedEmbedding_mat
declarations.says: The map sending an element of the adelic unitary group G to its matrix over the adeles is a closed embedding.

declarations.name: Space.IsRapid
declarations.says: F on G has rapid decay: |F(g)|·ht(g)^B is bounded on G for every natural number B.

declarations.name: Space.archCoords
declarations.says: For a space (J, x), the additive map sending y ∈ E^n to the archimedean components of x⁻¹y in Euclidean space ℂ^{fn}; its norm is the length of y.

declarations.name: Space.firstMinimum
declarations.says: The first minimum of the lattice of V, cut off at 1: the infimum of 1 and the lengths (Space.archCoords) of the nonzero lattice vectors.

declarations.name: Space.height
declarations.says: The height ht(g) = 1/λ(g), with λ(g) the first minimum of V moved by g, cut off at 1 (Space.firstMinimum).

declarations.name: eq_zero_of_norm_Φ
declarations.says: A non-zero algebraic integer has a conjugate of absolute value at least 1 (so if all conjugates are below 1, it is 0).

declarations.name: ideleAbs_det_mkAdelicGL
declarations.says: The idelic absolute value of det(a, b) is ∏_w |det a_w|² times the finite absolute value of det b.

declarations.name: minkowski_second
declarations.says: A form of Minkowski's second theorem: for y in GL_n(𝔸) there are a basis Y_j of E^n and integers x_j with y⁻¹Y_j integral at finite places, of Euclidean length ≤ 2^{x_j} over all f infinite places together, and |det y|_𝔸 · 4^{f∑x_j} ≤ (8fn·rd)^{fn}, rd the root discriminant.
declarations.reference: Minkowski's second theorem, adelic form (E. Bombieri, J. Vaaler, On Siegel's lemma, Invent. Math. 73 (1983); A. Borel, Publ. IHES 16 (1963))
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: with a crude explicit constant: |det y|_𝔸·4^{f Σx_j} ≤ (8fn·rd)^{fn}, rd the root discriminant, for a basis of Eⁿ with lengths ≤ 2^{x_j}; the sharp product of successive minima is not stated. REFERENCES.md: Bombieri–Vaaler work found, no place given.

declarations.name: sum_norm_sq_mulVec_of_isometry
declarations.says: An isometry Q (QᴴQ = 1) preserves the sum of squared absolute values.

declarations.name: tsum_prod_le_prod_tsum
declarations.says: For f : α → [0, ∞] and a finite index set n, the sum over all tuples x ∈ α^n of ∏_i f(x_i) is at most (∑_a f(a))^|n|.

declarations.name: IsFrob.conjPlace_conjGal
declarations.says: Frobenius elements are carried to Frobenius elements by complex conjugation of places and of Galois elements: if g is a q-Frobenius at A, then g^c is a q-Frobenius at the conjugate place.

declarations.name: IsFromU1.apply_idOrConjInv
declarations.says: A character χ coming from U(1) in the sense of IsFromU1 has χ(g^{−c}) = χ(g), where g^{−c} = (g^c)⁻¹; stated for both values of idOrConjInv.

declarations.name: IsFromU1.eq_one_of_mem_decompGroup
declarations.says: If χ satisfies IsFromU1 for S and I (anticyclotomic of modulus I), then χ is trivial on the decomposition group of every place A of Ω lying over a place v in S.

declarations.name: IsFromU1.eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove
declarations.says: If χ satisfies IsFromU1 for S and I (anticyclotomic of modulus I), then χ is unramified off I ∪ Ī: χ(g) = 1 for g in any inertia group above a finite place of E outside I and its conjugate.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.conjPlace_star
declarations.says: Let E be a CM field. If the valuation subring A of Ω lies over the finite place v of E, then the conjugate place of A under the chosen complex conjugation lies over the conjugate prime v̄.

declarations.name: cmConj_conjGal_smul
declarations.says: The chosen complex conjugation intertwines the action of g^c and of g: c(g^c·x) = g·c(x).

declarations.name: conjGal_conjGal
declarations.says: Conjugation by the chosen complex conjugation is an involution on the Galois group: (g^c)^c = g.

declarations.name: conjPlace
declarations.says: The conjugate place: the preimage of the valuation subring A of Ω under the chosen complex conjugation.

declarations.name: conjPlace_conjPlace
declarations.says: Conjugating a place twice gives the place back.

declarations.name: continuous_conjGal
declarations.says: The map g ↦ g^c on the Galois group is continuous.

declarations.name: cycChar_eq_one_of_mem_inertiaAbove
declarations.says: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character is trivial on every inertia group above a finite place of E not dividing ℓ.

declarations.name: idOrConjInv
declarations.says: The element g if b is true, and g^{−c} = (g^c)⁻¹ if b is false.

declarations.name: FinPlace.isPlaceOver_placeOver
declarations.says: The chosen place of Ω over a finite place v of K lies over v.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.exists_above
declarations.says: A place of Ω over v of K lies over some finite place u of an intermediate field L with u below v.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.exists_smul
declarations.says: The Galois group Γ of Ω/K acts transitively on the valuation subrings of Ω lying over a given prime v of K.
declarations.reference: J. Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory, Ch. I §9 (transitivity on primes above a prime), extended to Ω by compactness

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.isPlaceOver_below
declarations.says: A place of Ω over a place u of L lies over the place of K below u.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.isUniformiser_iff
declarations.says: For A over v, π is a uniformiser (for the normalised valuation of A) exactly when v(π) = e^{−1}.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.smul
declarations.says: If A lies over v, so does every Galois translate gA.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.unique
declarations.says: A place of Ω lies over at most one finite place of K.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.valuationVia_eq_one_iff
declarations.says: For A over v and x ∈ K, x is a unit at A exactly when it is a unit at v.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff
declarations.says: For A over v, an integer n is a unit at A exactly when n ∉ v.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.valuation_natCast_lt_one_iff
declarations.says: For A over v, an integer n lies in the maximal ideal of A exactly when n ∈ v.

declarations.name: algebraMap_ringOfIntegers_mem
declarations.says: The image of an algebraic integer of K lies in every valuation subring of Ω.

declarations.name: exists_isPlaceOver_of_val_ne_one
declarations.says: A valuation subring of Ω on which some non-zero x ∈ K is not a unit lies over a finite place of K.

declarations.name: adeleExtension
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism from the finite adeles of E to F: the component at the prime induced by σ : E → F, followed by a continuous extension of σ to the completion.

declarations.name: adeleExtension_star
declarations.says: For a CM field E, the extension adeleExtension σ of a p-adic embedding σ to finite adeles takes at the conjugate of x the value that the extension of σ ∘ conj takes at x.

declarations.name: complexToCp
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism from ℂ to ℂ_p obtained by composing an isomorphism ι from ℂ onto the algebraic closure of ℚ_p with the inclusion into ℂ_p.

declarations.name: isEquiv_placeOfEmb
declarations.says: The pull-back of the norm of F along σ is equivalent to the valuation of the prime of E induced by σ.

declarations.name: mem_placeOfEmb
declarations.says: An integer x of the number field E lies in the prime placeOfEmb σ induced by an embedding σ of E into an ultrametric normed field over ℚ_p if and only if ‖σ x‖ < 1.

declarations.name: natCast_mem_placeOfEmb
declarations.says: The rational prime p lies in the prime of E induced by an embedding σ of E into an ultrametric normed field F over ℚ_p.

declarations.name: norm_adeleExtension_eq_iff
declarations.says: For finite adeles x, y, the extended embedding gives elements of equal norm exactly when x and y have equal valuations at the prime induced by σ.

declarations.name: norm_adeleExtension_le_one
declarations.says: The extension of σ to finite adeles maps the integral adeles into the closed unit ball.

declarations.name: norm_le_one_of_isIntegral
declarations.says: Algebraic integers map into the closed unit ball under every ring map into an ultrametric normed field.

declarations.name: norm_ringOfIntegers_le
declarations.says: Integers of E map into the closed unit ball under every embedding into an ultrametric normed field.

declarations.name: placeOfEmb
declarations.says: The prime of E above p induced by an embedding σ of E into an ultrametric normed field F over ℚ_p: the integers x of E with ‖σ x‖ < 1.

declarations.name: weightEmbedding
declarations.says: For an infinite place v and ι : ℂ → F, the embedding x ↦ ι(Φ_v(x̄)) of E in F, with Φ the CM type.
declarations.note: depends on the proof's choice of CM type Φ.

declarations.name: Haar.lintegral_chart_rotate_le
declarations.says: Let J be a hermitian involution, Φ: V → U(J) injective and differentiable on a measurable A, with Jacobian w for Jg⁻¹dg in measure preserving coordinates e. For almost every real t and all f ≥ 0, ∫_A (w(p)/vol U(n)) f(e^{it}Φ(p)) dp ≤ ∫ f dhaarU.
declarations.reference: the change of variables (area) formula; Haar measure in Cayley coordinates: L. K. Hua, Harmonic Analysis of Functions of Several Complex Variables in the Classical Domains (1963), ch. III
declarations.note: stated as an inequality valid for almost every rotation by a unit scalar (25 lines).

declarations.name: abs_det_logDerivU_cayleyChart
declarations.says: For a hermitian involution J and Y the skew-hermitian matrix with coordinates y, if det(1−½J⁻¹Y) ≠ 0 then Cayley's chart is differentiable at y, and the form Jg⁻¹dg in real coordinates has absolute determinant (|det J|·|det(1−½J⁻¹Y)|²)^(−n) there.
declarations.reference: L. K. Hua (1963), ch. III (Jacobian of the Cayley transform)

declarations.name: cayleyChart
declarations.says: The Cayley chart: the element of U(J) with matrix (1+X)(1−X)⁻¹, X = ½J⁻¹Y, Y = skewOfReal y skew-hermitian; it is −1 when 1−X is singular.

declarations.name: cayleyDenom
declarations.says: The matrix 1 − ½J⁻¹Y, where Y is the skew-hermitian matrix skewOfReal y attached to the real matrix y; the denominator in Cayley's chart.

declarations.name: cayleyDensity
declarations.says: For J and a real matrix y, the real number (|det J|·|det(1−½J⁻¹S)|²)^(−n), S the skew-hermitian matrix with coordinates y.

declarations.name: det_cayleyDenom_one_ne_zero
declarations.says: For J = 1 the Cayley denominator 1 − ½Y is invertible (Y skew-hermitian).

declarations.name: haarU
declarations.says: The image under Cayley's chart of Lebesgue measure with density cayleyDensity divided by vol U(n), on the y with det(cayleyDenom J y) ≠ 0; for hermitian involutions J, the compact dual Haar measure.
declarations.note: normalised so that the compact group U(n) has mass one.

declarations.name: lintegral_eq_cayleyChart
declarations.says: For a hermitian involution J of size n and any f: U(J) → [0,∞], the integral of f against haarU equals the integral of (cayleyDensity divided by vol U(n)) times f∘cayleyChart over the real matrices y with det(cayleyDenom J y) ≠ 0.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_haarU
declarations.says: Let J, J' be hermitian involutions, a, b invertible, ε real nonzero, bᴴ(εJ)b = J'. A bijection φ: U(J) → U(J') given by g ↦ agb carries the measure haarU of U(J) to that of U(J').

declarations.name: measureSpaceU
declarations.says: The Haar measure haarU (Cayley-chart normalisation) as the canonical measure on U(J).

declarations.name: sphereDensity
declarations.says: The number 2π^k r^{k−1}/(k−1)!; for k ≥ 1 the sphere of radius ρ in ℂ^k has area ρ times its value at r = ρ².

declarations.name: volU
declarations.says: The volume ∏_{i<j} 2π^(i+1)/i! of the compact unitary group U(j).

declarations.name: Space.algFormCoeff_algFormRep
declarations.says: The coefficient of the right translate of an algebraic form by a is the coefficient of the form at g·(1, a).

declarations.name: Space.algFormEquiv
declarations.says: For V standard, l twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e) and K a subgroup of G_f, the isomorphism φ ↦ F_φ from K-fixed algebraic forms to K-fixed forms of type e_l.

declarations.name: Space.integral_mul_eq_classIntegral
declarations.says: On a standard space, for l = 2λ the parameter of (κ, e), φ a smooth algebraic form and Φ automorphic with Φ(x, g) = L_g(ρ(x)v⁺), L_g linear: ∫_{[G]} ΦF_φ = (dim ρ)⁻¹ ∫_{Γ\G_f} L_g(φ(g)) dg, with F_φ = ofAlgForm and vol K₀ = 1.
declarations.note: Schur orthogonality for the compact group G_∞ (5 lines, citing the dimension of ρ).

declarations.name: Space.isAutomorphic_algFormCoeff
declarations.says: Let V be standard and φ an algebraic form of weight (κ, e) with open stabiliser under right translation. For every linear functional L, the function g ↦ L(ḡ_∞⁻¹ φ(g_f)) on G (algFormCoeff) is automorphic.

declarations.name: Space.isForm_ofAlgForm
declarations.says: The form attached to a smooth algebraic form is a form of type e_l (the product kernel).

declarations.name: Space.ofAlgForm_toAlgForm
declarations.says: The form attached to the algebraic form of F is F.

declarations.name: Space.star_ofAlgForm
declarations.says: For signs all 1, the conjugate of the attached form at (x, g) is the Gram pairing of φ(g) with the conjugate Weyl action of x on the highest vector.

declarations.name: Space.toAlgForm
declarations.says: For V standard and l twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e), the linear isomorphism F ↦ φ_F from forms of type e_l to smooth algebraic forms of weight (κ, e).

declarations.name: Space.toAlgForm_formRep
declarations.says: The isomorphism Space.toAlgForm from forms of type e_l to smooth algebraic forms of weight (κ, e) commutes with right translation by G_f.

declarations.name: isSphericalWith_toAlgForm_iff
declarations.says: For V standard and l twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e), a form y of type e_l is spherical at w with Hecke polynomial p if and only if its algebraic form, as a function on G_f, is.

declarations.name: isStd_signedSpace
declarations.says: For stably unramified E and signs all 1, the signed space is standard.

entries.known_result: Poincaré series along a Bessel subgroup with unfolding, and unipotent strong approximation

declarations.name: Shape.Form.besselH
declarations.says: The subgroup 𝖧 of the unitary group of the whole space fixing every e_j, every e*_j and z; it is U(X₀) when z is orthogonal to X₀.

declarations.name: Shape.Form.besselS
declarations.says: The Bessel subgroup 𝖲: the elements of the unitary group that are unitriangular on the frame (e₁, …, e_ϱ, z); it contains the unipotent group 𝖴 and the group 𝖧.

declarations.name: besselH_apply_eq_or
declarations.says: For u in 𝖴 and h in 𝖧, each entry of h agrees with that of uh or with that of the identity.

declarations.name: besselS_le_normalizer_besselU
declarations.says: The Bessel subgroup 𝖲 normalises 𝖴.

declarations.name: besselU0_sup_besselH_le_besselS
declarations.says: 𝖴⁰ and 𝖧 generate a subgroup of 𝖲.

declarations.name: frameImage_mul_of_mem_agreeWithOneOn
declarations.says: Multiplying by an element agreeing with 1 on the frame rows does not change the frame image.

declarations.name: inv_mul_simpleRootSum_mem
declarations.says: For u in the unitary level, g⁻¹ times the simple-root sum of u lies in the ideal Q.

declarations.name: mem_unitaryLevel_of_besselU_mul
declarations.says: If uh lies in the unitary level with u in 𝖴 and h in 𝖧, then h lies in it.

declarations.name: simpleRootSum
declarations.says: For s in the unitary group, the sum σ(s) of the entries just above the diagonal of the block of s on the frame indices e₁,…,e_ϱ,z.

declarations.name: simpleRootSum_eq_zero_of_mem_besselH
declarations.says: The simple-root sum vanishes on 𝖧.

declarations.name: simpleRootSum_mul
declarations.says: The simple-root sum is additive on the Bessel subgroup 𝖲: σ(hu) = σ(h) + σ(u).

declarations.name: G.continuous_reindex
declarations.says: Re-indexing (with matching signs) is continuous on the adelic unitary groups.

declarations.name: G.isClosedEmbedding_sum
declarations.says: The block diagonal map from the product of the adelic unitary groups of signs s and t to that of the concatenated signs is a closed embedding.

declarations.name: Space.ext
declarations.says: Two spaces with the same base point are equal (extensionality).

declarations.name: Space.mem_Γ_iff_range
declarations.says: g lies in the arithmetic group Γ of V = (J, x) exactly when x g x⁻¹ has rational entries.

declarations.name: Space.ratEmbed_mulVec_vecAtPoint
declarations.says: The embedding of a rational isometry γ acts on the adelic vector of y as γ acts on y.

declarations.name: Space.signedSpace_eq_reindex
declarations.says: A space whose base point is that of the signed space is a re-indexing of the signed space of the permuted signs.

declarations.name: Space.sum_mem_Γ
declarations.says: A block diagonal element lies in Γ of a direct sum exactly when its blocks lie in the Γ of the summands.

declarations.name: Space.sum_ratEmbed
declarations.says: The embedding of a block diagonal rational isometry of a direct sum is the block diagonal of the embeddings.

declarations.name: Space.sum_vecAtPoint
declarations.says: The adelic vector of (y, z) in a direct sum is the pair of adelic vectors.

declarations.name: Space.witt
declarations.says: Witt's theorem for a hermitian space V: if X, Y are left invertible n × m matrices over E with XᴴJX = YᴴJY, J the matrix of V, then gX = Y for some g in U(J)(E).
declarations.reference: Witt's extension theorem for hermitian forms: U. A. First, Witt's extension theorem for quadratic spaces over semiperfect rings, J. Pure Appl. Algebra 219 (2015); over fields J. Dieudonné, La géométrie des groupes classiques (1955)
declarations.place: First, Cor. 4.9 and 4.11 (the header lists both without assigning them)
declarations.relation: the theorem
declarations.note: stated for frames: left-invertible matrices X, Y with the same Gram matrix XᴴJX = YᴴJY are related by an isometry g ∈ U(J)(E). Place from the header of the family file Lib/SiegelWeil/SingularForms/AdaptedHom; REFERENCES.md: Dieudonné work found, no place given; First not listed, so the place is unchecked.

declarations.name: U.mem_range_sum
declarations.says: Let J'' = diag(J,J') and g ∈ U(J''). For J' invertible, g = diag(a,1) with a ∈ U(J) iff its second block of columns is that of 1; for J invertible, symmetrically for diag(1,a) and the first block.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.IsShortExact.restrictAlong
declarations.says: Restricting a short exact sequence of discrete modules along a continuous homomorphism keeps it short exact.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.coboundary
declarations.says: The linear map from a discrete Γ-module A to its continuous 1-cocycles sending m to g ↦ gm − m.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.const
declarations.says: The Γ-equivariant linear map from A to the A-valued functions on Γ/U sending an element to the constant function with that value.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.funModule
declarations.says: For a subgroup U with Γ/U finite and discrete, the discrete Γ-module of functions f: Γ/U → A with action (gf)(x) = g·f(g⁻¹x).

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.restrictAlong
declarations.says: For a continuous homomorphism φ: G → Γ, the discrete Γ-module A viewed as a discrete G-module through φ.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.restrictTo
declarations.says: For a subgroup U of Γ, the discrete Γ-module A viewed as a discrete U-module.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.submodule
declarations.says: A Γ-stable R-submodule W of a discrete Γ-module A, as a discrete Γ-module with the restricted action.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.sum
declarations.says: The Γ-equivariant linear map from the A-valued functions on the finite set Γ/U to A sending f to the sum of its values.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.trivialisedCocycles.map
declarations.says: For an equivariant map u : A → B, the additive map between the groups DiscreteModule.trivialisedCocycles of A and B that composes both components of a pair of functions with u.

declarations.name: DiscreteUnits.ext
declarations.says: Two elements of Ω^× written additively are equal when their underlying units are equal.

declarations.name: exists_primitive_relation
declarations.says: Let ℓ be prime, r > 0, Y a finite abelian group, p: Y → (ℤ/ℓ^r)^ι additive, t: Fin k → ι, and #Y[ℓ]·ℓ^{k+1} ≤ ℓ^{|ι|}. Then some vector n with a unit entry vanishes at all t(j) and is orthogonal to p(Y).
declarations.note: a counting argument over ℤ/ℓ^r (dimension count in the ℓ-torsion), 18 lines.

declarations.name: IsBesselFunction
declarations.says: Bessel function: F : G₁ → ℂ^I bounded measurable, F(ny) = exp(σ(n) − conj σ(n))F(y) for n in besselU, σ = simpleRootSum, and F(hy) = rep(h)F(y) for h in U(κ).
declarations.note: Bessel functions for the Bessel subgroup of the proof's shape (no Bessel model is constructed).

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.continuous_convolve
declarations.says: On a second countable locally compact group G with two-sided Haar measure, for F : G → E bounded and strongly measurable, E a Hilbert space, and x integrable, y ↦ ∫ x(a⁻¹) F(ya) da is continuous.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.convolve_assoc
declarations.says: Convolution is associative: (F*x)*z = F*(x*z) for integrable x, z.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.convolve_right
declarations.says: The convolution of a bounded measurable F with an integrable x is bounded measurable.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.integrable_smul
declarations.says: For F bounded measurable and x integrable, a ↦ x(a)F(ya) is integrable for every y.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.lintegral_sq_convolve_convolve_le
declarations.says: Under the hypotheses of IsBoundedMeasurable.lintegral_sq_convolve, for integrable φ the function y ↦ ∫φ(a)(F*x)(ya)da has squared L²(ν) norm at most (‖x‖₂²/d)·(‖F‖²_ν/d)·‖φ‖₂².
declarations.note: an L² bound for iterated convolutions with the formal degree d, from Schur orthogonality (19 lines); the write-up must read it with its companion lemma.

declarations.name: IsIdempotentKernel.integral_inv_mul_translate
declarations.says: For an idempotent kernel ψ on a unimodular group, ∫ ψ(a⁻¹)ψ(g a y) da = ψ(g)ψ(y)/ψ(1).

declarations.name: besselValueRep
declarations.says: The unitary matrix representation rep of U(κ), read as a homomorphism to the continuous linear operators on the Euclidean space ℂ^I.

declarations.name: convolve
declarations.says: The convolution F*x of a vector-valued function F and a complex function x on G: the function y ↦ ∫ x(a⁻¹) F(ya) da.

declarations.name: integrable_convolve
declarations.says: The convolution of two integrable functions is integrable.

declarations.name: lintegral_enorm_sq
declarations.says: For an essentially bounded F, the lower integral of |F|² equals the integral of |F|².

declarations.name: IsCutoff.ae_lt_top
declarations.says: For a cutoff β, β is finite almost everywhere.

declarations.name: IsCutoff.integral_orbitMeasure
declarations.says: Integration of an H-invariant function against the orbit measure of a cutoff.

declarations.name: IsCutoff.measurePreserving
declarations.says: For a cutoff β, (x, h) ↦ hx carries (βμ) × ν to μ.

declarations.name: encard_le_of_separated
declarations.says: Packing bound: in a finite-dimensional real normed space V, if the points f(i), i in S, have pairwise distances at least m > 0 and norms at most R, with R ≥ 0, then S has at most (1 + 2R/m)^{dim V} elements.
declarations.note: a volume (packing) argument.

declarations.name: identDistrib_orbitMeasure
declarations.says: Independence of the cutoff: for H acting measurably on X, ν inversion invariant on H, μ H-invariant on X (both s-finite) and any cutoff β, an H-invariant measurable F has the same distribution under βμ as under the quotient measure orbitMeasure.

declarations.name: identDistrib_orbitMeasure_of_unfold
declarations.says: Let ν on H have a cutoff on X, σ carry ρ to ν, and (z, l) ↦ σ(l)·T(z) carry m × ρ to μ, with m, ρ s-finite, T measurable. For measurable H-invariant F, F under orbitMeasure ν μ and F∘T under m are identically distributed.

declarations.name: lintegral_orbitMeasure_lintegral
declarations.says: Unfolding: let H act measurably on X preserving the s-finite μ, with ν an s-finite inversion-invariant measure on H admitting a cutoff. For measurable f : X → [0,∞], integrating x ↦ ∫_H f(hx) dν over H\X gives ∫_X f dμ.
declarations.reference: Weil's integration formula for a quotient (A. Weil; N. Bourbaki, Intégration VII, 1963), in the form of O. Kallenberg, Probab. Theory Related Fields 139 (2007) (as cited in D. Gentner, G. Last, Math. Z. 267 (2011), §2)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for a measurable action with a cutoff β (a measurable weight of total mass one on each orbit) and s-finite measures; the quotient integral is defined through the cutoff, so no section or orbit space is needed. Places from the file header of Unimodular; REFERENCES.md: Kallenberg place confirmed at second hand, Gentner–Last and Bourbaki compared, place confirmed.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_orbitMeasure
declarations.says: Unfolding: let H act measurably on X with a cutoff, ν s-finite and inversion invariant on H, μ s-finite and H-invariant on X. Then (x, h) ↦ hx is measurable and carries βμ × ν to μ, where βμ is orbitMeasure for the chosen cutoff β.
declarations.reference: Weil's integration formula for a quotient (N. Bourbaki, Intégration VII, 1963; O. Kallenberg, Probab. Theory Related Fields 139 (2007))
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: the measure-preserving form of 501, with the orbit measure of a cutoff; places from the header of Unimodular.

declarations.name: tsum_inv_pow_le_of_separated
declarations.says: Let points f_i of a real normed space of finite dimension d have norms and mutual distances at least m > 0. For an integer n ≥ d + 2, ∑ ‖f_i‖^(−n) converges and is at most (5/m)^n.

declarations.name: tsum_le_of_separated
declarations.says: Let points f_i of a real normed space of dimension d have mutual distances at least m > 0, with ‖f_i‖ ≤ R u_i, u_i ≥ 1, R ≥ 0. If A > d and A ≤ c(A − d), then ∑ u_i^(−A) converges and is ≤ (1 + 2R/m)^d c.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.L_ne_zero
declarations.says: Let ν have weight e ≠ 0 and some tame part, and let S be finite. Then the L-function of x ↦ ν(x/x̄) without the factors at S ∪ S̄ is non-zero at every real s ≥ 1.
declarations.reference: non-vanishing of Hecke L-functions on re s ≥ 1 (Hecke; via J. Tate, Fourier analysis in number fields and Hecke's zeta-functions, 1950, in Cassels–Fröhlich ch. XV; S. Lang, Algebraic Number Theory, Part Three)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: only at real s ≥ 1, for the characters x ↦ ν(x/x̄) of weight e ≠ 0 with the Euler factors at S ∪ S̄ removed; the header says that non-vanishing is proved only when the square of the character is non-trivial and the continuation to a neighbourhood of 1 is by a Riemann sum (Müntz's formula) instead of Poisson summation. Header places: Tate §4.4–4.5 (continuation; REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed), Lang Part Three without a place (work found, no place given).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.atUnif_star
declarations.says: Let ν have weight e and tame part ψ, with ψ_w and ψ_w̄ trivial. Then the Hecke character x ↦ ν(x/x̄) takes mutually inverse values at the chosen uniformisers at w̄ and at w.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.baseChange_apply_inf
declarations.says: At the infinite places, the Hecke character x ↦ ν(x/x̄) is z ↦ ∏_w (z_w/|z_w|)^{2e_w}.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt
declarations.says: The finite part of the Hecke character x ↦ ν(x/x̄) is unramified at the place w (under the hypotheses on the tame part).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt_toAlgebraic
declarations.says: The algebraic Hecke character attached to ν is unramified at w (under the same hypotheses).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.isHeckeOfType
declarations.says: If the character ν of U(1)(𝔸) has weight e and tame part ψ, then the restriction of x ↦ ν(x/x̄) to the finite ideles of E is the finite part of a Hecke character of type 2e.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.toAlgebraic
declarations.says: For a character ν of U(1) of weight e, the algebraic Hecke character ν(x/x̄) υ(x)^{−k} |x|^{j−k/2}, of infinity type j + e − k on the CM type, j − e on its conjugate.
declarations.note: υ is the splitting character of the proof's Weil data (WeilData).

declarations.name: AutChar.L
declarations.says: The partial Hecke L-function of the character x ↦ ν(x/x̄) of E, without the Euler factors at S ∪ S̄.

declarations.name: IsHeckeOfType.toAlgebraic
declarations.says: For ψ a character of finite ideles of type m(Φ_w) − m(Φ̄_w), with m(Φ_w) + m(Φ̄_w) = k constant, the algebraic Hecke character ψ|·|^{k/2} of infinity type m.

declarations.name: WeilData.charUnramifiedAt_upsilon
declarations.says: The finite part of the splitting character υ is unramified at every finite place (by its construction).

entries.known_result: Schur orthogonality, and coefficients of integrable discrete series are cusp forms

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable
declarations.says: Property of F : Z → X: it is strongly measurable and its norm is bounded by one constant on all of Z.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.comp
declarations.says: Composing a bounded measurable function with a measurable map gives a bounded measurable function.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.integrable_mul_comp
declarations.says: The product of a bounded measurable function (composed with a measurable map) and an integrable function is integrable.

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.memLp_top
declarations.says: A bounded measurable function is essentially bounded (in L^∞).

declarations.name: IsBoundedMeasurable.of
declarations.says: A bounded continuous function on a second countable Borel space is bounded measurable.

declarations.name: MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.fubini
declarations.says: Fubini's theorem along a map T carrying ν × μ (both s-finite) to ρ: for ρ-integrable f, f∘T is integrable and ∫∫ f(T(k, g)) dμ(g) dν(k) = ∫ f dρ.
declarations.reference: Fubini's theorem

declarations.name: integral_skew_product
declarations.says: Let μ, ν be s-finite, T jointly measurable with each T_k preserving μ, and f integrable for ν × μ. Then g ↦ ∫ f(k, T_k g) dν(k) is μ-integrable, and its integral is ∫∫ f(k, g) dμ(g) dν(k).
declarations.reference: Fubini's theorem

declarations.name: integral_toCircle
declarations.says: Mean value property: if f is complex differentiable on the closed unit disc, then the integral of f over the unit circle, parametrised by ℝ/ℤ with Haar probability measure, equals f(0).
declarations.reference: the mean value property of holomorphic functions (Cauchy's integral formula)

declarations.name: le_of_halving
declarations.says: Maximum principle: let f be a real function bounded above and c ≥ 0. If for every upper bound M ≥ 0 of f each value is ≤ M/2 or ≤ c, then f ≤ c.

declarations.name: sq_lintegral_le
declarations.says: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for lower integrals of functions with values in [0, ∞]: if f, g are almost everywhere measurable and h² ≤ fg pointwise, then (∫h)² ≤ ∫f · ∫g.
declarations.reference: the Cauchy–Schwarz inequality

declarations.name: GlModule.adTwist
declarations.says: The twist of a gl_n-module by an invertible matrix g: X acts as gXg⁻¹ does in the original module.

declarations.name: GlModule.apply_eq_sum
declarations.says: A gl_n-module action is linear in the matrix: ρ(X) = Σ_{a,b} X_{ab} ρ(E_{ab}).

declarations.name: GlModule.filtration
declarations.says: The filtration M_s generated by x: M_0 = U(𝔨)x, the least subspace containing x stable under the E_ab with ε_a = ε_b, and M_{s+1} = M_s + Σ E_ab M_s.

declarations.name: GlModule.self_mem_filtration
declarations.says: x lies in every step M_s of the filtration it generates.

declarations.name: GlModule.word
declarations.says: For a list of index pairs (a₁,b₁),…,(a_s,b_s), the endomorphism E_{a₁b₁}⋯E_{a_s b_s} of M, the product taken in list order.

declarations.name: HCParam.HasGap.mono
declarations.says: A parameter with gap h has every smaller gap h′ ≤ h.

declarations.name: HCParam.HasGap.neg
declarations.says: The negative of a parameter with a gap has the same gap.

declarations.name: abs_lowestKType_le
declarations.says: If l = 2λ is a parameter of some gap g for the signs ε and |l_a| ≤ L for all a, then every entry of Λ = λ+ρ−2ρ_c satisfies |Λ_a| ≤ L + n.

declarations.name: abs_twoRho_le
declarations.says: Every entry of 2ρ (for the given sign pattern) is at most n in absolute value.

declarations.name: two_mul_lowestKType
declarations.says: Twice the lowest K-type is l + 2ρ_n − 2ρ_c entrywise (non-compact minus compact half-sums), for l = 2λ.

entries.known_result: Contravariant form on Weyl's lattice, Fischer product, irreducibility under U(n)

declarations.name: PolyRep.schur_conjTranspose_weylGram_schur
declarations.says: If the sizes fit κ (FitsRanks), then for complex n'_τ×n_τ matrices w_τ, z_τ: S_κ(w)* G' S_κ(z) = ∏_τ det(w_τ* z_τ)^{d_τ} · G S_κ(w*z), with G', G the Gram matrices for n', n and d_τ given by schurDetExp.
declarations.reference: header: J. C. Jantzen, Representations of Algebraic Groups (2nd ed. 2003); R. Goodman, N. Wallach, Symmetry, Representations, and Invariants (2009), ch. 5
declarations.note: invariance of the contravariant (Gram) form of Weyl's lattice under Schur functors of rectangular matrices, with determinant factors when the ranks differ (6 lines resting on the file's polynomial-representation theory); REFERENCES.md lists Jantzen II.8.17 and II.2.13 (second hand) and Goodman–Wallach (compared, place confirmed) for this file without saying which statement each supports.

declarations.name: classSum_deltaForm
declarations.says: Let e be injective and HasFiniteType hold. If additive maps L(g): W → ℂ satisfy L(e(γ)xk)(χ(k)ρ(γ)v) = L(x)(v) for all γ, k, the class sum of g ↦ L(g)(δ(g)) is L(x)(v), where δ is deltaForm at x, v.

declarations.name: deltaForm
declarations.says: The linear map sending v to the form y ↦ ∑ χ(x⁻¹e(γ)⁻¹y) ρ(γ)v of level (K, χ), summed over γ with x⁻¹e(γ)⁻¹y in K; it vanishes off e(Γ)xK.

declarations.name: finrank_levelSpace_smoothFormRep
declarations.says: If all stabilisers are trivial, the forms of level (K, χ) have dimension #(Γ\G/K)·dim W.
declarations.reference: B. Gross, Algebraic modular forms, Israel J. Math. 113 (1999)

declarations.name: freeLevelEquiv
declarations.says: If all stabilisers are trivial, evaluation at representatives r is a linear isomorphism from forms of level (K, χ) to W-valued functions on the double cosets e(Γ)\G/K.

declarations.name: levelSpace_smoothFormRep_apply
declarations.says: A form of level (K, χ) satisfies φ(γgk) = χ(k)ρ(γ)φ(g).

declarations.name: mem_smoothFunctions_of_eigen
declarations.says: Let K be an open subgroup of G and χ : K → ℂ multiplicative and equal to 1 near the identity. A function f : G → W with f(xk) = χ(k)f(x) for k in K is smooth.

declarations.name: smoothFormRep
declarations.says: The representation of G on smooth forms by right translation.

declarations.name: weylNormSq_schur_le
declarations.says: If the sizes fit κ (FitsRanks), there are reals ρ_{τ,i} ≥ 0 with ∑_{i<|n_τ|} ρ_{τ,i} ≤ ∑_{a,b}|z_τ(a,b)|² and ‖S_κ(z)ξ‖² ≤ ∏_τ∏_{i<|n_τ|} ρ_{τ,i}^{λ(τ,i)}·‖ξ‖² for all ξ, where λ(τ,i) = ∑_{i<h<|n'_τ|} κ_τ(h) and the norms come from the Gram matrices.
declarations.note: the eigenvalues of a Schur functor of z*z are monomials in the squared singular values (26 lines).

entries.known_result: Landau's lemma on Dirichlet integrals of one sign

declarations.name: IsPolar
declarations.says: The one-sided Landau setting: E is measurable and O(e^v) on v ≥ 0, its Laplace transform Φ(s) = ∫₀^∞ E(v)e^{(1−s)v} dv (re s > 2) continues to a meromorphic function with (s−1)Φ(s) analytic on re s ≥ 1, and Φ has at most simple poles in re s > 0, of residue r(ρ) at ρ.
declarations.note: no pole at s = 1 is allowed, since (s−1)Φ(s) vanishes there by construction.

declarations.name: IsPolar.landau
declarations.says: Landau's lemma, one-sided form: if E is as in the setting above with residues r, β > 0, re r(x) ≥ 0 for real x > β, and E(v) ≤ e^{(β−1)v} for large v, then r(ρ) = 0 for every ρ with re ρ > β (Φ has no pole right of β).
declarations.reference: H. L. Montgomery, R. C. Vaughan, Multiplicative Number Theory I. Classical Theory, Cambridge 2007 (Landau's theorem on Dirichlet integrals with non-negative coefficients); also D. V. Widder, The Laplace Transform, 1941
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: The published lemma says that a Laplace/Dirichlet integral of a function of one sign has a singularity at the real point of its abscissa of convergence; the Lean form is the corollary for transforms that are meromorphic with simple poles, applied to e^{(β−1)v} − E(v) ≥ 0, and it also admits real poles of non-negative residue. Place from the file header; REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed (not re-checked by us).

declarations.name: LSeriesHasSum_mul_vonMangoldt
declarations.says: For a Dirichlet character χ and re s > 1, Σ χ(n)Λ(n)n^{−s} = δ_χ/(s−1) − L̃′/L̃(s, χ), where δ_χ = 1 if χ is principal and 0 otherwise, and L̃(s, χ) is L(s, χ), or (s−1)L(s, χ) for principal χ.
declarations.reference: H. Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory (the Euler product and its logarithmic derivative)

declarations.name: entireL_ne_zero
declarations.says: L̃(s, χ) ≠ 0 for re s ≥ 1: L(s, χ) has no zero on re s ≥ 1, and (s−1)L(s, χ₀) does not vanish there either (at s = 1 it is the residue).
declarations.reference: non-vanishing of Dirichlet L-functions on re s = 1 (Hadamard, de la Vallée Poussin; Dirichlet at s = 1); quoted from Mathlib
declarations.relation: the theorem
declarations.note: proved by citing the two Mathlib theorems; the place is the Mathlib declaration (checked in the Lean proof).

declarations.name: integrableOn_laplace_of_abs_le
declarations.says: If E is measurable and |E(v)| ≤ Ce^v for v ≥ 0, then v ↦ E(v)e^{(1−s)v} is integrable on (0, ∞) for re s > 2.

declarations.name: laplace_pow
declarations.says: Laplace transform of a power: for complex s with re s > 0 and every natural number k, ∫₀^∞ t^k e^{−st} dt = k!/s^{k+1}.
declarations.reference: the Γ-integral

declarations.name: quadTwist_apply
declarations.says: For a Dirichlet character χ mod N and a prime d, the twist χ·(·/d) mod Nd takes the value χ(n)(n/d) at every integer n.

declarations.name: quadTwist_ne_one
declarations.says: For an odd prime d prime to N, the twist χ·(·/d) of a character χ mod N by the Legendre symbol is not principal.

declarations.name: tendsto_sub_mul_logDeriv_entireL
declarations.says: At every point s, the order of vanishing of L̃(·, χ) is 0 exactly when L̃(s, χ) ≠ 0, and (z − s)L̃′/L̃(z, χ) tends to that order as z → s, z ≠ s (residue of the logarithmic derivative).

declarations.name: Space.IsAutomorphic.mem_rapidFunctions
declarations.says: For a definite space (all signs equal), every automorphic function has rapid decay (the height is bounded).

declarations.name: Space.IsRapid.comp_mul_right
declarations.says: Right translates of functions of rapid decay have rapid decay.

declarations.name: Space.IsRapid.integrable
declarations.says: A continuous function of rapid decay is integrable over Γ\G.

declarations.name: Space.IsRapid.mul
declarations.says: A function of rapid decay times one of moderate growth has rapid decay.

declarations.name: Space.height_pos
declarations.says: The height is positive.

declarations.name: Space.one_le_height
declarations.says: The height is at least 1.

declarations.name: Space.rapidFunctions
declarations.says: The automorphic functions of rapid decay for the space V, as a subrepresentation of the complex functions on G under right translation by G_f.

declarations.name: inf_le_firstMinimum_sum
declarations.says: The shortest vector length, cut off at 1 (Space.firstMinimum), of the lattice of V ⊕ W at (g, h) is at least the minimum of those of V at g and W at h.

declarations.name: IsHCParam.eq_hcParameter
declarations.says: If l is twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e), its entries are the values of the parameter function at their positions.

declarations.name: IsHCParam.exists_decrPosition_eq
declarations.says: For q < n there is an index i at decreasing position q whose entry is the parameter value at q, with exactly q entries larger than every smaller value.

declarations.name: IsHCParam.hasGap
declarations.says: Twice a Harish-Chandra parameter has every gap c (entries distinct).

declarations.name: IsHCParam.lowestKType_eq
declarations.says: If l is twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e), then for signs all 1, lowestKType of l_w at i equals e_w + Σ_{p<h<|n|} κ_w(h), p the number of j with l_w(j) > l_w(i).

declarations.name: IsHCParam.prod_formalDegree
declarations.says: If l is twice the Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e), the product over w of the formal degrees formalDegree of l_w for the compact group U(n) equals the dimension of the representation of weight κ.
declarations.reference: Weyl's dimension formula (H. Weyl, The Classical Groups, 1939), read through formal degrees of compact groups
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for U(n): the product over the infinite places of the formal degrees deg_{l_w} (Weyl's dimension polynomial, Haar mass 1) is the number of basis vectors of Weyl's lattice of weight κ.

declarations.name: hcParameter_eq_of_steps
declarations.says: Fix w. If an integer sequence L has L(p) = L(p+1) + 2κ_w(p+1) + 2 whenever p+1 < N and equals hcParameter at one index q < N, then it equals hcParameter at every p < N.

declarations.name: highestVector_cyclic
declarations.says: Irreducibility: let each l_w be injective, v = highestVector κ l, and x range over the product of compact unitary groups. If ⟨v, xu⟩ = 0 for all x, or the linear form f kills all xv, then f(u) = 0.
declarations.reference: irreducibility of the representation of U(n) of highest weight κ (Schur's lemma; R. Goodman, N. Wallach, Symmetry, Representations, and Invariants, 2009)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: stated as cyclicity of the highest vector under the product of compact unitary groups: a linear form killing all translates xv, or orthogonal to them, kills u. Chapter from the header of DeltaForms; REFERENCES.md: Goodman–Wallach compared, place confirmed.

declarations.name: isHCParam_hcParameter
declarations.says: The parameter function gives a Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ, e).

entries.known_result: invariant integration on a quotient (Weil's formula), unfolding and unimodularity

declarations.name: cosetProdEquiv
