declarations.says: For a subgroup N of G, the bijection (G/N) × N → G sending (q, u) to u times the inverse of the chosen representative of the coset q.

declarations.name: exists_eq_smul_haar
declarations.says: On a second countable locally compact group with a Haar measure μ that is also right invariant, every s-finite right invariant measure ν is dμ for some d in [0, ∞].
declarations.reference: uniqueness of Haar measure (N. Bourbaki, Intégration VII, 1963)
declarations.relation: the theorem
declarations.note: for second countable locally compact groups and s-finite right-invariant measures: ν = d·μ with d in [0, ∞].

declarations.name: hasCutoff_count
declarations.says: The counting measure on a discrete subgroup Γ admits a cutoff on G (an instance of a property).

declarations.name: identDistrib_orbitMeasure_comp
declarations.says: Let σ : (H,ν) → (H',ν'), T : (X,μ) → (Y,μ') preserve measure, T(hx) = σ(h)T(x); ν, μ s-finite, ν inversion invariant, μ H-invariant, ν, ν' with cutoffs. For measurable H'-invariant F, F∘T and F are identically distributed for the quotient measures.

declarations.name: integral_quotMeasure_tsum
declarations.says: Unfolding: for a discrete subgroup Γ of a second countable locally compact group G with left Haar measure μ and f integrable, g ↦ ∑_{γ∈Γ} f(γg) is integrable on Γ\G, with integral ∫_G f dμ.
declarations.reference: unfolding / Weil's integration formula for a discrete subgroup (N. Bourbaki, Intégration VII, 1963)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: the case of a discrete subgroup Γ of a second countable locally compact group, with left Haar measure; includes integrability of the Γ-periodisation.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_count
declarations.says: A bijection between countable sets preserves counting measure.

declarations.name: quotMeasure_bot
declarations.says: The quotient measure for the trivial subgroup is μ itself.

declarations.name: tsum_toReal_smul_of_tsum_eq_one
declarations.says: If Σ f(x) = 1 in [0, ∞], then Σ f(x)·z = z.

declarations.name: CMLattice.monomialDeg
declarations.says: The degree a + 2b + 3c of a triple (a, b, c): the degree of the monomial θ^a·σ^{2b}·G^c (CMLattice.monomialSection) as a section.

declarations.name: CMLattice.monomialSection
declarations.says: For a triple (a, b, c) of natural numbers, the function θ^a·σ^{2b}·G^c on ℂ, with σ the sigma function and G = CMLattice.phiThetaCube the entire function φθ³.

declarations.name: CMLattice.monomialSection_eq
declarations.says: For x = (a, b, c) in ℕ³ and z + t ∉ Λ, the monomial θ^a·σ^{2b}·G^c (G the entire extension of φθ³) has value θ(z)^{a+2b+3c}·ξ(z)^b·φ(z)^c at z.

declarations.name: CMLattice.monomialSection_mem
declarations.says: For a CM datum C and x = (a, b, c) in ℕ³, the monomial θ^a·σ^{2b}·G^c, with G the entire extension of φθ³, is a section of degree a + 2b + 3c.

declarations.name: eq_of_taylorAtZero_eq
declarations.says: Two entire functions with the same Taylor series at 0 are equal (identity theorem).

declarations.name: seriesToCp
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism from power series over the valuation ring 𝔬 to power series over ℂ_p induced by the inclusion of coefficients.

declarations.name: seriesToCp_smul
declarations.says: The map from series over the valuation ring 𝔬 of ℂ_p to series over ℂ_p commutes with scalar multiplication by elements of 𝔬.

declarations.name: valRingCp
declarations.says: The valuation ring 𝔬 of ℂ_p.

entries.known_result: Chebotarev's density theorem, existence form

declarations.name: FrobeniusDatum
declarations.says: A finite place w of E of prime norm, a valuation subring A of Ω above w, and a geometric Frobenius s in Gal(Ω/E) at A.

declarations.name: chebotarev
declarations.says: Chebotarev: for a non-empty open W ⊂ Γ = Gal(K̄/K) and a finite set S of primes, there is v ∉ S of prime norm with a place above it all of whose arithmetic Frobenius elements lie in W.
declarations.reference: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory (v4.03, 2020) (Chebotarev density theorem); P. Stevenhagen, H. W. Lenstra, Chebotarëv and his density theorem, Math. Intelligencer 18 (1996)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: existence form only: for a non-empty open W in Gal(K̄/K) and a finite set S, some prime v ∉ S of prime norm (degree one) has a place above it whose Frobenius elements lie in W; no density. Place from the file header; REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed (not re-checked by us).

declarations.name: dense_of_mostFrobenii
declarations.says: If a property holds for most Frobenius data, the set of Galois elements where it holds is dense.

declarations.name: eventually_mostFrobenii
declarations.says: A property that holds at almost all places and implies another at the Frobenius data holds for most Frobenius data (filter monotonicity).

declarations.name: mostFrobenii
declarations.says: The filter 'most Frobenii': each nonempty open set has a nonempty open part all of whose geometric Frobenii (w, A, s), at almost all w of prime norm, lie in X.

declarations.name: mostFrobeniiAt
declarations.says: The filter of most Frobenii tending to g: mostFrobenii on triples (w, A, s), refined by the condition that s lies near g.

declarations.name: mostFrobenii_push
declarations.says: Sets of most Frobenius data push forward along an open embedding of Galois groups compatible with a map of places.

declarations.name: tendsto_mostFrobeniiAt
declarations.says: Continuous functions of the Frobenius tend to their value at g along the filter of most Frobenii at g.

declarations.name: Cancels.mono
declarations.says: Cancellation of cohomology classes along a cover is inherited by covers that factor through it.

declarations.name: Comparison.id
declarations.says: The comparison from F to itself given by the identity functor of C and the identity of F.

declarations.name: H
declarations.says: The group Ext^n(N,F) in the category of functors from C to abelian groups; for N = Z[Y] it is the cohomology H^n(Y,F).
declarations.note: the artifact's definition of cohomology: H^n(Y, F) = Ext^n(ℤ[Y], F) for presheaves on test rings (rings whose local rings are valuation rings of algebraically closed fields); the header says that equality with étale cohomology is neither proved nor used.

declarations.name: H.map
declarations.says: For α: N' → N, the homomorphism Ext^n(N,F) → Ext^n(N',F) given by precomposition with α.

declarations.name: cech.proj
declarations.says: The projection from the (m+1)-fold fibre power of p: E → Y to E taking the j-th coordinate.

declarations.name: fibreProd.snd
declarations.says: The second projection W ×_Y E → E from the fibre product of u: W → Y and p: E → Y.

declarations.name: sigma
declarations.says: For a family X_i of set-valued functors on C, the functor sending A to the disjoint union of the X_i(A).

declarations.name: sigma.desc
declarations.says: For maps f_i: X_i → Y of set-valued functors, the map from the disjoint union of the X_i to Y that is f_i on X_i.

entries.known_result: Isotropic flags in unitary groups (Heisenberg radicals, big Bruhat cell, Haar measure)

declarations.name: cartan_decomposition
declarations.says: Cartan decomposition of H_ϱ = U(V_ϱ): if σ ∈ H_ϱ has Z(σ)_{nn} = c, n = ϱ+1, with |c| > 1, then σ = h w_ϱ(c) h' for some h, h' in U(X₀), w_ϱ(c) the boost cellChart.
declarations.reference: Cartan (KAK) decomposition of a unitary group of real rank one (A. Knapp, Lie Groups Beyond an Introduction; S. Helgason, Groups and Geometric Analysis)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for H_ϱ = U(V_ϱ) of the proof's frame at ℂ, with an explicit boost w_ϱ(c) determined by the frame entry c = Z(σ)_{nn}, |c| > 1.

declarations.name: cellChart
declarations.says: For l = ϱ and c ≠ 0, the boost in the plane of x_{k₀}, z with h(z, wz) = a = c/min(1, |c|); otherwise the Weyl element floorWeyl of floor l with entry c.

declarations.name: cellChart_mem
declarations.says: The boost of floor l lies in H_l.

declarations.name: cellDensity
declarations.says: The density of floor l at c: |c|^{2(k−1)+4(ϱ−l)} for l < ϱ, and 2π^k max(|c|²−1, 0)^{k−1}/(k−1)! otherwise, where k = |κ|.

declarations.name: cellLaw
declarations.says: The measure on G₁ that is the image of the density cellDensity of floor l times dc on ℂ under c ↦ w_l(c)⁻¹ (cellChart).

declarations.name: complexBasis
declarations.says: The basis of V_ϱ = X₀ ⊕ ℂz made of the hyperbolic pair (1+i)/2·(x_{k₀} ± z) and the orthonormal vectors x_i, i ≠ k₀.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_normSq_sphereDensity
declarations.says: For nonempty κ, k = |κ|, the map ω ↦ |ω|² carries Lebesgue measure on ℂ^κ to the measure π^k r^{k−1}/(k−1)! dr on r > 0.
declarations.note: polar coordinates.

declarations.name: realFrameGram_cellChart
declarations.says: For |c| > 1, the top frame entry of the boost w_ϱ(c) is c.

declarations.name: DifferentiableAtU
declarations.says: The condition that a map Φ from a real normed space to U(J), viewed as matrix-valued, is real differentiable at the point p.

declarations.name: Haar.det_eq_mul_of_block_triangular
declarations.says: Block triangular determinant: if an endomorphism T of V × W (finite-dimensional, real) has first component (v,w) ↦ Av and its W-to-W block has determinant d, then det T = det A · d.

declarations.name: HasGaussianIntegral.measurePreserving
declarations.says: If the Haar volumes on finite-dimensional real spaces V, W satisfy the Gaussian normalisation HasGaussianIntegral for q, q', then a linear isomorphism e: V → W with q'(e x) = q(x) for all x is measure preserving.

declarations.name: abs_det_skew_congruence
declarations.says: For a complex n×n matrix C, the congruence S ↦ CᴴSC on skew-hermitian matrices, written in the real coordinates of skewOfReal and skewCoords, has determinant of absolute value |det C|^{2n}.

declarations.name: circleScalar
declarations.says: For real t, the scalar matrix e^{it}·1 as an element of U(J).

declarations.name: conjTranspose_logDerivU
declarations.says: For a differentiable map into U(J), the pulled-back form Jg⁻¹dg is skew-hermitian.

declarations.name: logDerivU
declarations.says: For Φ: V → U(J), the real linear map v ↦ Φ(p)*J dΦ_p(v), that is the form Jg⁻¹dg pulled back by Φ at p.

declarations.name: logDerivU_mul
declarations.says: Product rule for the logarithmic derivative: log-deriv(ΦΨ) = Ψᴴ·log-deriv(Φ)·Ψ + log-deriv(Ψ).

entries.known_result: rapid decay, finite dimension and Poincaré series for cusp forms, and algebraic modular forms

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.conj
declarations.says: The conjugate of a form of type e is a form of type ē.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.petersson_realConv_realConv
declarations.says: For a cusp kernel e on G_∞, forms F, F' of type e and α, β integrable on G_∞, ⟨R(α)F, R(β)F'⟩ equals ⟨F, F'⟩ times ∫∫ conj(α(x)) β(y) conj(e(x⁻¹y))/e(1) dy dx.
declarations.note: from the rank-one formula below.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.realConv_translate
declarations.says: Rank one formula: for a cusp kernel e, a form F of type e and x in G_∞, R(e) sends the translate F(· x) to conj(e(x))/e(1) · F.
declarations.note: e is a minimal idempotent kernel and F is reproduced by it.

declarations.name: Space.conj_petersson
declarations.says: The Petersson product is hermitian: conj⟨F, F′⟩ = ⟨F′, F⟩.

declarations.name: Space.inner_eq_petersson
declarations.says: The inner product of forms is the Petersson product (by definition).

declarations.name: Space.inner_formRep
declarations.says: Right translation by G_f preserves the Petersson inner product.

declarations.name: Space.integral_comp_mul_right
declarations.says: For F continuous and left Γ-invariant, the quotient integral of F(·x) equals that of F (right invariance of the quotient measure).

declarations.name: IsCuspKernel
declarations.says: A cusp kernel of order B on G_∞: a kernel e with ‖x‖^j e(x) integrable for j ≤ B+1, ‖x‖^B e(x) bounded (‖x‖ = ∏‖x_w‖), and α ∗ e = e for some continuous compactly supported α.

declarations.name: Space.formRep_apply
declarations.says: The representation on forms acts by right translation: (k·y)(g) = y(g(1, k)).

declarations.name: Space.integral_quotMeasure_eq_classSum
declarations.says: Let V be definite, F continuous and left Γ-invariant on G, f(g) = ∫_{G_∞} F(x, g) dx, and K ⊂ K₀ an open subgroup fixing f on the right. Then ∫_{Γ\G} F is [K₀ : K]⁻¹ times the class sum of f over Γ\G_f/K.
declarations.note: Weil's formula for a definite space, where Γ\G_f/K is finite (21 lines).

declarations.name: integral_mul_realConv
declarations.says: Fubini for right convolution: for c, k integrable, j measurable and F bounded measurable on G, ∫ c(z) R(k)F(j z) dν(z) = ∫_{G_∞} k(x) ∫ c(z) F(j(z)x) dν(z) dx, with ν s-finite.
declarations.reference: Fubini's theorem

declarations.name: isCuspKernel_typeKernel
declarations.says: For n nonempty, if every l_w = 2λ_w is a Harish-Chandra parameter whose entries λ_i, λ_j of different signs s are at least 500|n|³ + B apart, then the product kernel typeKernel l s is a cusp kernel of order B.
declarations.note: from the decay bounds for the Flensted-Jensen function at each infinite place.

declarations.name: le_prod_opNorm
declarations.says: For g in G_∞, 1 ≤ ∏_w ‖g_w‖ and each ‖g_w‖ is at most the product (all norms are ≥ 1).

declarations.name: measureReal_pos_of_isLevel
declarations.says: A level has positive measure.

declarations.name: Space.firstMinimum_le
declarations.says: The first minimum is at most the length of any non-zero lattice vector.

declarations.name: Space.firstMinimum_le_one
declarations.says: The first minimum λ of the lattice of V, cut off at 1, is at most 1.

declarations.name: Space.firstMinimum_pos
declarations.says: For every space V, λ > 0, where λ is the first minimum of the lattice of V cut off at 1 (Space.firstMinimum).
declarations.note: discreteness of the lattice in the archimedean coordinates.

declarations.name: Space.le_firstMinimum_iff
declarations.says: l ≤ λ exactly when l ≤ 1 and every non-zero lattice vector has length at least l.

declarations.name: Space.mem_and_norm_le_of_vecAtPoint
declarations.says: Suppose the adelic coordinates of ξ for V are N·k times those of η for W, with k of operator norm ≤ c at each infinite place. Then ‖ξ‖ ≤ Nc‖η‖; ξ is in V's lattice if η is in W's and N·k_f is integral.

declarations.name: Space.move_vecAtPoint
declarations.says: Moving the base point by g changes the adelic vector of ξ by g⁻¹.

declarations.name: Space.one_le_firstMinimum
declarations.says: If all signs of V agree, then Space.firstMinimum V ≥ 1: every nonzero vector of the lattice of V has length at least 1.

declarations.name: Space.exists_short_basis
declarations.says: For a natural number N ≠ 0 in the different of E, the lattice of V contains a basis of E^n of vectors of length at most 6N(fn)²/λ; f counts the infinite places, λ = min(1, first minimum of the lattice of V).
declarations.reference: the transference theorem: J. C. Lagarias, H. W. Lenstra, C. P. Schnorr, Korkin–Zolotarev bases and successive minima of a lattice and its reciprocal lattice, Combinatorica 10 (1990)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: a short-basis consequence with constant 6N(fn)²/λ (the header of Unimodular says the transference theorem is proved with constant n² in place of n/2, by projecting along a short vector). REFERENCES.md: work found, no place given.

declarations.name: Space.exists_short_basis_matrix
declarations.says: There is a constant c such that for every g the moved lattice has a basis of E^n in the ball of radius c·ht(g).

declarations.name: Space.exists_short_basis_stdSpace
declarations.says: Let N ≠ 0 be a natural number in the different of E, g in G_f. Some Y in GL_n(E) has columns in the lattice L_g of I_n (g⁻¹Y is integral) and entries of absolute value ≤ 6N(fn)² at every complex embedding, f the number of infinite places.
declarations.note: from the short-basis lemma for the standard space.

declarations.name: Space.shortBasisConst
declarations.says: The natural number 6N(fn)², f the number of infinite places of E and n the rank: the constant in the bound for short bases.

declarations.name: classSum_stdRatPoints_eq_mass
declarations.says: The class sum of 1 over the rational points of the standard space at level K₀ is the mass of the genus of rank #κ.

declarations.name: exists_rat_near_of_mem_differentIdeal
declarations.says: Let d ≠ 0 lie in the different of the CM field E with f infinite places. For z ∈ ℂ^f and a finite adele y there is a ∈ E with y − a integral and |z_w − a_w| ≤ (2f)²|d_w| at every infinite place w.
declarations.note: an explicit approximation (fundamental domain of the integers of E in its archimedean completion, scaled by the different).

declarations.name: mass_pos
declarations.says: The mass of the genus of the standard lattice of rank l is positive, for every l.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.Z1.eq_zero_on_decompGroup
declarations.says: A continuous 1-cocycle that vanishes on the inertia group and at a Frobenius element of a place B above the prime v vanishes on the decomposition group of B.
declarations.note: the decomposition group is topologically generated by inertia and a Frobenius.

declarations.name: IsTameGeneratorFor
declarations.says: γ lies in inertia at A, and γy/y = rootPowHom 1 for some m-th root y of some uniformiser π of K for A.

declarations.name: SplitPlaces
declarations.says: Auxiliary primes: distinct v_i ∤ N with places and Frobenii in U; m ∣ N; U fixes μ_m and contains all inertia off N; I is the inertia off N and the v_i; primes above N generate the class groups of number fields in Ω^U over K.
declarations.note: the auxiliary split primes of the Greenberg–Wiles argument.

declarations.name: SplitPlaces.decompGroup_le
declarations.says: The decomposition group at a place above an auxiliary prime v_i lies in U.

declarations.name: exists_isTameGeneratorFor
declarations.says: For B above a prime v of K, some γ in the inertia group of B multiplies an m-th root of some uniformiser of K by the fixed primitive m-th root of unity given by rootPowHom.
declarations.note: Kummer theory of the tamely ramified extension.

declarations.name: selmerZ1
declarations.says: The continuous 1-cocycles of ρ restricting into L_v on Dec(A_v) for v in S, and vanishing on complex conjugations and on inertia groups above primes outside S ∪ P.

declarations.name: selmerZ1.finite_unramified_cocycles
declarations.says: For a finite discrete module V of the absolute Galois group of K and a finite set S of primes, there are finitely many continuous 1-cocycles vanishing on all inertia groups above primes outside S.
declarations.reference: standard consequence of the finiteness of ray class groups (class field theory); the proof cites the idelic class-number lemma and the triviality of unramified characters of the idele classes

declarations.name: AutChar
declarations.says: The group of continuous circle-valued characters of U(1)(𝔸), the norm-one adeles of the CM field E, trivial on elements coming from E.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight
declarations.says: μ has weight e and tame part ψ: almost all residue characters ψ_w are trivial, and μ(u) = ∏_v u_v^{e(v)} · ∏_w ψ_w(u mod w) whenever u has integral finite part.

declarations.name: AutChar.baseChange
declarations.says: Base change: the homomorphism sending a character μ of U(1)(𝔸), trivial on rational points, to the Hecke character x ↦ μ(x/x̄) of E.

declarations.name: HeckeChar.atUnif
declarations.says: The value of the Hecke character χ at the local idele given by the chosen uniformiser at the finite place w.

declarations.name: HeckeChar.finPart
declarations.says: The homomorphism sending a unitary Hecke character of E to its restriction to the finite ideles, with values in ℂ^×.

declarations.name: coe_divStar
declarations.says: divStar(x) = x·(x̄)⁻¹ … by definition (x ↦ x/x̄).

declarations.name: divStar
declarations.says: The continuous homomorphism x ↦ x/x̄ from the units of a commutative topological monoid R with involution to the elements u with uū = 1.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.baseChange_finPart_locIdele
declarations.says: Let μ have weight e and tame part ψ, and let w be a finite place with w̄ ≠ w and ψ_{w̄} trivial. Then the base change y ↦ μ(y/ȳ), at a local unit x placed at w, equals ψ_w(x mod w).

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.mul_upsilonU1_pow
declarations.says: If μ has weight e and tame part ψ, then μ·υⁿ has weight n + e and tame part ψ.

declarations.name: AutChar.HasWeight.of_weight_eq
declarations.says: A weight may be replaced by an equal one.

declarations.name: WeilData.exists_chiFin_pow_eq_prod
declarations.says: For Weil data on E and a finite idele x, there are n > 0 and y ∈ E^× such that xⁿ and y have the same valuation at every finite place and (υ(x)|x|^(−1/2))ⁿ = ∏_v Φ_v(ȳ), over the embeddings Φ_v of the CM type.
declarations.note: from the finiteness of the class group (xⁿ principal) and the infinity type of υ on principal ideles.

declarations.name: WeilData.hasWeight_upsilonU1_pow
declarations.says: υⁿ has weight n (constant) and trivial tame part.

declarations.name: WeilData.hasWeight_upsilonU1_zpow
declarations.says: υ^z has weight z (constant) and trivial tame part for every integer z.

declarations.name: WeilData.norm_map_chiFin
declarations.says: |ι(χ_f(x))| = ∏_v |σ_v-extension of x| over the weight embeddings: the p-adic size of the finite splitting character is given by the CM type.

entries.known_result: Local class field theory, covering the invariant of the Brauer group, the Artin map, norms and the tame symbol

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.artinAt_eq_of_localArtin_eq
declarations.says: For A lying over w, if the local Artin symbol of x is the class of g in the abelianised decomposition group of A, then artinAt sends x to the class of g in the abelianisation of Γ.
declarations.note: compatibility of the local Artin symbol in the decomposition group with the global abelianisation; immediate from the definitions.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.exists_localArtin_eq
declarations.says: For A lying over w, if s in the decomposition group acts on residues as the (N w)^n-th power, n ≥ 0, then its class is the local Artin symbol of some x ∈ K_w^× of order −n.
declarations.reference: local class field theory (the local Artin map sends uniformisers to Frobenius elements): J.-P. Serre, Local Fields (1979)
declarations.place: Serre, Local Fields, Ch. XII–XIV (chapter range from the file header)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: existence of an element x of valuation −n whose local Artin symbol is the class of a given element acting on residues as the (Nw)^n-th power; stated for henselian fields such as fixed fields of decomposition groups, with the convention that uniformisers go to geometric Frobenii. REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed (chapter range only).

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.exists_localArtin_eq_tameGenerator
declarations.says: For A above w, there is a unit u of K_w whose local Artin image is the class of the chosen tame generator of inertia and whose residue generates the multiplicative group of the residue field.
declarations.reference: local class field theory (units map onto inertia; tame symbol): J.-P. Serre, Local Fields (1979)
declarations.place: Serre, Local Fields, Ch. XII–XIV (chapter range from the file header)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: only the existence of one unit u with Artin image the chosen tame generator of inertia whose residue generates the multiplicative group of the residue field. REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed (chapter range only).

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.tameGenerator
declarations.says: A chosen generator of tame inertia at the place A above w, as an element of the inertia group.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.tame_inertia
declarations.says: Let n be prime to w and f a homomorphism on Gal(Ω/K), trivial near 1 in inertia, with fⁿ = 1 on inertia. For s in inertia, f(s) is a power of f at the chosen tame generator, and f(φsφ⁻¹) = f(s)^q for a q-Frobenius φ.
declarations.reference: structure of tame inertia (procyclic, Frobenius acts by q-th powers): J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, Ch. IV

declarations.name: inertiaAbove
declarations.says: The union of the inertia groups in Gal(Ω/K) of all valuation subrings of Ω lying over a prime of the set S of primes of K.

declarations.name: isOpen_of_forall_pow_mem
declarations.says: For a finite place w of a number field K and n ≠ 0, every subgroup T of K_w^× that contains all n-th powers is open.
declarations.note: (K_w^×)ⁿ is an open subgroup of finite index.

declarations.name: EmbeddedNumberField
declarations.says: A number field K together with a chosen embedding into the fixed algebraic closure Ω of ℚ, given as an algebra structure.

declarations.name: IsPadicAt.isUniformiser_iff
declarations.says: Under an identification of the completion at v with a subfield of Q̄_p, an element is a uniformiser of the integers of Q̄_p (in the normalisation used) exactly when its valuation at v is e^{−1}.

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.decompGroup_le
declarations.says: An open subgroup containing the inertia group and a Frobenius at A contains the whole decomposition group (the decomposition group is generated topologically by inertia and a Frobenius).

declarations.name: IsPlaceOver.exists_isFrob
declarations.says: There is a Frobenius element at every place A of Ω lying over a finite place v.

declarations.name: cocycleKer
declarations.says: For a homomorphism a : G → R, R acting on M, and x : G → M with x(gk) = x(g) + a(g)x(k): the subgroup where x vanishes.

declarations.name: exists_comap_intQpBar_eq
declarations.says: For Ω an algebraic closure of ℚ, every valuation subring A in which p has valuation below 1 is the preimage of the integers of ℚ̄_p under some embedding Ω → ℚ̄_p.

declarations.name: sah
declarations.says: Sah's lemma: let x : G → M satisfy x(gk) = x(g) + a(g)x(k), with scalars a(g) in R. If x vanishes at (γg)⁻¹gγ, then (a(γ) − 1)x(g) = (a(g) − 1)x(γ).
declarations.note: the cocycle identity behind Sah's lemma (C.-H. Sah, 1968), a two-line computation.

declarations.name: IsCompletionGroup
declarations.says: The homomorphism j : Γ → Gal(Q̄_p over ℚ_p) is an open embedding whose image consists of the elements fixing e(K) pointwise.

declarations.name: exists_inducesPlace
declarations.says: An embedding ι : Ω → Q̄_p pulling the integers back to A induces an open embedding j of the decomposition group of A in Gal(Q̄_p/ℚ_p), with j(g)(ιx) = ι(gx), whose image consists of the automorphisms fixing ι(K) pointwise.
declarations.reference: decomposition groups as local Galois groups (J. Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory, Ch. II §9)

declarations.name: isLocalGalois_localFieldOf
declarations.says: If j is an open embedding of the topological group Γ into G_p, then Γ, acting on Q̄_p through j, is the absolute Galois group of the fixed field of j(Γ), in the sense of IsLocalGalois for the integers of Q̄_p.

declarations.name: norm_pow_sub_one_le_norm_sub_one
declarations.says: If |ζ| ≤ 1 then |ζ^a − 1| ≤ |ζ − 1| (ultrametric).

declarations.name: norm_zeta_sub_one_pow
declarations.says: If ζ is a primitive p^(m+1)-th root of unity in an ultrametric normed field, then ‖ζ − 1‖^(p^m(p−1)) = ‖p‖.
declarations.reference: L. Washington, Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields, Ch. 1 (the prime above p in ℚ(ζ_{p^n}))

declarations.name: pow_le_norm_aeval
declarations.says: Let K be algebraically closed, L a normed field over K, f in K[X] with leading coefficient a, x in L, r ≥ 0. If ‖x − w‖ ≥ r for every root w of f, then ‖f(x)‖ ≥ ‖a‖ r^(deg f).

declarations.name: valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one
declarations.says: p has valuation below 1 at the place of Ω induced by an embedding into Q̄_p.

declarations.name: Filling.frameGram_eq_frameImage
declarations.says: The frame Gram matrix Z(γ) is the matrix of the form between the frame and its image under γ.

declarations.name: Filling.frameGram_inv
declarations.says: For a hermitian invertible Gram matrix, Z(γ⁻¹) = Z(γ)ᴴ.

declarations.name: Filling.leadingMinor_frameGram_besselU_mul
declarations.says: Leading minors of the frame Gram matrix are invariant under γ ↦ u⁻¹γu′ with u, u′ in 𝖴.

declarations.name: eichlerMap
declarations.says: The matrix of the Eichler map v ↦ v + h(u, v)x − h(x, v)(u + ςx), where h is the form of J.

declarations.name: eichlerMap_mulVec
declarations.says: The Eichler map acts by v ↦ v + h(u, v)x − h(x, v)(u + ςx).

declarations.name: exists_mulVec_eq_single_det
declarations.says: For a square matrix Z there is y with Zy = det(Z)·e_top whose last entry is the leading minor of size n − 1 (adjugate column).

declarations.name: exists_unitary_eq_eichlerMap
declarations.says: If J is hermitian, x isotropic, u ⊥ x and ς + ς̄ = h(u, u), then the Eichler map is an isometry of J.

entries.known_result: Haar measure of U(J) in Cayley coordinates, volume of U(n), polynomial volume growth

declarations.name: IsProperMap.monoidHom_id
declarations.says: The identity homomorphism of U(J) is proper.

declarations.name: integral_decay_le
declarations.says: Let j : S → U(J) be a proper group homomorphism, J a hermitian involution of size n ≥ 1, ν right invariant, finite on compacts, c > 8n² natural, y∈U(J). Then (2/‖j(s)y‖)^c is ν-integrable with integral ≤ 16^c·ν{‖j(s)−1‖ ≤ 1} (operator norms).
declarations.reference: polynomial volume growth (header sources: L. K. Hua 1963; I. G. Macdonald, Invent. Math. 56 (1980); B. Gross, Invent. Math. 130 (1997))
declarations.note: integrability of (2/‖j(s)y‖)^c for c > 8n² with the explicit constant 16^c, for a proper homomorphism into U(J); explicit crude constants of this proof's own making.

declarations.name: isCompact_U_norm_le
declarations.says: Norm balls {‖y‖ ≤ T} in U(J) are compact.

declarations.name: lintegral_decay_le
declarations.says: The lower-integral form of the decay bound above.

declarations.name: measure_ball_le_covering
declarations.says: Covering bound: let j: S → U(J) be a group homomorphism, ν right invariant, y∈U(J), D, R ≥ 1, K ≥ 3DR². Then ν{‖j(s)y‖ ≤ R} ≤ K^{2n²} ν{‖j(s)−1‖ ≤ 1/D} (operator norms).
declarations.note: an explicit covering bound for norm balls in any group mapping to U(J) (13 lines); the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: measure_ball_ne_top_of_isProperMap
declarations.says: For a proper homomorphism j, the sets {‖j(s) − 1‖ ≤ R} have finite measure.

declarations.name: measure_sublevel_ne_zero
declarations.says: Let ν be a measure on a group S with a topology, positive on nonempty open sets. If f : S → ℝ is continuous and f(1) < r, the set {s | f(s) ≤ r} has nonzero measure.

declarations.name: IsHermInvolution.det_ne_zero
declarations.says: A hermitian involution has non-zero determinant.

declarations.name: IsHermInvolution.isUnit
declarations.says: A hermitian involution is invertible (J² = 1).

declarations.name: IsHermInvolution.mem_unitary
declarations.says: A hermitian involution is a unitary matrix.

declarations.name: U.norm_inv
declarations.says: For g in U(J), ‖g⁻¹‖ = ‖g‖ (operator norm).

declarations.name: U.one_le_norm
declarations.says: For g in U(J), ‖g‖ ≥ 1.

declarations.name: skewCoords
declarations.says: The real linear map sending a complex matrix x to the real matrix with entries Re x_ab + Im x_ab, divided by √2 off the diagonal; a left inverse of skewOfReal.

declarations.name: skewOfReal
declarations.says: The real linear map sending a real matrix y to the skew-hermitian matrix with entries i·y_aa on the diagonal and ((1+i)y_ab − (1−i)y_ba)/√2 off it.

declarations.name: HasFundDomain.pi
declarations.says: Products of fundamental domains are fundamental domains for the coordinatewise lattice.

declarations.name: IsCovolOneLattice.finite_preimage
declarations.says: A covolume-one lattice has finite intersection with every compact set (for an injective map).

declarations.name: Space.ratEmbed_injective
declarations.says: The embedding of the rational unitary group into G is injective.

declarations.name: ratVectors
declarations.says: The additive subgroup of adelic vectors indexed by n that is the image of E^n under the coordinatewise diagonal embedding.

declarations.name: stdSpace_embFin
declarations.says: The finite part of the embedding of γ for the standard space is γ read over the finite adeles.

declarations.name: volÔ_eq
declarations.says: vol(Ô) = ((rd_E/2)^{#infinite places})⁻¹.

declarations.name: CMLattice.norm_le_one_of_isogeny
declarations.says: If a complex number a satisfies aΛ ⊂ Λ' for the lattices of two CM data for d (a prime ≡ 7 mod 8), then a is p-adically integral: |ι(a)|_p ≤ 1.
declarations.note: integrality of the multiplier of an isogeny between two normalised CM curves at every p-adic place; the file calls such lemmas folklore, but the statement needs good reduction of both models; the write-up must read it or cite CM theory.

declarations.name: CMLattice.rescale_translate_eq_theta_pow_mul
declarations.says: Let 0 ≠ δ ∈ 𝓞_K with δδ̄ = N and δy ∈ Λ. Then, read in ℂ_p, the series (U_yθ)(δ̄z) lies in θ^N·𝔬[[φ]].
declarations.reference: cf. K. Bannai, S. Kobayashi, Algebraic theta functions and the p-adic interpolation of Eisenstein–Kronecker numbers, Duke Math. J. 153 (2010), 2.14–2.16 (header of the IntegralParameter file)
declarations.note: integrality of torsion translates of the CM theta function pulled back by an endomorphism δ̄; not compared with the cited paper.

declarations.name: congruencePart
declarations.says: The part of the power series f in the degrees congruent to r modulo m.

declarations.name: congruencePart_eq_sum
declarations.says: For a primitive m-th root of unity ζ, the part of f in degrees ≡ r (mod m) is m⁻¹ Σ_{i<m} ζ^{−ir} f(ζ^i z) (roots-of-unity filter).

declarations.name: eq_sum_pow_of_sub_pow_eq
declarations.says: In characteristic d′, if s − s^{d′^e} = x then s = Σ_{l<B} x^{d′^{el}} + s^{d′^{eB}} for every B (telescoping of Frobenius powers).

declarations.name: exists_val_coeff_le_val_eval
declarations.says: For a valuation v on an algebraically closed field K and finitely many multivariate polynomials f_i over K, there is a point y with coordinates in the valuation ring such that v(c) ≤ v(f_i(y)) (v multiplicative) for every i and every coefficient c of f_i.
declarations.note: the Gauss norm of finitely many polynomials is attained at a point of the unit polydisc (choose a point whose reduction avoids the zeros of the reduced polynomials); textbook non-archimedean analysis.

declarations.name: affineAction
declarations.says: The affine action attached to a cocycle c: the homomorphism sending g to the permutation v ↦ c(g) + ρ(g)v of B^n.

declarations.name: cocycle_apply_inv
declarations.says: For a 1-cocycle c, c(g⁻¹) = −ρ(g⁻¹)c(g).

declarations.name: exists_conj_side_detects
declarations.says: Let γ be the tame generator at A over P ∤ ℓ, ρ unramified at v = P or P̄, ℓ^M B = 0. For σ' = σ or σ^{−c}, Selmer cocycles killing γ' are unramified at v, and vanish on a decomposition group if they also kill φ', φ a Frobenius at A.
declarations.note: a local argument with the tame generator and a Frobenius at a place not above ℓ (16 lines); σ^{−c} denotes (σ^c)⁻¹.

declarations.name: length_localCocycles_le
declarations.says: Let ℓ^M kill B, m-th powers of inertia and inertia near 1 act trivially, and mℓ^M be a unit at A. Then localCocycles has length at most that of B^n plus that of ker(ρ(γ) − 1) on B^n, for any inertial γ.
declarations.note: local cocycles of a tamely acting module are determined by their values at a Frobenius and a tame generator.

declarations.name: localCocycles
declarations.says: The restrictions to the decomposition group of A of the continuous cocycles of Gal(Ω over E) for ρ with values in B^n that obey the relations L.

declarations.name: tame_affineAction
declarations.says: Let ℓ^M kill B, ρ kill m-th powers of inertia and inertia near 1, q = mℓ^M be a unit at A, c a locally constant cocycle, γ inertial. If c kills the tame generator, c(γ) = 0; in the affine action γ commutes with Frobenii of exponent ≡ 1 mod q.

declarations.name: H.add
declarations.says: The sum x+y of two classes x, y in Ext^a(N,F).

declarations.name: TotalH.comp
declarations.says: The biadditive map from total Ext(M,N) and total Ext(N,F) to total Ext(M,F) extending the Yoneda composition of homogeneous classes.

declarations.name: TotalH.comp_assoc
declarations.says: The Yoneda composition of total Ext groups is associative.

declarations.name: TotalH.map
declarations.says: For an exact functor Φ, the additive map from total Ext(N,F) to total Ext(ΦN,ΦF) obtained by applying Φ in each degree.

declarations.name: TotalH.map_comp
declarations.says: An exact functor is compatible with Yoneda composition of total Ext classes.

declarations.name: TotalH.map_map
declarations.says: Applying two exact functors in turn to a total Ext class equals applying their composite.

entries.known_result: Bessel subgroup of a real unitary group, with coordinates, Haar measure and Bessel functions

declarations.name: exists_tube
declarations.says: For T ≥ 8r, r the rank, there are a compact B ⊂ {‖y‖ ≤ T^{20(ϱ+1)}} in G₁ and a measurable Ω ⊂ 𝖴⁰ with 0 < ν(Ω) < ∞, Ω·{‖y‖ ≤ T} ⊂ B, and ν{u : uy ∈ B} ≤ T·ν(Ω) for all y; ν = Shape.besselHaar₀.
declarations.note: a tube lemma for the unfolding along the Bessel subgroup (29 lines), with explicit polynomial bounds; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: injective_freeEntries_besselU
declarations.says: The free-entry coordinates for IsFreeEntry are injective on the unipotent group U (besselU) of G₁.

declarations.name: isUnimodularHaar_besselHaar₀
declarations.says: The measure besselHaar₀ on the unipotent group 𝖴⁰ is a unimodular Haar measure (an instance of a property).

declarations.name: measurePreserving_conj_bessel
declarations.says: Let S be the subgroup of G₁ of elements that agree with the identity matrix at a given set of positions, normalised by the Bessel subgroup besselS. Then conjugation by any s in the Bessel subgroup preserves every Haar measure μ on S.
declarations.note: unimodularity of the unipotent radical, 20 lines.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_freeEntries_besselHaar
declarations.says: The free entries (freeEntries at IsFreeEntry) carry the measure Shape.besselHaar on 𝖴 to Lebesgue measure.

declarations.name: mem_besselU0_iff_apply
declarations.says: u lies in 𝖴⁰ exactly when its entries agree with the identity matrix at the positions above the level order or in the frame columns.

declarations.name: HCParam.HasLargeGap.isUnitaryCasimirGe_dsAction
declarations.says: For n ≥ 1 and gap 500n³ + A, the inner product on D_λ is invariant under 𝔲(diag ε), the generator ψ_λ has norm 1, and |y(g)| ≤ ‖y‖ for all y in D_λ and g in U(diag ε).
declarations.reference: Schur orthogonality for discrete series (R. Godement, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris 225 (1947); N. Wallach, Real Reductive Groups I (1988), ch. 7)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for the module D_λ generated by one explicit coefficient ψ_λ of U(p,q) with a large gap: invariance of the inner product, norm one of ψ_λ, and |y(g)| ≤ ‖y‖ (the orthogonality is proved for this module only). Header gives Wallach ch. 7 (a chapter); the CircleMean file has no citation in REFERENCES.md.

declarations.name: HCParam.dsGenerator
declarations.says: The function ψ_λ as an element of the module D_λ that it generates.

declarations.name: exists_smear_dsCoeffSmooth_eq
declarations.says: For n ≥ 1 and l = 2λ of gap 500n³ + A, every element of D_λ = U(𝔤)ψ_λ has the form g ↦ ∫ β(y⁻¹) ψ_λ(gy) dy for some smooth compactly supported function β on U(diag ε).
declarations.note: every element of U(𝔤)ψ_λ is a smoothing of ψ_λ by a test function (14 lines); comparable to Harish-Chandra's lemma that Z(𝔤)- and K-finite functions are reproduced by convolution, but not identified with it here.

declarations.name: formalDegree_pos
declarations.says: For n ≥ 1 and a parameter λ of gap 500n³ + A, the degree deg_λ, the reciprocal of ∫_G |ψ_λ|², is positive.

declarations.name: isKHighest_dsGenerator
declarations.says: For a parameter l = 2λ of gap h, ψ_λ is K-highest of weight Λ in the module D_λ = U(𝔤)ψ_λ.

declarations.name: norm_dsCoeff_le_one
declarations.says: For a parameter l = 2λ of any gap h for the signs ε, |ψ_λ(g)| ≤ 1 for every g in U(diag ε).

declarations.name: FockDualPair.IsMatchedPair
declarations.says: Row r and column c are matched: ξ = l_r − 2γ + |C| equals −(l'_c − 2γ' + |R|), and σ ε_r ε'_c ξ exceeds the absolute value of |R| − |C|.

declarations.name: FockDualPair.std
declarations.says: The dual pair data with sign σ = 1, integers γ and γ' + |R|, and variables indexed by R × C itself.

declarations.name: FockDualPair.swap
declarations.says: The dual pair data with rows and columns exchanged: sign −σ, integers γ', γ in this order, and the same variables.

declarations.name: FockDualPair.vacuumWeight
declarations.says: The weight of the vacuum on a row of sign s: γ minus the number of columns c with σ s ε'_c = −1.

declarations.name: IsJointHarmonic
declarations.says: Joint harmonic: l, l' match and Φ ≠ 0 is highest of weights Λ, Λ' for the row and column actions and satisfies IsHarmonic along columns and along rows.

declarations.name: pairSign
declarations.says: For a sign σ, sign vectors ε, ε' and an index pair (r,c), the sign σ ε_r ε'_c.

declarations.name: abs_norm_eq_prod_norm_sq
declarations.says: For x in a totally complex (CM) field E, |N_{E/ℚ}(x)| = ∏_v |Φ_v(x)|² over the infinite places.

declarations.name: eq_of_ψf
declarations.says: Nondegeneracy of the additive character ψ_f of the finite adeles of a number field E: if ψ_f(ta) = ψ_f(tb) for every finite adele t, then a = b.

declarations.name: forall_ψf_mul_eq_one
declarations.says: For a finite adele x of E, ψ_f(ux) = 1 for all integral finite adeles u if and only if dx is integral for every d in the different of E over ℚ.
declarations.reference: the dual of the integers under the standard character is the inverse different (J. Tate's thesis, in Cassels–Fröhlich ch. XV)

declarations.name: isOfFinOrder_ψf
declarations.says: Every value of the finite additive character ψ_f is a root of unity.

declarations.name: one_le_prod_norm_Φ
declarations.says: For a non-zero algebraic integer y of E, ∏_v |Φ_v(y)| ≥ 1 (its norm is a non-zero integer).

declarations.name: adeleOfLocal
declarations.says: Extension by zero: the additive and multiplicative map from the product of the E_w, w in P, to the finite adeles, with component 0 outside P.

declarations.name: adeleOfLocal_evalPlaces
declarations.says: Extension by zero of the S-components of x is idem(S)·x.

declarations.name: continuous_adeleOfLocal
declarations.says: Extension by zero is continuous.

declarations.name: continuous_evalPlaces
declarations.says: Evaluation at the places of S is continuous.

declarations.name: evalPlaces
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism sending a finite adele to its components at the places of the finite set P.

entries.known_result: base change, discreteness and compact quotient, and the modulus for the adeles of a number field

declarations.name: FinPlace.mem_comap
declarations.says: x lies in the place below w exactly when its image lies in w.

declarations.name: heckePolyCoeff
declarations.says: The number (−X)^d q^{d(d−1)/2} attached to a subspace U of k^n of dimension d, with q the number of elements of the field k (0 if k is infinite).

declarations.name: letterMinor
declarations.says: The minor det(x_{τ,i(a),j(b)})_{a,b∈l} of the variable matrix at τ, in rows i and columns j.

declarations.name: q_binomial_submodule
declarations.says: The q-binomial theorem for subspaces: for a subspace W of a finite vector space over a field with q elements, ∑_{U ⊆ W} (−X)^{dim U} q^{binom(dim U, 2)} = ∏_{l < dim W} (1 − q^l X) for X ∈ ℂ.
declarations.reference: the q-binomial theorem (Gauss; Cauchy), in the form of a sum over subspaces of a finite vector space
declarations.relation: the theorem
declarations.note: the subspace form Σ_{U⊆W} (−X)^{dim U} q^{binom(dim U,2)} = ∏_{l<dim W}(1 − q^l X); the header calls it the Gauss q-binomial theorem; no citation in REFERENCES.md.

declarations.name: trivialHecke
declarations.says: For natural numbers q, m and a complex number X, the product of 1 − q^l·X over 0 ≤ l < m.

declarations.name: Space.formTranslation
declarations.says: The representation of the finite adelic unitary group on forms of weight κ on V by right translation.

declarations.name: Space.forms
declarations.says: Algebraic modular forms of weight κ on a definite space V: functions f on G_f with open right stabiliser and f(γg) = ρ_κ(γ)f(g) for rational γ, ρ_κ = Space.weightRep.

declarations.name: block_embFin
declarations.says: The block embedding of the image of (γ, 1) is the image of the block embedding.

declarations.name: inf_supportedOn_le_principalLevel
declarations.says: Elements of K₀ supported on places where a is a unit lie in the principal level K(a).

declarations.name: smoothPairing_formTranslation
declarations.says: The smooth pairing is invariant under right translation.

declarations.name: SplitTameChar.exists_atPlaces_eq
declarations.says: Every element of GL_n(∏_{w∈S} E_w) is the S-component of an element supported on S.

declarations.name: atPlaces_of_mem_trivialOn
declarations.says: An element trivial at the places P has trivial P-components.

declarations.name: localChar_det
declarations.says: For finite adelic unitary g, localChar P ξ k at the determinant of the P-components of g equals ξ(d)|d|^{k/2}, d the idele that is det g at P and 1 elsewhere.

declarations.name: spaceChar_rankTwist
declarations.says: For n of even cardinality, the space character of the rank-n twist of ν is the base change of ν.

declarations.name: upsilonU1_det_of_mem_Kf
declarations.says: The splitting character υ is trivial on determinants of elements of K₀ (unramified).

entries.known_result: Euler product, continuation to s = 1, non-vanishing and prime densities for Hecke L-functions

declarations.name: CharUnramifiedAt.apply_locIdele_eq_zpow
declarations.says: If ψ is unramified at w, then ψ at the local idele of x equals ψ at the local idele of the uniformiser raised to the valuation of x (with the sign convention used).

declarations.name: IsHeckeOfType.ne_one
declarations.says: Over a CM field K, if ψ is the finite part of a Hecke character of type n and n ≠ 0, then ψ is not the trivial character.

declarations.name: IsHeckeOfType.norm_eq_one
declarations.says: A Hecke character ψ of type n on the finite ideles of K is unitary: |ψ(x)| = 1 for every x.

declarations.name: IsHeckeOfType.norm_heckeCoeff_le
declarations.says: The coefficients ψ(ϖ_v) of the Euler product of a Hecke character of type n have absolute value at most 1.

declarations.name: IsHeckeOfType.pow
declarations.says: The d-th power of a Hecke character of type n is a Hecke character of type d·n.

declarations.name: CutsOutLocus.IsHomogSolution.map
declarations.says: Homogeneous solutions of the equations of a locus are carried along ring maps.

declarations.name: CutsOutLocus.IsHomogSolution.refl
declarations.says: Every coordinate vector is a homogeneous solution for itself.

declarations.name: CutsOutLocus.IsHomogSolution.smul
declarations.says: Homogeneous solutions are stable under scaling by a unit u.

declarations.name: IsUnimodCoords.comp
declarations.says: Unimodular homogeneous coordinates of a point of projective space are carried along ring maps.

declarations.name: IsUnimodCoords.ext
declarations.says: Two points with the same unimodular homogeneous coordinates are equal.

declarations.name: ideleAbs
declarations.says: The module of an idele: the homomorphism x ↦ |x| (the adelic absolute value if E is totally complex) from the idele group of E to the multiplicative monoid ℝ.

declarations.name: ideleAbs_eq_one_of_mem_unitary
declarations.says: For a CM field E, a norm-one idele (x x̄ = 1) has module 1.

declarations.name: ideleAbs_eq_prod_of_v_eq_one
declarations.says: If x is a unit at every finite place, |x| = ∏_w |x_w|² over the infinite places.

declarations.name: ideleAbs_toAdele
declarations.says: The product formula: for a totally complex number field E and x in E^×, the principal idele of x has module ideleAbs equal to 1.
declarations.reference: the product formula (E. Artin, G. Whaples; e.g. J. W. S. Cassels, Global fields, in Cassels–Fröhlich (1967), ch. II)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for totally complex number fields with chosen embeddings.

declarations.name: finIdeleAbs
declarations.says: The module |x| of a finite idele x: the adelic absolute value of the idele with finite part x and component 1 at infinity.

declarations.name: genIndex_eq_inv_finIdeleAbs
declarations.says: For a finite idele a of a number field E, the inverse of the factor by which a scales additive Haar measure on the finite adeles equals |a|⁻¹, where |a| = finIdeleAbs a is the adelic absolute value.
declarations.reference: the module of an idele (A. Weil, Basic Number Theory, ch. IV; J. W. S. Cassels in Cassels–Fröhlich, ch. II §§14–16)

declarations.name: norm_locField_eq_q_zpow
declarations.says: For x ≠ 0 in E_w, |x| = q_w^{log v(x)} (normalised absolute value).

declarations.name: v_uniformizer_inv_mul_le_one_iff
declarations.says: v(ϖ⁻¹y) ≤ 1 exactly when v(y) < 1, ϖ the chosen uniformiser.

declarations.name: Reduction.IsIntBounded.star
declarations.says: If r bounds a and a is integral, then so is aᴴ.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.norm_le_of_firstMinimum_lt
declarations.says: Let F be a form of level K(M), its type a cusp kernel, N ≠ 0 in the different, κ = cuspConst, 0 < δ ≤ 1, λ(g) < (δ/(Mκ²))ⁿ. If |F(gx) − F(g)| ≤ C for real x with all ‖x_w − 1‖ ≤ δ, then |F(g)| ≤ C.
declarations.reference: header of Petersson: I. Satake, Sém. H. Cartan 10 (1957/58), exp. 9 bis; R. Godement, ibid., exp. 10; A. Borel, Park City lectures
declarations.note: the cusp step (72 lines): a form of type a cusp kernel, with oscillation at most C along small real translations, is bounded by C at points deep in the cusp (first minimum below an explicit power); cuspidality read as a bound by the oscillation along unipotent orbits with explicit depth; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: cuspConst
declarations.says: The real number 8fn·rd(E) + 12n⁶[E:ℚ]²N + 1, with f the number of infinite places of E, rd(E) its root discriminant and n the rank.

declarations.name: one_le_cuspConst
declarations.says: The cusp constant is at least 1.

declarations.name: exists_besselU_mul_toBesselH
declarations.says: Every s in 𝖲 is u·ι(h) with u in 𝖴 and h in the unitary group of the identity form on A^κ (under the hypotheses on A and N).

declarations.name: exists_toBesselH_eq
declarations.says: Every element of 𝖧 is the image of some element of the unitary group of the identity form under the middle-group embedding.

declarations.name: toBesselH
declarations.says: The embedding of the unitary group of the identity form on A^κ into the unitary group of the whole space with middle form Shape.middleGram N, acting on X₀ and fixing the other basis vectors.

declarations.name: toBesselH_mem
declarations.says: The middle-group embedding lands in 𝖧.

entries.known_result: Kronecker's first limit formula

declarations.name: CMLattice.exists_log_theta
declarations.says: In ℂ_p, θ = exp(−L) with L = O(z²), L″ = L₂ + ξ and √−d·L₂ integral. For each limit (a, N) of pairs (ιδ, ι(δδ̄)), δ ∈ 𝓞_K, the series φ(az), exp(NL − L(az)) and (NL − L(az))′ lie in 𝔬[[φ]].
declarations.note: p-adic integrality of the logarithm of the CM theta function and of its dilation quotients; the header of the IntegralParameter file points to Bannai–Kobayashi (2010) and Mazur–Tate, The p-adic sigma function (1991), for comparable statements; the write-up must read the proof (35 lines).

declarations.name: map_sqrt_neg_sq
declarations.says: Under ι, (i√d)² = −d.

declarations.name: mem_normPairClosure_of_pow_eq
declarations.says: If |ζ| = 1 and ζ^{N} = ζ with N the norm of the prime above p, then the pair (ζ, ζ^{p+1}) is a p-adic limit of pairs (ιδ, ι(δδ̄)) with δ ∈ 𝒪_K.
declarations.note: Teichmüller representatives as limits of quadratic integers (header).

declarations.name: sqrt_neg_mem_quadInt
declarations.says: i√d lies in the image of 𝒪_K in ℂ.

entries.known_result: the Galois action on CM theta functions and on the finite Weil representation

declarations.name: Space.semilinear_intertwines_weil
declarations.says: Let L be σ-semilinear with values in 𝒲_f, Lϱ(x) = ϱ(bx)L on 𝒲_f, σψ₀(z) = ψ₀(bb̄z), R ∩ R̄ = ∅. Then b is a unit, Lω(g) = (σΔ(g)/Δ(g))ω(g)L on 𝒲_f, and some c and unitary adele z have L vac = cω(z)vac, L(Ψ⊗vac) = cω(z)(σΨ⊗vac), Ψ Schwartz–Bruhat above R.
declarations.reference: G. Shimura, Theta functions with complex multiplication, Duke Math. J. 43 (1976) 673–696
declarations.note: a uniqueness (Stone–von Neumann/Schur) argument for the finite Weil representation: a semilinear map intertwining Heisenberg translations intertwines the Weil representation up to an explicit factor; REFERENCES.md: work found, no place given; the write-up must read it (43 lines) or locate the statement in Shimura's paper.

declarations.name: map_finMultiplier_mul_conj
declarations.says: For an automorphism σ of ℂ and a finite unitary point g, σ(Δ(g))σ(Δ̄(g)) = Δ(g)Δ̄(g), Δ the finite multiplier of the Weil representation.

declarations.name: multiplierRatio
declarations.says: The ratio σ(Δ(g))/Δ(g) for a finite unitary point g, with Δ = finMultiplier.

declarations.name: multiplierRatio_sq
declarations.says: For an embedding σ of ℂ into itself and a finite point g of the unitary group, the square of the factor σΔ(g)/Δ(g) (multiplierRatio) equals υ(det g)/σ(υ(det g)).

declarations.name: PeriodPair.area
declarations.says: The area |Im(ω̄₁ω₂)| of the fundamental parallelogram spanned by the periods ω₁, ω₂ of the period pair L.

declarations.name: PeriodPair.hermitianForm
declarations.says: The hermitian form (l, z) ↦ (π/A)·l̄·z on ℂ, A the area of the lattice of L, as a map real-linear in l and complex-linear in z.

declarations.name: area_pos
declarations.says: The area of the fundamental parallelogram of a lattice is positive.

declarations.name: exists_isIsogeny_of_mul_mem_lattice
declarations.says: If multiplication by the complex number a maps the lattice of L into the lattice of M, then a·ā·area(L) = N·area(M) for some natural number N.

declarations.name: Z1
declarations.says: The continuous 1-cocycles of ρ: the R-module of continuous f: G → M with f(gh) = f(g) + ρ(g)f(h).

declarations.name: actionRep
declarations.says: The R-linear representation of a monoid G on M obtained from a homomorphism χ : G → S into a monoid S acting R-linearly on M: g acts as χ(g).

declarations.name: charRep
declarations.says: For an R-module M and a character χ: G → R^×, the representation of G on M in which g acts as the scalar χ(g).

declarations.name: d0
declarations.says: The R-linear map from M to functions G → M sending m to g ↦ ρ(g)m − m.

declarations.name: AlgHeckeChar.avatar
declarations.says: The p-adic avatar: a chosen homomorphism sending the algebraic Hecke character (θ, n) to the continuous character μ of Gal(Ω/K') with μ(Art x) = ι(θ(x)) ∏_σ (ισ)(x_p)^{n_σ}.
declarations.note: the ℓ-adic Galois character attached to an algebraic Hecke character (θ, n).

declarations.name: AlgHeckeChar.avatar_localArtin
declarations.says: Let A lie over v, with v ∤ p or n_σ = 0 whenever ιℓ∘σ induces v. If g in the decomposition group D of A has class Art_v(x) in D^ab, the avatar of (θ, n) at g is ιℓ(θ(x)), x an idele at v.
declarations.note: from the defining property of the avatar and 949.

declarations.name: AlgHeckeChar.continuous_avatar
declarations.says: The ℓ-adic avatar of an algebraic Hecke character is continuous.

declarations.name: exists_comp_artinMap
declarations.says: Existence theorem: for K totally complex, a continuous homomorphism θ from the finite ideles to a group C with a T₁ topology, trivial on K^×, is μ∘Art for a continuous homomorphism μ: Γ → C.
declarations.reference: global class field theory, existence theorem: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory (v4.03, 2020); J. Tate, Global class field theory, in Cassels–Fröhlich (1967), ch. VII
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: only for totally complex K and with finite ideles (real places handled by total positivity); stated as: every continuous homomorphism from the finite ideles to a T₁ topological group, trivial on K^×, factors through the Artin map. The header points to Milne VI 4.9, VII 4–9, VIII 4; the file is among those whose citations were not part of the authors' check (REFERENCES.md).

declarations.name: IsComplexConj.cycCharMod_eq_neg_one
declarations.says: A complex conjugation acts on N-th roots of unity by inversion: the mod-N cyclotomic character is −1 on it.

declarations.name: IsComplexConj.cycChar_eq_neg_one
declarations.says: If σ ∈ Γ acts as a complex conjugation on the algebraically closed field Ω of characteristic zero, then the ℓ-adic cyclotomic character takes the value −1 at σ.

declarations.name: IsComplexConj.false_of_isTotallyComplex
declarations.says: No Galois element over a totally complex field K acts as a complex conjugation.

declarations.name: IsComplexConj.mul_self
declarations.says: A complex conjugation is an involution: c² = 1.

declarations.name: apply_eq_pow_of_isFrob
declarations.says: A q-Frobenius at the l-adic place acts on M-th roots of unity, l ∤ M, by ζ ↦ ζ^q.

declarations.name: exists_apply_eq_pow
declarations.says: Every element of the Galois group of Q̄_l over ℚ_l acts on an M-th root of unity, l ∤ M, as a power ζ ↦ ζ^{l^n}.

declarations.name: isUniformiser_ell
declarations.says: l is a uniformiser of the integers of Q̄_l in the normalisation used.

declarations.name: valuation_natCast_eq_one
declarations.says: An integer prime to l has valuation 1 (is a unit) at the l-adic place.

declarations.name: H.map_map
declarations.says: Pull-back along freeAb.map u then freeAb.map v equals pull-back along the composite map.

declarations.name: IsCohomDense.mono
declarations.says: If the subfunctor U of Y is dense for F and V is a subfunctor of Y containing U, then V is dense for F.

declarations.name: IsCohomDense.preimage
declarations.says: If the subfunctor U of Y is dense for F, then its preimage under any map p: E → Y is a dense subfunctor of E for F.

declarations.name: IsCohomDense.trans
declarations.says: Let U, V be subfunctors of Y. If V is dense in Y for F and U ∩ V, the preimage of U in V, is dense in V, then U is dense in Y.

declarations.name: freeAb.prod
declarations.says: For set-valued functors X, Y, the map ℤ[X × Y] → ℤ[X] ⊗ ℤ[Y] sending [(x, y)] to [x] ⊗ [y].

declarations.name: relFreeAb.map
declarations.says: For u:V'→V carrying U' into U, the induced morphism Z[V']/Z[U']→Z[V]/Z[U].

declarations.name: relFreeAb.map_comp
declarations.says: The maps of relative free abelian presheaves ℤ[V]/ℤ[U] compose: map v ∘ map u = map (v ∘ u) (in the stated order).

declarations.name: relFreeAb.mk_eq_zero
declarations.says: The class of a generator [x] in ℤ[V]/ℤ[U] vanishes when x lies in U.

declarations.name: Gm.ext
declarations.says: Two points of the multiplicative group over A are equal when their underlying units are equal.

declarations.name: HodgeH.baseChange
declarations.says: Base change: for an E-algebra k, the additive map from the Hodge cohomology over E of N to that over k of N restricted to k-algebras.

declarations.name: HodgeH.map
declarations.says: For α: N' → N, the k-linear pull-back from the degree-q Hodge cohomology of N to that of N'.

declarations.name: HodgeH.scale
declarations.says: For t ∈ k, the endomorphism s_t of the degree-q Hodge cohomology of N induced by (a, m) ↦ (a, tm) on A ⊕ M.

declarations.name: half_le_norm_dsCoeff
declarations.says: If ‖g − 1‖ ≤ (200β⁵)⁻¹ with β ≥ n + L + 1, then |ψ_λ(g)| ≥ 1/2 (from the Lipschitz bound below).

declarations.name: integral_tail_le
declarations.says: For l=2λ of gap 500n³+B with all |l_a| ≤ L and a natural number c > 8n², the function deg_λ·(2/‖g‖)^c is integrable on U(diag ε), with integral at most 8(2000(n+L+1)⁶)^{2n²}·2^c.
declarations.note: from the polynomial volume growth bound and a bound on deg_λ.

declarations.name: measure_ball_le_integral_dsCoeff
declarations.says: For a right-invariant measure ν on S and j : S → U(diag ε) with |ψ_λ∘j|² integrable, ν{‖j(s)‖ ≤ r} ≤ C(n, L)·r^{O(n²)}·∫|ψ_λ(j(s))|² dν, with explicit constants.
declarations.note: from the covering bound and |ψ_λ| ≥ 1/2 near 1.

declarations.name: norm_dsCoeff_sub_le
declarations.says: Let n ≥ 1 and l = 2λ be a parameter of gap 500n³ + B with all |l_a| ≤ L. For x, g in U(diag ε): |ψ_λ(xg) − ψ_λ(x)| ≤ 100(n+L+1)⁵‖g − 1‖, in the operator norm.
declarations.note: an explicit Lipschitz bound for ψ_λ (25 lines), with a constant polynomial in n and L; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: abs_det_logDerivU_col_eq_cayleyDensity
declarations.says: For the family θ ↦ Cayley chart of U(n) at skewColumnEquiv k₀ (θ,0), the form g⁻¹dg read in the column coordinates has absolute determinant the Cayley weight cayleyDensity (J = 1) at that point.
declarations.reference: L. K. Hua (1963), ch. III

declarations.name: cayleyChart_col_injective
declarations.says: For J = 1, the map sending θ to the k₀-th column of the Cayley chart at the point skewColumnEquiv k₀ (θ, 0), whose coordinate submatrix off k₀ vanishes, is injective.

declarations.name: skewColumnEquiv
declarations.says: A volume-preserving real linear homeomorphism onto real n×n matrices, inverse to y ↦ ((y_{k₀k₀}, column k₀ of skewOfReal y without its diagonal entry), block of y off k₀).

declarations.name: skewColumnEquiv_spec
declarations.says: The column equivalence is measure preserving, and its inverse reads off the diagonal entry, the column and the complementary block.

entries.known_result: Highest coefficient and reproducing property of the holomorphic discrete series

declarations.name: IsHolOfWeight.apply_mul_diagTorus
declarations.says: A function holomorphic of weight u transforms under the diagonal torus by the character t ↦ ∏_{τ,i} t_i^{u_{τ,i}}.

declarations.name: IsHolOfWeight.continuous
declarations.says: A function holomorphic of weight u is continuous.

declarations.name: kTypeNormSq_pos
declarations.says: The squared norm of the K-type of a parameter is positive.

declarations.name: lowerMask
declarations.says: The complex-linear map on matrices keeping the entries (i,j) with o_j < o_i and ε_i = ε_j and replacing all other entries by zero.

declarations.name: stdAddChar
declarations.says: The standard additive character of the adeles of E: the product of exp(−2πi ∑_w 2 Re x_w) over the infinite places and ψ_f of the finite part.

declarations.name: volÔ
declarations.says: The number 2^{r₂}/√|disc E|: the volume of the integral finite adeles that gives the quotient of the adeles by E total mass one.

declarations.name: volÔ_ne_zero
declarations.says: The volume constant 2^{r₂}/√|disc E| is non-zero.

declarations.name: Space.IsForm.mem_rapidFunctions
declarations.says: If e is a cusp kernel on G_∞, every form F of type e for V decays rapidly: |F| times any power of the height is bounded.
declarations.reference: rapid decay of cusp forms: A. Borel, Automorphic forms on reductive groups (Park City lectures); S. Miller, W. Schmid, On the rapid decay of cuspidal automorphic forms, Adv. Math. 231 (2012)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for forms reproduced by a cusp kernel (a bounded function reproduced by an integrable minimal idempotent, no differential equation). Place from the file header of Petersson; REFERENCES.md: Borel (Park City) work found, no place given; Miller–Schmid work found, no place given; so the place is unchecked.

declarations.name: Space.exists_kernel_form
declarations.says: Poincaré series: for a cusp kernel e, x ∈ G and a level K (IsLevel), there is a K-fixed form k of type e on V with conj k(g) = ∑_{γ∈Γ} e((xγg)_∞)·1_K((xγg)_f) for all g ∈ G.
declarations.reference: Poincaré series: R. Godement, Série de Poincaré et Spitzenformen, Sém. H. Cartan 10 (1957/58), exp. 10; A. Borel, Introduction to automorphic forms (1966)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for a cusp kernel e, a point x and a level K: the K-fixed form of type e whose conjugate is Σ_γ e((xγg)_∞)·1_K((xγg)_f). Place from the file header of Petersson; REFERENCES.md: Godement exp. 10 place confirmed at second hand.

declarations.name: Space.finite_levelSpace
declarations.says: If e is a cusp kernel on G_∞ and K is an open subgroup of G_f, the forms of type e fixed by K make up a finite-dimensional complex vector space.
declarations.reference: finite dimension of spaces of cusp forms (Harish-Chandra; A. Borel, Park City lectures; R. Godement, The spectral decomposition of cusp forms, PSPM 9 (1966))
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for forms of a type given by a cusp kernel and an open level K. Place from the file header of Petersson; REFERENCES.md: Borel work found, no place given; Godement PSPM 9 place confirmed at second hand.

declarations.name: exists_integral_stages_eq_mul
declarations.says: Unfolding in stages: i : L × H → G closed, L, H unimodular, Λ ⊂ H discrete, Γ = i(Λ), Re ρ ≥ 0, nonzero near a point. Some R ≠ 0 gives ∫_{Γ\G} F = Rc for continuous integrable F whenever each g has k in L × H with ∫_L ∫_{Λ\H} F(lakg) = ρ(g)c.
declarations.reference: header of the Unimodular file: O. Kallenberg, Probab. Theory Related Fields 139 (2007); N. Bourbaki, Intégration VII (1963)
declarations.note: unfolding in stages along a closed product subgroup L × H with a discrete Λ ⊂ H (23 lines), producing a non-zero constant R; a bespoke combination of Weil's formula; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: integral_quotMeasure_eq_zero_of_mean
declarations.says: Let Γ ≤ H ≤ G, Γ discrete, H closed, μ left invariant, F continuous, left Γ-invariant. If ∫ F(s j(x,b) x) dκ(b) = aF(sx) for s in H (κ a probability, j(x,b) in H) and ∫_H f(h j(x,b)) dh = d∫_H f with d ≠ a, then ∫_{Γ\G} F dμ = 0.
declarations.note: one of the two vanishing lemmas of the header that avoid unimodularity (18 lines): an averaging operator with eigenvalue a on F but d ≠ a on Haar measure forces ∫_{Γ\G} F = 0; the write-up must read it.

declarations.name: integral_quotMeasure_eq_zero_of_twist
declarations.says: Let Γ be a discrete subgroup of G, μ left invariant, F continuous and left Γ-invariant. If F(uy) = cF(y) for all y, for some u in G and c with |c| = 1, c ≠ 1, then ∫_{Γ\G} F dμ = 0.
declarations.note: translation invariance of the quotient integral, with the twist c ≠ 1.

declarations.name: IsContPeriodic.integrable_out
declarations.says: A continuous periodic function, read at coset representatives, is integrable on the compact quotient B/B₀.

declarations.name: norm_quotMean_le
declarations.says: |quotMean F| ≤ C when |F| ≤ C.

declarations.name: quotMean
declarations.says: For a subgroup B₀ with B/B₀ compact and F : B → ℂ, the integral of F at chosen coset representatives against the Haar probability measure of B/B₀.

entries.known_result: Height of the formal group of a CM curve

declarations.name: CMLattice.complex_multiplication_theta
declarations.says: Complex multiplication for theta functions. Let Λ_C = Ω₀𝒪_K and C^σ = CMLattice.galConjugate. There are Ω ≠ 0 with area(C^σ) = |Ω|²√d/2 and a positive integer multiple in Λ_{C^σ}, and a_S ∈ K for finite S ⊂ K, clustering at a finite adele as S grows, with σ(U_{xΩ₀}θ_C) = U_{xΩa_S}θ_{C^σ} as Taylor series for x ∈ S.
declarations.reference: G. Shimura, Introduction to the Arithmetic Theory of Automorphic Functions (1971); J. Milne, Complex Multiplication (2020) (main theorem of complex multiplication)
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: soft form: only that multipliers a_S with a cluster point in the finite adeles describe the action of σ ∈ Aut(ℂ/K) on Taylor series of torsion translates of the theta function, with the Chowla–Selberg-type area normalisation; the adele is not identified with the Artin map. Places from the file header; REFERENCES.md: both place confirmed at second hand.

declarations.name: CMLattice.exists_unit_coeff_degree_le
declarations.says: Let Z = X + ⋯ with f(Z) integral for all f ∈ 𝔬[[φ]], let aΛ ⊂ Λ with aā = q odd, and let g be integral without constant term, Z(g) = ι(a)Z. Then g has a unit coefficient in some degree ≤ q.
declarations.reference: M. Deuring, Die Typen der Multiplikatorenringe elliptischer Funktionenkörper (1941); J. Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves, IV.7 (height of a formal group); for the Lubin–Tate form, V. Drinfeld, Elliptic modules (1974), 1.7
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: only an upper bound for the height of the formal group of the CM curve over the integers of ℂ_p: an endomorphism of odd degree q has a unit coefficient in degree at most q. Places from the file header; REFERENCES.md: Silverman compared, place confirmed; Deuring work found, no place given.

declarations.name: CMLattice.one_le_norm_coeff_translatedWp_nonsplit
declarations.says: If for every f in 𝔬[[φ]] ⊂ ℂ_p[[z]] the coefficient of z^{p−1} in f′ has absolute value below 1, then the coefficient of z^{p−1} in ιξ has absolute value at least 1, and p does not split in ℚ(√−d).
declarations.reference: Deuring's criterion for supersingular reduction (M. Deuring 1941); J. Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves, IV.7 and V.4
declarations.relation: weaker form
declarations.note: one direction only: a vanishing Hasse invariant (all coefficients of z^{p−1} in f′ small) forces p to be non-split in ℚ(√−d). REFERENCES.md: Deuring work found, no place given.

declarations.name: CMLattice.multiPhiRing
declarations.says: The ring 𝔬[[φ(μ_i)]] of series over ℂ_p: integral power series in the series φ(∑_x μ_{i,x} z_x), i ∈ I.

declarations.name: CMLattice.subst_mem_multiPhiRing
declarations.says: If v lies in the ring 𝔬[[φ]] of integral series in φ, then substituting the linear form Σ μ_{i,x} z_x into v gives an element of 𝔬[[φ(μ_i)]] for each i.

declarations.name: CMLattice.translatedWpDeriv_add_mem_multiPhiRing
declarations.says: Euler's addition formula in integral form: read in ℂ_p, the series φ(u + w) lies in 𝔬[[φ(u), φ(w)]] (the addition law of the CM curve is integral in the parameter φ).
declarations.note: comparable to the integrality of the formal group law of an integral Weierstrass model (J. Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves, IV.1), but for the bespoke parameter φ at a 2-torsion origin; the write-up must read the proof (22 lines) or reduce it to that statement.

declarations.name: QZChar.ker
declarations.says: The kernel of a continuous character χ : Γ → ℚ/ℤ, as a subgroup of Γ.

declarations.name: cycCharMod
declarations.says: The cyclotomic character modulo N: the homomorphism Γ → (ℤ/N)^× giving the action of Γ on the N-th roots of unity in Ω.

declarations.name: placeOver
declarations.says: For a finite prime v of the number field K, a chosen valuation subring of Ω lying over v.

declarations.name: IsLocalGalois.exists_inertia_smul_eq_of_pow_eq
declarations.says: For x, y with xⁿ = yⁿ = π (π in k) and n > 0, some inertia element sends x to y (Kummer theory of the tamely ramified extension k(π^{1/n})).

declarations.name: IsLocalGalois.tame_inertia
declarations.says: Let n be a unit of A, yⁿ a uniformiser of k, f on inertia with open kernel and fⁿ = 1. Then f kills the stabiliser of y, f(s) generates the image if sy/y has order n, and f(φsφ⁻¹) = f(s)^q for a q-Frobenius φ.
declarations.reference: structure of tame inertia (J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, Ch. IV §2)

declarations.name: inertia_fixes_root_of_unit
declarations.says: Let s lie in the inertia group of A and let n be a unit of A. If w^n is a unit of A fixed by s, then s·w / w = 1.

declarations.name: Comparison.trans
declarations.says: The composite of comparisons (φ,β) from F to F' and (φ',β') from F' to F'': the functor φ∘φ' with the map Fφφ' → F'φ' → F''.

declarations.name: H.map_comp
declarations.says: Pull-back on Ext is functorial: (α′∘α)* = α′* … in the stated order (H^n(·, F) is a contravariant functor).

declarations.name: abbrev
declarations.says: An exact functor between abelian categories: additive and preserving finite limits and finite colimits (a class abbreviation).

declarations.name: HodgeH.map_comp
declarations.says: Pull-back on Hodge cohomology is functorial: (α∘β)* = α*∘β* in the stated order.

declarations.name: HodgeH.map_zero
declarations.says: Pull-back along the zero map is zero on Hodge cohomology.

declarations.name: IsLocalSymbol.map
declarations.says: Local symbols (local generators of a point class at a point y) are carried along ring maps φ: the image of a local symbol at y is a local symbol at φ(y).

declarations.name: hasDerivAt_smear
declarations.says: Derivatives of a convolution fall on the test function: if a curve γ in U(diag ε) has γ'(t) = γ(t)X, then smear α along γ has derivative at t the value at γ(t) of smear (Xα), Xα the right derivative.
declarations.note: differentiation under the integral sign.

declarations.name: rightDeriv_smear
declarations.says: The smoothing of F by the right derivative Xα of a test function α is the right derivative by X of the smoothing by α.

declarations.name: smear
declarations.says: For continuous F : U(diag ε) → E, the linear map sending a compactly supported smooth α to the function g ↦ ∫ α(y⁻¹)F(gy) dy.

declarations.name: continuous_U_iff_matrix
declarations.says: A map into U(J) is continuous exactly when it is continuous as a matrix-valued map.

declarations.name: det_mulLeft_mulRight_real
declarations.says: For complex square matrices P of size m and Q of size n, the real-linear map X ↦ PXQ on complex m×n matrices has determinant |det P|^(2n)·|det Q|^(2m).

declarations.name: exists_U_coe_eq
declarations.says: A matrix x with xᴴJx = J defines an element of U(J).

declarations.name: IsHolOfWeight.circle_mean_holMinorsPi
declarations.says: Circle mean: let the order o be injective with sign +1 first, u K-dominant, F holomorphic of weight u. The mean over |s| = 1 of F(diag(s^o)h)·∏_{τ,i} s^(−o_i u^τ_i) equals m^hol_u(h)·F(1), for every h in U(diag ε)^Φ.
declarations.note: the circle mean extracts one Fourier coefficient.

declarations.name: IsHolOfWeight.integral_mul_conj_holMinorsPi
declarations.says: Reproducing formula: let the order o be injective with signs +1 first, each u_τ K-dominant, F holomorphic of weight u on U(diag ε)^Φ, and F·conj(m) integrable for the compact dual measure, m = holMinorsPi ε u. Then ∫ F·conj(m) = (∫ |m|²)·F(1).
declarations.reference: reproducing property of the holomorphic discrete series (Harish-Chandra, Representations of semisimple Lie groups IV–VI, 1955–56)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for products of U(p,q) and holomorphic functions of K-dominant weight on the group, integrable against the minors for the compact dual measure: ∫ F·conj(m) = (∫|m|²)·F(1).

declarations.name: isHolOfWeight_holMinorsPi
declarations.says: If the order o is injective with the indices of sign +1 first, and every u^τ is K-dominant for o, then the product of minors m^hol_u (holMinorsPi) on U(diag ε)^Φ is holomorphic of weight u in the sense of IsHolOfWeight.

entries.known_result: Finiteness of the cokernel of the Cartan map, and Higman's criterion

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.FiniteKilledFixedInj
declarations.says: The G-module A is finite, killed by n, fixed by the subgroup Q, and the endomorphism z − m of A (z in G, m a natural number) is injective.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.FiniteKilledFixedInj.isHigmanProjective_of_coprime
declarations.says: If A is finite, killed by n and fixed by Q, and the index of Q is prime to n, then A has Higman's property DiscreteModule.IsHigmanProjective for Q.
declarations.reference: Higman's criterion for relative projectivity (J.-P. Serre, Linear Representations of Finite Groups, 1977)
declarations.relation: special case
declarations.note: for finite modules killed by n and fixed by Q, with [G : Q] prime to n; "projective" is read as Higman's property. The header's place, Serre Thm 35 (REFERENCES.md: compared, place confirmed), is for the finiteness of the cokernel of the Cartan map, the file's main known result, not for Higman's criterion.

declarations.name: sqrt_weylNormSq_classSum_le
declarations.says: If every value of f has Weyl norm at most B after an automorphism σ of ℂ, then so does its class sum, up to the factor #Γ\G/K.

declarations.name: weylGauge_classSum_le_one
declarations.says: A p-adic gauge bound on c·f(x) for all x gives the same bound for (A·c)·(class sum), A a common multiple of the stabiliser orders.

declarations.name: heckeFun_sum
declarations.says: The Hecke operator of f is Σ_q f(q)·π(q)v over the cosets in its support.

declarations.name: levelSpace_anti
declarations.says: Level spaces grow when the level shrinks: K ⊂ K′ gives V^{K′} ⊂ V^K.

declarations.name: Space.isUnit_J
declarations.says: The matrix J over E of a space (J, x) is invertible.

declarations.name: Space.map_J
declarations.says: The image of J over the adeles is (x⁻¹)ᴴ·diag(s)·x⁻¹ (with the standard form at the finite places).

declarations.name: U.inl
declarations.says: The block embedding a ↦ diag(a, 1) of U(diag ε) into the unitary group of the concatenated signs (ε, η).

declarations.name: maxCompact
declarations.says: The subgroup K_∞K₀ of G: elements that are unitary matrices at each infinite place and lie in GL_n(Ô) at the finite places.

declarations.name: QZ
declarations.says: The group ℚ/ℤ; it is given the discrete topology.

declarations.name: QZ.mk
declarations.says: The quotient homomorphism ℚ → ℚ/ℤ.

declarations.name: DiscreteModule.index_smul_eq_zero_of_resH2
declarations.says: If the restriction of a class x in H² to an open subgroup U vanishes, then [Γ : U]·x = 0.
declarations.reference: corestriction∘restriction = multiplication by the index (J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, Ch. VII)

declarations.name: QZChar.comap
declarations.says: For a continuous homomorphism φ: H → Γ, the additive map from continuous ℚ/ℤ-valued characters of Γ to those of H, χ ↦ χ∘φ.

declarations.name: mem_selmerModule_iff
declarations.says: A function c lies in the Selmer module exactly when it is a cocycle, vanishes on inertia outside S, obeys the local conditions L, and is locally constant.

declarations.name: selmerModule_mono
declarations.says: A member c of the Selmer module for (S, L) lies in that for (T, K) if K ⊆ L and c vanishes on inertia at all places of S outside T.

declarations.name: selmerZ1.card_mul_pow_le
declarations.says: Let M be finite, unramified outside S (primes dividing N), fixed by complex conjugations, with at most (#M)^k trivialised cocycles, and B¹ ⊂ L_v on S. Then selmerZ1, ramification allowed at the primes of s, has #selmerZ1·(#M)^(#S+#∞) ≤ (#M)^k·∏_{v∈S} #(L_v ∩ Z¹), ∞ the infinite places of K.
declarations.note: a Selmer-group count with ramification allowed at the auxiliary primes (27 lines), part of the Greenberg–Wiles lower bound.

declarations.name: selmerZ1.exists_split_primes_relations
declarations.says: Relations at split primes. For U fixing M and μ_m, without complex conjugations, there are split primes, Frobenii φ_i and elements γ_i such that each family (n_i) with ∑ n_i(x(γ_i)) = 0 on Selmer cocycles x extends to an equivariant homomorphism on U giving such relations at other split primes. A bound on trivialised cocycles bounds their number below.
