declarations.says: Rallis inner product formula, doubling form: if rk T > 2 rk S, f is clean, f' arbitrary and y, y' are rapidly decreasing automorphic forms on U(S), then g -> <f', omega(g,1)f><y', R(g)y> is integrable on U(S)(A) and <theta_{f'} y', theta_f y>_{U(T)} = vol([U(T)]) times its integral.
declarations.reference: S. Rallis, L-functions and the oscillator representation, LNM 1245 (1987); J.-S. Li, Crelle 428 (1992); unitary unfolding: Y. Liu (2011) Prop. 2.3, Eischen-Harris-Li-Skinner 4.1.4
declarations.relation: special case: Weil's convergent range rk T > 2 rk S (Siegel-Weil without regularisation), test data clean (boundary orbits removed by the datum), local doubling integrals not evaluated; but for rapidly decreasing rather than only cuspidal forms
declarations.note: REFERENCES.md: J.-S. Li, Crelle 428 (1992) 'work found, no place given'. Header places (Liu Prop 2.3, EHLS 4.1.4) not checked.

declarations.name: isConjKernelPair_kernelPair
declarations.says: If the Harish-Chandra parameters of s and +-l have the large-gap property at every infinite place, then the kernel pair (type kernels of l and -l) is a conjugate cusp kernel pair.
declarations.note: Content: discrete-series kernels with large gap are cusp kernels (integrable discrete series; Lib/Adelic/CuspForms, Lib/DiscreteSeries) and conj kernel(l) = kernel(-l).

declarations.name: isEdgeFamily_of_paramsCorrespond
declarations.says: If the parameters (gamma, l) of S and (gamma', l') of T correspond under the theta correspondence of discrete-series parameters (ParamsCorrespond), then the kernel pairs with the joint harmonic polynomial form an edge family for any family of characters with weights gamma, gamma'.
declarations.note: Content from Lib/Weil/Lift/Edge (joint harmonics, J.-S. Li's discrete-series theta lifts; Kashiwara-Vergne).

declarations.name: isSharp_modDatum
declarations.says: If the signs of S agree or m != (1), b has trivial tame part off m, and F != 0 on matrices mod m satisfies L y = 1 on its support (L fixed), then F (x) vacuum is a sharp datum for principal level m at the places dividing m m-bar, with constant <F,F>/|(O/m)^{mn}|/|GL_n(O/m)|.
declarations.note: Sharp: the matrix coefficient <F, omega(g)F> is supported on (and constant on) the principal congruence subgroup; authors' notion for the test datum of the inner product formula. Local computation with the Weil representation.

declarations.name: kernelPair
declarations.says: The pair of discrete-series type kernels: that of the parameter l (at false) and of -l (at true), for the signature s.

declarations.name: modDescent
declarations.says: The theta descent from forms of type e' on T to forms of type e on S, with the same kernel (characters a(n), a(n')) and datum (polynomial P at infinity, Psi mod m) as modLift.

declarations.name: modLift
declarations.says: The global theta lift from forms of type e on S to forms of type e' on T, with characters a(n), a(n') and Schwartz datum: harmonic polynomial P at infinity, Psi modulo m at the finite places, vacuum elsewhere.

declarations.name: pairWeil_modDatum_single
declarations.says: For integral finite points k, k' of the two unitary groups and x = k'^-1 y k mod m, the Weil representation sends the datum v (x) 1_x (x) vac to a(det k') b(det k)^-1 times v (x) 1_y (x) vac.
declarations.note: Integral points act linearly on the lattice model, up to the characters.

declarations.name: partialIntegral
declarations.says: The integral of Phi over the points of the adelic unitary group whose finite part is integral at every place of the set A.

declarations.name: realZetaCoeff
declarations.says: eps_w = -1 if w precedes w-bar in a fixed well-ordering of the finite places, else 1: so 1 if w = w-bar and one sign of each on a split pair.
declarations.note: Bookkeeping device for writing zeta factors of the real subfield: (1 - eps_{w-bar} x)(1 - eps_w x) = 1 - x^2.

declarations.name: realZetaCoeff_factor_mul
declarations.says: For a split place w: (1 - eps_{w-bar} x)(1 - eps_w x) = 1 - x^2.

declarations.name: tendsto_partialIntegral
declarations.says: For integrable Phi, the integral over the points integral at the places of R outside B tends, as the finite set R exhausts the places, to the integral over the points integral at all places outside B (dominated convergence).

entries.known_result: header: Hilbert–Schmidt estimates, matrix logarithm and integrated Jacobi formula near 1; Lagrange's identity for the top coefficient; transport of the discrete-series coefficient, its measure and product formula through a frame to U(J)

declarations.name: HCParam.psiInFrame
declarations.says: For l = 2λ a Harish-Chandra parameter of U(p,q) = U(diag ε) and a frame p with p*Jp = diag(ε): the function g ↦ ψ_λ(p⁻¹gp) on U(J), ψ_λ the lowest-K-type discrete-series coefficient (Flensted-Jensen's integral).

declarations.name: SignFrame
declarations.says: A frame of the hermitian matrix J with signs ε: an invertible complex matrix p with p*Jp = diag(ε).

declarations.name: coordProj
declarations.says: The diagonal 0/1 matrix projecting onto the coordinates satisfying a condition p.

declarations.name: det_one_add_eq_exp_trace_logOneAdd
declarations.says: If the Hilbert–Schmidt norm of X is at most 1/2, then det(1 + X) = exp tr log(1 + X), with log(1 + X) = ∫₀¹ (1 + sX)⁻¹X ds (integrated Jacobi formula).

declarations.name: exists_lagrange_weights
declarations.says: Lagrange interpolation: for integers x_0 > … > x_{M−1} there are reals c_k ≥ 1 with c_k² = |∏_{j≠k}(x_k − x_j)| such that the X^{M−1}-coefficient of every real P of degree < M is Σ_k (−1)^k P(x_k)/c_k².

declarations.name: flenstedJensen_shift_eq_conj
declarations.says: For l with a gap, u supported on pairs (i, j) with l_i < l_j and ε_i = ε_j, X and (1 − u)X accretive: Flensted-Jensen's normalised integral satisfies FJ_λ(1, ((1 − u)X)*) = conj FJ_λ(1, X).
declarations.note: Technical identity of the Flensted-Jensen realisation of discrete series of U(p,q); rests on lemmas of Lib/DiscreteSeries (flenstedJensen_eq_of_accretive, Borel equivariance of weight minors).

declarations.name: frameEquiv
declarations.says: The isomorphism of topological groups U(J) → U(diag ε), g ↦ p⁻¹gp, given by a frame p (p*Jp = diag ε).

declarations.name: frobenius_norm_mul_of_unitary
declarations.says: ‖XY‖_HS = ‖Y‖_HS when X*X = 1 (Hilbert–Schmidt norm is unitarily invariant).

declarations.name: frobenius_norm_sq_eq_sum
declarations.says: ‖X‖_HS² = Σ_{i,j} |X_ij|².

declarations.name: intDiagonal
declarations.says: The complex diagonal matrix diag(w) of an integer vector w.

declarations.name: integral_comp_frameEquiv
declarations.says: ∫_{U(J)} f(p⁻¹gp) dg = ∫_{U(diag ε)} f(g) dg for the chosen Haar measures (the frame isomorphism preserves them).
declarations.note: Holds because the Haar measures on the unitary groups are normalised compatibly (measurePreserving_haarU).

declarations.name: inv_one_add_bounds
declarations.says: Neumann series: if ‖X‖_HS ≤ σ ≤ 1/2 then 1 + X is invertible and ‖(1 + X)⁻¹ − 1‖ ≤ 2σ.

declarations.name: isAccretive_of_norm_sub_one_lt
declarations.says: If ‖X − 1‖_HS < 1 then X is accretive (X + X* positive definite).

declarations.name: isIdempotentKernel_psiInFrame
declarations.says: Schur orthogonality for discrete series: if l = 2λ has gap ≥ 500n³ + A, then e(g) = d_λψ_λ(p⁻¹gp) on U(J) is continuous, integrable, e(g⁻¹) = conj e(g), e(1) ≠ 0 and ∫ e(z)e((zx)⁻¹y) dz = e(x⁻¹)e(y)/e(1).
declarations.reference: Harish-Chandra, Discrete series for semisimple Lie groups II, Acta Math. 116 (1966); A. Knapp, Representation Theory of Semisimple Groups (1986)
declarations.relation: special case: lowest-K-type coefficient of the discrete series of U(p,q) with Harish-Chandra parameter far from the walls (integrable range), transported to U(J) by a frame; d_λ is defined as (∫|ψ_λ|²)⁻¹
declarations.note: Here only a transport through the frame; the content is HCParam.HasLargeGap.isIdempotentKernel_dsKernel in Lib/DiscreteSeries (other part of the catalogue).

declarations.name: isStarProjection_coordProj
declarations.says: The coordinate projection is a self-adjoint idempotent.

declarations.name: logOneAdd
declarations.says: The matrix log(1 + X) := ∫₀¹ (1 + sX)⁻¹X ds (the logarithm of 1 + X for small X).

declarations.name: norm_entryMask_le
declarations.says: Setting some entries of X to zero does not increase its Hilbert–Schmidt norm.

declarations.name: norm_logOneAdd_le
declarations.says: ‖log(1 + X)‖_HS ≤ 2‖X‖_HS when ‖X‖_HS ≤ 1/2.

declarations.name: norm_proj_mul_le
declarations.says: ‖PX‖_HS ≤ ρ for an orthogonal projection P and ‖X‖_HS ≤ ρ.

declarations.name: norm_smul_le_of_le_one
declarations.says: ‖ρX‖ ≤ σ if ‖X‖ ≤ σ and 0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1.

declarations.name: norm_trace_mul_le
declarations.says: |tr(XY)| ≤ ‖X‖_HS‖Y‖_HS (Cauchy–Schwarz).

declarations.name: trace_mul_logOneAdd
declarations.says: For ‖X‖_HS ≤ 1/2 and any D, s ↦ tr(D(1 + sX)⁻¹X) is integrable on [0, 1] with integral tr(D·log(1 + X)).

declarations.name: trace_star_mul_self_eq_norm_sq
declarations.says: tr(X*X) = ‖X‖_HS².

entries.known_result: none named (header: general lemmas of linear algebra and matrices, textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: Filling.exists_mul_eq_of_col_mem_range
declarations.says: Over a field k: if every column of the matrix y lies in the column space of x, then y = x·s for some matrix s.

declarations.name: Filling.mem_span_unit_iff
declarations.says: For a subring R of a commutative ring A and a unit g of A: x ∈ R·g if and only if g⁻¹x ∈ R.

declarations.name: IsHermUnit
declarations.says: Class: the square matrix J over a ring with involution is hermitian (J* = J) and invertible.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix
declarations.says: Predicate: every entry of the matrix M over A lies in the subring R (M is R-integral).

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.add
declarations.says: Sums of R-integral matrices are R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.isInt_transpose
declarations.says: The transpose of an R-integral matrix is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.mul
declarations.says: Products of R-integral matrices are R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.mulVec
declarations.says: An R-integral matrix maps R-integral vectors (R^n inside A^n) to R-integral vectors.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.one
declarations.says: The identity matrix is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.smul
declarations.says: If a ∈ R and M is R-integral then aM is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.sub
declarations.says: Differences of R-integral matrices are R-integral.

declarations.name: IsStarStable
declarations.says: Class: the subring R of the ring with involution A is stable under the involution.

declarations.name: IsUnimodular
declarations.says: Predicate on a square matrix T over A: T is hermitian and lies in GL_n(R') (a unimodular hermitian matrix over R').

declarations.name: colLattice
declarations.says: The R'-module M·R'^n spanned by the columns of the matrix M (a lattice when M has full rank).

declarations.name: denomIndex
declarations.says: The denominator of a ∈ A relative to R': the index [R' : {r ∈ R' : ar ∈ R'}] of additive groups.

declarations.name: exists_mulVec_eq_of_annihilator
declarations.says: Duality of linear algebra: if every linear form l vanishing on the columns of P indexed by s and of P' indexed by s' has l(PX) = l(P'Y), then Px = P'y for some x = X off s and y = Y off s'.
declarations.note: Finite-dimensional duality (annihilator of a sum of subspaces); proof by the double annihilator.

declarations.name: exists_mul_add_mul_eq
declarations.says: Over a field: if the kernel of the matrix x is contained in the column space of y, then y·e + b·x = 1 for some matrices e, b.
declarations.note: Via a generalized inverse of x.

declarations.name: intVectors
declarations.says: The R'-module R'^n of vectors in A^n all of whose entries lie in the subring R'.

declarations.name: preimageLattice
declarations.says: The R'-module {v ∈ A^n : Mv ∈ R'^m} of vectors that the matrix M maps to integral vectors.

declarations.name: submoduleIndex
declarations.says: The index [M' : M ∩ M'] of additive groups for submodules M, M' of A^m (0 if infinite).

declarations.name: unitaryLevel
declarations.says: Principal congruence subgroup of level g of the unitary group U(J)(A): elements k ∈ U(J) with k ∈ GL_n(R') and g⁻¹(k − 1) R'-integral.

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Kisin lattice (Breuil–Kisin module) of a crystalline lattice (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.WachKisin.PeriodMatrixFrame).

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.E
declarations.says: For a chart, E = z^e A(z) + p ∈ S (A a unit series), the Eisenstein-type element; it equals ξ times a unit of A_inf.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.FixesThetaZ
declarations.says: g ∈ G_p fixes Λ = W(F_{p^f}) ⊂ A_inf pointwise and fixes θ(z).

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.S
declarations.says: The image S of the chart's map Λ[[X]] → A_inf (the Breuil–Kisin ring W(F_{p^f})[[z]]).

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.coord₀
declarations.says: A chosen S-linear coordinate λ_0: A_inf → S restricting to the identity on S (from an adic basis of A_inf over S).

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.coord₀_coe
declarations.says: λ_0 is the identity on S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.dvd_iff_coe_dvd
declarations.says: For a, b ∈ S, a divides b in S iff it does in A_inf.
declarations.note: λ_0 is an S-linear retraction

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.dvd_smul_sub_of_fixesLambda
declarations.says: If g ∈ G_p fixes Λ pointwise and d ∈ A_inf divides gz − z, then d divides gs − s for every s ∈ S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.exists_dvd_sub_sum_z_pow
declarations.says: Weierstrass division: if p^n e = N, every s ∈ S is congruent modulo φ^n(E) to Σ_{i<N} w_i z^i with w_i ∈ Λ.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.exists_z_dvd_sub_const
declarations.says: Every s ∈ S is a + z t with a ∈ Λ, t ∈ S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.frobE
declarations.says: φ^n(E) ∈ S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.not_p_dvd_z
declarations.says: p does not divide z in A_inf.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.smul_theta_of_fixesThetaZ
declarations.says: If g fixes Λ and θ(z), then g fixes θ(s) for every s ∈ S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.z
declarations.says: The image z of the variable X in S.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.z_eq_teichmuller
declarations.says: z is the Teichmüller lift [π^♭] of the chart's element π^♭ ∈ O^♭.

declarations.name: Lift.Chart.z_pow_mem_span
declarations.says: z^e ∈ (E, p).

declarations.name: Lift.FixesLambda
declarations.says: g ∈ G_p fixes the image of Λ = W(F_{p^f}) in A_inf pointwise.

declarations.name: Lift.WittFq
declarations.says: Λ = W(F_{p^f}), with F_{p^f} realised as {x ∈ O^♭ : x^(p^f) = x}.

declarations.name: Lift.card_flatFq
declarations.says: {x ∈ O^♭ : x^(p^f) = x} is a field with exactly p^f elements.

declarations.name: Lift.exists_chart_of_pow_mul_eq_neg
declarations.says: Given x ∈ O_C and a unit v with x^e v = −p, there is ev: Λ[[X]] → A_inf with θ(ev X) = x such that every unit series A with θ(ev A) = v gives a chart with ramification e, z = [x^♭], and E = z^e A + p.
declarations.note: uses that E ∈ ker θ is a generator (Fontaine's criterion for generators of ker θ)

declarations.name: Lift.flatFq
declarations.says: The subring {x ∈ O^♭ : x^(p^f) = x} of O^♭, a field with p^f elements.

entries.known_result: Part of: adelic Weil representation of a unitary group and the invariant theta functional (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/PairSplitting)

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.add_apply
declarations.says: (v + w)(x) = v(x) + w(x) in the reproducing space.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.conj_modelInner
declarations.says: The inner product of the reproducing space is hermitian: conj⟨v,w⟩ = ⟨w,v⟩.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.continuous
declarations.says: Every element of the reproducing space is a continuous function on W.
declarations.note: Dominated convergence in the reproducing identity.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.ext
declarations.says: Two elements of the reproducing space with the same values are equal.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.heisOp_apply
declarations.says: Heisenberg operator: (ρ(y)v)(x) = β(y,x)·v(x − y).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.hom_ext
declarations.says: Two bounded linear maps from the reproducing space to a complex Banach space that agree on all translates ρ(y)vac are equal.
declarations.note: From the reproducing formula.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.integrable_norm_sq
declarations.says: For v in the reproducing space, |v|² is integrable (v is integrable and bounded).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.map_eq_integral
declarations.says: Reproducing formula: for a bounded linear map T from the reproducing space to a Banach space, Tv = ∫ v(y)·T(ρ(y)vac) dμ(y).
declarations.note: Coherent-state decomposition v = ∫ v(y) ρ(y)vac dμ(y).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.modelEval
declarations.says: Evaluation v ↦ v(x) at a point x, as a continuous linear functional (norm ≤ 1) on the reproducing space.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.modelInner_heisOp_vacElem
declarations.says: Reproducing property: ⟨ρ(x)vac, v⟩ = v(x).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.modelInner_self
declarations.says: ⟨v, v⟩ = ∫ |v(x)|² dμ(x).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.norm_apply_le
declarations.says: |v(x)| ≤ ‖v‖ (the L¹ norm) for every x.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.norm_eq
declarations.says: The norm of the reproducing space is the L¹ norm: ‖v‖ = ∫ |v(x)| dμ(x).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.smul_apply
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.vacElem
declarations.says: The vacuum e, as an element of the reproducing space {v ∈ L¹(W): v(x) = ∫ v(y)β(y,x)e(x−y) dμ(y)} that it defines.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.vacElem_apply
declarations.says: vac(x) = e(x).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.valueAt_apply
declarations.says: The evaluation functional at x sends v to v(x).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.zero_apply
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Heisenberg.Rep.integrated
declarations.says: For a representation R of the Heisenberg datum on a Banach space X, the bounded bilinear map (v, f) ↦ ∫ v(y)·R(y)f dμ(y), v in the reproducing space, f ∈ X (integrated representation).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.Rep.map_integrated
declarations.says: A bounded linear intertwiner T of two Heisenberg representations commutes with integration: T(R.integrated v f) = R′.integrated v (Tf).

declarations.name: Heisenberg.Rep.map_integrated_eq_integral
declarations.says: For a bounded linear map T: T(∫ v(y)R(y)f dμ(y)) = ∫ v(y)·T(R(y)f) dμ(y).
declarations.note: Bounded operators commute with Bochner integrals.

entries.known_result: Adelic Weil representation of a unitary group and the invariant theta functional (CM fields with enough roots of unity, splitting character, self-dual rank-one lattice, no polarisation)

declarations.name: G.onHom_fin
declarations.says: The image of a pair of finite adelic points in U(Hom(S,T)) is a finite adelic point (trivial at the infinite places).

declarations.name: G.onHom_mulVec
declarations.says: The image of (g, h) in U(Hom(S,T)) acts on x (read as an n′×n matrix) by x ↦ h x g⁻¹.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.homSource
declarations.says: From a splitting (k, l, ι) of V over V₀ (V = isotropic ⊕ V₀ ⊕ dual isotropic), the induced splitting of Hom(V,T) over Hom(V₀,T) with frames J_T⁻¹⊗(k*J)ᵀ, 1⊗(l*J)ᵀ, 1⊗(J₀⁻¹ι*J)ᵀ.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.homSource_kAdelic
declarations.says: The adelic isotropic frame of the induced splitting of Hom(V,T) is (dual frame of T)⁻¹ ⊗ (l-coordinates)ᵀ.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.homTarget
declarations.says: From a splitting (k, l, ι) of V over V₀, the induced splitting of Hom(T,V) over Hom(T,V₀) with frames k⊗J_Tᵀ, l⊗1, ι⊗1.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.homTarget_kAdelic
declarations.says: The adelic isotropic frame of the induced splitting of Hom(T,V) is k_adelic ⊗ (dual frame of T)ᵀ.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.sourceTerm
declarations.says: For an adelic n′×p matrix x, the term f ↦ f[x] of the mixed model: the zero term along maps killing k^⊥ of ϱ(x̃)f, where x̃ ∈ Hom(V,T) has x̃k = x and kills l, ι.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.sourceTerm_levi
declarations.says: Levi action in the mixed model: for g with gk = km, gι = ιg₀, (ω_{aυ^p,b}(g,h)f)[x] = χ_T(det m)⁻¹|det m|^{n′/2}·ω_{a,b}(g₀,h)(f[h⁻¹xm]), n′ = rk T, χ_T(y) = b(y/ȳ)υ(y)^{−n′}.
declarations.note: Standard mixed-model formula (cf. Kudla 1994; Harris–Kudla–Sweet 1996, §1).

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.sourceTerm_radicalElt
declarations.says: Unipotent action in the mixed model: for u = n(c, z), z hermitian, (ω_{a,b}(u,1)f)[x] = ψ(½ tr(z x*ε′x))·ϱ(x c*ε₀)(f[x]), ε′, ε₀ the standard forms of T and V₀.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.symm_homSource_zeroTerm_eq_integral
declarations.says: On Hom(V,T), the zero term for the splitting with k and l exchanged is the integral over adelic x of the mixed-model terms f[x] (partial Fourier transform).

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.zeroTerm_homSource_comp
declarations.says: Zero terms are compatible with composing splittings: the zero term for D∘D′ is the zero term for D′ of the zero term for D.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.zeroTerm_homSource_congr
declarations.says: The zero term of the induced splitting depends only on k^⊥ and ι: if k′*Jk = 0 and ι′ = ι the zero terms agree.

declarations.name: Space.dualFrame
declarations.says: For a space with adelic frame x, the invertible adelic matrix (x⁻¹)*ε (inverse εx*), ε the standard form of its signs.

declarations.name: Space.varrho_pairWeil
declarations.says: Heisenberg and Weil operators of the pair commute up to the action: ϱ(x)ω(q)f = ω(q)ϱ(q₂⁻¹ x q₁)f for x ∈ Hom(V,T)(𝔸), q = (q₁, q₂).

declarations.name: Space.vecAtPoint_hom
declarations.says: A rational n′×n matrix x corresponds in Hom(S,T) to the adelic matrix x_T⁻¹ x x_S (x_S, x_T the frames).

declarations.name: kronecker_mulVec_eq_matToVec
declarations.says: (A ⊗ Bᵀ)·vec(x) = vec(A x B) for matrices A, B, x.

declarations.name: matToVec_add
declarations.says: vec(x + y) = vec(x) + vec(y).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: pairChar_apply
declarations.says: pairChar(a,b)(g,h) = a(det h)·b(det g)⁻¹.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: pairWeil_apply
declarations.says: ω_{a,b}(p)f = pairChar(a,b)(p)·ω(onHom p)f.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: vecToMat_matToVec
declarations.says: Reading a matrix as a vector and back gives the matrix.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

entries.known_result: Part of: Schrödinger and mixed models of the Weil representation, action of parabolic subgroups (see Lib/Weil/MixedModel/ZeroTermLaw); this file: moduli prime to their conjugates, reduction, primitive additive characters, level-𝔪 data and theta kernels

declarations.name: Modulus
declarations.says: A modulus of the CM field E: a nonzero ideal 𝔪 of O_E prime to its complex conjugate (no finite place w with both w and w̄ dividing 𝔪).

declarations.name: Modulus.ResRing
declarations.says: The residue ring O_E/𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.disjoint_places_star
declarations.says: The set of places dividing 𝔪 is disjoint from its conjugate.

declarations.name: Modulus.generator
declarations.says: A chosen integral finite idele t, equal to 1 off 𝔪, with tÔ the kernel of reduction modulo 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.generator_spec
declarations.says: The chosen idele t of 𝔪 is integral, is 1 at places not dividing 𝔪, and x ∈ Ô reduces to 0 mod 𝔪 iff t⁻¹x ∈ Ô.

declarations.name: Modulus.isPrimitive_primAddChar
declarations.says: The chosen additive character ψ′ of O_E/𝔪 is primitive: x ↦ ψ′(ax) is nontrivial for every a ≠ 0.

declarations.name: Modulus.isSchwartzBruhat_liftFn
declarations.says: The lift to finite adelic vectors of a function on (O_E/𝔪)^n is Schwartz–Bruhat above the places dividing 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.isValuationPair_resRing
declarations.says: For any a, b in O_E/𝔪 there is an idempotent e with a and b both in the principal ideal generated by (1−e)a + eb.
declarations.note: O_E/𝔪 is a finite product of local principal ideal (chain) rings.

declarations.name: Modulus.liftFn
declarations.says: The linear map sending Ψ on (O_E/𝔪)^n to the function on finite adelic vectors equal to Ψ(x mod 𝔪) if x is integral at the places dividing 𝔪 (read on those components) and 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: Modulus.name_char_eq_translate_projOn
declarations.says: For S the places dividing 𝔪, u ∈ Ô^n and Ψ(x) = ψ′(Σ x_i u_i mod 𝔪): naming Ψ at S equals the Heisenberg translate ϱ(α b̄) composed with the projection P^S, b the S-part of t⁻¹u.
declarations.note: Computation in the Schrödinger model at S.

declarations.name: Modulus.places
declarations.says: The set of finite places of E dividing 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.primAddChar
declarations.says: The additive character r ↦ ψ_f(ȷαᾱ t⁻¹ r̃) of O_E/𝔪, t the chosen idele generating 𝔪 and r̃ ∈ Ô a lift of r.

declarations.name: Modulus.primAddChar_reduction
declarations.says: For x ∈ Ô, ψ′(x mod 𝔪) = ψ₀(t⁻¹x), ψ₀ = ψ_f(ȷαᾱ·).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Modulus.reduction
declarations.says: A chosen ring homomorphism Ô → O_E/𝔪 extending reduction on O_E, with kernel tÔ for an integral idele t equal to 1 off 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.reduction_congr
declarations.says: Two integral finite adeles with the same components at the places dividing 𝔪 have the same reduction mod 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.reduction_eq_zero_iff
declarations.says: An integral finite adele reduces to 0 mod 𝔪 iff it lies in 𝔪Ô.

declarations.name: Modulus.reduction_idem_mul
declarations.says: Multiplying by the idempotent adele of the places of 𝔪 does not change the reduction mod 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.reduction_surjective
declarations.says: Reduction Ô → O_E/𝔪 is surjective.

declarations.name: Modulus.valued_generator
declarations.says: At each finite place w, |t_w| = exp(−(multiplicity of w in 𝔪)) for the chosen generator t.

declarations.name: modDatum
declarations.says: The datum v ⊗ Ψ ⊗ vac on Hom(S,T): real part the Fock vector v, at the places dividing 𝔪 the function Ψ on matrices mod 𝔪 (named there), the vacuum elsewhere.

declarations.name: modKernel
declarations.says: The theta kernel θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ, P](g, h) = θ(ω_{a,b}(g,h)(v_P ⊗ Ψ ⊗ vac)) for a function Ψ on matrices mod 𝔪 and a polynomial P.

entries.known_result: header: part of the contravariant form on Weyl's lattice, Fischer product, irreducibility under U(n) (see Lib/Adelic/CuspForms/DeltaForms).

declarations.name: AlgForm
declarations.says: Algebraic modular forms of weight (κ,e) on the unitary group of the standard hermitian space I_n over a CM field E: functions φ on U(𝔸_f) with open right stabiliser and φ(γg) = ρ(γ)φ(g) for γ ∈ U(E), ρ the weight representation.
declarations.reference: Gross, Algebraic modular forms, Israel J. Math. 113 (1999)

declarations.name: IsHCParam
declarations.says: l is the (doubled) Harish-Chandra parameter of (κ,e): each l_w is injective and l_w(i) = 2(e_w + λ(w,p)) + |n| − 1 − 2p with p = #{j : l_w(j) > l_w(i)}.

declarations.name: Space.weightRep
declarations.says: The representation of U(J)(E) on coordinate vectors of weight (κ,e), through its images at the infinite places (complex conjugate Weyl representations).

declarations.name: algFormRep
declarations.says: The representation of U(𝔸_f) on algebraic forms of weight (κ,e) by right translation.

declarations.name: conjWeylRep
declarations.says: The representation of ∏_w U(n) (one unitary group per infinite place, signs s) on coordinate vectors of weight κ by the complex conjugate Weyl matrices, twisted by det^{e_w}.

declarations.name: decrPosition
declarations.says: For l: n → ℤ and an index i, the number of j with l_j > l_i.

declarations.name: gramForm
declarations.says: The sesquilinear Gram form (ξ,η) ↦ ξ*Gη on complex coordinate vectors of weight κ, G the integer Gram matrix (contravariant form).

declarations.name: gramForm_apply
declarations.says: ⟨ξ,η⟩ = ξ*Gη.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: gramForm_conjWeylRep
declarations.says: The Gram form is invariant under ∏_τ U(n) acting in weight (κ,e) (unitarity of the Weyl representation on compact groups for the contravariant form).
declarations.note: From contravariance G·S_κ(g) = S_κ(gᵀ)ᵀ·G with g unitary.

declarations.name: gramForm_map_weightRep
declarations.says: For a field automorphism σ of ℂ and γ ∈ U(E), ⟨σ∘ρ(γ)u, σ∘ρ(γ)v⟩ = ⟨σ∘u, σ∘v⟩: the Gram form stays invariant after conjugating by σ.

declarations.name: hcParameter
declarations.says: The integer 2λ_p + N − 1 − 2p, entry p of 2(λ+ρ) in rank N, λ_p = e_w + Σ_{p<h<N} κ_w(h).

declarations.name: highestVector
declarations.says: The highest (extremal) vector v⁺ attached to l: the evaluation vector at the array with entry 1 in row a of block w in column #{j : l_w(j) > l_w(a)}, 0 elsewhere.

declarations.name: integralAbove
declarations.says: The open compact subgroup of U(𝔸_f) of elements integral and invertible at all primes above p.

declarations.name: map_weightRep
declarations.says: For σ: ℂ → R a ring homomorphism, σ∘ρ(γ)v = weylRep(σ-images of γ at the places)·(σ∘v): the weight representation of rational points is defined over the image.

declarations.name: nablaBasis_eq_one
declarations.says: If κ is concentrated in height |n| (only full columns), every basis minor product is 1 (the representation is a power of det).

declarations.name: schur_eq_one
declarations.says: Same hypothesis: the Schur matrix S_κ(z) is the 1×1 identity.

declarations.name: stdSpace_ratEmbed_apply
declarations.says: The component at the infinite place w of the embedding of rational points of U(I_n) is the matrix γ mapped by the embedding Φ_w.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: stdSpace_weightRep_apply
declarations.says: For the standard space, ρ(γ)v = weylRep(conjugated images of γ at the places)·v.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: weylGauge
declarations.says: The p-adic gauge of a vector ξ at g ∈ U(𝔸_f): the largest p-adic absolute value of a coordinate of ρ(g⁻¹)ι(ξ), g⁻¹ acting in weight (κ,e) through its components at the primes above p (fixed embedding ι of ℂ into ℂ_p).
declarations.note: Used to measure p-integrality of algebraic forms.

declarations.name: weylRep_map
declarations.says: weylRep commutes with ring homomorphisms: weylRep(f(g)) = f(weylRep(g)).

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Kisin lattice (Breuil–Kisin module) of a crystalline lattice (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.WachKisin.PeriodMatrixFrame).

declarations.name: IsWeilPair.eq_pow_of_isFrob
declarations.says: If (s, m) is a Weil pair and s⁻¹ acts on the residue field of Q̄_p as x ↦ x^q, then q = p^m.

declarations.name: IsWeilPair.mul
declarations.says: Weil pairs multiply: (s, m), (t, m') Weil pairs ⇒ (st, m + m') is one.

declarations.name: IsWeilPair.pow
declarations.says: (s, m) a Weil pair ⇒ (s^n, nm) is one.

declarations.name: Lift.FrobGroup
declarations.says: The group ℤ × Γ; on rings with bijective Frobenius (A_inf, W(C^♭)) the pair (n, g) acts as φ^n j(g).

declarations.name: Lift.FrobGroup.inr
declarations.says: The inclusion Γ → ℤ × Γ, g ↦ (0, g).

declarations.name: Lift.FrobGroup.phi_pow_smul
declarations.says: φ^n ∈ ℤ × Γ acts on A_inf as the n-th iterate of Frobenius.

declarations.name: Lift.FrobGroup.snd
declarations.says: The projection ℤ × Γ → Γ.

declarations.name: Lift.FrobGroup.φ
declarations.says: The element (1, 1) of ℤ × Γ, acting as Frobenius.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart
declarations.says: A Kummer chart for Γ: a Breuil–Kisin chart together with a subgroup Γ' of index prime to p containing the elements near 1, with j(Γ') the fixer of Λ and θ(z), and for each l ≥ 0 some g ∈ Γ' with g z = [ε]^l z.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.IsUnramified
declarations.says: The Kummer chart is unramified: E = z + p, e = 1 and d = 0.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.chart_isChartOf
declarations.says: The chart of a Kummer chart is a chart of the field fixed by j(Γ).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.differentExp
declarations.says: d = 0 if the ramification index e of the chart is 1, and d = v_p(e) + 1 otherwise.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.thetaPhiInv_phi_pow
declarations.says: θ ∘ φ^(−a) ∘ φ^a = θ.

declarations.name: Lift.exists_flatFq_root
declarations.says: For a ring map s: W(F_{p^f}) → K to a field, every x ∈ K with x^(p^f) = x is s([a]) for the Teichmüller lift of some a ∈ F_{p^f}.

declarations.name: Lift.exists_kummer_chart
declarations.says: If j(Γ) is open in G_p there is a Kummer chart over Λ = W(F_{p^f}) with ef = [G_p : j(Γ)], j(Γ) fixing Λ and θ(z), containing the fixer of θ(S), a p^f-Frobenius and elements with gz = [ε]^l z (l ≥ 0); e = 1, E = z + p if j(Γ) contains inertia.
declarations.reference: M. Kisin, Crystalline representations and F-crystals, Progr. Math. 253 (2006), §1.1
declarations.note: the standard Breuil–Kisin set-up from a uniformiser and a compatible system of its p-power roots

declarations.name: Lift.exists_smul_teichmuller_eq
declarations.says: If a closed subgroup C of G_p is transitive on the n-th roots of π for every n > 0, and u, v ∈ O^♭ have untilts with the same e-th power π, then some g ∈ C sends [u] to [v].
declarations.note: compactness of C

declarations.name: Lift.fixes_roots_iff_fixesLambda
declarations.says: g ∈ G_p fixes all (p^f − 1)-th roots of unity iff it fixes Λ = W(F_{p^f}) ⊂ A_inf pointwise.

declarations.name: Lift.isUnit_teichmuller_sub
declarations.says: For distinct a, b ∈ F_{p^f} ⊂ O^♭, [a] − [b] is a unit of A_inf.

declarations.name: Lift.wittToQpBar
declarations.says: The Z_p-algebra map W(F_{p^f}) → Q̄_p whose composite with Q̄_p ⊂ C_p is θ restricted to W(F_{p^f}).

declarations.name: Lift.wittToQpBar_injective
declarations.says: That map W(F_{p^f}) → Q̄_p is injective.

entries.known_result: Part of: theta kernels of unitary dual pairs: functoriality, seesaw, growth, rapid decay (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/KernelDecay); part of: adelic Weil representation and the invariant theta functional (Lib/Weil/DualPair/PairSplitting)

declarations.name: G.onHom_atPlace_mem
declarations.says: If g and h are integral (in K_w) at a finite place w, so is their image in U(Hom(S,T)).

declarations.name: G.onHom_scalarFin
declarations.says: The pair of finite scalar matrices (ν, ν′) acts on Hom(S,T) as the scalar ν′/ν.

declarations.name: Space.exists_mapsTo_ratVectors
declarations.says: Landherr's theorem (Hasse principle for hermitian forms), as used: for two spaces V, W with the same signs, some g ∈ U(s)(𝔸) carries the rational vectors of V into those of W.
declarations.reference: W. Landherr, Äquivalenz Hermitescher Formen über einem beliebigen algebraischen Zahlkörper, Abh. Math. Sem. Univ. Hamburg 11 (1936)
declarations.relation: special case: hermitian spaces given with an adelic frame to the standard form of the same signs (so everywhere locally isometric), over the stably unramified CM fields of the Weil data; stated as existence of an adelic isometry matching rational points
declarations.note: One-line consequence of Space.exists_eq_move in Lib/Adelic/Landherr/Landherr (other part of the catalogue).

declarations.name: Space.mem_ratVectors_hom
declarations.says: x is a rational vector of Hom(S,T) iff x_T·x·x_S⁻¹ is a rational matrix.

declarations.name: Space.theta_vacElem_eq_prod_lineTheta
declarations.says: If g carries the rational points of the orthogonal sum of lines with signs s into those of V, then θ_V(ω(g)ϱ(x)vac) = ∏_i θ_i(ϱ(x_i)vac) for all adelic x (θ_i the chosen theta functional of the line of sign s_i).
declarations.note: Uniqueness of the theta functional up to scalar plus transport.

declarations.name: Space.vacElem_apply_eq_prod_lineTheta
declarations.says: If V has the rational points of the standard sum of lines, then vac(x) = ∏_i θ_i(ϱ(x_i)vac).

declarations.name: commute_scalarFin
declarations.says: Finite scalar matrices are central in U(𝔸_f).

declarations.name: detOn_star
declarations.says: For g ∈ U(𝔸_f), the determinant of g at the places of Ā is the conjugate inverse of the determinant at the places of A.

declarations.name: finMultiplier_onHom_left
declarations.says: The finite multiplier of (g, 1) acting on Hom(S,T) by x ↦ x g⁻¹ is Δ_f(g_f⁻¹)^{n′}, n′ = rk T.

declarations.name: homSigns_sum_source
declarations.says: The signs of Hom(V₁ ⊕ V₂, T) are the concatenation of those of Hom(V₁,T) and Hom(V₂,T).
declarations.note: Bookkeeping.

declarations.name: homSigns_sum_target
declarations.says: The signs of Hom(T, V₁ ⊕ V₂) are the concatenation of those of Hom(T,V₁) and Hom(T,V₂).
declarations.note: Bookkeeping.

declarations.name: pairWeil_boxProd_source
declarations.says: Seesaw factorisation in the first space: on Hom(V₁ ⊕ V₂, T), ω_{bb′,a}(diag(g₁,g₂), h)(f ⊠ f′) = ω_{b,a}(g₁,h)f ⊠ ω_{b′,a}(g₂,h)f′.

declarations.name: pairWeil_boxProd_target
declarations.says: Seesaw factorisation in the second space: for g block diagonal (g₁, g₂), on Hom(T,V), ω_{a,bb′}(h,g)(f ⊠ f′) = ω_{a,b}(h,g₁)f ⊠ ω_{a,b′}(h,g₂)f′.

declarations.name: pairWeil_eq_smul_of_projOn_eq
declarations.says: If P^A f = f and g, h are integral and supported on A, then ω_{a,b}(g,h)f = a(det h)·b(det g)⁻¹·f.

declarations.name: pairWeil_name_of_mem
declarations.says: For A ∩ Ā = ∅, Ψ Schwartz–Bruhat above A and g, h with integral finite parts: ω_{a,b}(g,h)(Ψ⊗f) = Ψ′⊗ω_{a,b}(g,h)f with Ψ′(x) = Ψ(h_f⁻¹ x g_f).

declarations.name: pairWeil_name_on
declarations.says: At split places: for g, h supported on A ∪ Ā, ω_{a,b}(g,h)(Ψ⊗f) = χ_S(det h_A)·χ_T(det g_A)⁻¹·|det g_A|^{n′/2}|det h_A|^{−n/2}·Ψ(h⁻¹·g)⊗f, χ_S, χ_T the space characters, n = rk S, n′ = rk T.
declarations.note: Standard Schrödinger-model formula where U(n)(E_w) ≅ GL_n.

declarations.name: projOn_pairWeil
declarations.says: If P^A f = f and the image of p in U(Hom(S,T)) is integral at the places of A, then P^A(ω_{a,b}(p)f) = ω_{a,b}(p)f.

declarations.name: scalarFin
declarations.says: The homomorphism sending a norm-one finite adele ν to the scalar matrix ν·1 in the finite adelic unitary group of rank n.

declarations.name: theta_boxProd_source
declarations.says: Multiplicativity of the theta functional: θ_{Hom(V₁⊕V₂,T)}(f ⊠ f′) = θ(f)·θ(f′).

declarations.name: theta_boxProd_target
declarations.says: If the frame of V is block diagonal with the frames of V₁, V₂, then θ_{Hom(T,V)}(f ⊠ f′) = θ(f)·θ(f′).

entries.known_result: Part of: theta kernels of unitary dual pairs: functoriality, seesaw, growth, rapid decay (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/KernelDecay); part of: tower property, constant term of a theta lift along an isotropic line (Lib/SiegelWeil/Tower/LargeSideConstantTerm)

declarations.name: Modulus.factor_reductionK₀
declarations.says: For 𝔫 ⊂ 𝔪, reducing an integral element mod 𝔫 and then mod 𝔪 equals reducing it mod 𝔪.

declarations.name: Modulus.normNegOne
declarations.says: The unit of O_E/𝔪 obtained by reducing the chosen element of Ô of norm −1.

declarations.name: Modulus.reductionK₀
declarations.says: Reduction modulo 𝔪 as a homomorphism from the stabiliser K₀ of Ô^n in U(𝔸_f) to GL_n(O_E/𝔪).

declarations.name: exists_modKernel_neg_left
declarations.says: Negating S conjugates kernels: some c with |c| = 1 (depending only on S, T) has θ^{−S,T}_{a⁻¹υⁿ, b⁻¹υ^{n′}}[Ψ′, P̄](g,h) = c·conj θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h) for all a, b, 𝔪, Ψ, P, g, h, where Ψ′(x) = conj Ψ(η⁻¹x), η the reduction of the norm −1 unit.
declarations.note: Uniqueness of the theta functional; c not computed.

declarations.name: lineTerm
declarations.says: For lines split off W′ and V′, the operator from data on Hom(W′,V′) to data on Hom(W,V): translate by a rank-one map scaled by a ∈ 𝔸_E, then take both zero terms; a Boolean β selects one of two mixed models.

declarations.name: modDatum_factor
declarations.says: If 𝔪′ ⊂ 𝔪, the datum mod 𝔪′ given by the pull-back of Ψ under O_E/𝔪′ → O_E/𝔪 equals the datum mod 𝔪 given by Ψ.

declarations.name: modKernelBilin
declarations.says: The kernel value θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h) as a complex bilinear form in the function Ψ on matrices mod 𝔪 and the Fock polynomial P.

declarations.name: modKernelBilin_apply
declarations.says: modKernelBilin(g,h)(Ψ,P) = θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: modKernelI
declarations.says: The theta kernel θ^{S,I_{n′}}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,(1,h)) for T = I_{n′} (sum of n′ norm forms) and h a finite adelic point.

declarations.name: modKernelI_block
declarations.says: Seesaw factorisation for I_n = I_{n₁} ⊕ I_{n₂}: θ^{T,I_n}_{a,bb′}[ΨΨ′, PP′](g, h₁ ⊕ h₂) = θ^{T,I_{n₁}}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h₁)·θ^{T,I_{n₂}}_{a,b′}[Ψ′,P′](g,h₂) (finite h₁, h₂).

declarations.name: modKernel_mul_Kf_left
declarations.says: Right translation by an integral finite k ∈ U(S): θ[Ψ,P](g(1,k), h) = θ[b(det k)⁻¹·Ψ(· k̄)](g,h), k̄ the reduction of k mod 𝔪.

declarations.name: modKernel_mul_Kf_right
declarations.says: Right translation by an integral finite k ∈ U(T): θ[Ψ,P](g,(x, hk)) = θ[a(det k)·Ψ(k̄⁻¹ ·)](g,(x,h)).

declarations.name: modKernel_reindex
declarations.says: The kernel θ[Ψ,P](g,h) is unchanged when the coordinates of S and T are relabelled by sign-compatible bijections and Ψ, P, g, h are relabelled accordingly.

declarations.name: modKernel_sum_left
declarations.says: Seesaw factorisation in the first space: the kernel of (S ⊕ V, T) for aa′, b with ΨΨ′ and PP′ at (g ⊕ g′, h) is θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h)·θ^{V,T}_{a′,b}[Ψ′,P′](g′,h).

declarations.name: modKernel_sum_right
declarations.says: Seesaw factorisation in the second space: the kernel of (S, T ⊕ V) for a, bb′ with ΨΨ′ and PP′ at (g, h ⊕ h′) is θ^{S,T}_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h)·θ^{S,V}_{a,b′}[Ψ′,P′](g,h′).

declarations.name: modKernel_twist
declarations.says: Twisting the characters: θ_{aμ,bμ′}[Ψ,P](g,h) = μ(det h)·μ′(det g)⁻¹·θ_{a,b}[Ψ,P](g,h).

declarations.name: pairWeil_modDatum_Kf
declarations.says: For integral finite k ∈ U(S), k′ ∈ U(T): ω_{a,b}(k,k′)(Ψ mod 𝔪, v) = a(det k′)b(det k)⁻¹·(x ↦ Ψ(k̄′⁻¹ x k̄), v).

declarations.name: renameRowsCols
declarations.says: For maps e, f of row and column indices, the ℂ-algebra map of polynomial rings X_{(i,r,c)} ↦ X_{(i,e(r),f(c))}.

declarations.name: tsum_lineTerm
declarations.says: For base-adapted lines A, X: Σ_{ξ∈E} θ(lineTerm_true(ξ)f) = Σ_{ξ∈E} θ(lineTerm_β(ξ)f), and each line term is the term of an explicit adapted mixed model of Hom(W′,V′) over Hom(W,V).
declarations.note: Called 'Poisson summation' by the authors; both sums equal θ of one datum by the theta expansion in a mixed model (Lib/Weil/MixedModel); the rest is explicit frames (34 lines).

declarations.name: vacuumDatum
declarations.says: The datum Ψ ⊗ vac in 𝒲_f of Hom(S,T): Ψ, a function on matrices mod 𝔪, placed at the places dividing 𝔪, applied to the vacuum.

entries.known_result: header: commutativity of the spherical Hecke algebra of GL_n (Gelfand's trick, split places only) and the Eichler commutation relation (Tamagawa 1963; Rallis 1982; Howe 1979); the used declarations are only basic lattice and congruence-subgroup lemmas

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.isInt_conjTranspose
declarations.says: If the subring R is stable under the involution, the conjugate transpose of an R-integral matrix is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsIntMatrix.neg
declarations.says: The negative of an R-integral matrix is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsUnimodular.isIntMatrix
declarations.says: A unimodular hermitian matrix over R is R-integral.

declarations.name: IsUnimodular.mem_unitaryLevel
declarations.says: Let J be unimodular hermitian over an involution-stable subring R and u ∈ R a unit of A. An isometry x of J with u⁻¹(x − 1) integral lies in the principal congruence subgroup of U(J) of level u.
declarations.note: The point is that x⁻¹ = J⁻¹x*J is then integral too.

declarations.name: IsUnimodular.splitGram
declarations.says: If the Gram matrix T on V_ϱ is unimodular hermitian over R, so is the Gram matrix of the whole space V = (ϱ hyperbolic planes) ⊕ V_ϱ of the shape.
declarations.note: General fact (orthogonal sum with hyperbolic planes), stated for the shapes of the proof.

declarations.name: Membership.mem.isIntMatrix
declarations.says: An element k of GL_n(R) is an R-integral matrix.

declarations.name: Membership.mem.isIntMatrix_inv
declarations.says: The inverse of an element k of GL_n(R) is an R-integral matrix.

declarations.name: colLattice_le
declarations.says: If every column of M lies in the R-submodule L, then the R-span of the columns of M is contained in L.

declarations.name: col_mem_colLattice
declarations.says: Each column of M lies in the R-span of the columns of M.

declarations.name: exists_invTransposeGL_inv_eq
declarations.says: If O ⊂ R is a 'valuation pair' (Smith normal form holds over O) and g ∈ GL_n(R), there is k ∈ GL_n(O) with gᵀ = (kᵀ)⁻¹gk, i.e. gk symmetric.
declarations.note: Immediate from the Smith normal form g = k₁dk₂ (take k = k₂⁻¹k₁ᵀ); the Smith form over a valuation pair is proved in the same file.

declarations.name: invTransposeGL
declarations.says: The automorphism g ↦ (gᵀ)⁻¹ of GL_n(R).

declarations.name: invTransposeGL_mem_intGL
declarations.says: (kᵀ)⁻¹ ∈ GL_n(O) if and only if k ∈ GL_n(O).

declarations.name: isOpen_intVectors
declarations.says: If the subring R is open in the topological ring A, then R^n is open in A^n.

declarations.name: liftIntegralFn
declarations.says: For a map π: R → B, the ℂ-linear map sending a function f on matrices over B to S ↦ f(πS) if S is R-integral and 0 otherwise (inflation from a quotient).

declarations.name: mem_besselU
declarations.says: x lies in the Bessel unipotent group 𝖴 of the shape iff x_{ij} = δ_{ij} whenever level(j) ≤ level(i).
declarations.note: Unfolding of the definition.

declarations.name: mulVec_mem_intVectors_iff
declarations.says: For k ∈ GL_n(R): kw ∈ R^n if and only if w ∈ R^n.

declarations.name: single_mem_intVectors
declarations.says: The standard basis vectors lie in R^n.

declarations.name: unitaryLevel_one
declarations.says: The principal congruence subgroup of level 1 of U(J) is U(J) ∩ GL_n(R).

declarations.name: unitaryLevel_one_le_normalizer
declarations.says: The integral points U(J) ∩ GL_n(R) normalise the principal congruence subgroup of U(J) of level u.

entries.known_result: harmonic highest vectors for (U(p,q), U(n)) give holomorphic vectors

declarations.name: IsAdelicHol
declarations.says: A function F on the adelic unitary group is adelically holomorphic of weight u (order o): for every adelic g, h ↦ F(g·(h,1)) on the archimedean group is holomorphic of weight u.

declarations.name: exists_heis_vacElem_eq_sum_modDatum
declarations.says: If 𝔪 = (ḡ) and x is a finite adelic vector of Hom(V,V′) with gx integral, then the Heisenberg translate ϱ(αx) of the vacuum is Σ_y χ(z_y)·(level-𝔪 datum of the indicator of y), y over matrices mod 𝔪, for some finite adeles z_y.
declarations.note: Finite Fourier decomposition of a translated lattice vacuum.

declarations.name: integral_mul_sum_const_mul
declarations.says: If each F·f_i is rapid of level a, then ∫ F·Σ c_i f_i = Σ c_i ∫ F·f_i over the automorphic quotient.

declarations.name: isAdelicHol_pairTheta
declarations.says: If the real datum v is holomorphic of weight u, the theta function g ↦ θ(ω_{a,b}(g,k)(v⊗f)) is adelically holomorphic of weight u.
declarations.note: Apply the definition of holomorphic data to the functional θ∘ω.

declarations.name: isSchwartzBruhat_residueDatum
declarations.says: For finite places w_i with w̄_i ≠ w_j, the datum defined by a function of residue matrices at the w_i is Schwartz–Bruhat at those places.

declarations.name: liftFn_eq_residueDatum
declarations.says: The lift to adelic matrices of a function on matrices mod 𝔪 equals the residue datum at the places of 𝔪.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: maxOpNorm
declarations.says: For u in the archimedean unitary group, the maximum over infinite places of the operator norm of its matrix.

declarations.name: mem_holomorphicData_of_highestVector
declarations.says: If a linear map f into the Fock space intertwines the conjugate of the weight-(κ,e′) representation of the definite group with its Weil action and f(highest vector) is holomorphic of weight u, then every f(ξ̄) is holomorphic of weight u.
declarations.note: Span argument using cyclicity of the highest weight vector (highestVector_cyclic, GLn library).

declarations.name: modDatum_vacVector
declarations.says: With the Gaussian as real part, the level-𝔪 datum of Ψ on Hom(V,V′) is the 'name' at the places of 𝔪 of the lift of Ψ applied to the vacuum.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: mul_modKernel_mem_rapidOfLevel
declarations.says: A rapidly decreasing automorphic function of principal level N times a level-𝔪 theta kernel (𝔪 = (N), b unramified off 𝔪) is again rapid of level N.
declarations.note: Uses the moderate growth of theta kernels proved elsewhere (isModerate).

declarations.name: mul_sum_mem_rapidOfLevel
declarations.says: If each F·f_i is rapid of level a, so is F·Σ c_i f_i.

declarations.name: prod_mem_holomorphicData
declarations.says: Kashiwara–Vergne (harmonic highest vectors give holomorphic vectors): if at each infinite place P_w is a joint harmonic highest vector of weight u_w for the standard pair, then Q = ∏_w P_w is nonzero and its Fock vector is holomorphic of weight u.
declarations.reference: M. Kashiwara, M. Vergne, On the Segal–Shale–Weil representations and harmonic polynomials, Invent. Math. 44 (1978) 1–48; M. G. Davidson, Pacific J. Math. 129 (1987)
declarations.relation: weaker form: one direction only (matrix coefficients of harmonic highest vectors extend holomorphically with explicit weight); no decomposition theorem
declarations.note: Header gives K–V III 6.3, 7.2 and Davidson Prop. 2.2, Thm 2.9; REFERENCES.md records Davidson for this file as 'work found, no place given', K–V not for this file.

declarations.name: rapidOfLevel
declarations.says: The space of rapidly decreasing automorphic functions on U(V) that are right invariant under the principal congruence subgroup K(a).

declarations.name: reductionK₀_map_modulusResidue
declarations.says: Reducing k ∈ K_f modulo 𝔪 and then to the residue field at w equals reducing k at w.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: residueDatum_congr
declarations.says: If the entries of y − x have absolute value < 1 at each place w_i, the residue datum takes the same value at y and x.

declarations.name: staircaseWeight
declarations.says: The weight γ + n·[s_c = −1] − s_c·Σ_{o(c)<j<n} k(s_c, j) at the basis vector c of a staircase with k(η, j) minors of size j and sign η.

declarations.name: staircase_harmonic_highest
declarations.says: Kashiwara–Vergne (products of minors are joint harmonic highest vectors for (U(p,q), U(n))): the product of k(η,p) copies of the p×p minor on the first p columns of sign η and the first (η = 1) or last p rows is, if the sizes fit, nonzero, harmonic and highest on both sides, of explicit weights.
declarations.reference: M. Kashiwara, M. Vergne, On the Segal–Shale–Weil representations and harmonic polynomials, Invent. Math. 44 (1978) 1–48
declarations.relation: special case: the explicit staircase products of minors under the fitting condition (Σ sizes ≤ n), with their weights
declarations.note: Header attributes it to Kashiwara–Vergne (III 6.3, 7.2 for the known result); not recorded as checked for this file.

declarations.name: star_mem_rapidOfLevel
declarations.says: The complex conjugate of a rapid level-a function is rapid of level a.

declarations.name: traceChar
declarations.says: The additive character y ↦ ψ(tr(yu)) of matrices modulo 𝔪 attached to a matrix u, ψ the chosen primitive additive character of O_E/𝔪.

entries.known_result: header: Leray measures on hermitian quadrics disintegrate volume, uniquely, over an axiomatised place (`Place`: a locally compact ring with involution, Haar measure, τ with τ + τ̄ = 1, skew unit δ, Haar measure ν on skew elements, modulus md, unitary character ψ, Plancherel constant)

declarations.name: Place.IsDisintegration.map
declarations.says: If (l_β) disintegrates μ along x ↦ x*Tx and M has a left inverse with M*JM = T, then the push-forwards of l_β under v ↦ Mv disintegrate the push-forward of μ along x ↦ x*Jx.
declarations.note: Change of variables; disintegration means ∫f(x*Jx, x)dμ = ∫∫f(δ⁻¹β, x)dl_β dν(β), l_β weakly continuous and finite on compacts.

declarations.name: Place.IsDisintegration.unique
declarations.says: Two disintegrations l, l' of the same measure μ along the same hermitian form agree at every skew element β (by weak continuity in β).
declarations.note: Equality a.e. in β plus continuity, then uniqueness of Radon measures.

declarations.name: Place.flatChart
declarations.says: The chart of the quadric h(v, v) = Γ := δ⁻¹b in a hyperbolic plane ⟨e, e'⟩ ⊕ (A^ι, T): (t, w, a) ↦ (t̄⁻¹τ(Γ − h(w, w)) + ta)e + te' + w, with a skew.

declarations.name: Place.form_flatChart
declarations.says: For T hermitian and t a unit, the flat chart lands on the quadric: h(v, v) = δ⁻¹b for v = flatChart(t, w, a).

declarations.name: Place.isDisintegration_quadricMeasure
declarations.says: For T hermitian, the measures δ_Γ (images of dt dw dν(a) under the flat charts) form a disintegration of the volume of A² ⊕ A^ι along v ↦ h(v, v), for the form hyperbolic plane ⊕ T (Leray measures on the quadrics).
declarations.note: Standard local computation (as in Weil's local Siegel–Weil theory), proved here by Fubini and linear changes of variables over the axiomatised place; the write-up should present or cite it.

declarations.name: Place.map_mul_volume
declarations.says: The push-forward of the Haar measure of A under x ↦ ux (u a unit) is md(u)⁻¹ times it.

declarations.name: Place.md_inv
declarations.says: md(u⁻¹) = md(u)⁻¹ for a unit u.

declarations.name: Place.md_ne_zero_and_ne_top
declarations.says: The modulus md(u) of a unit is neither 0 nor ∞.

declarations.name: Place.measurePreserving_mulVec
declarations.says: If (det T)‾·det T = 1, then v ↦ Tv preserves the volume of A^ι.

declarations.name: Place.quadricMeasure
declarations.says: The measure δ_Γ on the quadric h(v, v) = Γ: the image of dt dw dν(a) under the flat chart (a Leray measure).

declarations.name: Place.skewMeasure_le_of_sub_mem
declarations.says: If S is a set of skew elements and u a unit with u(τδ⁻¹β + β') ∈ C for all β, β' ∈ S − S, and vol(C)/md(u) ≤ x², then ν(S) ≤ x.

declarations.name: Place.skewUnitMul
declarations.says: For Γ with Γ̄ = Γ, the skew element δΓ, δ the skew unit of the place.

declarations.name: TraceOne
declarations.says: Class: a chosen element τ with τ + τ̄ = 1 in a commutative ring with involution (τ = 1/2 in characteristic 0).

declarations.name: isClosed_skewAdjoint
declarations.says: The skew-adjoint elements {x : x̄ = −x} form a closed subset of A.
declarations.note: A Prop-valued instance.

declarations.name: lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp
declarations.says: If p holds almost everywhere and f = g wherever p holds, then ∫f = ∫g.

declarations.name: lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map
declarations.says: If ζ∘f⁻¹ = c⁻¹ζ with 0 < c < ∞, then ∫g dζ = c∫g d(f_*ζ).

declarations.name: lintegral_le_of_ae_imp
declarations.says: If p holds almost everywhere and f ≤ g wherever p holds, then ∫f ≤ ∫g.

declarations.name: skewPart
declarations.says: The skew element x − x̄ attached to x.

entries.known_result: header: part of the tower property, constant term of a theta lift along an isotropic line (see Lib.SiegelWeil.Tower.LargeSideConstantTerm); this file: primitive matrices extend to bases, partner data and their laws

declarations.name: IsPartner
declarations.says: Partner functions for a character χ of R: Φ on a×n matrices vanishes off the x_k (rows of k⁻¹ in the last block), Ψ on n×b matrices off the y_k (first b columns of k), k ∈ GL_n(O), and Φ(x_k) = χ(det k)Ψ(y_k).

declarations.name: IsPartner.left_mul
declarations.says: If Φ, Ψ are partners for χ, then χ(det g)Φ(gx) = Φ(x) for all g ∈ GL_a(O) and all a×n matrices x.

declarations.name: IsPartner.lift_of_reduction
declarations.says: Partners over a quotient R of a local ring O (π: O → R surjective, local) inflate to partners over O (functions f(πS) on integral S, 0 elsewhere) for any χ' with χ'(u) = χ(πu) on units.

declarations.name: IsPartner.right_mul
declarations.says: If Φ, Ψ are partners for χ, then Ψ(yg)χ(det g) = Ψ(y) for all g ∈ GL_b(O).

declarations.name: IsPrimitiveMatrix.mul_iff
declarations.says: If y is primitive over O (integral with an integral left inverse), then yx is primitive iff x is.

declarations.name: IsValuationPair.exists_firstCols_iff
declarations.says: If O ⊂ R is a valuation pair, an n×b matrix y is the first b columns of some k ∈ GL_n(O) iff y is primitive (entries in O and a left inverse over O).
declarations.note: Primitive families extend to bases; via a Hermite normal form over the valuation pair.

declarations.name: det_fromRows_invLastRows
declarations.says: det(rows s stacked over the last rows of k⁻¹, reordered)·det k = det(s·(first columns of k)).

declarations.name: exists_firstCols_eq_mul
declarations.says: For g ∈ GL_b(O), f ∈ GL_a(O), k ∈ GL_n(O) there is j ∈ GL_n(O) with first columns y_k g, last rows of j⁻¹ equal to f·x_k, and det j·det f = det k·det g.

declarations.name: exists_invLastRows_iff_transpose
declarations.says: x is the last rows of k⁻¹ for some k ∈ GL_n(O) iff xᵀ is the first columns (for the swapped splitting) of some element of GL_n(O).

declarations.name: firstCols
declarations.says: For k ∈ GL_n(R) and the indices split as b ⊔ a: the columns of k indexed by b.

declarations.name: hasLeftInv_invLastRows_transpose
declarations.says: The transpose of the last rows of k⁻¹ has a left inverse.

declarations.name: invFirstRows
declarations.says: The rows of k⁻¹ indexed by the first block b.

declarations.name: invFirstRows_mul_firstCols
declarations.says: (first rows of k⁻¹)·(first columns of k) = 1.

declarations.name: invLastRows
declarations.says: For k ∈ GL_n(R) and the indices split as b ⊔ a: the rows of k⁻¹ indexed by a.

declarations.name: invLastRows_mul_firstCols
declarations.says: (last rows of k⁻¹)·(first columns of k) = 0.

declarations.name: isPrimitiveMatrix_firstCols
declarations.says: For k ∈ GL_n(O), the first columns of k form a primitive matrix over O.

declarations.name: isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_mem_intGL
declarations.says: An invertible square matrix k is primitive over O iff k ∈ GL_n(O).

entries.known_result: Amitsur's formula for the characteristic polynomial of a sum (integrality consequence)

declarations.name: DoubleCosets
declarations.says: The set Γ\G/K of double cosets of a group G for subgroups Γ and K.

declarations.name: HasLargeSplit
declarations.says: For a weight N on exponent vectors (finitely supported X → ℕ): D is a sum of k exponents α_1, …, α_k with r ≤ ∏_b N(α_b).

declarations.name: IsCompact.relIndex_ne_zero
declarations.says: For a compact subgroup K and an open subgroup H of a topological group, the index [K : H ∩ K] is finite.

declarations.name: amitsur_charpoly_mem_of_span
declarations.says: Amitsur's formula, integrality consequence: if ρ: Λ → M_n(A) is a B-algebra map and Λ is B-spanned by elements s with charpoly ρ(s) having coefficients in (the image of) B, then every ρ(w) has this property.
declarations.reference: S. A. Amitsur, On the characteristic polynomial of a sum of matrices, Linear and Multilinear Algebra 8 (1980) 177–182; G. Chenevier, The p-adic analytic space of pseudocharacters of a profinite group (2014)
declarations.relation: weaker form: only the integrality consequence of Amitsur's formula, not the formula for the characteristic polynomial of a sum
declarations.note: Header cites Chenevier 2014, (1.5); the file lies outside the authors' REFERENCES check.

declarations.name: charpoly_smul_coeff
declarations.says: The X^k-coefficient of the characteristic polynomial of aM is a^{n−k} times that of M (n − k truncated at 0).

declarations.name: classAut
declarations.says: The subgroup Γ ∩ gKg⁻¹, the stabiliser in Γ of the coset gK.

declarations.name: classSum
declarations.says: The weighted class sum Σ_{c ∈ Γ\G/K} f(g_c)/#(Γ ∩ g_cKg_c⁻¹), g_c a chosen representative (mass-formula weights).

declarations.name: eq_and_eq_one_of_doubleCoset_rep
declarations.says: Let e: Δ → G be a homomorphism, r a system of representatives of e(Δ)\G/K, and Δ act freely at r(d)K. Then e(γ)r(d)K = r(c)K only for c = d and γ = 1.

declarations.name: exists_adjugate_of_charpoly_mem
declarations.says: If all characteristic-polynomial coefficients of every ρ(w) lie in B, then for each w there are v ∈ Λ and F ∈ B with det ρ(w) = F and ρ(vw) = ρ(w)ρ(v) = F·1 (the adjugate, by Cayley–Hamilton).

declarations.name: exists_eq_map_mul_rep_mul
declarations.says: With r a system of representatives of e(Δ)\G/K, every g ∈ G is e(γ)r(c)k for some class c, γ ∈ Δ and k ∈ K.

declarations.name: herm_represents_one
declarations.says: A hermitian form that is not negative semidefinite on a subspace S represents 1 on S.

declarations.name: isLocallyConstant_of_eventually_mul
declarations.says: A function on a topological group invariant under right translation by a neighbourhood of 1 is locally constant.

declarations.name: levelSpace
declarations.says: For a representation π of G, a subgroup K and a character χ of K: the submodule of vectors v with π(k)v = χ(k)v for all k ∈ K.

declarations.name: map_mem_levelSpace_of_commute
declarations.says: An operator commuting with π(K) preserves the χ-eigenspace of K.

declarations.name: relIndex_mul_measure_inf
declarations.says: For a left-invariant Borel measure μ on a Hausdorff topological group, K compact and H open subgroups: [K : H ∩ K]·μ(H ∩ K) = μ(K).

declarations.name: rightRegular
declarations.says: The right regular representation of G on functions F: G → W, (g·F)(x) = F(xg).

entries.known_result: none named (header: imaginary quadratic field ℚ(√−d): degree, CM structure, integers, different, quadratic character)

declarations.name: PrimeSevenModEight
declarations.says: Class: the natural number d is a prime ≡ 7 mod 8.
declarations.note: The proof's d satisfies it (d ≡ N₀/2 − 1 mod N₀ with 8 | N₀).

declarations.name: QuadField
declarations.says: The imaginary quadratic field K = ℚ(i√d) ⊂ ℂ.

declarations.name: QuadField.absNorm_span_eq_mul_star
declarations.says: For d ≡ 3 mod 4 and y ∈ O_K: the absolute norm of the ideal (y) is yȳ.

declarations.name: QuadField.c₀
declarations.says: For d ≡ 3 mod 4: the algebraic integer c₀ = (1 + √−d)/2 of K (root of X² − X + (d+1)/4).

declarations.name: QuadField.different_eq_span_and_adjoin_c₀
declarations.says: For a prime d ≡ 7 mod 8: the different of K/ℚ is generated by 2c₀ − 1 = √−d, and O_K = ℤ[c₀].
declarations.reference: e.g. J. Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory (1999), ch. I

declarations.name: QuadField.nonempty_algHom_of_isPrimitiveRoot
declarations.says: For a prime d ≡ 3 mod 4, ℚ(√−d) embeds into every field M of characteristic 0 containing a primitive d-th root of unity (the quadratic Gauss sum g satisfies g² = −d).
declarations.note: A def constructing the embedding; its content is the classical evaluation of g².

declarations.name: QuadField.sqrtNegD
declarations.says: The generator √−d = i√d of K.

declarations.name: QuadField.sqrtNegDInt
declarations.says: For d ≡ 3 mod 4: √−d as an element of O_K, written 2c₀ − 1.

declarations.name: chiK
declarations.says: The Legendre symbol (·/d) as an integer-valued Dirichlet character mod the prime d; for d ≡ 3 mod 4 it is the character χ_K of K = ℚ(√−d).

declarations.name: chiK_eq_legendreSym
declarations.says: χ_K(n) = (n/d) (Legendre symbol).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: chowlaSelbergConst
declarations.says: For an odd prime d: γ − Re L'/L(1, χ), γ Euler's constant and χ the Legendre symbol mod d (the constant of the Chowla–Selberg/Kronecker limit formula).

declarations.name: entireL
declarations.says: The entire function L(s, χ) for χ non-principal, and the continuation of (s − 1)L(s, χ) for χ principal.

declarations.name: quadTwist
declarations.says: For a Dirichlet character χ mod N and a prime d: the character χ·(·/d) mod Nd.

declarations.name: totient_mul_totient_le_finrank
declarations.says: If a number field M contains primitive roots of unity of coprime orders n and d, then [M : ℚ] ≥ φ(d)φ(n).

entries.known_result: header: general lemmas of linear algebra and matrices (textbook or folklore); contains the matrix Gauss sum relation (known result stated in Lib/Weil/GaussSum/ShearInvariance)

declarations.name: IsPrimitiveMulChar
declarations.says: A multiplicative character χ of a finite commutative ring R is primitive: for every a ≠ 0 some unit 1 + ca has χ(1+ca) ∉ {0, 1}.

declarations.name: TensorChain
declarations.says: The iterated complex tensor product S_{j−1} ⊗ ⋯ ⊗ S_0 (ℂ for j = 0).

declarations.name: TensorChain.lift
declarations.says: For bilinear maps b_i: S_i × M_i → M_{i+1} and x in M_0, the linear map S_{j−1}⊗⋯⊗S_0 → M_j, s_{j−1}⊗⋯⊗s_0 ↦ b_{j−1}(s_{j−1}, ⋯ b_0(s_0, x)).

declarations.name: TensorChain.map
declarations.says: For endomorphisms t_i of S_i, the endomorphism t_{j−1}⊗⋯⊗t_0 of S_{j−1}⊗⋯⊗S_0.

declarations.name: TensorChain.pure
declarations.says: The pure tensor f_{j−1}⊗⋯⊗f_0 of a family of vectors f_i ∈ S_i (1 ∈ ℂ for j = 0).

declarations.name: TensorChain.pure_congr
declarations.says: Pure tensors of length m agree when the families agree below m.

declarations.name: TensorChain.pure_smul
declarations.says: If g_j = c_j f_j for j < m, then g_{m−1}⊗⋯⊗g_0 = (∏_{j<m} c_j)·f_{m−1}⊗⋯⊗f_0.

declarations.name: compUpTo
declarations.says: For linear maps L_i: M_i → M_{i+1}, the composite L_{j−1}∘⋯∘L_0: M_0 → M_j (identity for j = 0).

declarations.name: exists_primitive_residue_addChar
declarations.says: If π: O → R is a surjection with kernel {x : gx ∈ O} and ψ is an additive character of F with ψ(tO) = 1 exactly for t ∈ O, then π(x) ↦ ψ(gx) is a well-defined primitive additive character of R.

declarations.name: exists_sum_smul_addChar_trace_eq
declarations.says: For a primitive additive character ψ of a finite commutative ring R, every complex function on N×a matrices over R is a linear combination of the characters y ↦ ψ(tr(yu)), u an a×N matrix.
declarations.note: Finite Fourier inversion.

declarations.name: index_stabilizer_GL_vector
declarations.says: For a finite field F and a nonzero u ∈ F^n, the stabilizer of u in GL_n(F) has index |F|^n − 1.
declarations.note: Orbit–stabilizer: GL_n(F) is transitive on nonzero vectors.

declarations.name: isUnit_of_mapMatrix
declarations.says: If f: R → S is a local ring homomorphism and f(M) is an invertible matrix, then M is invertible.

declarations.name: matrixFourier
declarations.says: The finite Fourier transform on matrices: for an additive character ψ of a finite ring R and f on N×a matrices, f̂(ρ) = Σ_v f(v)ψ(tr ρv) for ρ an a×N matrix.

declarations.name: matrix_gauss_sum
declarations.says: Gauss sums of a character of the determinant over matrix rings: for primitive ψ, χ and S on square matrices with S(gd) = χ(det g)S(d) (g invertible), Ŝ(y) = χ⁻¹(det y)Ŝ(1), and Ŝ(1)·conj(Σ_v χ(det v)ψ(tr v)) = S(1)·#M_a(R).
declarations.reference: T. Kondo, On Gaussian sums attached to the general linear groups over finite fields, J. Math. Soc. Japan 15 (1963) 244–255
declarations.relation: weaker form: only the eigen-relation and a norm identity, no exact value of the Gauss sum; but over any finite commutative ring with primitive characters (Kondo treats finite fields)
declarations.note: Header of ShearInvariance (the known result's home) says: one-dimensional ramified characters only, exact value not computed. No citation for this file in REFERENCES.md.

declarations.name: sum_addChar_dotProduct
declarations.says: Orthogonality of characters: for primitive ψ on a finite ring R and z ∈ R^a, Σ_x ψ(z·x) equals |R^a| if z = 0 and 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: sum_addChar_trace_mul
declarations.says: For primitive ψ and an a×N matrix ρ over a finite ring, Σ_v ψ(tr ρv) over N×a matrices v equals the number of such matrices if ρ = 0 and 0 otherwise.

entries.known_result: Gauss sums of a character of the determinant over matrix rings

declarations.name: IntegralFrame.blocks_spec
declarations.says: For an integral frame (an integral invertible matrix (K I L) with integral inverse cut into rows K′, I′, L′), all blocks are integral and K′K = I′I = L′L = 1 while the mixed products vanish.
declarations.note: unfolding of P·Q = 1.

declarations.name: IntegralFrame.stdDatum
declarations.says: For an integral frame and a function G, the function x ↦ G(x·(K I)) if the matrix x is integral and 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: Membership.mem.transpose_mem_schwartzBruhat
declarations.says: If Ψ is a Schwartz–Bruhat function supported in matrices with a left inverse, then y ↦ Ψ(yᵀ) is Schwartz–Bruhat, supported in matrices whose transpose has a left inverse.

declarations.name: TameLocalChar.norm_eq_one
declarations.says: A tamely ramified character χ (inverse on integral units factoring through a primitive character of a finite residue ring) has |χ(t)| = 1 for integral units t.

declarations.name: invOnUnits_eq_mul_of_unit
declarations.says: For an integral unit t, χ⁻¹·1_{O^×}(x) = χ(t)·χ⁻¹·1_{O^×}(xt).

declarations.name: invOnUnits_mul
declarations.says: The cut-off inverse character x ↦ χ(x)⁻¹ on integral units (0 elsewhere) is multiplicative on the integers O.

declarations.name: isIntMatrix_of_stdColDatum_ne_zero
declarations.says: For integral s, if the standard datum Ψ_s(y) = χ⁻¹(det sy)·1[y integral, det sy a unit] is nonzero then y is integral and sy is primitive.

declarations.name: isPartner_stdRowDatum_stdColDatum
declarations.says: For integral s, the standard row datum Φ (χ⁻¹ of the determinant of the matrix with rows s and x) and the standard column datum Ψ_s are partners: supported on the rows of k⁻¹ resp. columns of k for k ∈ GL_n(O), with Φ(x_k) = χ(det k)Ψ_s(y_k).

declarations.name: isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_isIntegralUnit_det
declarations.says: A square matrix over F is primitive (integral with integral left inverse) iff it is integral and its determinant is a unit of O.

declarations.name: isPrimitiveMatrix_of_stdColDatum_ne_zero
declarations.says: For integral s, if Ψ_s(y) ≠ 0 then y is primitive (integral with an integral left inverse).

declarations.name: schwartzBruhat.of_support_primitive
declarations.says: A locally constant function on matrices whose support consists of primitive matrices is a Schwartz–Bruhat function supported in matrices with a left inverse.

declarations.name: shear_invariant
declarations.says: Let s be integral, u a column and r a row with su = 0, ru = 0. If a linear form Λ on a space M of Schwartz–Bruhat functions is invariant under all y ↦ y + u z s y, then Λ takes the same value on Ψ_s and on y ↦ Ψ_s(y + u r y) when both lie in M.
declarations.note: Proof: write the sheared datum as an average over the compact group of integral shears; one paragraph.

declarations.name: stdColDatum
declarations.says: The standard column datum Ψ_s(y) = χ⁻¹(det sy) if y is integral and det sy is a unit of O, and 0 otherwise (χ a tamely ramified character of a product of local fields).

declarations.name: stdColDatum_mem_schwartzBruhat
declarations.says: For integral s and tame χ, Ψ_s is locally constant with compact support in the matrices with a left inverse.

declarations.name: stdRowDatum
declarations.says: The standard row datum: x ↦ χ⁻¹(det) of the square matrix with rows those of s and x (ordered by e) if it lies in GL_n(O), and 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: stdRowDatum_mem
declarations.says: For tame χ the standard row datum is locally constant with compact support in the matrices that have a right inverse.

entries.known_result: header: part of the duality of Weyl modules and Cartan component (see Branching) and of abstract Hecke operators and weighted class sums (see Lib/Adelic/Hecke/ClassMean); this file: Cartan product of complementary blocks; linearity, Fubini and integrality of class sums.

declarations.name: HasColumnsBelow
declarations.says: Condition on a weight kp (column multiplicities kp(τ,h)) relative to |N| ≤ |n|: kp(τ,h) = 0 for all τ and |N| ≤ h < |n|, so that the Schur functor of weight kp lives on N columns without a determinant twist.

declarations.name: HasColumnsBelow.schur_mul_schur
declarations.says: Under that condition, S_kp(A)·S_kp(B) = S_kp(AB) for matrices A_τ of size n×N and B_τ of size N×N (multiplicativity of Schur matrices).

declarations.name: cartanProduct
declarations.says: The Cartan product: the bilinear map sending y (weight kp, on the first N coordinates) and η (weight km, on the last m coordinates, acted on by g^{−T}) to the vector of the mixed weight obtained by tensoring their Schur images under g and applying an integral left inverse of the mixed Cartan embedding.

declarations.name: classSum_comm
declarations.says: Fubini for class sums: Σ_{Γ\G/K} Σ_{Γ'\G'/K'} f = Σ_{Γ'\G'/K'} Σ_{Γ\G/K} f, where the class sum of f is Σ_c f(g_c)/#(Γ∩g_cKg_c⁻¹).

declarations.name: classSum_le_card_mul_sq
declarations.says: If √f(g) ≤ M for all g, then the class sum of f over Γ\G/K is at most #(Γ\G/K)·M².

declarations.name: classSum_mul
declarations.says: Linearity: (class sum of f)·a = class sum of f·a in a ℚ-algebra.

declarations.name: classSum_sum
declarations.says: Linearity: the class sum of a finite sum is the sum of the class sums.

declarations.name: map_cartanProduct
declarations.says: At g = 1 the Cartan product has integer coefficients: for a ring homomorphism f: ℂ→K, f∘(y·η) = (f∘y)·(f∘η).

declarations.name: map_classSum
declarations.says: An additive map L commutes with class sums: L(class sum of f) = class sum of L∘f.

declarations.name: mixedCartan_mulVec_cartanProduct
declarations.says: Tensors on complementary blocks lie in the Cartan component: the mixed Cartan embedding applied to the Cartan product of y and η equals the tensor S_kp(incl_N)y ⊗ S_km(incl_m)η of their images under the block inclusions.
declarations.note: Proof via cyclicity of the extremal vector and the laws of the integral Cartan embedding (Lib/GLn/Dual/MixedCartan).

declarations.name: mul_classSum
declarations.says: Linearity: a·(class sum of f) = class sum of a·f.

declarations.name: norm_schur_mulVec_le
declarations.says: Over an ultrametric normed field, if all entries of the matrices A_τ have norm ≤ 1, then ‖S_kp(A)v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ (Schur matrices have integral polynomial entries).

declarations.name: smul_classSum_mem
declarations.says: Integrality of class sums: if each #(Γ∩gKg⁻¹) divides M and f takes values in an additive subgroup p, then M·(class sum of f) ∈ p.

declarations.name: weylNormSq_cartanProduct
declarations.says: The Cartan product is isometric for the Gram norms: ‖y·η‖² = ‖y‖²‖η‖².
declarations.note: Formal from the isometry law of the mixed Cartan embedding and the previous lemma.

declarations.name: weylRep_cartanProduct
declarations.says: Equivariance: the Cartan product at g ∈ ∏_τ GL_n(K) equals the representation of the mixed weight, twisted by det^{−Σ_{1≤i<|n|} km(i)}, applied to the Cartan product at 1.
declarations.note: Formal from the intertwining law of the mixed Cartan embedding.

entries.known_result: Part of: adelic Weil representation of a unitary group and the invariant theta functional (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/PairSplitting)

declarations.name: Gf.mulVec_mem_integralBox
declarations.says: If g ∈ U(𝔸_f) is integral (in K_w) at every place w ∈ S, then gx lies in the box of vectors integral at S iff x does.

declarations.name: Space.dataInner_omega_left
declarations.says: Unitarity of the Weil operators: ⟨ω(g)f, f′⟩ = ⟨f, ω(g⁻¹)f′⟩.

declarations.name: Space.ext_integrated
declarations.says: If P^S f = f and a bounded linear map L kills v_P ⊗ ϱ_f(y)vac for every polynomial P and every finite y vanishing above S ∪ S̄, then L(f) = 0.
declarations.note: Density of these vectors among P^S-fixed data (reproducing formula, density of polynomials in the Fock space).

declarations.name: Space.finHeisOp_finHeisOp
declarations.says: Composition law of the finite Heisenberg operators: ϱ_f(x)ϱ_f(y) = ψ₀(c̄₀·y*x)·ϱ_f(x + y).

declarations.name: Space.heisRep_right_rho
declarations.says: The finite-part Heisenberg operator of y is ϱ(αy) (finite vector).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: Space.omega_vacElem_sum
declarations.says: Lattice-model formula: for g ∈ U(𝔸_f), ω(g)vac = Δ_f(g)|Δ_f(g)|^{−2}·Σ_y ϱ_f(gy)vac over coset representatives y of Ô^n ∩ g⁻¹Ô^n in Ô^n.
declarations.note: Explicit computation of the Weil operator on the lattice vacuum.

declarations.name: Space.projOn_empty
declarations.says: P^∅ is the identity.

declarations.name: Space.projOn_integrated
declarations.says: P^S(v ⊗ f) = v ⊗ P^S f.

declarations.name: Space.projOn_vacElem
declarations.says: P^S vac = vac.

declarations.name: Space.projOn_ϱ
declarations.says: P^S commutes with ϱ(y) when the finite part of y vanishes above S ∪ S̄.

declarations.name: Space.rho_finVec
declarations.says: ϱ(αx)ϱ(αy) = ψ₀(½·y*x)·ϱ(α(x + y)) for finite adelic vectors x, y.

declarations.name: Space.rho_integrated
declarations.says: If y has zero real part, ϱ(y)(v ⊗ f) = v ⊗ ϱ(y)f.

declarations.name: Space.rho_integrated_realCoord
declarations.says: ϱ(y)(v ⊗ f) = (ϱ_ℝ(r(y))v) ⊗ ϱ((0, y_f))f: the real part of y acts on the Fock vector, the finite part on the datum.

declarations.name: mulVec_finVec
declarations.says: m·(0, αy) = (0, α·m_f y) for an adelic matrix m and a finite vector y.
declarations.note: Bookkeeping.

entries.known_result: Part of: theta kernels of unitary dual pairs: functoriality, seesaw, growth, rapid decay (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/KernelDecay)

declarations.name: Space.ModerateWeight
declarations.says: A moderate weight from U(S) to U(T): a continuous function M of moderate growth on U(S)(𝔸) and a continuous map j: U(S)(𝔸) → U(T)(𝔸) with ht(j(g)) ≤ C·ht(g).

declarations.name: Space.lift
declarations.says: The theta lift with datum φ: h ↦ ∫_{[U(S)]} θ(ω(g,h)φ)·y(g) dg, a function on U(T)(𝔸).

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.exists_clm_lift
declarations.says: For y automorphic of rapid decay and each h, the value at h of the theta lift of y is a continuous linear functional of the datum φ.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.fixesLeft_lift
declarations.says: The theta lift is left invariant under the rational points of U(T).

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.integrable_theta_mul
declarations.says: For y of rapid decay, g ↦ θ(ω(g,h)φ)·y(g) is integrable on [U(S)] (moderate growth times rapid decay).

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.integral_lift_eq_integral_descent
declarations.says: Adjointness of lift and descent: for y, y′ automorphic of rapid decay on U(S), U(T), ∫_{[U(T)]} y′·lift(y) = ∫_{[U(S)]} y·lift_swap(y′).
declarations.note: Fubini.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.isAutomorphic
declarations.says: If φ is fixed by an open subgroup L of U(S)(𝔸_f), then g ↦ θ(ω(g,h)φ) is automorphic on U(S) (continuous, left invariant under rational points, right L-invariant).

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.isModerate
declarations.says: g ↦ θ(ω(g,h)φ) has moderate growth on U(S)(𝔸).
declarations.note: From moderate_growth.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.liftBilin
declarations.says: The theta lift (φ, y) ↦ lift(φ, y) as a ℂ-bilinear map from data and rapidly decreasing automorphic functions on U(S) to functions on U(T)(𝔸).
