declarations.name: ThetaKernel.lift_equivariant
declarations.says: Equivariance: lift(φ, y)(h l) = lift(ω(k,l)φ, y(·k))(h) for automorphic y.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.lift_omega_left
declarations.says: lift(ω(k,1)φ, y) = lift(φ, y(·k⁻¹)) for automorphic y.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.moderate_growth
declarations.says: Moderate growth of theta kernels: there are C and A with |θ(ω(g,h)φ)| ≤ C‖φ‖·(ht(g)·ht(h))^A for all g, h and all data φ.
declarations.note: Header: known result (growth of theta kernels); standard, proved from a reduction-theory bound (exists_rat_norm_le_height) for the kernel.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.swap
declarations.says: The theta kernel for (T, S) obtained by exchanging the two groups: (h, g) ↦ ω(g, h), same functional θ.

declarations.name: ThetaKernel.theta_rat_mul
declarations.says: θ(ω(γg, h)φ) = θ(ω(g, h)φ) for rational γ ∈ U(S)(E).

declarations.name: lift_mul_right
declarations.says: lift(φ, y)(hk) = lift(ω(1,k)φ, y)(h).

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Kisin lattice (Breuil–Kisin module) of a crystalline lattice (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.WachKisin.PeriodMatrixFrame).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.exists_derivative_dvd_p_pow
declarations.says: For a Kummer chart there is a polynomial P over Λ with E | P(z) in S and θ(P'(z)) | p^d in O_C, where d = 0 if e = 1 and d = v_p(e) + 1 otherwise (a bound for the different).
declarations.reference: J.-P. Serre, Local Fields (1979), ch. III §6
declarations.note: different of a totally ramified extension of degree e divides e·π^(e−1)

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.frobEUnit
declarations.says: φ^a(E) as a unit of W(C^♭) (p does not divide φ^a(E)).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.frobE_dvd_phi_pow_tau
declarations.says: For a < b, φ^a(E) divides φ^b(τ) in A_inf.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.frobE_eq
declarations.says: φ^a(E) computed in S equals φ^a applied to E in A_inf.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.galMonoid
declarations.says: The submonoid {(0, g) : g ∈ Γ'} of ℤ × Γ.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.not_frobE_dvd_frobE_of_ne
declarations.says: For a ≠ b, φ^a(E) does not divide φ^b(E).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.not_frobE_dvd_p
declarations.says: φ^a(E) does not divide p.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.not_frobE_dvd_zTau
declarations.says: φ^a(E) does not divide δ = zτ.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.phi_pow_smul_z
declarations.says: φ^a(z) = z^(p^a).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.smul_phi_pow_comm
declarations.says: Elements of the Galois monoid commute with φ^a in any action of ℤ × Γ.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau
declarations.says: δ = zτ ∈ A_inf.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTauUnit
declarations.says: δ = zτ as a unit of W(C^♭) (p divides neither z nor τ).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau_dvd_phi_pow_smul
declarations.says: zτ divides φ^a(zτ).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.zTau_mul_E_dvd_smul_sub
declarations.says: For g ∈ Γ' and s ∈ S, zτE divides g s − s in A_inf.
declarations.note: g z = [ε]^l z and [ε]^l − 1 is divisible by μ ~ τE

entries.known_result: none named (header: general lemmas of linear algebra; two-block matrices, block embedding of GL_r, block-triangular criteria)

declarations.name: eq_inclMatrix_mul_iff
declarations.says: For an injection u: r → n with 0/1 inclusion matrix ι_u (n×r): T = ι_u·(rows u(r) of T) if and only if the rows of T outside u(r) vanish.

declarations.name: extendGL
declarations.says: For an injection u: r → n, the embedding GL_r(R) → GL_n(R), g ↦ 1 + ι_u(g − 1)ι_uᵀ: g on the coordinates u(r), identity on the others.

declarations.name: extendGL_mul_inclMatrix
declarations.says: extendGL(g)·ι_u = ι_u·g.

declarations.name: extendGL_spec
declarations.says: The block of extendGL(g) on u(r)×u(r) is g, and its rows outside u(r) are those of the identity matrix.

declarations.name: inclMatrix_transpose_mul
declarations.says: ι_uᵀ·T is the submatrix of T formed by the rows indexed by u(r).

declarations.name: inclMatrix_transpose_mul_self
declarations.says: ι_uᵀ·ι_u = 1 for an injection u.

declarations.name: index_rangeParabolic
declarations.says: The parabolic subgroup stabilising the coordinate subspace off u(r) has the same index in GL_n(R) as the standard block-triangular parabolic (they correspond under g ↦ (gᵀ)⁻¹).

declarations.name: map_inclMatrix
declarations.says: A ring homomorphism applied entrywise maps the inclusion matrix ι_u over R to the inclusion matrix over the target.

declarations.name: mem_rangeParabolic_iff
declarations.says: x lies in the range parabolic of u iff x_{u(i), j} = 0 for all i and all j outside u(r).

declarations.name: mem_stabilizer_col_iff
declarations.says: x ∈ GL_n(R) fixes every column of T (acting by left multiplication) iff xT = T.

declarations.name: rangeParabolic
declarations.says: The parabolic subgroup of GL_n(R) of matrices whose rows indexed by u(r) vanish in the columns outside u(r), i.e. the stabiliser of the coordinate subspace spanned by the e_j, j ∉ u(r).

declarations.name: residueDatum
declarations.says: For finite places w_i of a number field E and a function f of matrices over the residue fields: the function on adelic matrices x equal to f(x mod w_i)_i if x is integral at every w_i, and 0 otherwise.
declarations.note: A Schwartz–Bruhat-type function inflated from residue fields; used to build local data.

declarations.name: submatrix_mul_of_mem_rangeParabolic
declarations.says: For x in the range parabolic of u: the rows u(r) of xT equal (x restricted to u(r)×u(r))·(rows u(r) of T).

entries.known_result: the Ostrowski–Taussky inequality and an upper bound for Hua's determinant integral (only an upper bound, with an affine change of the rows, in place of the exact value); sources: Ostrowski–Taussky 1951; Hua, Harmonic Analysis in the Classical Domains, 1963

declarations.name: HasGaussianIntegral.pi
declarations.says: If ∫_V exp(−t q(x)) dx = (π/t)^a for all t > 0, then on V^ι the function Σ_i q(x_i) satisfies the same with exponent a·|ι| (Fubini).
declarations.note: A Prop-valued instance.

declarations.name: holCoord
declarations.says: For signs ε, the real-linear map of ℂ^ι conjugating the coordinates x_i with ε_i = 1 and keeping the others.

declarations.name: holCoord_eq
declarations.says: (holCoord x)_i = x̄_i if ε_i = 1 and x_i otherwise.
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: hua_integral_le
declarations.says: Hua's integral: for M > 0, S invertible k×k, c ≥ 0, r ≥ k, y_i = x_iS + a_i: ∫ c|det(M + Σ_{i∈s} y_i*y_i)|^{−(|s|+r)} over rows x_i ∈ ℂ^k (i ∈ s) is at most c(π^k/(k!|det S|²))^{|s|}|det M|^{−r}.
declarations.reference: L. K. Hua, Harmonic Analysis of Functions of Several Complex Variables in the Classical Domains (Transl. Math. Monographs 6, AMS 1963)
declarations.relation: weaker form: an upper bound (per row π^k/k! in place of the exact Gamma factor π^kΓ(r+1−k)/Γ(r+1)), for affinely shifted rows, instead of Hua's exact evaluation
declarations.note: Header says so itself; the integral is a lower Lebesgue integral over the rows indexed by s (others fixed).

declarations.name: norm_det_le_norm_pow
declarations.says: |det x| ≤ ‖x‖_HS^n for a complex n×n matrix x.

declarations.name: posProj
declarations.says: The diagonal projection P₊ onto the coordinates with sign ε_i = 1.

declarations.name: pow_le_exp_log_factorial_add
declarations.says: For l ∈ ℕ, x ≥ 0 and real v: x^l ≤ l!·exp(lv + x·e^{−v}).

declarations.name: principalMinor
declarations.says: The principal minor Δ_p(y) of a complex square matrix y on the indices satisfying p.

declarations.name: principalMinor_eq_det
declarations.says: Δ_p(x) = det(1 − P(1 − x)), P the diagonal projection onto the indices satisfying p.

declarations.name: principalMinor_mul
declarations.says: If x_ij = 0 or b_jk = 0 whenever i, k satisfy p and j does not, then Δ_p(xb) = Δ_p(x)Δ_p(b).

declarations.name: principalMinor_of_forall
declarations.says: The principal minor on all indices is the determinant.

declarations.name: realHeis
declarations.says: For signs ε, the Heisenberg datum on ℂ^ι: the unit-modulus bicharacter β(x, y) = exp((y*εx − x*εy)/2) = exp(i Im y*εx).

declarations.name: realVac
declarations.says: The Gaussian vacuum x ↦ exp(−|x|²/2) on ℂ^ι.

entries.known_result: none named (header: primes and residue degrees, Frobenius on quadratic integers, lifting the exponent at 2, decomposition of rational primes in ℚ(√−d) by the Legendre symbol)

declarations.name: FinPlace.charP_quotient
declarations.says: If the finite place w of a number field lies above the prime p, its residue field has characteristic p.

declarations.name: FinPlace.exists_natCast_mem
declarations.says: Every rational prime p lies below some finite place of a number field F.

declarations.name: FinPlace.exists_q_eq_pow
declarations.says: For w above p there is f with Nw = p^f, and x^{p^n} ≡ x mod w for all integers x of F iff f divides n.

declarations.name: FinPlace.natCast_mem_iff_dvd
declarations.says: For w above p and an integer n: n ∈ w iff p | n.

declarations.name: QuadField.chiK_two
declarations.says: For a prime d ≡ 7 mod 8: (2/d) = 1, i.e. 2 splits in K = ℚ(√−d).
declarations.note: Second supplementary law of quadratic reciprocity.

declarations.name: QuadField.eq_map_c₀_pow_iff
declarations.says: For a prime d ≡ 7 mod 8, p an odd prime and φ: O_K → R a ring map to characteristic p: x = φ(c₀)^{pⁿ} iff 2x − 1 = (p/d)ⁿ·φ(√−d) (Frobenius on (1 + √−d)/2).
declarations.note: Euler's criterion and quadratic reciprocity ((−d/p) = (p/d) for d ≡ 3 mod 4).

declarations.name: QuadField.map_sqrtNegDInt_sq
declarations.says: φ(√−d)² = −d for every ring map φ from O_K.

declarations.name: QuadField.prime_inert_or_eq_mul
declarations.says: For d ≡ 3 mod 4 and w above p in K: the primes above p are w and some J, and either J = w with Nw = p² (inert), or Nw = NJ = p and (p) = wJ (split or ramified).

declarations.name: QuadField.q_eq_iff_legendreSym_ne_neg_one
declarations.says: For a prime d ≡ 7 mod 8 and w above p in K = ℚ(√−d): Nw = p iff (p/d) ≠ −1 (decomposition law).

declarations.name: chiK_cases
declarations.says: For primes p, d: either p = d and (p/d) = 0, or p ≠ d and (p/d) = ±1.

declarations.name: nonsplitWeight
declarations.says: The weight ρ_p = 1/(p² − 1) if (p/d) = −1, 1/(2(p − 1)) if p = d, and 1/(p − 1) if p splits.
declarations.note: Local weight used in the log-theta and valuation sums (Lib/CM/KroneckerLimit/LogTheta, New/Curve/LiveSum).

declarations.name: primeNorm
declarations.says: The norm q of a prime of K above p: p² if (p/d) = −1, p otherwise.

declarations.name: two_pow_le_of_pow_eq_one
declarations.says: Lifting the exponent at 2: if |q| > 1, o ≥ 1 and q^o ≡ 1 mod 2^{s+1}, then 2^s ≤ (|q| + 1)·o.

entries.known_result: none named (header: general lemmas of algebraic number theory, textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: CoeffRing.eventually_primitiveRoot
declarations.says: For every k ≥ 1, O_L contains a primitive k-th root of unity for all sufficiently large L.

declarations.name: CoeffRing.isUnit_iff_norm_eq_one
declarations.says: x ∈ O_L is a unit iff |x| = 1.

declarations.name: CoeffRing.normLength
declarations.says: Normalised length on O_L: n ↦ n·v(ϖ), ϖ a uniformiser and v(ℓ) = 1, so that O_L/ℓ has normalised length 1.

declarations.name: CoeffRing.normLength_addVal
declarations.says: The normalised length of the valuation of x ∈ O_L equals its ℓ-adic valuation −log_ℓ|x|.

declarations.name: CoeffRing.normLength_mono
declarations.says: The normalised length is monotone.

declarations.name: CoeffRing.normLength_natCast_mul
declarations.says: The normalised length is additive: of k·g it is k times that of g.

declarations.name: apply_eq_self_of_mem_inertiaGroup
declarations.says: An element of the inertia group of Gal(ℚ̄_p/ℚ_p) fixes every root of unity of order f prime to p.

declarations.name: ellVal_le_add_iff
declarations.says: For |y| ≤ 1: v_ℓ(x) ≤ c + v_ℓ(y) iff ℓ^{−c}|y| ≤ |x| (v_ℓ = −log_ℓ|·| truncated at 0).

declarations.name: ellVal_le_ellVal
declarations.says: If |y| ≤ |x| then v_ℓ(x) ≤ v_ℓ(y).

declarations.name: ellVal_le_iff
declarations.says: v_ℓ(x) ≤ c iff ℓ^{−c} ≤ |x|.

declarations.name: ellVal_mul_le
declarations.says: v_ℓ(xy) ≤ v_ℓ(x) + v_ℓ(y) for the truncated valuation.

declarations.name: ellVal_natCast
declarations.says: For a positive integer f, v_ℓ(f) is the usual ℓ-adic valuation of f.

declarations.name: not_dvd_pow_sub_one
declarations.says: p does not divide p^f − 1 for f ≥ 1.

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Potentially crystalline representations, Hodge–Tate weights, Weil–Deligne Frobenius (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.Crystalline.RegularityFrobenius).

declarations.name: Dpcris
declarations.says: D_pcris(T): the Z_p-submodule of B_max ⊗_{Z_p} T of elements fixed by j(g) ⊗ ρ(g) for all g with j(g) in some neighbourhood of 1 in G_p (invariants under some open subgroup).

declarations.name: GroupOverGp
declarations.says: A group G bundled with a homomorphism j: G → G_p = Gal(Q̄_p/Q_p) with open image.

declarations.name: HasJumps
declarations.says: A multiset J of integers lists the Hodge–Tate jumps of T at γ: for every u, the multiplicity of the jump u equals the count of u in J.

declarations.name: IsAdmissible
declarations.says: Fontaine admissibility along a filter F on Γ: the elements of B_max ⊗ T fixed by j(g)⊗ρ(g) for F-almost all g span B_max ⊗ T over B_max.

declarations.name: IsPotCrys
declarations.says: T is potentially crystalline: the elements of B_max ⊗ T fixed by all g with j(g) near 1 span B_max ⊗ T over B_max.
declarations.note: period ring is Colmez's B_max (named Bcris in Lean), equivalent to B_cris for this purpose

declarations.name: IsWeilPair
declarations.says: (s, m) is a Weil pair: s ∈ G_p acts on the residue field of the integers of Q̄_p as x ↦ x^(1/p^m) (geometric Frobenius to the m); m = 0 means s is in inertia.

declarations.name: OverGp
declarations.says: A group Γ together with a homomorphism j: Γ → G_p = Gal(Q̄_p/Q_p) whose image is open.

declarations.name: coefEnd
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism R → End_{B_max}(B_max ⊗_{Z_p} T) letting the coefficients R act on the T factor.

declarations.name: crysCocycles
declarations.says: Z_f(T): the R-module of maps c: Γ → T such that some y ∈ B_max ⊗ T has 1 ⊗ c(g) = g y − y for all g (for T free over Z_p: the crystalline, i.e. Bloch–Kato finite, cocycles).

declarations.name: isWeilPair_zero_iff
declarations.says: (s, 0) is a Weil pair if and only if s lies in the inertia group of the valuation ring of Q̄_p.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: jump
declarations.says: Multiplicity of the Hodge–Tate jump u of T at γ: R → C_p: the Q̄_p-dimension (0 if infinite) of the space of γ-semilinear f: T → C_p with f(gx) = χ(g)^(−u)·g f(x) for g near 1.

declarations.name: linearFrob
declarations.says: β_{s,m}: a chosen B_max-linear endomorphism of B_max ⊗ T agreeing with φ^m j(s) ⊗ ρ(s) on D_pcris(T), if one exists (arbitrary otherwise); the linearized Weil–Deligne Frobenius.
declarations.note: defined by choice; its defining property is linearFrob_apply

declarations.name: tensorAction
declarations.says: For m acting on a ring B and an endomorphism f of T, the Z_p-linear endomorphism b ⊗ x ↦ (m b) ⊗ f(x) of B ⊗_{Z_p} T.

entries.known_result: Potentially crystalline representations, Hodge–Tate weights and the Weil–Deligne Frobenius

declarations.name: IsAdmissible.of_jointly_injective
declarations.says: Fontaine's formalism, stability under subobjects: if finitely many jointly injective Z_p-linear maps f_i: T' → S_i are equivariant along F (F coarser than 'near 1') and each S_i is admissible along F, then T' is admissible along F.
declarations.reference: J.-M. Fontaine, Représentations p-adiques semi-stables, Astérisque 223 (1994), Exp. III; O. Brinon, B. Conrad, CMI notes on p-adic Hodge theory (2009)
declarations.relation: special case: subobjects only, for Colmez's B_max, with admissibility along a filter (invariants under an open subgroup)
declarations.note: header cites Fontaine Exp. III §1 and Brinon–Conrad 5.2.1 (file in REFERENCES.md's unchecked list); needs the regularity of B_max

declarations.name: IsAdmissible.of_pairing
declarations.says: Fontaine's formalism, duals: if T (finite free over R) is admissible along F and T'' ≅ Hom_R(T, R(c)) equivariantly, then T'' is admissible along F; and on inertia, a polynomial killing (s, 0) on T kills (s⁻¹, 0) on T''.
declarations.reference: J.-M. Fontaine, Représentations p-adiques semi-stables, Astérisque 223 (1994), Exp. III; O. Brinon, B. Conrad, CMI notes on p-adic Hodge theory (2009)
declarations.relation: special case: duals twisted by χ^c, period ring B_max; the clause on inertia (killing polynomials) is an addition
declarations.note: header: 'Known result: Potentially crystalline representations, Hodge–Tate weights, Weil–Deligne Frobenius'

declarations.name: IsCrystalline.linearFrob_eq_one
declarations.says: If T is crystalline and j(s) is in inertia, the linear Frobenius β_{s,0} on B_max ⊗ T is the identity.
declarations.note: converse half of Fontaine's criterion (see IsPotCrys.isCrystalline_of_inertia_fixes)

declarations.name: IsKilledBy.of_jointly_injective
declarations.says: If T' has jointly injective φ-semilinear maps, equivariant near 1 and at s, to finitely many potentially crystalline S_i on which P = φ(Q) kills the Weil pair (s, m), then T' is potentially crystalline and Q kills (s, m) on T'.

declarations.name: IsPotCrys.eventually_linearFrob_eq_one
declarations.says: For T finite free and potentially crystalline, β_{g,0} = 1 for all g with j(g) close enough to 1 and in inertia.
declarations.note: a basis of D_pcris is fixed by a small open subgroup

declarations.name: IsWeilPair.inv
declarations.says: If j(s) is in inertia (Weil pair (j(s), 0)), so is j(s⁻¹).

declarations.name: IsWeilPair.smul_eq_of_fixed_nearOne
declarations.says: If (j(s), m) is a Weil pair and b ∈ B_max is fixed by j(g) for all g near 1, then φ^m j(s) fixes b.
declarations.note: relies on Lib's identification of the elements of B_max fixed by an open subgroup with W(F_{p^f})[1/p] (B_max^{G_L} = L_0)

declarations.name: baseChange_linearFrob
declarations.says: For potentially crystalline T, T', a Weil pair (j(s), m) and f: T → T' equivariant for s and near 1, 1 ⊗ f intertwines the operators β_{s,m} of T and T'.

declarations.name: commute_coefEnd_linearFrob
declarations.says: For potentially crystalline T and a Weil pair (j(s), m), β_{s,m} commutes with the action of the coefficients a ∈ R.

declarations.name: linearFrob_apply
declarations.says: Weil–Deligne Frobenius of a potentially crystalline representation: for a Weil pair (j(s), m), the chosen B_max-linear β_{s,m} agrees with φ^m j(s) ⊗ ρ(s) on every element of D_pcris(T).
declarations.reference: J.-M. Fontaine, Représentations l-adiques potentiellement semi-stables, Astérisque 223 (1994), Exp. VIII
declarations.relation: weaker form: only one linear operator β_{s,m} per Weil pair (existence of the B_max-linear extension of φ^m s on D_pcris); no Weil–Deligne representation on D_pcris is built, polynomials killing β replace it
declarations.note: header cites Fontaine Exp. VIII 2.3 (not checked); uses that φ^m s is L_0-linear on D_pcris

declarations.name: linearFrob_mul
declarations.says: Multiplicativity: for potentially crystalline T and Weil pairs (j(s), m), (j(t), k), β_{st, m+k} = β_{s,m} β_{t,k}.

declarations.name: map_eq_zero_of_roots
declarations.says: K algebraically closed of characteristic 0, φ: K[X] → A a ring map with φ(X)^n = 1 for some n > 0: if φ(Q) = 0 then φ(P) = 0 for every P vanishing at all roots of Q.
declarations.note: X^n − 1 is separable

entries.known_result: header: part of the standard basis theorem for Schur (dual Weyl) modules over any ring (see MinorBasis: De Concini–Eisenbud–Procesi 1980; Akin–Buchsbaum–Weyman 1982, II.2.16, II.4.11).

declarations.name: FitsRanks.refl
declarations.says: The size condition holds for n' = n.

declarations.name: PolyRep.coord_mem_of_coeff_mem
declarations.says: If f = Σ_j x_j b_j ∏_τ det_τ^{e_τ} and all coefficients of f lie in an additive subgroup A, then every x_j lies in A (the basis is unitriangular in monomials).

declarations.name: linearIndependent_nablaBasis
declarations.says: Analogue of the standard basis theorem (independence half): over any commutative ring R the authors' minor products b_i (built one row at a time, indexed by chosen standard fillings) are linearly independent.
declarations.reference: De Concini, Eisenbud, Procesi, Young diagrams and determinantal varieties, Invent. Math. 56 (1980); Akin, Buchsbaum, Weyman, Schur functors and Schur complexes, Adv. Math. 44 (1982)
declarations.note: The published standard basis theorem concerns semistandard bitableaux; the MinorBasis header says this basis is different, so the published statement does not apply verbatim. MinorBasis header gives ABW II.2.16, II.4.11; REFERENCES.md: ABW 'work found, no place given'.

declarations.name: map_schur
declarations.says: Entries of Schur matrices commute with ring homomorphisms: φ(S_κ(z)_{ij}) = S_κ(φ(z))_{ij}.

declarations.name: prod_tableauPoly_mem_nabla
declarations.says: A product over τ of tableau polynomials (products of minors) lies in the module of Borel semi-invariants of the corresponding weight.

declarations.name: schur_apply_eq_prod
declarations.says: The Schur matrix of a tuple is the Kronecker product of the one-place Schur matrices: S_κ(z)_{ij} = ∏_τ S_{κ_τ}(z_τ)_{i_τ j_τ}.

declarations.name: schur_diagonal
declarations.says: S_κ(diag(x_τ)) is diagonal with i-th entry ∏_τ ∏_a x_τ(a)^{w}, w the number of entries a in the filling i_τ (weights of the basis).

declarations.name: schur_diagonal_eq_prod
declarations.says: Same as the previous, written as a product over all entries of the fillings, under the size condition.

declarations.name: schur_map
declarations.says: Base change: S_κ(φ(z)) = φ(S_κ(z)) entrywise for a ring homomorphism φ.

declarations.name: schur_mul_left
declarations.says: Functoriality: S_κ(gz) = S_κ(g)S_κ(z) for square g_τ and rectangular z_τ.

declarations.name: schur_smul
declarations.says: Homogeneity: S_κ(t·z) = ∏_τ t_τ^{Σ_i i·κ_τ(i)}·S_κ(z).

declarations.name: sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis
declarations.says: Defining expansion of Schur matrices: b'_i(zy) = Σ_j S_κ(z)_{ij} b_j(y)∏_τ det(y_τ)^{d_τ}.
declarations.note: Uses that the basis spans the semi-invariants (standard basis theorem, MinorBasis).

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Artin–Schreier–Witt resolution over the tilt (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.WachGamma.KisinModuleDefs).

declarations.name: Lift.GalLattice
declarations.says: A Galois lattice: a finite free O-module (with compatible Z_p-structure) carrying an O-linear representation of Γ.

declarations.name: Lift.GalLattice.tateDual
declarations.says: The twisted dual L^∨(1) = Hom_O(L, O(1)), Γ acting on O(1) through the cyclotomic character.

declarations.name: Lift.GalLattice.tensor
declarations.says: The tensor product Y ⊗_O L of two Galois lattices with the diagonal action.

declarations.name: Lift.InClass
declarations.says: Y lies in the class (F, K, U): admissible for periods fixed near 1 and F-almost everywhere, Hodge–Tate jumps at each embedding g in U(g), and Q kills (s, 0) whenever K(s, Q) holds and j(s) is in inertia.
declarations.note: the authors' class of crystalline-type lattices with bounded weights and prescribed inertial polynomials

declarations.name: Lift.InClass.isPotCrys
declarations.says: A lattice in a class (F, K, U) is potentially crystalline.

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing
declarations.says: A pairing of Y and L modulo p^m: an O-linear ψ: Y ⊗ L → O(1) with gψ − ψ = p^m c(g) for a crystalline cocycle c of (Y ⊗ L)^∨(1), together with a Z_p-linear functional f: O → Z_p.

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing.CupBounds
declarations.says: The cup product (g, h) ↦ b(a(g), g·c(h)) of maps a: Γ → Y, c: Γ → L, with b the pairing modulo p^m and Z/p^m(1) ⊂ Q̄_p^×, is the coboundary of a continuous 1-cochain.

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing.modPairing
declarations.says: The Z_p-bilinear pairing Y × L → Z_p/p^m, (y, l) ↦ f(ψ(y ⊗ l)) mod p^m.

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing.modPairing_rho
declarations.says: The pairing modulo p^m is equivariant into the Tate twist: b(gy, gl) = χ(g)·b(y, l).

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing.thirdPairing
declarations.says: The O-valued pairing ((λ, o), t) ↦ (p^m λ + o ψ)(t) between the extension of O by (Y ⊗ L)^∨(1) along c and Y ⊗ L.

declarations.name: Lift.Pairing.thirdPairing_equivariant
declarations.says: That pairing is equivariant into O(1): β(gx, gt) = χ(j(g))·β(x, t).

declarations.name: Lift.cupOrthogonal
declarations.says: L^{⊥𝒬}: the O-module of maps c: Γ → L whose cup product with every crystalline cocycle of every Y in the family 𝒬 bounds, for every pairing modulo p^m of Y and L (an orthogonal complement for local duality).
declarations.note: the authors' substitute for the dual Selmer condition

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Fontaine's period rings and the fundamental exact sequence (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.PeriodRings.BdR).

declarations.name: Ainf
declarations.says: A_inf = W(O^♭): p-typical Witt vectors over the tilt O^♭ of the ring of integers O_C of C_p.

declarations.name: FrobGal.smul_def
declarations.says: The element (n, g) of ℤ × G_p acts on a ring with Frobenius as x ↦ φ^n(g x).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: WittCFlat
declarations.says: W(C^♭): p-typical Witt vectors over the fraction field C^♭ of O^♭.

declarations.name: epsRoot
declarations.says: A chosen ε^(1/p) ∈ O^♭ for a compatible system ε = (1, ζ_p, ζ_{p²}, …) of p-power roots of unity.

declarations.name: epsTilt
declarations.says: ε = (1, ζ_p, ζ_{p²}, …) ∈ O^♭, defined as the p-th power of the chosen ε^(1/p).

declarations.name: isPrimitiveRoot_untilt_epsPow
declarations.says: For a rational s, the untilt (ε^s)^♯ is a primitive root of unity of order the denominator of s.

declarations.name: mk_complex_eq_mk_padicAlgCl
declarations.says: ℂ and Q̄_p have the same cardinality (the continuum).

declarations.name: mu
declarations.says: μ = [ε] − 1 ∈ A_inf ([·] the Teichmüller lift).

declarations.name: theta
declarations.says: Fontaine's ring homomorphism θ: A_inf → O_C, [x] ↦ x^♯.

declarations.name: theta_teichmuller
declarations.says: θ([x]) = x^♯ for x ∈ O^♭.

entries.known_result: Part of the Bargmann–Fock model of the oscillator representation of U(p,q) (see Lib/Weil/Fock/OscillatorPair); this file: the L¹ Fock space, polynomial vectors, tensor products of Fock vectors, block-diagonal action over places

declarations.name: Heisenberg.IsVacuum.measurePreserving_equiv
declarations.says: If e, e′ are vacua for Haar measures μ on W and μ′ on W′ and φ: W′ → W is an isomorphism of topological groups with e∘φ = e′, then φ carries μ′ to μ.
declarations.note: A vacuum fixes the normalization of Haar measure (∫|e|² dμ = 1); uniqueness of Haar measure up to a scalar.

declarations.name: blockMatrix
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism sending a T-indexed family of complex ι×ι matrices to the block-diagonal matrix indexed by T×ι.

declarations.name: fockSpace
declarations.says: The Fock space 𝓕 of signature ε: integrable functions c on ℂ^ι with c(x) = ∫ c(y)β(y,x)e(x−y) dy, e(x) = exp(−|x|²/2) the Gaussian vacuum, with the L¹ norm.
declarations.note: An L¹ (Feichtinger-type) reproducing space, not the Hilbert Fock space of holomorphic functions.

declarations.name: polyVector
declarations.says: The linear map P ↦ v_P from complex polynomials in ι variables to 𝓕, v_P(x) = P(ζ(x))·exp(−|x|²/2), where ζ(x)_i = x̄_i at positive and x_i at negative coordinates.
declarations.note: The definition includes the proof that v_P lies in the reproducing space (via derivatives of the Heisenberg action).

declarations.name: polyVector_apply
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: polyVector_one
declarations.says: The Fock vector of the constant polynomial 1 is the Gaussian vacuum exp(−|x|²/2).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: realBoxProd
declarations.says: For coordinates split by e: ι₁ ⊔ ι₂ ≅ ι with signs ε₁, ε₂, the bounded bilinear map 𝓕(ε₁) × 𝓕(ε₂) → 𝓕(ε) sending two Fock vectors to their external (tensor) product.

declarations.name: realBoxProd_polyVector
declarations.says: The external product of v_P and v_Q is v_{P′Q′}, where P′, Q′ are P, Q with variables renamed into ι along e.
declarations.note: Computation from the definitions.

declarations.name: realHeisOp
declarations.says: For x in ℂ^ι, the Heisenberg operator on 𝓕: c ↦ (z ↦ β(x,z)·c(z−x)).

declarations.name: realInner
declarations.says: The bounded sesquilinear form on 𝓕, conjugate-linear in the first variable: (c, c′) ↦ ∫ c̄·c′.

declarations.name: realWeil
declarations.says: The oscillator (Weil) representation ω₀ of the real unitary group U(ε) on 𝓕: ω₀(u)c = conj(det d)·∫ c(y) ϱ(uy)e dy, d the negative block of u, e the Gaussian.
declarations.note: A genuine representation because of the splitting proved in realAction (FockAction).

declarations.name: vacVector
declarations.says: The Gaussian vacuum exp(−|x|²/2) as an element of 𝓕.

entries.known_result: Part of the Bargmann–Fock model of the oscillator representation of U(p,q) (see Lib/Weil/Fock/OscillatorPair) and of the mixed models of the Weil representation (see Lib/Weil/MixedModel/ZeroTermLaw); this file: weighted moments, density of polynomial vectors in all moment norms, mixed Schrödinger–Fock model

declarations.name: IsRapidDatum
declarations.says: A Fock vector v is rapid if all its weighted moments mom_N(v) = ∫(1+‖y‖)^N |v(y)| dy are finite.

declarations.name: MixedModel.isRapidDatum_slice
declarations.says: In a mixed Schrödinger–Fock model v ↦ v[a], if v is rapid then every slice v[a] is rapid.
declarations.note: From the slice estimate (1+‖a‖)^M mom_N(v[a]) ≤ C·mom_{N+M}(v) proved in the same file.

declarations.name: exists_tendsto_weightedNorm
declarations.says: If v in 𝓕 is rapid, there is one sequence of polynomials P_n with mom_N(v − v_{P_n}) → 0 for every N.
declarations.note: Proof: expand the reproducing kernel exp⟨ζ(y),ζ(x)⟩ in its Taylor series and use dominated convergence; Fock-model analogue of the density of Hermite expansions in Schwartz space.

declarations.name: isRapidDatum_integral
declarations.says: If F: Y → 𝓕 is measurable and ∫ mom_N(F(y)) dν(y) < ∞ for all N (ν s-finite), then F is Bochner integrable and ∫F dν is rapid.

declarations.name: isRapidDatum_vacVector
declarations.says: The Gaussian vacuum is rapid.

declarations.name: lintegral_weightedNorm_smul_le
declarations.says: If mom_{N′}(F(y)) ≤ C(1+‖y‖)^N for all y, then ∫ mom_{N′}(v(y)F(y)) dy ≤ C·mom_N(v) for v in 𝓕.

declarations.name: weightedNorm
declarations.says: The weighted moment mom_N(v) = ∫(1+‖y‖)^N |v(y)| dy ∈ [0,∞] of a Fock vector (sup norm, Lebesgue measure divided by π^|ι|).

declarations.name: weightedNorm_integral_le
declarations.says: mom_N(∫F dν) ≤ ∫ mom_N(F(t)) dν(t) for an s-finite measure ν (Minkowski's integral inequality).

declarations.name: weightedNorm_polyVector_ne_top
declarations.says: Polynomial Fock vectors v_P have all weighted moments finite.

declarations.name: weightedNorm_realHeisOp_le
declarations.says: mom_N(ϱ(y)v) ≤ (1+‖y‖)^N·mom_N(v) for the Heisenberg operator ϱ(y).

declarations.name: weightedNorm_realWeil_le
declarations.says: mom_N(ω₀(u)v) ≤ |Δ(u)|·(1+‖u‖)^N·mom_N(e)·mom_N(v) for u in U(ε), e the Gaussian vacuum.

declarations.name: weightedNorm_smul
declarations.says: mom_N(c·v) = |c|·mom_N(v).
declarations.note: unfolding

entries.known_result: header: part of the contravariant form on Weyl's lattice, Fischer product, irreducibility under U(n) (see Lib/Adelic/CuspForms/DeltaForms: Jantzen 2003; Goodman–Wallach 2009, ch. 5; Howe 1995).

declarations.name: PolyRep.eval_toPoly
declarations.says: The polynomial attached to ξ, Σ_i (Gξ)_i b_i (b_i the basis minor products), has value ev_yᵀGξ at an array y.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: PolyRep.ext_weylEval
declarations.says: Over an infinite domain R, two linear maps from coordinate vectors of weight κ to a free module agree if they agree on all evaluation vectors ev_y with ∏_τ det_τ(y)^{e_τ} ≠ 0 (y ranging over an infinite set).

declarations.name: PolyRep.rowSubst_highestPoly
declarations.says: Substituting the array y into the highest-weight polynomial gives ∏_τ ∏_{h<N_τ} (h×h leading minor of the substituted matrix)^{κ_τ(h)}.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: PolyRep.schur_squarePart_mulVec
declarations.says: S_κ(squarePart_e(y))·ev_{perm(e)} = ev_y: the evaluation vector at y is the image of the extremal vector under the Schur matrix of the square part of y.

declarations.name: PolyRep.squarePart
declarations.says: For an array y and enumerations e_τ, the square matrices with (a,b) entry y((τ,a), e_τ(b)): the first |n_τ| columns of block τ.

declarations.name: fockPairing_toPoly_nablaBasis
declarations.says: Over a domain of characteristic 0, the Fock (Fischer) pairing ⟨P,Q⟩ = P(∂)Q(0) of the polynomial attached to ξ with the basis element b_k is h_κ·ξ_k (h_κ the hook number).

declarations.name: fockPairing_toPoly_toPoly
declarations.says: ⟨toPoly ξ, toPoly η⟩_Fock = h_κ·ξᵀGη: the Gram form is the Fischer product up to the hook number.

declarations.name: map_toPoly
declarations.says: Attaching polynomials commutes with ring homomorphisms (integer coefficients).

declarations.name: range_toPoly
declarations.says: Over ℂ, ξ ↦ Σ_i (Gξ)_i b_i maps onto the module of Borel semi-invariant polynomials of the weight given by κ (the Schur module realized in polynomials on matrices).
declarations.note: Rests on the spanning half of the authors' analogue of the standard basis theorem for their row-by-row minor-product basis (Lib/GLn/SchurModule/MinorBasis; cf. De Concini–Eisenbud–Procesi 1980, Akin–Buchsbaum–Weyman 1982) and on invertibility of G over ℚ.

declarations.name: weylGram_mul_fockPairing
declarations.says: Contravariant form versus Fischer product: the integer Gram matrix G times the matrix of Fock pairings ⟨b_i,b_j⟩ of the basis minor products equals h_κ·1, h_κ the (positive) hook number.
declarations.reference: Header of Lib/Adelic/CuspForms/DeltaForms: Jantzen 2003; Goodman–Wallach 2009, ch. 5; Howe 1995
declarations.note: This normalization (G defined so that G·Fock = h·1 with integer G) is the authors' form of the known duality between the contravariant form and the Fischer inner product.

declarations.name: weylGram_mul_schur
declarations.says: G·S_κ(g) = S_κ(gᵀ)ᵀ·G: Schur matrices of g and gᵀ are adjoint for the Gram form (contravariance), over a domain of characteristic 0.
declarations.note: Follows from the adjointness of substitutions z and zᵀ for the Fock pairing.

entries.known_result: none named (header: general lemmas of linear algebra and matrices, textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: SubmoduleElem
declarations.says: The type of elements of a submodule S of a module M (notation only).

declarations.name: adjugate_fin_succ_eq_det_submatrix'
declarations.says: Cofactor formula: adj(A)_{ij} = (−1)^{i+j} det(A with row j and column i deleted), for a square matrix A over a commutative ring.
declarations.note: Restatement of a Mathlib lemma with another sign convention.

declarations.name: det_classical
declarations.says: The determinant does not depend on the chosen decidable-equality instance on the index set.
declarations.note: Purely technical rewriting lemma; nothing to say in the write-up.

declarations.name: det_fromBlocks_one₁₁'
declarations.says: Schur complement: det [[1, B], [C, D]] = det(D − C·B).

declarations.name: det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂'
declarations.says: det [[A, 0], [C, D]] = det A · det D (block lower triangular).

declarations.name: det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁'
declarations.says: det [[A, B], [0, D]] = det A · det D (block upper triangular).

declarations.name: det_succ_row_zero'
declarations.says: Laplace expansion of the determinant along the first row.

declarations.name: diagonal_classical
declarations.says: The diagonal matrix does not depend on the chosen decidable-equality instance.
declarations.note: Purely technical rewriting lemma.

declarations.name: fromBlocks_one'
declarations.says: The block matrix [[1, 0], [0, 1]] is the identity matrix.

declarations.name: inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff'
declarations.says: If A is invertible exactly when D is, then [[A, B], [0, D]]⁻¹ = [[A⁻¹, −A⁻¹BD⁻¹], [0, D⁻¹]] (Lean's total inverse).

declarations.name: star_mulVec_dotProduct
declarations.says: (Bx)*·y = x*·(B*y) for a matrix B over a ring with involution and vectors x, y (B* the conjugate transpose).

entries.known_result: Part of: theta lift for a definite unitary pair as a class sum on algebraic modular forms (stated in Lib/Weil/CompactLift/RallisFormula)

declarations.name: IsLiftWeight
declarations.says: Weight condition for the definite lift U(n) → U(n′): |n| < |n′|, the diagram κ has no column of height strictly between |n| and |n′|, and e_τ = e_b,τ + κ_τ(|n|) (κ_τ(h) = number of columns of height h at τ).

declarations.name: Kernel.lift
declarations.says: Theta lift of algebraic modular forms with datum Φ for an abstract kernel (ω, jet matrix): φ ↦ (h ↦ ∫_{Γ\G} J(ω(g,h)Φ)(φ(g)) dg), Γ the rational points, Haar measure with vol K = 1 (a finite class sum).
declarations.note: Abstract kernel = smooth representation ω of G_f × G′_f on data with a Γ×Γ′-equivariant linear map to Hom(V_κ,e, V_κ,ea).

declarations.name: Kernel.lift_equivariant
declarations.says: Equivariance of the lift: the lift with datum ω(a,b)Φ of the right translate of φ by a equals the right translate by b of the lift of φ with datum Φ.
declarations.note: Change of variables in the class integral.

declarations.name: dotProduct_schurJet_mulVec
declarations.says: A · J_κ(F) · ξ equals the jet at F of the polynomial Aᵀ S_κ(z) ξ, J_κ(F) the matrix of jets of F along the Schur matrix S_κ.
declarations.note: Bilinearity of jets; unfolding.

declarations.name: eval_schurCoeffPoly
declarations.says: Evaluating the polynomial Aᵀ S_κ(z) ξ at a point z gives A · S_κ(z) · ξ (under the lift-weight condition, so that the Schur matrix of the substituted matrices is the substituted Schur matrix).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: map_schurJet
declarations.says: A ring homomorphism φ commutes with the entries of the jet matrix along S_κ: φ(J_κ(F)_{i′,i}) = J_κ(φ(F))_{i′,i}.

declarations.name: pairWeilFinite
declarations.says: The Weil representation of pairs (g,h) of finite-adelic unitary elements on the finite part 𝒲_f of the Schwartz–Bruhat space of Hom(V,T), restricted from the pair Weil representation with splitting characters a, b.

declarations.name: realPairWeil_schurCoeffPoly
declarations.says: For definite signs and κ with the lift-weight condition, the real (Fock) Weil representation of U(n)×U(n′) at (x,y) sends the Fock polynomial Aᵀ S_κ(z) ξ to the one with A replaced by A·ρ_κ,ea(y⁻¹) and ξ by ρ_κ,e(x)ξ.
declarations.note: Computation from the multiplicativity of Schur matrices (polynomial functor); content of the Kashiwara–Vergne description of joint harmonics, proved directly.

declarations.name: schurCoeffPoly
declarations.says: The bilinear map (A, ξ) ↦ Aᵀ S_κ(z) ξ with values in polynomials in the entries of the n′×n matrices z_τ (one per infinite place τ), S_κ the Schur matrix of the diagram κ.

declarations.name: schurJet_jetSeries_eq_smul
declarations.says: Homogeneity: for f ∈ 𝒮(Hom(I_n, I_n′)) the jet matrix along S_κ of the scaled Taylor series T_c f is c^L times that of T_1 f, L the number of boxes of κ in columns of height < |n′|.
declarations.note: S_κ is homogeneous of degree L.

declarations.name: thetaKernel
declarations.says: The theta kernel of the definite pair (I_n, I_n′): data 𝒲_f with the action of finite-adelic pairs, each f giving the matrix of jets of T_c f along S_κ; equivariance under rational points and openness of stabilisers are proved in the definition.
declarations.note: Definite (compact at infinity) unitary dual pair; c a scale.

entries.known_result: Part of: Schrödinger and mixed models of the Weil representation, action of parabolic subgroups (see Lib/Weil/MixedModel/ZeroTermLaw); this file: Schwartz–Bruhat functions above a set of places, coset indicators, the adelic Heisenberg datum as an orthogonal sum

declarations.name: IsSchwartzBruhat
declarations.says: A function Ψ on finite adelic n-vectors is Schwartz–Bruhat above a set S of places: it depends only on the components at S, is locally constant, and its support has S-parts in a compact set.

declarations.name: IsSchwartzBruhat.comp
declarations.says: If Ψ is Schwartz–Bruhat above S and A has a left inverse B, then y ↦ Ψ(Ay + y₀) is Schwartz–Bruhat above S.

declarations.name: IsSchwartzBruhat.eq_sum_cosetIndicator
declarations.says: If Ψ is Schwartz–Bruhat above S and invariant on its support under translations y with t⁻¹y integral at S, then Ψ is a finite sum Σ_q Ψ(q)·(indicator of q + t·(integral box)) with all Ψ(q) ≠ 0.

declarations.name: IsSchwartzBruhat.integrableOn
declarations.says: For F continuous and Ψ Schwartz–Bruhat above S, F·Ψ is integrable on the vectors integral outside S.

declarations.name: IsSchwartzBruhat.mem_of_cosets
declarations.says: A Schwartz–Bruhat Ψ lies in a subspace P if every y with Ψ(y) ≠ 0 has a neighbourhood U such that P contains all coset indicators (t integral idele) whose cosets have S-parts in U.

declarations.name: adelicSum
declarations.says: The isomorphism (y, z) ↦ κ·(y, z) from (complex coordinates at the infinite places) × (finite adelic vectors) onto 𝔸_E^n, under which the adelic bicharacter β is the product of the real and finite ones and the vacuum factorizes.
declarations.note: Bundles the verification that β and the vacua correspond (orthogonal sum of Heisenberg data).

declarations.name: boxIndicator
declarations.says: The indicator of the finite adelic n-vectors that are integral at every place of S.

declarations.name: cosetIndicator
declarations.says: The indicator of the finite adelic vectors x with t⁻¹(x − z) integral at every place of S.

declarations.name: detOn
declarations.says: The homomorphism GL_n(𝔸_f) → 𝔸^×, g ↦ the idele equal to det g at the places of S and 1 elsewhere.

declarations.name: idem_mul_star
declarations.says: For S disjoint from its conjugate, the idempotent adele 1_S times its conjugate is 0.

declarations.name: realSigns
declarations.says: The sign function on pairs (infinite place, coordinate) returning the sign of the coordinate.

entries.known_result: header: elementary bound n <= phi(n)(2 log n + 1); tube lemma; strong integrals of operator families; Ostrowski-Taussky determinant inequality; operator norm versus entries (textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: IsCompact.eventually_forall_mem
declarations.says: Tube lemma: for f jointly continuous on X x Y and K compact in Y, if W is a neighbourhood of f(x0, y) for every y in K, then f(x, y) lies in W for all y in K and all x near x0.

declarations.name: Subgroup.IsOpen
declarations.says: The subgroup U of the topological group G is an open subset.

declarations.name: l2_opNorm_le_of_apply
declarations.says: A complex m x n matrix with all entries of absolute value <= M has l2 operator norm <= m n M.

declarations.name: l2_opNorm_single
declarations.says: The l2 operator norm of c times a matrix unit E_ij is |c|.

declarations.name: le_totient_mul_log
declarations.says: For n >= 1: n <= phi(n)(2 log n + 1), phi Euler's totient function.

declarations.name: norm_apply_le_l2_opNorm
declarations.says: Each entry of a complex matrix is bounded in absolute value by its l2 operator norm.

declarations.name: ostrowski_taussky
declarations.says: Ostrowski-Taussky inequality, in the form used: if H is positive semidefinite and Theta + Theta* - H is positive semidefinite (n x n complex), then |det H| <= 2^n |det Theta|.
declarations.reference: A. Ostrowski, O. Taussky, On the variation of the determinant of a positive definite matrix, Indag. Math. 13 (1951)
declarations.relation: weaker form: follows from the Ostrowski-Taussky inequality |det Theta| >= det((Theta + Theta*)/2) for Theta with positive definite Hermitian part, together with monotonicity of det on positive semidefinite matrices ((Theta+Theta*)/2 >= H/2)

declarations.name: rep_apply_apply
declarations.says: For a monoid homomorphism rho from G to bounded operators: rho(g)(rho(h)v) = rho(gh)v.

declarations.name: strongIntegral
declarations.says: The strong integral of a family F of bounded operators: the bounded operator x -> integral of F(y)x dmu(y) when this map is bounded, an unspecified operator otherwise.

declarations.name: strongIntegral_apply
declarations.says: For Banach spaces X, Z and a family F of bounded operators with y -> F(y)x integrable for every x, the strong integral sends x to the integral of F(y)x.
declarations.note: Boundedness of x -> integral F(y)x by the closed graph theorem.

entries.known_result: header: general lemmas of group theory (textbook or folklore): central idempotents of complex group algebras, tensor products over finite products of groups

declarations.name: IsCentralProj
declarations.says: e is a central idempotent of the complex group algebra C[H]: e^2 = e and its coefficients form a class function.

declarations.name: IsCentralProj.map
declarations.says: Applying a ring endomorphism sigma of C to the coefficients of a central idempotent gives a central idempotent.

declarations.name: IsCentralProj.one_sub
declarations.says: If e is a central idempotent, so is 1 - e.

declarations.name: IsCentralProj.piTensorElem
declarations.says: If each x_i is a central idempotent of C[G_i], then the tensor product of the x_i is a central idempotent of C[prod_i G_i].

declarations.name: IsClassFunction.commute
declarations.says: An element of C[H] whose coefficients form a class function is central.

declarations.name: asAlgebraHom_eq_sum
declarations.says: For a representation sigma of a finite group H and e in C[H]: sigma(e) = sum_s e(s) sigma(s) (unfolding).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: asAlgebraHom_piTensorElem_mulSingle
declarations.says: For a representation rho of a finite product prod_j G_j and x in C[G_i], the pure tensor with x at i and 1 elsewhere acts as x acts in the restriction of rho to the factor G_i.

declarations.name: piTensorElem
declarations.says: The multiplicative map (x_i) -> tensor product of the x_i, from prod_i C[G_i] to C[prod_i G_i]; its coefficient at (s_i) is prod_i x_i(s_i).

declarations.name: piTensorElem_apply_eq_zero
declarations.says: If for some i the factor x_i kills v in the restriction of rho to G_i, then the tensor product of the x_j kills v.

declarations.name: piTensorElem_mul_eq_zero
declarations.says: If x_i y_i = 0 for some i, then (tensor of x)(tensor of y) = 0.

entries.known_result: header: products of principal minors, Fischer's inequality, maximal compact subgroup of U(p,q), polar decomposition, exponential onto K (the used declarations are basic matrix lemmas)

declarations.name: IsBorelMatrix.inv
declarations.says: The inverse of an invertible complex matrix that is block upper triangular for the order o is again such a matrix (the Borel-type subgroup is closed under inverse).

declarations.name: IsBorelMatrix.mul
declarations.says: Products of invertible matrices block upper triangular for o are again such matrices.

declarations.name: U.inv_mat
declarations.says: For g in the unitary group U(p,q) of the diagonal sign matrix ε: g⁻¹ = ε g* ε.

declarations.name: blockDiagAlg.inv_mem
declarations.says: The centraliser of ε in the complex matrices (block diagonal matrices for the signs ε) is closed under inversion.

declarations.name: blockDiagPart_eq
declarations.says: The block diagonal part of x for the signs ε equals (x + εxε)/2.

declarations.name: det_eq_prod_diag_of_blockTriangular
declarations.says: A matrix that is triangular for an injective ordering o of the indices has determinant equal to the product of its diagonal entries.

declarations.name: maxCompactU.coe_inv
declarations.says: For k in the maximal compact subgroup U(p) × U(q) = U(n) ∩ U(p,q): k⁻¹ = k*.

declarations.name: mem_blockDiagAlg
declarations.says: x commutes with ε if and only if x_{ij} = 0 whenever ε_i ≠ ε_j.

declarations.name: neg_sum_abs_le_and_le_sum_abs
declarations.says: For an integer vector w: −Σ_j |w_j| ≤ w_i ≤ Σ_j |w_j|.

declarations.name: weightMinors_eq_det_zpow_mul_prod
declarations.says: If det x ≠ 0 and a ≤ w_i ≤ b for all i, the product of principal minors of weight w is m_w(x) = (det x)^a ∏_{a<t≤b} Δ_t(x), Δ_t the principal minor on {i : w_i ≥ t}.
declarations.note: Reindexing of a finite product (definition of m_w is in Lib/DiscreteSeries).

entries.known_result: header: complex Gaussian integral; determinant monotone in the semidefinite order; matrix Bessel inequality; product measures under reindexing; uniqueness of Haar measure normalised by one integral

declarations.name: Matrix.IsAccretive
declarations.says: A complex square matrix A is accretive: its hermitian part is positive definite, A + A* > 0.

declarations.name: Matrix.IsAccretive.det_ne_zero
declarations.says: An accretive matrix is invertible.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_flip
declarations.says: Exchanging the two index sets, α^{ι×Y} → α^{Y×ι}, preserves the product measure.

declarations.name: measurePreserving_sigma
declarations.says: For a bijection e: ⊔_i n_i → Y, the regrouping α^Y → ∏_i α^{n_i}, x ↦ (x(e(i, j)))_{i,j}, preserves the product measures.

declarations.name: norm_det_le_norm_det_of_posSemidef
declarations.says: If 0 ≤ P ≤ Q in the semidefinite order then det P ≤ det Q.
declarations.reference: R. Horn, C. Johnson, Matrix Analysis
declarations.note: Proved here from the Ostrowski–Taussky inequality (Lib/General/Analysis/OstrowskiTaussky).

declarations.name: norm_det_sq_le_of_posSemidef
declarations.says: If the block matrix [[P, A], [B, Q]] (square blocks of equal size) is positive semidefinite, then |det A|² ≤ det P · det Q.
declarations.note: Called 'Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for determinants' in the source; proof via the Schur complement and monotonicity of det.

declarations.name: posSemidef_bessel
declarations.says: Matrix Bessel inequality: if ‖E‖_op ≤ 1 then X(1 − EE*)X* is positive semidefinite for every X.

declarations.name: realMeasure
declarations.says: Lebesgue measure on ℂ^ι divided by π^{|ι|} (so that ∫ exp(−|z|²) = 1).

declarations.name: star_dot_self_eq_norm_sq
declarations.says: x*·x = ‖x‖² (euclidean norm) for x ∈ ℂ^ι.

declarations.name: star_dot_self_eq_sum
declarations.says: x*·x = Σ_i |x_i|².

entries.known_result: header: part of Green's characters of GL_n(F_q) and the parabolic-induction ring (see LabelDegree); this file: class functions on similarity classes, parabolic induction product, Mackey formula.

declarations.name: Hall.add_apply
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Hall.evalGL
declarations.says: The value of a class function F (on similarity classes of endomorphisms over k) at an invertible matrix g ∈ GL_n(k).

declarations.name: Hall.ext
declarations.says: Two class functions agreeing on the classes of all endomorphisms of all kⁿ are equal.

declarations.name: Hall.neg_apply
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Hall.one_apply
declarations.says: The unit of the parabolic-induction ring is 1 on the class of dimension 0 and 0 elsewhere.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Hall.smul_apply
declarations.says: (aF)(c) = a·F(c).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: Hall.zero_apply
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: IsCentralProj.isChar
declarations.says: If e is a central self-adjoint idempotent of ℂ[G], G finite, then g ↦ |G|·e(g) is the character of a finite-dimensional representation.
declarations.reference: J.-P. Serre, Linear Representations of Finite Groups (1977)
declarations.note: Central idempotents are sums of the isotypic idempotents (χ(1)/|G|)Σ χ̄(g)g.

declarations.name: SimClass.charpoly
declarations.says: The characteristic polynomial of a similarity class of endomorphisms of kⁿ.

declarations.name: StableSubspace.comap
declarations.says: For a linear map p intertwining g and g', the preimage p⁻¹(W) of a g'-stable subspace W, as a g-stable subspace.

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Potentially crystalline representations, Hodge–Tate weights, Weil–Deligne Frobenius (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.Crystalline.RegularityFrobenius).

declarations.name: IsAdmissible.mono
declarations.says: Admissibility along a filter F implies admissibility along every finer filter F' ≤ F.

declarations.name: IsCrystalline.isPotCrys
declarations.says: Crystalline representations are potentially crystalline.

declarations.name: IsPotCrys.comp
declarations.says: If ρ is potentially crystalline for j: Γ → G_p and φ: Γ' → Γ is a homomorphism with j∘φ of open image, then ρ∘φ is potentially crystalline for j∘φ.

declarations.name: IsPotCrys.exists_hasJumps
declarations.says: Potentially crystalline representations are Hodge–Tate: for R algebraic over Z_p and T finite free over R and potentially crystalline, at each γ: R → C_p the jumps (with multiplicity) form a multiset of cardinality rk T.
declarations.reference: J.-M. Fontaine, Représentations p-adiques semi-stables, Astérisque 223 (1994), Exp. III; O. Brinon, B. Conrad, CMI notes on p-adic Hodge theory (2009)
declarations.relation: special case: potentially crystalline instead of de Rham (crystalline ⇒ de Rham ⇒ Hodge–Tate), stated as: the Hodge–Tate multiplicities at each embedding γ sum to the rank
declarations.note: header of RegularityFrobenius cites Fontaine Exp. III §1, §5 and Brinon–Conrad 2.3.1, 5.2.1, 6.3 (not checked)

declarations.name: Lift.baseChangePairing_map
declarations.says: Naturality of the base-changed bilinear pairing: for b: T × T' → T'' and maps f, f', f'' compatible with b and a multiplicative linear map ψ: A → A', base change along ψ commutes with the induced pairings A⊗T × A⊗T' → A⊗T''.

declarations.name: fixedPeriods.map
declarations.says: Functoriality of fixed periods: a G_p-equivariant period-ring map B → B_max and an equivariant map T → T' send elements of B ⊗ T fixed along F into those of B_max ⊗ T' fixed along F.

declarations.name: isAdmissible_comp_iff
declarations.says: For φ: Γ' → Γ and a filter F on Γ', admissibility of (j∘φ, ρ∘φ) along F is admissibility of (j, ρ) along the image filter φ(F).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: isAdmissible_of_cyclotomicGp_zpow
declarations.says: If Γ acts on T through a power χ^c of the cyclotomic character, T is admissible along every filter (Z_p(c) ⊗ R^n is crystalline).
declarations.note: uses t = log[ε] ∈ B_max invertible with g·t = χ(g)t

declarations.name: map_nearOne
declarations.says: If j is injective and φ: Γ' → Γ has j∘φ of open image, then φ maps the filter 'near 1' of Γ' (for j∘φ) onto that of Γ.

declarations.name: overZp
declarations.says: A representation of Γ on a module T over a Z_p-algebra R, regarded as a Z_p-linear representation (restriction of scalars).

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Potentially crystalline representations, Hodge–Tate weights, Weil–Deligne Frobenius (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.Crystalline.RegularityFrobenius).

declarations.name: IsPotCrys.sum_jump_eq_jump_overZp
declarations.says: For R a domain finite free over Z_p and T finite free over R and potentially crystalline: the jump multiplicities of T over Z_p are Σ_γ jump_γ(u); and weight-u maps f with f(ζt) = w f(t) span a C_p-space of dimension ≤ Σ_{γ(ζ) = w} jump_γ(u).
declarations.note: restriction of scalars: C_p ⊗_{Z_p} T = ⊕_γ C_p ⊗_{R,γ} T

declarations.name: card_algHom_eq_finrank
declarations.says: For a domain R finite free over Z_p, the number of Z_p-algebra maps R → C_p equals the rank of R.

declarations.name: crysCocycles.apply_mul
declarations.says: If T is free over Z_p, every c ∈ Z_f(T) is a 1-cocycle: c(gh) = c(g) + g·c(h).

declarations.name: crysCocycles.coboundary_mem
declarations.says: Coboundaries are crystalline: for x ∈ T the map g ↦ gx − x lies in Z_f(T).

declarations.name: crysCocycles.map
declarations.says: Functoriality: a Z_p-linear equivariant map f: T → T' sends Z_f(T) into Z_f(T') by c ↦ f∘c.

declarations.name: crysCocycles.of_smul
declarations.says: Saturation: if a ∈ Z_p is non-zero and a·c ∈ Z_f(T), then c ∈ Z_f(T).
declarations.note: p is invertible in B_max

declarations.name: exists_jump_of_jointly_injective
declarations.says: If T (finite free, R a domain algebraic over Z_p) has jointly injective equivariant maps to finitely many finite free potentially crystalline S_i, every jump of T at γ is a jump of some S_i at γ.
declarations.note: sub-objects of Hodge–Tate representations have weights among those of the ambient

declarations.name: hasJumps_of_cyclotomicGp_zpow
declarations.says: If Γ acts on T (finite free over R, R algebraic over Z_p) through χ^c, then the jumps of T at every γ are −c, repeated rk T times.
declarations.note: uses Tate's theorem C_p(n)^{G_K} = 0 for n ≠ 0

declarations.name: jump_baseChange
declarations.says: Extension of scalars: if f: T → T' is semilinear along φ: R → R', maps a basis to a basis and is equivariant near 1 (R' algebraic over Z_p), then jump_u of T' at γ' equals jump_u of T at γ'∘φ.

declarations.name: jump_eq_of_pairing
declarations.says: Duality: if T is potentially crystalline and T' ≅ Hom_R(T, R) with b(gx, gy) = χ(g)^c b(x, y), then the jump u of T' at γ has the multiplicity of the jump −u − c of T.
declarations.note: uses that T is Hodge–Tate (IsPotCrys.exists_hasJumps)

entries.known_result: header: Part of: Kisin lattice (Breuil–Kisin module) of a crystalline lattice (known result; see Lib.PadicHodge.WachKisin.PeriodMatrixFrame).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.frobE_zpow_mem_hodgeFil
declarations.says: For a ≥ 0 and m ∈ ℤ, the image of φ^a(E) under φ^(−a) followed by A_inf → B_dR, raised to the m-th power, lies in t^m B_dR^+ (E generates ker θ).

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil
declarations.says: The chart's Galois monoid preserves each step t^n B_dR^+ of the filtration.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.mem_valueField_of_fixed
declarations.says: An element of B_dR fixed by Γ' lies in B_dR^+ and in the field 𝒦_0.
declarations.note: from Tate's B_dR^{G_K'} = K' (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem)

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.mul_mem_hodgeFil_iff_of_not_frobE_dvd
declarations.says: If r ∈ A_inf is not divisible by φ^a(E), then φ^(−a)(r) is a unit of B_dR^+, so φ^(−a)(r)^m x ∈ t^n B_dR^+ iff x ∈ t^n B_dR^+.

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.phiInvToBdR_mem_valueField
declarations.says: φ^(−a)(s) lies in 𝒦_a for s ∈ S.
declarations.note: by definition of 𝒦_a

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.smul_sub_mem_hodgeFil_of_valueField
declarations.says: Let x ∈ B_dR^+ ∩ 𝒦_a and g, t_1, …, t_m in Γ'. If φ^a(E) divides (g − 1)Σ t_l s for all s ∈ S, then (g − 1)Σ t_l x ∈ tB_dR^+.
declarations.note: technical step in the authors' framework

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.sum_map_mem_of_valueField
declarations.says: For f: A_inf → S S-linear, r_l ∈ A_inf and v_l ∈ 𝒦_a (finitely many): every B_dR^+-submodule of B_dR containing Σ φ^(−a)(r_l) v_l also contains Σ φ^(−a)(f(r_l)) v_l.
declarations.note: rests on IsChartOf.dvd_extendToBPlus (S-linear maps of A_inf extend to B^+ and respect divisibility in B_dR^+)

declarations.name: Lift.KummerChart.valueField
declarations.says: 𝒦_a: the subfield of B_dR generated over the fixed field K' of Γ' by the images of the bicommutant S_B and of φ^(−a)(S).

declarations.name: Lift.phiInvToBdR
declarations.says: The ring homomorphism A_inf → B_dR given by φ^(−a) followed by the structure map.

entries.known_result: Part of: adelic Weil representation of a unitary group and the invariant theta functional (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/PairSplitting)

declarations.name: G.blockEmb
declarations.says: The block-diagonal embedding U(s₁)(𝔸) × U(s₂)(𝔸) → U(s)(𝔸) of adelic unitary groups of an orthogonal sum, after reindexing coordinates.

declarations.name: Space.IsStd
declarations.says: A hermitian space V is standard: all its signs are +1 and its adelic point x is the identity.

declarations.name: Space.boxProd
declarations.says: For an orthogonal splitting V = V₁ ⊕ V₂, the bounded bilinear map 𝒮(V₁)×𝒮(V₂) → 𝒮(V), c₁⊠c₂ = ∬ c₁(y₁)c₂(y₂) ϱ(y₁,0)ϱ(0,y₂)vac dy₁dy₂ (tensor product of Weil data), ϱ the Heisenberg operators.
declarations.note: 𝒮(V) is the artifact's space of data (Heisenberg-module completion), not literally Schwartz functions.

declarations.name: Space.boxProd_integrated
declarations.says: The box product of integrated data v₁⊗f₁ and v₂⊗f₂ is the integrated datum of the real box product v₁⊠v₂ and the finite box product f₁⊠f₂.

declarations.name: Space.jetSeries
declarations.says: Scaled Taylor series T_a f of the theta function of f: the coefficient of z^α is a^{|α|}/α! · θ(v_α ⊗ f), v_α the Fock vector of the monomial z^α, θ the theta functional.

declarations.name: Space.jet_jetSeries_eq_theta
declarations.says: The jet of T_a f along a polynomial P equals θ(v_{P(az)} ⊗ f).
declarations.note: Unfolding and linearity.

declarations.name: Space.rho_boxProd
declarations.says: Heisenberg operators act componentwise on box products: ϱ(x)(f₁⊠f₂) = ϱ(x₁)f₁ ⊠ ϱ(x₂)f₂ for x = (x₁, x₂).

declarations.name: boxes
declarations.says: The number Σ_τ Σ_{h<N} h·κ_τ(h) of boxes of the diagrams κ_τ in columns of height below N (κ_τ(h) = number of columns of height h).

declarations.name: realSigns_comp_split
declarations.says: The real signature data of an orthogonal sum is the concatenation of those of the summands.
declarations.note: Bookkeeping.

declarations.name: schurJet
declarations.says: The linear map sending a power series F in matrix variables z_τ to the matrix of its jets (Taylor coefficients) along the entries of the Schur matrix S_κ(z).

entries.known_result: Part of: theta kernels of unitary dual pairs: functoriality, seesaw, growth, rapid decay (stated in Lib/Weil/DualPair/KernelDecay); part of: Schrödinger and mixed models (Lib/Weil/MixedModel/ZeroTermLaw); part of: Fourier coefficients of theta lifts as periods over stabilisers (Lib/Shimura/ComplexTheta/PeriodVanishing)

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.HasIntegrableTerms
declarations.says: Absolute convergence of the unfolded theta integral: h ↦ Σ_x |θ((ω_{a,b}(g,h)f)[x_T⁻¹x])·y(h)|, summed over rational matrices x, has finite integral over [U(T)] (default y = 1).

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.IsAdapted.mixedModel
declarations.says: The mixed Schrödinger–Fock model of the real Weil representation attached to a splitting V = (isotropic ⊕ V₀ ⊕ dual) whose frames are orthonormal at infinity and integral.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.centreCoeff_eq_integral_stabilizer
declarations.says: Unfolding: for y continuous, left U(V)(E)-invariant with absolutely convergent unfolded integral, x₀ rational with invertible Gram matrix β and stabiliser S: the Fourier coefficient at ȷβ of the theta lift of y equals the integral over S\U(V)(𝔸) of the x₀-term times y.
declarations.note: Header: known result (Fourier coefficients of theta lifts as periods over stabilisers); standard unfolding using Witt's theorem (rational x with xᴴJx = β form one orbit).

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.centreCoeff_integral_eq_tsum
declarations.says: If the unfolded theta integral converges absolutely, the Fourier coefficient at ȷβ of the lift of y from U(V) to U(W) is Σ over rational x with xᴴJx = β of ∫ (x-term)·y over [U(V)].
declarations.note: Fourier expansion of the theta kernel in the mixed model and Fubini.

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.hasIntegrableTerms_integrated_name
declarations.says: For split S, P ∩ P̄ = ∅, Ψ Schwartz–Bruhat above P supported on maps of full rank (after a ring map φ: 𝔸_f → R ≠ 0), v with all moments finite: the datum v⊗Ψ⊗vac has absolutely convergent unfolded theta integral over [U(T)].
declarations.note: Consequence of the decay estimate of KernelDecay (data supported on full-rank maps at split places).

declarations.name: Space.Splitting.thetaTerm
declarations.says: For split S and a rational matrix x, the x-term θ((ω_{a,b}(g,h)f)[x_T⁻¹x]) of the theta kernel in the mixed model along the isotropic subspace (x_T the frame of T).

declarations.name: eq_of_integrated_zeroTerm_eq
declarations.says: If v ⊗ (zero term of f°) = u ⊗ (zero term of f°) for all data f (f° the real vacuum projection), then v = u.

declarations.name: mixedTerm_integrated
declarations.says: In an adapted splitting, the mixed-model term at x of v ⊗ f is (slice of v at the real coordinates of x) ⊗ (mixed term of the real vacuum projection f° at the finite part of x).

declarations.name: vacuumFactor
declarations.says: For an adapted splitting, the non-zero constant c with: the mixed model sends the vacuum to c times a Gaussian factor times the vacuum of the smaller space.

declarations.name: zeroTerm_integrated
declarations.says: For a splitting adapted at the point 1, the zero term of v ⊗ f is v[0] ⊗ (zero term of f°), v[0] the slice at 0 in the real mixed model.

entries.known_result: Part of: joint harmonics and global theta lifts between discrete series types (known result stated in Lib/Weil/Lift/Edge); this file: arrows (theta data carrying forms of one type to forms of another), lift and descent

declarations.name: IsArrow
declarations.says: For a theta kernel K between unitary spaces S and T, a datum φ is an arrow e → e′ if every form of type e on S is rapidly decreasing and its theta lift by φ is a form of type e′ on T.
declarations.note: Authors' vocabulary; a type e is a discrete-series type given by an integrable projector kernel.

declarations.name: IsArrow.coe_formLift
declarations.says: For an arrow φ, the chosen bilinear lift L_φ y equals the theta lift of y as a function.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: IsArrow.eq_formLift_of_coe_eq
declarations.says: A form z on T whose underlying function is the theta lift of y by φ′ equals L_{φ′} y.
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: IsArrow.formRep_formLift
declarations.says: Equivariance: for k, k′ in the finite adelic groups of S, T, the right translate by k′ of L_φ y equals L_{ω(k,k′)φ} applied to the right translate of y by k.
declarations.note: Change of variables in the theta integral.

declarations.name: IsArrow.formRep_formLift_of_eq_smul
declarations.says: If ω(k,k′)φ = c·φ′, then the k′-translate of L_φ y is c·L_{φ′}(k-translate of y).

declarations.name: IsArrow.inner_formLift_adjoint
declarations.says: If φ is an arrow e → e′ and, for the swapped pair, an arrow between the conjugate types, then ⟨L_φ y, x⟩ = ⟨y, conj(D_φ conj x)⟩: the adjoint of the theta lift is the conjugate of the descent.
declarations.note: Fubini (seesaw-type adjointness), justified by rapid decay.

declarations.name: IsArrow.integral_mul_formLift_swap
declarations.says: Lift and descent are transposes: ∫_{[T]} z·L_φ y = ∫_{[S]} y·D_φ z for forms y of type e and z of type ε′.
declarations.note: Fubini on [S]×[T], justified by rapid decay.

declarations.name: IsEdge.isArrow
declarations.says: If Φ is an edge e → e′ for the real Weil representation of weights γ, γ′, and a, b are automorphic characters of these weights, then Φ⊗f (f in the finite part) is an arrow e → e′ for ω_{a,b}, and for the swapped pair an arrow ē′ → ē.
declarations.note: Docstring tags it with the known result of Lib/Weil/Lift/Edge, but the proof only unpacks the edge property (which already contains the global lifting statement) using the existence of a level; the content is isEdge_of_isJointHarmonic.

declarations.name: conjForm
declarations.says: Complex conjugation F ↦ F̄ as a conjugate-linear map from forms of type e to forms of the conjugate type.

declarations.name: formLift
declarations.says: A chosen bilinear map (φ, y) ↦ L_φ y into forms of type e′ on T, equal to the theta lift of y by φ whenever y is rapid and its lift is such a form.

entries.known_result: header: part of Galois representations attached to forms on definite unitary groups (see AvatarCompatibility).

declarations.name: GalRep
declarations.says: An ℓ-adic Galois representation: a homomorphism Gal(Ω/E) → GL_m(ℚ̄_ℓ) (continuity not included).

declarations.name: HasJumpsAt
declarations.says: For every embedding inducing the place A above ℓ and every compatible τ: E → ℚ̄_ℓ, the Hodge–Tate jumps (weights) of r with multiplicity are J(τ).

declarations.name: IsFiniteTypeAt
declarations.says: r has finite type at A: trivial on inertia elements near 1 if ℓ is a unit at A, and potentially crystalline along every embedding into ℚ̄_ℓ inducing A.

declarations.name: IsGoodAt
declarations.says: r is good at A: unramified (trivial on inertia) if ℓ is a unit at A, and crystalline along every embedding into ℚ̄_ℓ inducing A.

declarations.name: PadicPlaceEmbedding
declarations.says: An embedding Ω → ℚ̄_ℓ inducing the place A, with the compatible open embedding of the decomposition group of A into Gal(ℚ̄_ℓ/ℚ_ℓ).

declarations.name: PadicPlaceEmbedding.cyclotomicGp_eq_cycChar
declarations.says: The ℓ-adic cyclotomic character of Gal(ℚ̄_ℓ/ℚ_ℓ) restricted along the embedding equals the global cyclotomic character on the decomposition group.

declarations.name: PadicPlaceEmbedding.isWeilPair_zero_iff
declarations.says: (s,0) is a Weil pair (s in the Weil group with degree 0) iff s lies in the inertia group at A.

declarations.name: PolyKillsAt
declarations.says: P kills s at A: P(r(s)) = 0 if ℓ is a unit at A, and, along every ℓ-adic embedding, P kills the Weil pair (s,k) in the Weil–Deligne sense (IsKilledBy).

declarations.name: decompRep
declarations.says: The restriction of r to the decomposition group of A, acting on column vectors over ℚ̄_ℓ.

entries.known_result: header: differents and root discriminants; ramified ideals divide the different; one-dimensional Sobolev trace inequality iterated at a cube corner (textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: abs_discr_eq_rootDiscr_pow
declarations.says: For a totally complex number field K: |disc K| = (rd_K^{r})^2 = rd_K^{[K:Q]}, rd_K the root discriminant and r the number of infinite places.

declarations.name: differentIdeal_eq_span_of_dvd
declarations.says: L/K number fields, A a Dedekind domain with fraction field K, x in O_L with K(x) = L, f in A[X] with f(x) = 0, y = f'(x). If (y) divides the different of O_L over A, then the different equals (y) and A[x] = O_L.
declarations.reference: conductor-different formula f * D = (g'(x)), e.g. J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, ch. III
declarations.note: One direction of the criterion O_L = A[x] iff D = (g'(x)), allowing any f vanishing at x.

declarations.name: dvd_differentIdeal_of_mem_sq
declarations.says: Dedekind's different theorem (ramified primes divide the different), in the form: a prime P of O_L whose square contains a rational prime p divides the different of L over Q.
declarations.reference: J. Neukirch, Algebraic Number Theory (1999), ch. III, section 2
declarations.relation: special case: only 'P ramified (e >= 2) implies P | D_{L/Q}', from P^{e-1} | D; not the converse nor the exact exponent

declarations.name: finrank_eq_two_mul_card_infinitePlace
declarations.says: A totally complex number field has degree over Q twice its number of infinite places.

declarations.name: ne_zero_of_differentIdeal_eq_span
declarations.says: If x generates the different of O_L over Z, then x != 0.

declarations.name: numInfPlaces
declarations.says: The number of infinite places of the number field K.

declarations.name: rootDiscr_pos
declarations.says: The root discriminant rd_K = |disc K|^{1/[K:Q]} is positive.

declarations.name: sobolev_chain
declarations.says: Measurable f_i(x, omega), i words in a finite alphabet L, with |d_d f_i| <= Lambda sum_l |f_{l i}| on the cube [0, eps]^D (0 < eps <= 1) a.e. in omega: if the L2 norms over cube x omega of the f_i with |i| <= |D| are <= K, then integral of |f_empty(0, omega)|^2 <= (2(1 + (|L| Lambda)^2)/eps)^{|D|} K.
declarations.note: One-dimensional Sobolev trace inequality |g(0)|^2 <= (2/eps) int |g|^2 + 2 eps int |g'|^2, iterated once per coordinate; proof is routine but several lines.

declarations.name: zpow_sum_of_ne_zero
declarations.says: For s != 0 in a field: s^{sum_i f(i)} = prod_i s^{f(i)} (integer exponents).

entries.known_result: header: Picard group, pull-back, fpqc descent of sections and frames; projective space over Z, O(1), linear systems, maps to projective space, projective embeddings (textbook or folklore)

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsFrame.inv
declarations.says: If u is a frame (nowhere vanishing global section) of the line bundle L, then u^-1 is a frame of the dual L^-1.
declarations.note: Line bundles are given by an open cover with transition functions g_ij on ring-valued points (Cech cocycle presentation).

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsFrame.mul
declarations.says: If u is a frame of L and v a frame of M, then (u_i v_j) is a frame of L (x) M.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsHomogCoords.map
declarations.says: For a linear system L, if v gives homogeneous coordinates of the A-valued point t with v_i a unit, then phi o v gives homogeneous coordinates of t o Spec(phi) for every ring map phi: A -> R.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsHomogCoords.mul
declarations.says: Segre: if v gives homogeneous coordinates of t for L and w for N, then (v_i w_j) gives homogeneous coordinates of t for L (x) N.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsHomogCoords.ne_zero
declarations.says: Over a local ring, some homogeneous coordinate of a point is nonzero.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsHomogCoords.smul
declarations.says: Homogeneous coordinates may be scaled by a unit u of A.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsIsomorphic.mul
declarations.says: If L is isomorphic to M and N to P, then L (x) N is isomorphic to M (x) P (isomorphic: L (x) M^-1 has a frame).

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsIsomorphic.refl
declarations.says: Every line bundle is isomorphic to itself.

declarations.name: LineBundle.IsLinearSystem.mul
declarations.says: The tensor product of two linear systems is a linear system (the Segre product).
declarations.note: Linear system: transition functions g_ij regular on U_i, zero off U_i, and (g_ij)_j homogeneous coordinates of points in U_i (a map to projective space).

entries.known_result: header: definitions for Green's characters of GL_n(k) (τ_P, Ξ_c, labels, χ∘det, the reflection sum, the idempotents e_c) and general lemmas on Frobenius orbits of roots (textbook or folklore).

declarations.name: IsFaithfulMulChar
declarations.says: K algebraically closed with an injective multiplicative character T: K^× → ℂ^× (used to name characters of finite fields by elements).

declarations.name: IsLabel
declarations.says: c is a label of degree r: a monic squarefree polynomial over k of degree r with nonzero constant term.

declarations.name: exists_pow_card_pow_eq_of_root
declarations.says: Any two roots x, y of an irreducible P over a finite field k are Frobenius conjugates: y = x^{|k|^i} for some i < deg P.

declarations.name: faithfulChar
declarations.says: A chosen injective multiplicative character from the algebraic closure of k to ℂ.

declarations.name: labelIdem
declarations.says: The element e_c = Σ_g (Ξ_c(1)/|G|)·conj Ξ_c(g)·g of ℂ[G], G = GL_n(k), Ξ_c Green's character of the label c (formed with the chosen faithful character), if c is a label of degree n; 0 otherwise.

declarations.name: monicsOfDegree
declarations.says: The finite set of monic polynomials of degree r over the finite field k.

declarations.name: pow_pred_eq_one_iff
declarations.says: For Q ≥ 2: x^{Q−1} = 1 iff x ≠ 0 and x^Q = x.

declarations.name: reflectionSum
declarations.says: The element Σ χ(det h)⁻¹·h of ℂ[GL_n(k)] over the invertible h of the form 1 + u·lᵀ (u a column vector, l fixed).

declarations.name: root_pow_card_pow_eq_self_iff
declarations.says: For a root x of an irreducible P over k: x^{|k|^n} = x iff deg P divides n.

entries.known_result: header: part of Taylor–Wiles freeness at auxiliary primes (see AuxPlaceOperators).

declarations.name: BaseLevel.diagOp
declarations.says: For t: systems → ℚ̄_ℓ, the endomorphism of the space of forms acting on the isotypic space of each Hecke eigensystem x by the scalar ι⁻¹(t(x)).

declarations.name: BaseLevel.diagOp_apply
declarations.says: On a form of system x, the diagonal operator acts by ι⁻¹(t(x)).
declarations.note: unfolding

declarations.name: BaseLevel.eventually_isOffLevel
declarations.says: For a finite family of levels L, all but finitely many places w are off-level: w, w̄ ∉ S, w ∤ ℓ, and if w splits each isotypic form of level L is spherical at w with the chosen eigenvalues.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.formEnd_ext
declarations.says: Two endomorphisms of the forms of level L agreeing on every eigensystem's isotypic part are equal.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.formsOfLevel_le_levelSpace
declarations.says: Forms of level L are fixed by the integral points trivial at the places of L and S.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.formsOfLevel_le_of_eigensystem
declarations.says: The forms of level L are spanned by their eigenforms: a subspace containing the intersection with every isotypic space contains them all.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.heckeAction
declarations.says: The O-algebra homomorphism from the Hecke algebra to lattice-preserving operators: t acts on forms of system x by ι⁻¹(t(x)).

declarations.name: BaseLevel.heckeAlgebra
declarations.says: The Hecke algebra 𝕋: functions t on Hecke eigensystems with values in ℚ̄_ℓ whose diagonal action keeps the integral forms of level L integral.

declarations.name: BaseLevel.systemAction
declarations.says: The O-algebra map sending t: systems → ℚ̄_ℓ to the operator multiplying forms of system x by ι⁻¹(t(x)).

entries.known_result: header: part of complex uniformisation of PEL abelian varieties; Appell–Humbert; finite class number (see Lib.Shimura.Uniformisation.AppellHumbert)

declarations.name: IsAppellHumbert.add
declarations.says: Appell–Humbert data add: if (B, χ) and (B', χ') are Appell–Humbert data on V/L, so is (B + B', χχ').

declarations.name: IsAppellHumbert.ne_zero
declarations.says: The semicharacter χ of Appell–Humbert data does not vanish on L (|χ| = 1).

declarations.name: IsAppellHumbert.neg
declarations.says: If (B, χ) are Appell–Humbert data, so are (−B, χ⁻¹).

declarations.name: RealComplexForm.pullForm
declarations.says: The pull-back (u, v) ↦ B(φu, φv) of the form B along a complex-linear map φ: V' → V.

declarations.name: abbrev
declarations.says: The class abbreviation IsFullRankLattice (named 'abbrev' by the census): L ⊂ V is discrete and a ℤ-lattice of full rank.
declarations.note: Census artifact: 'class abbrev IsFullRankLattice' parsed with the name 'abbrev'; New never mentions IsFullRankLattice, so the syntactic use is probably the keyword.

declarations.name: riemannForm_pullForm
declarations.says: The Riemann form of the pulled-back form is the pull-back of the Riemann form: E_{φ*B}(u, v) = E_B(φu, φv).
declarations.note: Unfolding.

declarations.name: thetaShift_of_mem
declarations.says: For a theta function f of type (B, χ) and l ∈ L, the twisted translate of f by l is χ(l)f.
declarations.note: Definition of the theta space.

declarations.name: thetaSpace.mul
declarations.says: The product of theta functions of types (B, χ) and (B', χ') has type (B + B', χχ').

declarations.name: thetaSpace.pow
declarations.says: The n-th power of a theta function of type (B, χ) has type (nB, χⁿ).
